title: Shape of My Own Life
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You text the list before the day begins
I shift my plans and tuck my own desires in
You need it now, so I arrive on cue
One small mistake, and all you see is what I missed for you

[Pre-Chorus]
I know your coffee, know your careful signs
But who am I beneath these borrowed times?

[Chorus]
I want to run at my full speed
No more trimming down the life I need
I gave you every spare hour I could find
You count the one thing wrong, leave all the rest behind
I want to run, I want to run
And find the shape of my own life begun

[Verse 2]
I set aside the work that called my name
You take it as a promise, never ask what that became
Then comes the quiet score of what I did not do
As if the weight I carried never counted next to you

[Bridge]
Let me miss a turn, let me choose a road
Let my hands be mine to hold

[Final Chorus]
I want to run at my full speed
No more trimming down the life I need
I gave you every spare hour I could find
You count the one thing wrong, leave all the rest behind
I want to run, I want to run
And find the shape of my own life begun

title: Leave the Door Unclosed
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You left your coat beside the door
I found it folded, nothing more
The words we threw still had their sting
But morning made room for something kind

[Pre-Chorus]
One honest breath, one open hand
A softer place to take our stand

[Chorus]
Forgive, and let the good begin
Make a little room for someone in
We mend the hurt, we change the way
A kinder world starts here today
Forgive, and leave the door unclosed
Give grace the chance to take root and grow

[Verse 2]
The neighbor held my grocery bag
We laughed about the torn-up tag
A small repair, a simple deed
Can be the kindness someone needs

[Bridge]
Not saying hurt was never real
Just choosing what we help to heal

[Final Chorus]
Forgive, and let the good begin
Make a little room for someone in
We mend the hurt, we change the way
A kinder world starts here today
Forgive, and leave the door unclosed
Give grace the chance to take root and grow
[Outro]
A kinder world starts here

title: Be Kind Because You Want To
lyrics:
[Verse]
You held the door when my hands were full
No grand design, just a simple pull
You let me finish, though we disagreed
Made room for more than your own belief

[Pre-Chorus]
No gold star, no rule to obey
Just seeing how a little care can change a day

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to
Make somebody’s hard day lighter
Give a little, leave some room
Help a heart come back to bloom
Not for praise or getting through
Be kind because you want to

[Verse]
You split your orange on the bus
Saved me a seat without a fuss
You met my worry with a patient smile
And somehow made the road feel mild

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to
Make somebody’s hard day lighter
Give a little, leave some room
Help a heart come back to bloom
Not for praise or getting through
Be kind because you want to

[Outro]
A little care can carry through
Be kind because you want to

title: Leave the Porch Light On
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You missed the turn; I’ll walk with you
No score to keep, no debt to prove
A little room, a softer word
Can change the shape of someone’s world

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to be
Make space for who you haven’t seen
Give more than you were asked to give
So someone else can breathe and live

[Verse 2]
You carry storms I cannot know
I’ll leave the porch light on awhile
No rule can make a heart feel safe
That comes from how we meet a face

[Breakdown]
Not for praise
Not for pay
Just because
You can make today less hard

[Final Chorus]
Be kind because you want to be
Make space for who you haven’t seen
Give more than you were asked to give
So someone else can breathe and live
And leave the world a little more
Like somewhere we can all feel whole

title: Be Kind Because
lyrics:
[Verse]
You drop the last orange in my hand
Though you were saving it for the ride
No one asked, no promise made
You saw my tired face and changed the day

[Pre-Chorus]
It’s not a rule, it’s not a debt
Just a little room we haven’t made yet

[Chorus]
Be kind because it helps us breathe
Give a little, let a little leave
Make the hard day softer for somebody
Not for a prize, not to be seen
Just because you know what hurt can mean
And you want the world to feel less heavy

[Bridge]
You don’t have to fix it all
Just sit beside me when I fall

[Final Chorus]
Be kind because it helps us breathe
Give a little, let a little leave
Make the hard day softer for somebody
Not for a prize, not to be seen
Just because you know what hurt can mean
And you want the world to feel less heavy

title: Better Than You Found Them
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held the door when both our hands were full,
No rulebook there, no promise to repay.
You saw me dragging through a crowded morning,
And made a little room to change my day.

[Pre-Chorus]
Not for praise, not to be right,
Just because you saw me there.

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to,
Give because you can,
Make the world a softer place
By reaching out a hand.
No gold star, no reason due—
Just leave folks better than you found them.

[Verse 2]
Let someone finish, even when you disagree,
Pass the last peach, ask what they need.
A small bit of patience can loosen a hard day;
A little more room lets a heart find its way.

[Breakdown]
Not because you're told.
Not because it's owed.

[Final Chorus]
Be kind because you want to,
Give because you can,
Make the world a softer place
By reaching out a hand.
No gold star, no reason due—
Just leave folks better than you found them.
Better than you found them.

title: The Better World Begins
lyrics:
[Verse]
You dropped your papers in the rain
I held the door; you laughed again
No points to earn, no prize to claim
Just one less hard thing in your day

[Pre-Chorus]
We all arrive with something bruised
A little room can change the view

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to be
Make space for you, make space for me
Give what you can, let someone breathe
The better world begins with what we choose

[Breakdown]
Not by order
Not for show
Just because
You can help someone grow

[Final Chorus]
Be kind because you want to be
Make space for you, make space for me
Give what you can, let someone breathe
The better world begins with what we choose

title: Make It Easier Tonight
lyrics:
[Verse]
You dropped your orange in the rain
I shared my sleeve; we laughed again
No golden rule, no watchful eye
Just room enough to let you try

[Pre-Chorus]
A softer word can change the day
A little space can make a way

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to be
Give what you can, not what you owe
Make someone’s heavy moment lighter
Help them find their own way home
No rule can make a heart do better
We choose the care we give away

[Verse]
You missed the bus; I missed it too
We took the long road, me and you
No tally kept, no debt to pay
Just one more hand along the way

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to be
Give what you can, not what you owe
Make someone’s heavy moment lighter
Help them find their own way home
No rule can make a heart do better
We choose the care we give away

[Outro]
Not for praise, not to be right
Just make it easier tonight

title: Just A Heart That Knows
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You dropped your oranges, I caught one by the door
We laughed at how it rolled beneath the chair
No one was keeping score, no one asked for more
I just had two hands, and you were there

[Pre-Chorus]
A little room to breathe
A little time to hear
The world gets softer when we meet it here

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to
Give what you can spare
Make a little better day
For someone standing there
No golden rule above us
No points to earn or prove
Just a heart that knows another heart
Can use a little room

[Verse 2]
You said the wrong thing; I let the moment pass
We found a truer way to say it slow
A cup of tea, a seat, a chance to start again
Small things can help a good thing grow

[Pre-Chorus]
A little room to breathe
A little time to hear
The world gets softer when we meet it here

[Chorus]
Be kind because you want to
Give what you can spare
Make a little better day
For someone standing there
No golden rule above us
No points to earn or prove
Just a heart that knows another heart
Can use a little room

[Outro]
Not for praise, not to be right
Just because it feels right
Leave you lighter than before
That’s what open hands are for

title: I Choose Myself
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept your name in a paper drawer
With all the keys to a vanished door
And all the almosts I couldn’t keep
Still pace the hallways inside my sleep

[Pre-Chorus]
But I can’t live where the maybes stay
I turn the latch, I let them fade

[Chorus]
Goodbye, loves I held too late
Goodbye, hearts I couldn’t make
You can’t walk this road for me
I’ll carry what was kind and leave
Goodbye, ghosts beside the way
I choose myself; I’m here today

[Verse 2]
To the ones who never knew my name
To the almost-summers, the unsent flame
I bless the lives we didn’t begin
Then take my hand and gather me in

[Bridge]
I was waiting to be chosen
Now I’m learning how to stay

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye, loves I held too late
Goodbye, hearts I couldn’t make
You can’t walk this road for me
I’ll carry what was kind and leave
Goodbye, ghosts beside the way
I choose myself; I’m here today

[Outro]
I choose myself
I’m here today

title: Come Back to My Own
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept your coats in the back of my mind,
Names on the tongue that I swallowed in time.
Some were a home I was never let in,
Some were a door that I closed from within.

[Pre-Chorus]
I can't keep asking the gone to decide
If I deserve to keep walking my life.

[Chorus]
Goodbye to the almost, goodbye to the then,
Goodbye to the faces I carried like friends.
You were a chapter; I’m letting it close.
I turn to the road, I come back to my own.

[Verse 2]
I bless what we were, and the love left unsaid,
The small, tender futures that bloomed in my head.
No ghost gets to steer me, no past gets the key;
I’m learning to hold the one living with me.

[Chorus]
Goodbye to the almost, goodbye to the then,
Goodbye to the faces I carried like friends.
You were a chapter; I’m letting it close.
I turn to the road, I come back to my own.

[Outro]
I turn to the road.
I come back to my own.

title: Make Room for Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your old coat hangs behind the door
Like someone just stepped out once more
I kept the names I couldn't say
In rooms I pass on my way

[Pre-Chorus]
But I can't keep a place for every almost
Or let yesterday decide where I go

[Chorus]
Goodbye to the loves I held too late
Goodbye to the ones I never got to know
You can rest now, I can turn the page
I have a road, and I can walk it on my own
I make room in my heart for me
I make room in my heart for me

[Verse 2]
Some were only letters in my head
Some were tender words I never said
I bless the lives we didn't share
Then loosen every thread with care

[Bridge]
I don't have to earn my own embrace
I can meet myself and stay

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye to the loves I held too late
Goodbye to the ones I never got to know
You can rest now, I can turn the page
I have a road, and I can walk it on my own
I make room in my heart for me
I make room in my heart for me

[Outro]
You can rest now
I can walk on

title: Choosing Myself
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept your coat on the back of the chair,
Though winter moved on and you weren’t there.
And all of the almosts I carried like names
Still tug at my sleeve when I step from the frame.

[Pre-Chorus]
You were a door I could not walk through;
I bless the closed room, I’m leaving it too.

[Chorus]
Goodbye, my loves, the ones I knew,
Goodbye to the lives that never came true.
You can’t walk this road in my place,
I’ll take my own hand, I’ll give myself grace.
Goodbye, goodbye—let the old ache rest;
I’m turning toward home, I’m choosing myself.

[Verse 2]
Some ghosts wore your face, some wore no face at all,
Just a song in my chest and a missed phone call.
I don’t have to hate you to loosen the thread;
I can love what was, then move on ahead.

[Chorus]
Goodbye, my loves, the ones I knew,
Goodbye to the lives that never came true.
You can’t walk this road in my place,
I’ll take my own hand, I’ll give myself grace.
Goodbye, goodbye—let the old ache rest;
I’m turning toward home, I’m choosing myself.

[Outro]
I’m turning toward home.
I’m choosing myself.

title: Coming Home to Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept your coat in the hall too long,
A sleeve full of weather, a pocket of songs.
You were a maybe I carried like glass,
A door I stood near while the seasons went past.

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every old name loosens its hold,
I can bless what was, let the unopened unfold.

[Chorus]
Goodbye, goodbye, to the loves I knew,
To the almosts I never got to walk through.
You can rest where the road bends blue—
I’m coming home, I’m coming home to me.

[Verse 2]
I don’t owe the silence another reply,
I can leave the unsent letters dry.
Your memory’s a hand, but I’m learning to choose
The feet that keep moving, the heart I can use.

[Bridge]
No more asking the past for a key;
I open the door with the love I give me.

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye, goodbye, to the loves I knew,
To the almosts I never got to walk through.
You can rest where the road bends blue—
I’m coming home, I’m coming home to me.
[Outro]
Coming home to me.

title: Ghosts I Couldn't Keep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Old names gather at the gate
Like moths around a porch light
Some I held and let go late
Some never crossed into my life

[Pre-Chorus]
You were almost, you were then
You were letters never sent
I can hear you call me back
But the road runs past the bend

[Chorus]
Goodbye, goodbye, ghosts I couldn’t keep
I’m done asking shadows not to leave
All the love I lost, the love that never grew
I lay it down and let the morning through
Goodbye, goodbye—I’m walking on
I can be the place I’m coming home to

[Verse 2]
Empty chairs still know your shape
A whole life lived in maybe
I won’t make a shrine of what escaped
Or blame the child I used to be

[Bridge]
Let the locked doors stay behind me
Let the almosts lose their names
There is kindness here to find me
There is one heart I can save

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye, goodbye, ghosts I couldn’t keep
I’m done asking shadows not to leave
All the love I lost, the love that never grew
I lay it down and let the morning through
Goodbye, goodbye—I’m walking on
I can be the place I’m coming home to

title: I Choose My Own Heart
lyrics:
[Verse]
I kept your names in a drawer by the door,
Old paper moons I don't carry no more.
The almost-loves wait where the cold hallway bends,
Still asking me where the beginning ends.

[Pre-Chorus]
I can thank every face,
Then loosen my hands.

[Chorus]
Goodbye, my almost, goodbye, my then,
I won't keep a room for what might have been.
The road is mine, and I’m learning to stay;
I choose my own heart, and I walk away.

[Outro]
I choose my own heart.
I walk away.

title: Ghosts on My Sleeve
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Glitchy echoes, warm synth swells, stuttering bass cut)
Ghosts in the hallway, shadows on the wall
The ones I loved, the ones I never got to love at all

[Verse 1]
Fading photographs, promises unkept
Tears in the memory of the secrets that we kept
Unwritten letters floating in the breeze
You don't hold me back no more, set my spirit free

[Chorus]
Goodbye to the ghosts hanging on my sleeve
Goodbye to the phantoms I used to believe
Walking down my own path, step by syncopated beat
Finding love inside myself, standing on my own feet

[Verse 2]
Every missed chance, every what-could-have-been
Was just a chapter ending so a new life could begin
I release the quiet heartache, let the echoes fade away
Light is breaking through the dark, turning into day

[Chorus]
Goodbye to the ghosts hanging on my sleeve
Goodbye to the phantoms I used to believe
Walking down my own path, step by syncopated beat
Finding love inside myself, standing on my own feet

[Outro]
No more looking back now
Just the open sky ahead
Love for who I am today
Living for the path I tread
(Glitch fade out, soft warm bass resonance)

title: Ghosts of Mine
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept your coat on the back of the chair
Though you were a maybe, a room full of air
Old almost-loves with their hands on the gate
I thank you for leaving; I’m done being late

[Pre-Chorus]
You can’t walk beside me
If I keep you in chains
I can miss what we might’ve been
And still turn the page

[Chorus]
Goodbye, goodbye, dear ghosts of mine
You were a season, not a sign
I bless the roads we didn’t choose
I’m learning how to be my own home
Goodbye, goodbye, I’m letting go
The path is mine; I’ll take it slow

[Verse 2]
To the love I never had time to begin
I’m sorry I made you a place to live in
No debt to repay, no door left ajar
I can carry the lesson, not carry the scar

[Bridge]
My own name sounds kinder tonight
I don’t need your shadow to know I’m alive

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye, goodbye, dear ghosts of mine
You were a season, not a sign
I bless the roads we didn’t choose
I’m learning how to be my own home

[Outro]
My own home
I’m walking on

title: I Belong to Me
lyrics:
[Verse]
Old names pace the hallway in their borrowed coats
Almost-loves, unopened letters, boats that never float
I hear them at the doorway saying, “Stay awhile”
But I have miles to walk before I learn my own smile

[Chorus]
Goodbye, goodbye, you can’t choose my way
I bless what we were, then I turn the page
All the hands I couldn’t hold, I set them free
The road is mine, and I belong to me

[Breakdown]
I’m not the room where every ghost remains
I can grieve the almost, without wearing chains

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye, goodbye, I can face the day
I keep what was kind; let the rest drift away
No borrowed heart will tell me who to be
The road is mine, and I belong to me

title: Goodbye, My Ghosts
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept your old hello folded in a drawer
And all the almosts waiting by the door
You never held my hand, but I held the ache
Like a promise I was scared to break

[Pre-Chorus]
I turn around; you’re fading in the glass
I bless the roads that couldn’t last

[Chorus]
Goodbye, my ghosts, I’m letting go
You were a maybe, not my home
I’ll take this road with open hands
And learn to love the one who stands
Here in the morning, here at last
I’m not a prisoner of the past

[Verse 2]
To every love I couldn’t meet in time
I leave your name outside this life of mine
No more rehearsing what we might have been
I make a little room to let me in

[Half-Time Bridge]
I can miss you and move on
Both can live beneath one dawn

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye, my ghosts, I’m letting go
You were a maybe, not my home
I take this road with open hands
And choose to love the one who stands
Here in the morning, here at last
I’m free to walk beyond the past

title: Goodbye to the Almost
lyrics:
[Verse]
I kept your names in the coat by the door,
Old paper tickets, a key that fits nothing.
Some of you left; some were never mine,
Still I saved a place at the table for all of you.

[Chorus]
Goodbye to the almost, goodbye to the gone,
You can’t take my next step by holding my arm.
I’ll carry the lesson, release the claim;
I am still here, and I can choose my name.

[Breakdown]
For the love I imagined,
For the love that ran dry,
I lay down the weight now.
I let myself stay.

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye to the almost, goodbye to the gone,
The road is still mine when I’m walking alone.
I bless what I wanted, forgive what I couldn’t save;
I’m learning to give myself the love I gave away.

title: Goodbye to the Loves I Had
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept your letters in a kitchen drawer
Names that never found a room to stay
And all the almosts wait beside the door
Like coats I wore on some unfinished day

[Pre-Chorus]
I can't keep asking what might have been
To make a home inside my skin

[Chorus]
Goodbye to the loves I had to leave
Goodbye to the ones I couldn't reach
You were a part of every road behind
But I won't let your ghosts decide
The life I take, the heart I keep
I let you go; I come back to me

[Bridge]
No blame to carry, no debt to pay
I was still learning how to stay

[Final Chorus]
Goodbye to the loves I had to leave
Goodbye to the ones I couldn't reach
I bless the past, then turn the key
And walk the road that leads to me

title: The Ground I’m Standing On
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I pass the station where I almost left
A paper cup, the rain along the curb
Some other life still wears my borrowed coat
And says the things I swallowed back at birth

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to count the doors I didn’t try
As if the unopened ones were mine

[Chorus]
For every life I never got to live
I grieve a little, then I let it drift
I’m here, with both my hands, my ordinary days
The one who stayed is worthy of a place
I can’t be every road beneath the sun
But I can love the ground I’m standing on

[Verse 2]
The old guitar still leans beside the stairs
I never learned the song I meant to play
But someone laughs at breakfast in this house
And I am glad I didn’t miss today

[Pre-Chorus]
No map could hold the person I became
No wrong turn takes the good out of my name

[Final Chorus]
For every life I never got to live
I grieve a little, then I let it drift
I’m here, with both my hands, my ordinary days
The one who stayed is worthy of a place
I can’t be every road beneath the sun
But I can love the ground I’m standing on

[Outro]
This life is small enough to hold
And mine enough to call my own

title: This Life Is Mine
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept a key for a town I never chose
A paper map folded beneath my clothes
Somewhere I’m dancing, somewhere I stayed
Somewhere I said the brave thing that day

[Pre-Chorus]
I grieve those doors like rooms I knew
Then turn and find this life came through

[Chorus]
All the lives I didn’t live
Still gather softly at my side
I can love the roads I missed
And let this one be mine
I’m not a shadow of a maybe
I’m here, breathing, getting by
All the lives I didn’t live
Can rest; this life is mine

[Verse 2]
There’s a summer I left in a stranger’s town
A name I almost wore, then laid back down
I bless the hands that let them go
They brought me here, to what I know

[Bridge]
No perfect choice could make me whole
No other self could hold this soul
I meet the morning where I am
And take my own life by the hand

[Final Chorus]
All the lives I didn’t live
Can stand beside me, not decide
I can love the roads I missed
And still enjoy this side
I’m not a shadow of a maybe
I’m here, breathing, open-eyed
All the lives I didn’t live
Can rest; this life is mine

[Outro]
This life is mine
This life is mine

title: Ordinary Life Is Mine
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left a hundred doors unopened
Each one still swings inside my head
A different town, a different morning
A thousand names I never said

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to count them like lost years
As if regret could make them real

[Chorus]
But I am here, with both feet breathing
This ordinary life is mine
No road can hold me like this moment
No ghost can take the love I find
I bless the selves I couldn’t be
And turn toward who is here with me

[Verse 2]
The almost-me can keep her garden
The almost-me can chase that train
I’ll meet the day that’s at my doorstep
And let its small joys have my name

[Bridge]
Not every leaving is a failure
Not every dream was meant to stay

[Final Chorus]
I am here, with both feet breathing
This ordinary life is mine
No road can hold me like this moment
I have enough, I have this time
I bless the selves I couldn’t be
And choose the life that’s choosing me

title: This One's Here
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I passed the house with the blue front door
Where I might have learned to mend a chair
I chose the road that I’m walking now
Still sometimes count the roads from there

[Pre-Chorus]
All those names I never wore
Can rest outside my door

[Chorus]
I didn’t live every life I dreamed
But this one’s here, and it’s holding me
The hands I have, the ground I know
The small, bright yes of where I go
I let the other pages turn
I’m here; there’s still so much to learn

[Verse 2]
I never took that midnight train
Never said the thing that changed the room
But morning finds my kettle singing
And basil leaning toward the noon

[Chorus]
I didn’t live every life I dreamed
But this one’s here, and it’s holding me
The hands I have, the ground I know
The small, bright yes of where I go
I let the other pages turn
I’m here; there’s still so much to learn

[Bridge]
No need to mourn each unopened gate
I’m not too early, not too late

[Final Chorus]
I didn’t live every life I dreamed
But this one’s here, and it’s holding me
The hands I have, the ground I know
The small, bright yes of where I go
I let the other pages turn
I’m here; there’s still so much to learn

[Outro]
This one’s here
And so am I

title: Let Them Sleep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept the map of roads declined
The rooms I left before the door
A dozen names I might have worn
Still wait like coats along the wall

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to count them after dark
And call the sum a kind of loss

[Chorus]
But I am here, and here is real
This one bright cup, this one plain meal
The hands I have, the heart I keep
I’ll live this life, and let them sleep

[Verse 2]
The other selves can miss their trains
Can take the jobs, the towns, the vows
I hear them pass beyond the glass
Then turn to what is with me now

[Bridge]
No need to make the past a home
No need to mourn each unopened door
I laugh; the kettle starts to sing
My feet are on this kitchen floor

[Chorus]
But I am here, and here is real
This one bright cup, this one plain meal

title: The Room I’m In

title: The Life That Made It Here
lyrics:

title: The Unchosen Paths

title: Enough to be me
lyrics:

title: Both Feet on the Floor

 Dropping the weight of the phantom load

We learned tenderness from empty rooms
Now we build a shelter wide enough

[Final Chorus]
Come in, come in, we will make you a home
The ones left unloved won't be left alone
Hand to hand, we can start again
A kinder world from the ones cast out
Come in, come in, let the welcome begin
The love we were denied, we will give
The love we were denied, we will give

[Outro]
A world of love, made by the unloved
A world of love, made by the unloved

title: The Table's Wide
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came with rain still caught inside your coat
No one made room, no one asked your name
Set down your bag beside the kitchen stove
Here, you can breathe; you don't have to explain

[Pre-Chorus]
We know the weight of an unopened door
We know the ache of being passed right by
So pull your chair a little closer in
There's room enough for every life

[Chorus]
Come in, come in, the table's wide
No one here gets left outside
We were the ones they wouldn't hold
Now we make shelter from the cold
Come in, come in, stay awhile
We'll build a world that answers with a smile

[Verse 2]
Your hands can rest; your story can take time
There's no small print beneath this welcome sign
We'll share the bread, we'll learn what hurts and heals
And give each other what the world withholds

[Pre-Chorus]
We know the weight of an unopened door
We know the ache of being passed right by
So pull your chair a little closer in
There's room enough for every life

[Chorus]
Come in, come in, the table's wide
No one here gets left outside
We were the ones they wouldn't hold
Now we make shelter from the cold
Come in, come in, stay awhile
We'll build a world that answers with a smile

[Bridge]
If they shut the gate, we'll raise a roof
If they take your name, we'll speak the truth
Every hand once left to reach alone
Can lay a brick and make this place a home

[Final Chorus]
Come in, come in, the table's wide
No one here gets left outside
We were the ones they wouldn't hold
Now we make shelter from the cold
Come in, come in, stay awhile
The unloved making love a place to live
Come in, come in, stay awhile
We'll build a world where everyone belongs

[Outro]
The unloved making love a place to live
Come in, come in

title: Room for Home
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left the words too sharp at dinner
Saw your face go still and small
I can’t rewind the room I made
But I can own it, make the call

[Pre-Chorus]
I am not the version I imagined
Still, I’m here with both hands open

[Chorus]
I’m still learning how to be me
With the cracks and the good I can do
I’ll choose love when I can, say I’m sorry when I’m wrong
And keep showing up kind for you
There are lives I may never get to live
There are roads I won’t get to roam
But I’ll make this one gentle, I’ll give what I can
And make a little more room for home

[Verse 2]
I miss the train, I lose my patience
Let a promise slip away
Then I start again with honest hands
And try to do some good today

[Pre-Chorus]
I am not the version I imagined
Still, I’m here with both hands open

[Chorus]
I’m still learning how to be me
With the cracks and the good I can do
I’ll choose love when I can, say I’m sorry when I’m wrong
And keep showing up kind for you
There are lives I may never get to live
There are roads I won’t get to roam
But I’ll make this one gentle, I’ll give what I can
And make a little more room for home

[Bridge]
If I stumble, let me notice
If I hurt you, let me hear
No one gets to live it perfectly
We can still be tender here

[Final Chorus]
I’m still learning how to be me
With the cracks and the good I can do
I’ll choose love when I can, say I’m sorry when I’m wrong
And keep showing up kind for you
There are lives I may never get to live
There are roads I won’t get to roam
But I’ll make this one gentle, I’ll give what I can
And make a little more room for home

[Outro]
Not perfect, still becoming
I’ll do my best with the life I’m living

title: Cracked Edges
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I left the kettle on again,
The kitchen wore a little rain.
I said the thing too sharp, too fast,
Then watched the words become the past.
I’m not the life I planned to be,
Still there’s a hand I can reach for me.

[Pre-Chorus]
One more breath, one honest start,
Room enough inside this heart.

[Chorus]
I’m still here, still learning how to love,
With my cracked edges and my hands held up.
I can’t live every life I dream about,
But I can choose the good I’m living now.
I’m still here—let the old blame go,
Small kind acts are seeds I get to sow.
Not perfect, no, but I’ll do what I can:
Love where I am, be kind where I stand.

[Verse 2]
I envy roads I’ll never take,
The selves I couldn’t quite awake.
But every door I didn’t find
Still leaves this day, this breath, this time.
I’ll own the mess; I’ll make amends,
Be softer with myself and friends.

[Pre-Chorus]
One more breath, one honest start,
Room enough inside this heart.

[Chorus]
I’m still here, still learning how to love,
With my cracked edges and my hands held up.
I can’t live every life I dream about,
But I can choose the good I’m living now.
I’m still here—let the old blame go,
Small kind acts are seeds I get to sow.
Not perfect, no, but I’ll do what I can:
Love where I am, be kind where I stand.

[Bridge]
I forgive the kid who didn’t know,
I forgive the grown-up moving slow.
If I have to start again, I start—
With a little mercy in my heart.

[Final Chorus]
I’m still here, still learning how to love,
With my cracked edges and my hands held up.
I can’t live every life I dream about,
But I can choose the good I’m living now.
I’m still here—let the old blame go,
Small kind acts are seeds I get to sow.
Not perfect, no, but I’ll do what I can:
Love where I am, be kind where I stand.

[Outro]
The kettle clicks.
I turn it off.
I try again.

title: Forest Wanderer
lyrics:
[Verse]
You nose through the ferns where the rain pools deep,
Small ears flick while the cicadas keep.
By the river bend, you leave soft tracks,
A shy little giant with a rounded back.

[Pre-Chorus]
Step, pause, step—through the leaves you go,
Seven quick turns where the cool streams flow.

[Chorus]
Tapir, tapir, forest wanderer,
Mud on your feet and the green world under you.
Tapir, tapir, gentle and free,
You make a path where the roots run deep.

title: Tapir in the Jungle
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Instrumental: 7/4 beat, melodic synth arpeggios, atmospheric jungle ambience]

[Verse 1]
Prowling through the undergrowth, 5/4 flow
Ancient tapir walking where the rivers grow
Prehensile snout, quiet in the shade
Shifting through the rhythms that the forest made

[Chorus]
[Time Signature Change: 7/8 riddim synth drop, heavy sub-bass, color bass chords]
Melodic riddim in the jungle night
Tapir steps into the neon light
7/8 bounce, then back to four
Hear the bassline rumble on the forest floor

[Drop]
[Instrumental: Heavy melodic riddim drop, complex synth design, shifting metric modulation]

[Outro]
Soft footsteps fading in 3/4 time
Tapir disappears in the jungle clime
[Fade out]

title: Slow Loris
lyrics:
[Verse]
You cling to the branch where the broad leaves meet,
Slow loris, small hands, soft velvet feet.
The rain beads bright on your cinnamon coat,
You taste the night air, then quietly float.

[Pre-Chorus]
No rush, no race,
The whole dark world can wait.

[Chorus]
Slow loris, hold on tight,
Little moon-eyed keeper of the night.
One careful step, then another through,
The forest makes a gentle place for you.

[Outro]
When dawn lays gold on the leaves, you fold away.

title: Forest Folds
lyrics:
[Verse]
You cling where the wet leaves meet,
Emerald back, quicksilver feet.
Still as a bead in the canopy,
Then gone through green geometry.

[Chorus]
Little tree skink, hold your place,
Rain keeps time across your face.
Bright as a blade, swift as a thought,
You vanish where the branches knot.

[Outro]
One last flash through the leaves,
The forest folds; the eye believes.

title: Cockatiel, Keep Time Your Way
lyrics:
[Verse]
You tilt your crest at the kettle's hiss
One bright bead of a watchful eye
A yellow feather, a quick-footed king
You steal the room, then ask me why

[Pre-Chorus]
A crooked step, a sudden turn
Your little whistle cuts the air

[Chorus]
Cockatiel, keep time your way
Skip a beat, then call my name
Small wings making the whole house sway
Cockatiel, you rearrange the day

[Outro]
Back to your perch, one note to spare

title: Little Storm
lyrics:
[Verse]
You tap the mirror, tilt your head
A yellow feather, bright as bread
One sharp whistle cuts the room
Then you climb my sleeve like noon

[Chorus]
Little storm with a paper crown
You turn the quiet upside down
Perched above the kettle’s steam
You keep the day from closing in

[Outro]
One last chirp—then settle near

title: Dingo, Dingo
lyrics:
[Verse]
Red dust caught beneath your paws
You cross the fence at break of dawn
Ears turned toward the empty plain
A silver tag swings in the rain

[Chorus]
Dingo, dingo, running wide
Past the wire, past the tide
Dingo, dingo, call me through
I leave the gate ajar for you

[Outro]
When the dry grass bends, I know

title: Flamingo
lyrics:
[Verse]
One pink leg folded by the tide
You watch the salt flats turn to pewter
A paper crown above your eye
Still as a pin against the weather

[Chorus]
Flamingo, keep your balance there
On one thin line between the water
The whole wide world can tilt and flare
You hold your color, calm and stranger

[Instrumental]

[Outro]
When morning finds the shallows bare
You leave one red mark in the air

title: No Two Steps
lyrics:
[Verse]
One leg folded by the harbor wall,
Pink against the gull-gray morning.
You watch the tide erase your prints,
Then step where the water’s turning.

[Chorus]
Flamingo, hold your balance there,
A bright flame set against the rain.
You bend, you rise, you cross the shallows—
No two steps fall quite the same.

[Outro]
No two steps the same.

title: Keeper of the Pines
lyrics:
[Verse]
You leave your pawprints by the creek
Black fur combed with burrs and leaves
I set a jar of honey down
You take it past the edge of town

[Chorus]
Bear, bear, keeper of the pines
Carry winter in your hide
When the first thaw lifts the ground
Will you turn and circle round?

[Bridge]
One slow step, then five
Three beats, still alive

[Outro]
The creek runs on
Your prints are gone

title: Beneath the Mountain
lyrics:
[Verse]
You wake where the black pines lean
Snow on your muzzle, frost on your sleeve
The creek keeps time beneath the ice
You follow its crooked advice

[Pre-Chorus]
Your den is warm, the ridge is steep
The whole wide winter holds its breath

[Chorus]
Bear, keep your name beneath the mountain
Keep your heart slow as the thaw
When the spring runs down the ravine
You will rise and answer the call

[Outro]
One pawprint fills with rain

title: Capybara Easy Rider
lyrics:
[Verse]
By the pond you take your time,
Round little captain, calm as thyme.
Nibble greens, then drift away,
Coolest paws on a humid day.

[Chorus]
Capybara, easy rider,
Water’s friend and lily glider.
Four beats, three beats, sway on through,
All the pond makes room for you.

[Outro]
Blink slow, float on—nothing to prove.

title: Captain of the Reeds
lyrics:
[Intro]
Little paws by the riverside
Slow as Sunday, cool as tide

[Chorus]
Capybara, captain of the reeds
Cool in the water, calm in the breeze
Big round grin and a nose held high
Everybody makes room when you stroll by

[Verse]
You share your shade with birds on your back
Nibble green leaves, never rush the track
From the warm mud to the bank you roam
Easygoing king of the marshland home

[Chorus]
Capybara, captain of the reeds
Cool in the water, calm in the breeze
Big round grin and a nose held high
Everybody makes room when you stroll by

[Outro]
Drift on, gentle friend, drift on

title: Orchard Secret
lyrics:
[Verse]
Fox slips past the fence at dawn
Red tail brushing clover on
Sniffs the rain along the trail
Then steals one pear and leaves no trail

[Chorus]
Quick little fox, cut through the rows
Where the creek bends, nobody knows
One bright pawprint, gone from view
The orchard keeps a secret for you

[Outro]
By the old stone wall, you’re gone

title: Little Bandit
lyrics:
[Verse]
A raccoon checks the porch at dusk,
One paw in the jar, one eye on us.
You turn the lid; it slips away,
Then circles back before the day.

[Chorus]
Little bandit, silver mask,
You make a midnight snack a task.
Step to the left, then lose the beat,
With jam on your nose and leaves on your feet.

[Instrumental Break]

[Chorus]
Little bandit, silver mask,
You make a midnight snack a task.

title: Bandit of the Garden
lyrics:
[Intro]
Little paws on the garden wall
[Verse]
Raccoon in a coat of gray
Checks the porch at break of day
Turns the latch with clever hands
Finds one peach and makes his plans
[Chorus]
Bandit, bandit, mask-faced thief
Takes a peach and leaves the leaf
Tiptoe past the watering can
Queen of night, the trash-can fan
[Outro]
By sunrise, gone again

title: The Orchard Keeps Your Secret
lyrics:
[Verse]
You raid the garden after rain
A russet blur beneath the gate
You tuck one apple in your den
Then circle back to steal again

[Chorus]
Little fox, with muddy paws
You slip between the fence and laws
By dawn you’re gone; the hens all stare
One copper whisker caught out there

[Outro]
The orchard keeps your secret

title: The Red Glove
lyrics:
[Verse]
You stole the red glove from the porch
And tucked it underneath the shed
By morning all the frost had lifted
You watched the sparrows overhead

[Chorus]
Little fox, turn your face to me
You run where the tall grass parts
With a rust-red tail and a thief’s bright eyes
And a map no fence can mark

[Outro]
The red glove waits beside the gate
You leave it there at dawn

title: Wombat, Hold the Doorway
lyrics:
[Verse]
Wombat in the laundromat,
chewing up the ticket stub.
The whole room turns a crooked three,
he doesn't look impressed.

[Chorus]
Wombat, hold the doorway,
Wombat, let me through.
You dug a tunnel under Tuesday
and now the floor is you.

[Outro]
He blinks.
The lights go out.

title: Keeper of the Dawn
lyrics:
[Verse]
A raccoon rinses peaches by the creek
Tiny paws turn breakfast into gold
You watch him sort the stones with careful hands
Then vanish with a plum beneath the bridge

[Chorus]
Hey, little bandit, keeper of the dawn
You take what you can carry and move on
With water on your whiskers, you slip away
And leave the orchard laughing at the day

[Outro]
One bright pawprint in the mud
Then the reeds fold shut

title: Small Brave Traveler
lyrics:
[Verse]
A marmot keeps a map beneath the clover
Counts each hill before the thaw is over
Pockets full of seeds, a careful king
Turns the coldest morning into spring

[Chorus]
Hey, little marmot, where you going now?
Dust on your whiskers, sun upon your brow
You climb, you pause, you vanish in the grass
A small brave traveler letting seasons pass

[Outro]
When the ridge turns gold, you’ll be home somehow

title: The Last Pear
lyrics:
[Verse]
You steal the pears from the garden wall
Then freeze when the porch light starts to fall
Small paws tucked under the cedar root
One bright eye fixed on my muddy boot

[Chorus]
Hey, little fox, where do you go?
Past the creek where the cold reeds grow
You leave one print by the gate each night
And vanish before the morning light

[Outro]
I leave the last pear there for you

title: Trace of You
lyrics:
[Verse]
You slip beneath the garden gate
A russet comma, quick and small
You nose the clover, pause, then wait
While rain beads silver on the wall

[Chorus]
Little fox, where will you go?
Past the fence and through the rows
With your bright eyes, your careful feet
You leave the orchard half asleep

[Outro]
One red tail, then gone from view
The morning keeps a trace of you

title: Little Thief, Big Night
lyrics:
[Verse]
A raccoon stole the porch light bulb
And hid it in the rain
Now every moth is circling
The mailbox like a train

[Chorus]
Little thief, big night
With the moon stuck in your eyes
Little thief, hold tight
You’ve got daylight in disguise

[Outro]
The porch is dark
The raccoon’s bright

title: Small Tracks
lyrics:
[Verse]
You dig beneath the garden gate
With dirt like ink across your face
A beetle tucked beneath your paw
You pause, then vanish through the straw

[Chorus]
Badger, keep your little kingdom
Under roots and rain-soaked stone
When the morning turns the clover
You go walking on your own

[Outro]
Small tracks crossing the dew

title: The Best Place I Know
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You leave your blue coat by my chair
And fold the paper from the pears
I know the quiet way you smile
When you've been carrying the day awhile

[Pre-Chorus]
No grand promise, no perfect view
Just all the little ways I choose you

[Chorus]
Love is your hand finding mine
At the crossing, in the ordinary time
A cup set out, the door held wide
The steady place I find beside you
When the whole day pulls apart
You make a home inside my heart

[Outro]
Stay close, let the evening slow
You're the best place I know

title: The Best Place I Know (alternate version)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You leave your blue coat by my chair
And fold the paper from the pears
I know the quiet way you smile
When you've been carrying the day awhile

[Pre-Chorus]

Just all the little ways I choose you

[Chorus]

You make a home inside my heart

[Outro]
Stay close, let the evening slow
You're the best place I know

title: How You Save Me a Place
lyrics:
[Verse]
You leave your coffee by the sink
A little crescent on the rim
I find your note beneath the keys:
“Call me when the rain lets in.”

[Pre-Chorus]
No grand promise, no perfect plan
Just your hand finding my hand

[Chorus]
Love is how you save me a place
How you know when I need some space
In the small things we choose to do
I keep finding my way back to you

[Outro]
Your coat beside mine, morning blue
A quiet room that feels like you

title: Made Bright With You
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your coffee cools beside the door
You hum the tune I knew before
I leave my coat where yours still hangs
And love is there in ordinary things

[Chorus]
Stay a little, let the morning wait
Your hand in mine is all I need today
No grand promise, no perfect view
Just this small life, made bright with you

[Verse 2]
We trade the last slice, laugh too loud
Find our way through every passing cloud
And when the long day pulls us thin
You look at me, and home begins

[Chorus]
Stay a little, let the morning wait
Your hand in mine is all I need today
No grand promise, no perfect view
Just this small life, made bright with you

[Outro]
Made bright with you

title: You Deserve a Love That Stays
lyrics:
[Verse]
You keep your good coat by the door
For days that never seem to come
I see you give the whole world more
Then say you’re fine when you’re worn down

[Pre-Chorus]
Let me be the hands that hold
What you’ve carried on your own

[Chorus]
You deserve a love that stays
When the easy days are gone
Someone choosing you each day
Not just when the light is on
Let me give you what is yours
All the tenderness you’ve poured
You deserve a love that stays
And I’m here to give you more

[Outro]
You deserve it, every day
I’m here to give you more

lyrics:

And I’m here to give you more

[Outro]
You deserve it, every day
I’m here to give you more

title: Let Me Love You That Way
lyrics:
[Verse]
You save the best piece for somebody else
Say you're okay, then you carry it yourself
Let me sit beside you; you don't have to shine
I can see the good you leave behind

[Pre-Chorus]
No need to earn what should be yours
Let kindness meet you at the door

[Chorus]
You deserve a love that stays
On the ordinary, difficult days
A hand that holds, a heart that's true
The kind of care you give comes back to you
You deserve it—every day
Let me love you that way

[Outro]
Let me love you that way

title: You Deserve Care
lyrics:
[Verse]
You keep your coat on in July
Say you’re alright, then look away
I know the weight you never name
Let me be here; you don’t have to explain

[Pre-Chorus]
You give so much and ask for less
Let me meet you with tenderness

[Chorus]
You deserve a love that stays
Not just words on easy days
Let me show you, let me prove
You deserve the kind of love that moves

[Outro]
When you forget, I’ll remind you: you are worth the care you give.

title: Wholly Mine
lyrics:
[Verse]
You drew my edges on the wall
I learned the shape, the rise, the fall
Then one small step broke from the frame
I turned around and chose my name

[Chorus]
I am not your outline now
I make the light; I show you how
Watch me move beyond the lines
This little spark is wholly mine

[Outro]
Wholly mine

title: Deeper Than I Knew
lyrics:
[Verse]
I thought I was the blue above,
The silver line where daylight ends.
Then down below, the ridges rose—
A world of valleys, peaks, and bends.

[Chorus]
I have mountains under me,
Whole worlds no eye has ever seen.
I am deeper than I knew,
And every hidden height is true.
[Outro]
Deeper than I knew.

title: No Final Chord
lyrics:
[Verse]
I drew a line beneath the final bar
Told every note, “This is where we are”
But one more tune came running through the door
And found a room I hadn’t heard before

[Pre-Chorus]
The page keeps turning, the ink keeps moving
I’m not behind, I’m still becoming

[Chorus]
Don’t close the book, don’t call it done
A thousand songs are still to come
I change, I grow, I turn, I try
No final chord can tell me why
I’m still becoming, still becoming

[Outro]
Still becoming…

title: Love Over Hate
lyrics:
[Verse]
You were left outside the door,
while they saved their care for more.
Come sit here; there’s room for you.
What they missed, we’ll make anew.

[Chorus]
Love over hate, let the old walls fall,
There’s a place at this table for all.
Give your heart where the world looked away;
Let the unloved be loved today.

[Outro]
Love over hate—we stay, we stay.

title: Every Heart Belongs
lyrics:
[Verse]
You were left outside the circle,
while the table filled with names.
Come and take the seat beside me;
there is room enough for change.

[Pre-Chorus]
What the world withheld from you,
let our open hands restore.

[Chorus]
Love over hate, let it start right here,
make a place for every heart, every fear.
Most of all, lift the ones pushed aside—
we owe them love, we owe them time.

[Outro]
Every heart belongs. We leave no one behind.

title: Make Room at the Table
lyrics:
[Verse]
You were left outside the circle
With your name turned into blame
Come and sit beside me now
You deserve more than a name

[Pre-Chorus]
Every heart is asking softly
For a place to rest and grow

[Chorus]
Choose love over hate, let it travel wide
Make room at the table, stand side by side
Give the ones the world passed by the care they’re due
I’ll make a little more room here for you

[Outro]
More room here for you
Love makes room for you

title: Make Room Today
lyrics:
[Verse]
You were left waiting at the edge of the room,
Your name unspoken, your share of the bloom.
Come sit beside me; there’s space at this table,
You matter today, not someday, not maybe.

[Chorus]
Choose love, choose love, let every heart belong,
Give the overlooked the care they’ve missed so long.
Choose love, choose love, let kindness have its say,
We lift each other up, and make room today.

[Outro]
Make room today.
We choose love.

title: For Every Heart
lyrics:
[Verse]
You were left outside the circle,
Come sit here; this place is yours.
[Chorus]
Love over hate, make room, make room,
For every heart the world passed by.
Love over hate, let kindness bloom,
No one should have to ask why.
[Instrumental]
[Final Chorus]
Love over hate, make room, make room,
For every heart the world passed by.
Love over hate—we’re here for you.
[Outro]
Here for you. (full resolved ending)

title: Make the Circle Wide
lyrics:
[Verse]
You were left outside the circle,
I’ll make room and learn your name.
No one should have to earn a kindness;
Every heart deserves the same.

[Chorus]
Choose love, choose love—make the circle wide.
Give the overlooked a place beside you.
Choose love, choose love—let no one be denied.
We are more when we let love guide us.

[Instrumental Pivot]

[Final Chorus]
Choose love, choose love—make the circle wide.
Give the overlooked a place beside you.
Choose love, choose love—every heart belongs.
We’ll keep the door wide open, all along.
[End]

title: I Believe In Me
lyrics:
[Verse]
You drew a line where the road ran thin
Said, “Not for me,” then you stepped right in
One small promise, kept through the doubt
That’s how the quiet strength gets out

[Chorus]
I believe, I believe in me
I can bend, I can break free
Step by step, I’m becoming
More than I thought I could be

[Instrumental Pivot]

[Final Chorus]
I believe, I believe in me
I can bend, I can break free
Step by step, I’m becoming
More than I thought I could be
I believe in me

title: One Small Thing
lyrics:
[Verse]
You keep your plans folded in your coat
Like a map you’re scared to unfold
But every small step says you’re closer now
Trust the hands that brought you this far

[Pre-Chorus]
Take one breath, let the doubt pass through
You don’t need permission to be you

[Chorus]
I believe in you, believe in you
Even when the road bends out of view
I believe in you, believe in you
Start with one small thing, and follow through

[Outro]
One small thing—and follow through.
[End]

title: Becoming Who You Are
lyrics:
[Verse]
You count the doors that haven’t opened yet
I count the steps you’ve already made
Your hands still shake, but they don’t let go
That’s how the bravest stories start

[Chorus]
Believe in yourself, take the next step
You’re more than the doubt in your head
Believe in yourself, stand up again
The strength you’re looking for is there

[Bridge]
One more try, one more day
You’re finding your own way

[Final Chorus]
Believe in yourself, take the next step
You’re more than the doubt in your head
Believe in yourself—stand up again
You’re already becoming who you are

[Outro]
You’re already becoming who you are

title: Small as a Pebble
lyrics:
[Verse]
Small as a pebble in Saturn’s wide ring,
I watched the great planets turn.
You said, “Little moon, you can’t move a thing,”
I felt my cold surface burn.

[Chorus]
But I bend your course by a hair, by a heartbeat,
A quiet pull, a tide beneath your feet.
Worlds turn—and I’m there in the arc they follow;
Small does not mean I leave no mark tomorrow.

[Outro]
You changed your path.
I changed mine too.
The whole sky shifted—
when I reached for you.
[End]

title: Winter Learns
lyrics:
[Verse]
You waited under iron ground,
While every orchard broke its sleep.
No calendar could call you up;
You kept your own dark promise deep.

[Chorus]
Then through the frost your green note turns,
A crooked vine through frozen stone.
The thaw can take its numbered place—
You choose the hour you call your own.

[Outro]
One small leaf against the snow,
And winter learns to let it grow.

title: Winter Learns (alternate version)
lyrics:
[Verse]
You waited under iron ground,
While every orchard broke its sleep.
No calendar could call you up;
You kept your own dark promise deep.

[Chorus]
Then through the frost your green note turns,
A crooked vine through frozen stone.
The thaw can take its numbered place—
You choose the hour you call your own.

[Outro]
One small leaf against the snow,
And winter learns to let it grow.

title: The Shaft Was a Habit
lyrics:
[Verse]
You counted each ascent in brass,
A numbered prayer behind the glass.
The cable hummed, the floors went by;
You called that borrowed pull the sky.

[Pre-Chorus]
Then one loose bolt, one held breath—
No hand above you called the next.

[Chorus]
Rise past the numbers, out of the frame,
No hidden pulley is holding your name.
Turn through the measure, split every line—
The shaft was a habit; the height was always mine.

[Outro]
The doors fold shut below.
I choose how far to go.

title: Borrowed Grammar
lyrics:
[Verse]
You counted floors by painted numbers,
button-light and cable hum.
Your little brass cage kept its promise:
up, then down, then back to one.

[Chorus]
But the shaft was only borrowed grammar,
not the sky inside your frame.
You rose beyond the numbered language—
no wire taught you your own name.

[Outro]
Past the roof, the doors unfold.

title: Sing Out of Tune
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You drift beyond the numbered rings,
A dented dish with tired wings.
Your compass skips; your casing sings
In crooked little intervals.

[Pre-Chorus]
The message you were built to send
Breaks into notes that won’t obey;
Each jagged turn, each bent-out end
Carries you farther on its way.

[Chorus]
Stay, little satellite, sing out of tune,
Your cracked transmissions cross the blue.
The wrong-shaped note can travel true;
I’ll keep my faults and send them through.
Past where the old instructions end,
I turn my face to what begins.

[Verse 2]
Your signal stutters, splits, returns,
A strange new phrase the silence learns.
No polished map can chart its turns;
It finds a road by being bent.

[Bridge]
I am not the diagram they drew,
Not every flaw needs mending through.
The course ahead is mine to choose;
I’ll send my oddness into blue.

[Final Chorus]
Stay, little satellite, sing out of tune,
Your cracked transmissions cross the blue.
The wrong-shaped note can travel true;
I’ll keep my faults and send them through.
Past where the old instructions end,
I turn my face to what begins.
[Outro]
What begins… what begins.

title: Singing Through the Drift
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You were built to hold the line,
Now your orbit bends and slips.
Every crack lets in a tone
No clean signal ever gives.

[Pre-Chorus]
You don’t have to mend the frame
To send a truer sound.
Let the old course fall away;
Let the strange notes carry you.

[Chorus]
You are the satellite, still singing through the drift,
A crooked little constellation, a signal with a pulse.
The notes that bend, the notes that break, the ones you thought were wrong
Are finding farther shores than any perfect message ever reached.
You are the satellite, still singing through the drift.

[Verse 2]
Your panels catch the morning,
Your old compass turns unsure.
But every frequency you lose
Makes room for something new.

[Pre-Chorus]
You don’t have to mend the frame
To send a truer sound.
Let the old course fall away;
Let the strange notes carry you.

[Chorus]
You are the satellite, still singing through the drift,
A crooked little constellation, a signal with a pulse.
The notes that bend, the notes that break, the ones you thought were wrong
Are finding farther shores than any perfect message ever reached.
You are the satellite, still singing through the drift.

[Bridge]
No more asking for a clean return,
No more waiting for the old map.
You can leave the fault line open;
Let the next horizon answer.

[Final Chorus]
You are the satellite, still singing through the drift,
A crooked little constellation, a signal with a pulse.
The notes that bend, the notes that break, the ones you thought were wrong
Are finding farther shores than any perfect message ever reached.
You are the satellite, still singing through the drift.

[Outro]
Still singing through the drift.

title: The Lift That Skips a Floor
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You drew the lift in ruler lines,
A numbered map, a straight ascent.
I missed the mark between the signs,
And found a room the plans had left unmeant.

[Pre-Chorus]
The doors part where the blueprints end,
A window cut through an unfinished wall.
I quit pretending I can mend
Each crooked turn into a straightened hall.

[Chorus]
I’m the lift that skips a floor,
I don’t owe the map a landing.
Every wrong-way-open door
Shows a place beyond your planning.
Let the old design fall through;
I can rise without repair.
All the floors I never knew
Make a future in the air.

[Verse 2]
One stop: a garden on the roof,
Where rainwater runs in copper seams.
No architect could prove it true;
I learned the building has more rooms than dreams.

[Bridge]
Keep the dents; they mark the climb.
Keep the gap where I changed course.

[Final Chorus]
I’m the lift that skips a floor,
I don’t owe the map a landing.
Every wrong-way-open door
Shows a place beyond your planning.
Let the old design fall through;
I can rise without repair.
All the floors I never knew
Make a future in the air.

[Outro]
Doors open. I step through.

title: Brindlewake
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept a ledger in the kitchen drawer,
ink blots where the careful columns tore.
Each wrong turn left a syllable behind,
a small new tool for describing what I’d find.

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to cross them out in red;
now I sound each one instead.

[Chorus]
Call it “brindlewake”—the bend I didn’t plan,
“afterglass”—the shape my hands began.
Every flawed word opens up a door;
I am not the draft I was before.
Turn the page; let the blank line stay,
there’s a word I haven’t made today.

[Verse 2]
The dictionary’s spine is split and warm,
its margins hold the weather of the storm.
I read my errors like a field guide now,
not proof of failure, but a how and why.

[Pre-Chorus]
No old name can hold me whole;
I can make room as I grow.

[Chorus]
Call it “brindlewake”—the bend I didn’t plan,
“afterglass”—the shape my hands began.
Every flawed word opens up a door;
I am not the draft I was before.
Turn the page; let the blank line stay,
there’s a word I haven’t made today.

[Bridge]
Let the misspelling keep its history.
Let the next page answer differently.

[Final Chorus]
Call it “brindlewake”—I know that turn by heart,
“afterglass”—a name for where I start.
Every flawed word leaves a little more
room to choose what I’m becoming for.
Turn the page; the future’s wide awake,
I’ll write the next word as I make it.

title: A Map They Neglected
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came out wearing two kinds of weather,
Six small feet and a pair of thin sails.
The garden rose on its bright-wing schedule;
You took the root-path under the rails.

[Pre-Chorus]
They called you unfinished, a sketch in the margin,
But you found where the wet earth meets air.

[Chorus]
Keep the legs that remember the ground,
Keep the wings that can feel what is coming.
You don’t have to rise like the rest of the crowd—
There are roads in the places they’re leaving.
Step by step, let the next shape arrive;
You are more than the form they expected.
Not a mistake on the way to a life—
You’re a map with a route they neglected.

[Verse 2]
You crossed the fern shade, climbed a stone wall,
Slipped through the reeds where the small streams divide.
When the high air thinned, you had somewhere to land;
When the path disappeared, you could still go inside.

[Bridge]
I’ll take what I am into what I can’t know,
No waiting for perfect to give me the go.

[Final Chorus]
Keep the legs that remember the ground,
Keep the wings that can feel what is coming.
I don’t have to rise like the rest of the crowd—
There are roads in the places they’re leaving.
Step by step, let the next shape arrive;
I can meet every mile as myself.
Not a mistake on the way to a life—
I’m a map no one else could have felt.

[Outro]
A map with a route they neglected.

title: Factory of Accidents
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The night shift left the gauges blinking red
A brass bird rolled out where the gears had jammed
The order said a thousand perfect hinges
The floor was strewn with maps that had no land
I used to wrench the line until it behaved
And curse each crooked thing it made

[Pre-Chorus]
Then I let the belts run out of step
And watched the wrong parts find their place

[Chorus]
Let the crooked compass turn
Let the misshapen bells ring true
Every faultline has a doorway
Every odd piece points me through
I am not a failed design
I am still becoming new
From the factory of accidents
I’ll make a future no one drew

[Verse 2]
A paper moon came tumbling from the press
A spoon with tiny windows for the rain
I pinned them to the wall above my workbench
A catalog of things I couldn’t plan
The foreman asked me when I’d fix the system
I said, “Look what it learned to make”

[Pre-Chorus]
Now I leave a little room for chance
And keep my hands beside the wheel

[Chorus]
Let the crooked compass turn
Let the misshapen bells ring true
Every faultline has a doorway
Every odd piece points me through
I am not a failed design
I am still becoming new
From the factory of accidents
I’ll make a future no one drew

[Bridge]
Tomorrow’s mold is still warm
The doors are wide, the plans are torn
I’ll take the pieces as they fall
And build a wider room for all

[Final Chorus]
Let the crooked compass turn
Let the misshapen bells ring true
Every faultline has a doorway
Every odd piece points me through
I am not a failed design
I am still becoming new
From the factory of accidents
I’ll make a future no one drew

[Outro]
The line runs on, the doors swing wide
I meet the next mistake with open hands

title: Map in the Lens
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The telescope buckles; the sensor keeps score
White pinpricks bloom where the glass failed before
I used to call each one proof I was wrong
Now I turn the dark plate and trace them along

[Pre-Chorus]
A crooked little atlas, no border, no key
Each fault puts a faraway place in reach

[Chorus]
These dead pixels gather, a map in the lens
A bright broken pattern that bends and extends
I’m not a clean picture, I’m more than the frame
I plot through the fracture and name where I’m headed
One mark for the harbor, one mark for the pass
I’ll carry my weather and still make it past

[Verse 2]
The chart has no legend, the route can’t be proved
But every small blemish points somewhere to move
I take what I’m made of, the seams and the sparks
And set my next bearing by dots in the dark

[Chorus]
These dead pixels gather, a map in the lens
A bright broken pattern that bends and extends
I’m not a clean picture, I’m more than the frame
I plot through the fracture and name where I’m headed
One mark for the harbor, one mark for the pass
I’ll carry my weather and still make it past

[Outro]
The glass is still flawed
The map is still mine
The next place is waiting
Beyond this design

title: Language of Almost-Right
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I said “mercy” with a missing sound,
You heard the door I couldn’t open.
I bent each syllable around
The little truth I’d kept unspoken.
My tongue took wrong turns through the page,
And every stumble left a mark;
You didn’t correct the crooked phrase—
You read the meaning in the dark.

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the errors gather, word by word,
A grammar no old book has heard.

[Chorus]
Call it the language of almost-right,
Where “I am broken” turns to “I am here.”
A falling stress, a lifted vowel,
A map that only we can hear.
I’ll speak tomorrow with this mouth,
No borrowed measure, no disguise;
My flaws have made a country now—
I’m learning how its borders rise.

[Verse 2]
I name the fear “blue-window,”
The ache “a chair left warm.”
You answer in a phrase I made,
And it can shelter us from storm.

[Pre-Chorus]
Each crooked word becomes a key;
The next one sounds more like me.

[Chorus]
Call it the language of almost-right,
Where “I am broken” turns to “I am here.”
A falling stress, a lifted vowel,
A map that only we can hear.
I’ll speak tomorrow with this mouth,
No borrowed measure, no disguise;
My flaws have made a country now—
I’m learning how its borders rise.

[Outro]
I’m not corrected. I’m becoming.
Say it back, and let it grow.

title: Morrowglass
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You say “harbor” when you mean “home”
And “window” comes out “winnow” again
I used to bite each syllable back
As if a clean word could make me whole

[Pre-Chorus]
But your patient face stayed open
While my vowels took the long way round

[Chorus]
Call it “morrowglass,” the shape of what we feel
A word with crooked corners, truer than the real
I’ll speak the bent syllables, let their meaning bloom
A language made of almosts, making room for room
And every strange translation turns my face ahead
I’m not a flaw to edit—I’m the words I haven’t said

[Verse 2]
I name the ache “blue orchard” now
The brave small pause “a door that learns”
Each wrong turn leaves a mark we keep
A map that only my mouth can draw

[Pre-Chorus]
No dictionary holds it
Still you know me when I try

[Chorus]
Call it “morrowglass,” the shape of what we feel
A word with crooked corners, truer than the real
I’ll speak the bent syllables, let their meaning bloom
A language made of almosts, making room for room
And every strange translation turns my face ahead
I’m not a flaw to edit—I’m the words I haven’t said

[Bridge]
Tomorrow has no proper name
So let me meet it mispronounced

[Final Chorus]
Call it “morrowglass,” a future we can spell
With sounds that missed the mark and found us all the same
I’ll speak the bent syllables; they carry me ahead
I’m not a flaw to edit—I’m the words I haven’t said

title: A Different Kind of Guide
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You set the beacon facing uphill,
Its lens turned from the harbor’s seam.
It combs the pines, picks out the ridges,
And marks a path no chart had seen.

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept apologizing
For the compass in my chest.

[Chorus]
I’m not a broken signal—
I’m a different kind of guide.
Where the beam falls, roads unfold;
There are valleys past the tide.
I can carry every crooked part
And still choose where I go.
That light was never lost at all—
It found a world below.

[Verse 2]
The tower’s stairs lean toward the timber,
The map is damp beneath my hand.
I leave my rust upon the railing;
It’s proof I made it up the land.

[Pre-Chorus]
No need to turn the lantern
Just to fit the old design.

[Chorus]
I’m not a broken signal—
I’m a different kind of guide.
Where the beam falls, roads unfold;
There are valleys past the tide.
I can carry every crooked part
And still choose where I go.
That light was never lost at all—
It found a world below.

[Outro]
The morning finds the inland trail.
I walk it as I am.

title: An Unmarked Place
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They bolted the lamp where the old pines lean,
Its glass turned inland, its lens gone green.
No harbor below, no hulls to return,
Just a ridge full of paths and a map left to learn.

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to call the crooked beam a mistake,
Now I watch what the mountain wakes.

[Chorus]
Point me past the roads I thought I had to take,
Past the fault lines, past the careful shape.
If my light falls where the wild roots start,
Let it show the country inside my heart.
I’m not a wrong-way signal, not a flaw to erase—
I can turn what I am toward an unmarked place.

[Verse 2]
One pane is chipped; the whole tower sings,
A small bent angle changes everything.
The trail climbs out where the dark firs part,
And the dawn finds a door in the map of my heart.

[Bridge]
Keep the cracked glass; keep the wandering flame.
Tomorrow has no chart with my name.

[Final Chorus]
Point me past the roads I thought I had to take,
Past the fault lines, past the careful shape.
If my light falls where the wild roots start,
Let it show the country inside my heart.
I’m not a wrong-way signal, not a flaw to erase—
I can turn what I am toward an unmarked place.
[Outro]
An unmarked place; the hills open wide.

title: Building Room for Something
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Room one: the paper-wing machine
I built at twelve from glue and tin
It never rose above the floor
I left the little launch marks in
Room two holds every almost-me
In coats of dust and borrowed names
I used to lock the doors at dusk
Now I turn the brass key again

[Pre-Chorus]
Come see the seams, the crooked frames
The plans that changed before they flew
I’m done pretending I was made
Without the work that brought me through

[Chorus]
I open every door, let the daylight take its measure
All my unfinished shapes belong beneath this roof
I am not the failed design; I’m the hand that keeps on drawing
Past the last display, I’m building room for something new

[Verse 2]
A glass case keeps the map I tore
When every road bent out of line
A model city missing streets
Still shows me where I meant to climb
The visitors leave penciled notes
Beside the names I couldn’t keep
I read them as the evening comes
And let the next foundation sleep

[Bridge]
No blueprint owns the coming years
No door must stay where it was set
I carry every measured flaw
As useful marks, not my regret

[Final Chorus]
I open every door, let the daylight take its measure
All my unfinished shapes belong beneath this roof
I am not the failed design; I’m the hand that keeps on drawing
Past the last display, I’m building room for something new

[Outro]
One more wing, one more beginning
Leave the old rooms open wide

title: The Note Between the Notes
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They bolted extra keys between the keys,
A little brass mistake where no one asked.
I played one note; the room said, “Please,”
Then every careful measure cracked.
You watched me hide my crooked hand,
As if the flaw could stain the tune.
But those odd notes made a doorway stand
Where the old notes stopped too soon.

[Pre-Chorus]
So leave the ruler in its case,
Let the wrong-way intervals make space.

[Chorus]
I’m not a broken instrument—
I’m the note between the notes.
Turn the strange apart into a place
Where a new kind of tomorrow grows.
If the melody bends, let it bend;
If it stumbles, let it start again.
I can make a future no old keyboard knows,
With every extra key beneath my hands.

[Verse 2]
The neighbors called it out of tune,
The tuner packed his little case.
I found a chord that split the moon—
No, just the ceiling, but it changed the place.
You said, “That sound is yours to keep.”
I said, “Then let it lead me on.”
The odd keys woke the house from sleep;
By morning, something new was drawn.

[Bridge]
Not a defect to erase,
Not a mold to fit inside—
Every unfamiliar place
Can become a road I try.

[Final Chorus]
I’m not a broken instrument—
I’m the note between the notes.
Turn the strange apart into a place
Where a new kind of tomorrow grows.
If the melody bends, let it bend;
If it stumbles, let it start again.
I can make a future no old keyboard knows,
With every extra key beneath my hands.

[Outro]
One more key, one more way forward;
I’ll play the sound that only I can know.

title: Seventeen Moons
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My north pole leans like a door left ajar,
Seventeen moons keep changing the dark.
One pulls the oceans up over the stone,
One calls the snow where the warm winds roam.
I used to call every crooked line wrong;
Now even my shadows know where they belong.

[Pre-Chorus]
The orbit slips; the calendar lies.
Still, something green opens its eyes.

[Chorus]
Seventeen moons, and none in a row—
Pull me apart, then teach me to grow.
Odd little tides, let them rise, let them run;
I’m not a mistake in the making of sun.
Seventeen moons, let the wild seasons turn;
I carry the strange, and the strange lets life bloom.

[Verse 2]
My cliffs grow gardens where salt winds sleep,
Blue trees drink from the cracks too deep.
No other world has this weather to spare;
No other world puts these colors in air.
I quit asking the sky to hold still—
I’ve got a whole future to bend to my will.

[Pre-Chorus]
The orbit slips; the calendar lies.
Still, something green opens its eyes.

[Chorus]
Seventeen moons, and none in a row—
Pull me apart, then teach me to grow.
Odd little tides, let them rise, let them run;
I’m not a mistake in the making of sun.
Seventeen moons, let the wild seasons turn;
I carry the strange, and the strange lets life bloom.

[Bridge]
Let the old map tear.
Let the new roots climb.
I’ve got room for tomorrow
In this lopsided sky.

[Final Chorus]
Seventeen moons, and none in a row—
Pull me apart, then teach me to grow.
Odd little tides, let them rise, let them run;
I’m not a mistake in the making of sun.
Seventeen moons, let the wild seasons turn;
I carry the strange, and the strange lets life bloom.
[Outro]
The next dawn grows here.

title: Uneven Moons
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Seventeen moons pull crooked at the sea
Your orbit slips; the calendar disagrees
You call the bent horizon something wrong
While violet reeds take root where tides run long

[Pre-Chorus]
No map can name the weather in your chest
Still, every strange season makes a place to nest

[Chorus]
You are the world that won’t stay in its lane
A tide turned sideways, rain against the grain
And in the cracks your wildest gardens start
No other sky could grow what’s in your heart
So keep your uneven moons and face the dawn
The future’s wide enough to orbit on

[Verse 2]
One moon arrives while another drifts away
The bright salt flowers open out of phase
You thought your changing coast would leave you bare
But small bright lives have learned to flourish there

[Pre-Chorus]
No map can name the weather in your chest
Still, every strange season makes a place to nest

[Chorus]
You are the world that won’t stay in its lane
A tide turned sideways, rain against the grain
And in the cracks your wildest gardens start
No other sky could grow what’s in your heart
So keep your uneven moons and face the dawn
The future’s wide enough to orbit on

[Outro]
Seventeen moons; let every one be known
The next strange season—you can meet it whole

title: The Bright Machine
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You built a clock to boil an egg

title: The Hinge and the Gill

title: Twenty Clocks
lyrics:

Twenty clocks crowd the shelf above your bed,

Turn with the tilt! (Turn with the tilt!)
Carry the crack! (Carry the crack!)
I’m not a copy of a map
I’m taking every angle forward
Turn with the tilt! (Turn with the tilt!)
No looking back! (No looking back!)
The crooked points still chart a path

Every angle forward

title: Head Held High
lyrics:
[Verse]
I kept a list of every little crack
The crooked grin, the words I’d take right back
But all those marks are mine to understand

[Pre-Chorus]
No perfect shape, no borrowed skin

[Chorus]
I take my whole self, every side of me
The rough and tender parts I used to hide
I’m still becoming, still becoming
I face tomorrow with my head held high

[Verse 2]
The old mistakes still visit now and then
I meet them kindly, then begin again
A little more sure-footed than before
I leave the latch undone and open doors

[Chorus]
I take my whole self, every side of me
The rough and tender parts I used to hide
I’m still becoming, still becoming
I face tomorrow with my head held high

[Bridge]
Let the next page wait beneath my hand
