[Final Chorus]
I take my whole self, every side of me
The rough and tender parts I used to hide
I’m still becoming, still becoming
I face tomorrow with my head held high
[Outro]
Still becoming, head held high

title: Take The Whole Of Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to hide the cracks in every photograph
And measure every word before I let it pass
But all these crooked edges carried me this far
I’m learning how to meet myself exactly where we are

[Pre-Chorus]
No need to sand me down
No need to turn around

[Chorus]
I take the whole of me, the rough and tender parts
I let the old mistakes become a map, not marks
I’m walking toward the day with open hands and eyes
I take the whole of me—and let tomorrow rise

[Verse 2]
Some mornings I still stumble over what I can’t undo
I leave a little room for all the ways I’m still brand new
The plans I drew in pencil can be redrawn as I go
There’s more ahead than all the things I used to know

[Bridge]
Every scar has something true to say
I can listen, then keep moving anyway

[Chorus]
I take the whole of me, the rough and tender parts
I let the old mistakes become a map, not marks
I’m walking toward the day with open hands and eyes
I take the whole of me—and let tomorrow rise

[Outro]
Let tomorrow rise

title: The Person That I Am
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to hide the crack in every plan
And wear a borrowed smile when I could
But every crooked line has brought me here
I’m learning how to hold myself with care

[Verse 2]
I miss a step, then find another way
I say the wrong thing, own it, make it right
The parts I judged are still a part of me
I meet them now with room enough to breathe

[Chorus]
I’m still becoming, I’m still on my way
I take my whole heart into a brighter day
Every rough edge, every honest scar
I’ll keep moving forward as the person that I am

[Verse 3]
Tomorrow isn’t asking me to shine
It only asks me not to turn away
I’ll take the lesson, leave the blame behind
And make a little more room for the light

[Bridge]
If I lose my footing, I can start again
No perfect map, no need to pretend
I’ll meet the morning open-eyed
With all I am, I’ll step outside

[Chorus]
I’m still becoming, I’m still on my way
I take my whole heart into a brighter day
Every rough edge, every honest scar
I’ll keep moving forward as the person that I am

[Outro]
Still becoming, still on my way
Whole heart open to a brighter day

title: I’ll Take This Life Instead
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list of things to fix
In the margin of my notebook
That old green coat, the chipped front tooth
The way I lose my place mid-sentence

[Pre-Chorus]
There you are, a step ahead
Perfect posture, perfect plans
I run hard, you turn your head
I laugh and let you pass

[Chorus]
I’m still here, I’m still here
With my crooked little compass
I can love the road I’m on
Even when I’m not the best one
I’m still here, I’m still here
All my rough edges come with me
That better me can race ahead
I’ll take this life instead

[Verse 2]
Burnt toast, late bus, rain on my sleeve
I make a joke and miss the cue
Some days I’m brave, some days I leave
A half-done list beside the sink

[Pre-Chorus]
There you are, a step ahead
Never tired, never unsure
I wave you on, then breathe again
I don’t have to win that race

[Chorus]
I’m still here, I’m still here
With my crooked little compass
I can love the road I’m on
Even when I’m not the best one
I’m still here, I’m still here
All my rough edges come with me
That better me can race ahead
I’ll take this life instead

[Bridge]
Let the mirror keep its measuring
Let the morning find me late
I can hold the parts I’m changing
And the parts I’ll always make

[Final Chorus]
I’m still here, I’m still here
With my crooked little compass
I can love the road I’m on
Even when I’m not the best one
I’m still here, I’m still here
All my rough edges come with me
That better me can race ahead
I’ll take this life instead

[Outro]
I’ll take this life instead

title: I'm Still Here
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list of all my almosts
Folded in my jacket seam
Every page says, “Try again, then
Be the person in your dreams”
But I’m tired of being measured
By a face I’ve never been
So I’ll leave that list unopened
Let the ordinary in

[Pre-Chorus]
I have dents I didn’t choose
I have good I can’t explain
Both are standing in my shoes
Both can come along today

[Chorus]
I’m still here, I’m still here
With my rough edges and my open hands
I’m still here, I’m still here
Not the perfect one I planned
Let that better me keep running
I don’t have to disappear
I can take this life as it is
I’m still here

[Verse 2]
There’s a cup beside the sink now
With a chip beside the rim
I used to hide it from the company
Now I pour the coffee in
I can miss the mark on Tuesday
Laugh about it on the stairs
I’m not waiting for permission
To be glad that I am here

[Bridge]
Maybe I’ll grow, maybe I won’t
Maybe both can still be true
I can love the life I’m living
While I’m reaching for what’s new

[Final Chorus]
I’m still here, I’m still here
With my rough edges and my open hands
I’m still here, I’m still here
Not the perfect one I planned
Let that better me keep running
I don’t have to disappear
I can take this life as it is
I’m still here

title: Ghost of Who I Could Have
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Scars and stains on a beaten heart
Torn up shoes right from the start
Looking in the mirror at the crack
Wondering if I can ever turn it back
Every shadow carries what I missed
Ghost of someone sitting on my list
Chasing down an echo in the dark

[Pre-Chorus]
She's so much taller, she's so much brave
Running circles right above my grave
Hold your breath, don't look down
She's the queen of this whole town

[Chorus]
Ghost of who I could have been
Chasing me through thick and thin
I stumble through the best I know
And let the phantom shadows go
Ghost of who I could have been
Telling me I'll never win
I'm holding onto right right now
Embracing every single flaw somehow

[Verse 2]
Coffee spills on a dirty floor
Knocking softly on an open door
Tripping up on every single step
Living out the promises I kept
She's a masterpiece I'll never reach
Walking down a distant golden beach
While I'm standing right here in the rain

[Pre-Chorus]
She's so much taller, she's so much brave
Running circles right above my grave
Hold your breath, don't look down
She's the queen of this whole town

[Chorus]
Ghost of who I could have been
Chasing me through thick and thin
I stumble through the best I know
And let the phantom shadows go
Ghost of who I could have been
Telling me I'll never win
I'm holding onto right right now
Embracing every single flaw somehow

[Bridge]
At the edge of what I thought I'd be
I turn around and finally look at me
She can keep her crown of endless light
I'll take the mess and make it mine tonight

[Final Chorus]
Ghost of who I could have been
Chasing me through thick and thin
I stumble through the best I know
And let the phantom shadows go
Ghost of who I could have been
Telling me I'll never win
I'm holding onto right right now
Embracing every single flaw somehow

title: Enough Without Another
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list of things to fix
In the pocket of my oldest jeans
Every page says, “Not quite yet,”
Every margin says, “Be more than me”

[Pre-Chorus]
But I’m still here, still breathing in
With all my rough edges showing

[Chorus]
I’m not the almost, I’m not the after
I’m this heart, this mess, this laughter
Let that perfect shadow run
I’ll take today, I’ll take the sun
I’m not the almost, I’m not the maybe
I can love the life that made me
Every crack and every color
I’m enough without another

[Verse 2]
I say the wrong thing, miss the turn
Burn the toast and laugh it off
Some days I’m brave, some days I learn
That being human’s not a flaw

[Pre-Chorus]
That better me can chase the wind
I’ll meet this moment where I’m standing

[Bridge]
If I never catch that distant face
I still have this life to live

[Final Chorus]
I’m not the almost, I’m not the after
I’m this heart, this mess, this laughter
Let that perfect shadow run
I’ll take today, I’ll take the sun
I’m not the almost, I’m not the maybe
I can love the life that made me
Every crack and every color
I’m enough without another

[Outro]
I’m enough, I’m enough
Without another

title: Meet Myself Right Here
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list of all my almosts
Folded small beside the bed
Every morning wears their faces
Every plan I never had

[Pre-Chorus]
They walk ahead, so clean and bright
I chase them till I lose my sight

[Chorus]
I am not the one I might have been
I am this hand, this heart, this skin
All my crooked parts come in
I let them sit beside me
Life keeps opening its door
I don’t need to win that race
The better me can run ahead
I’ll meet myself right here

[Verse 2]
There’s a chipped cup by the window
There’s a bill I meant to pay
There’s a laugh that comes out crooked
And I’m keeping it today

[Pre-Chorus]
That perfect shadow knows my name
But I don’t owe it every day

[Chorus]
I am not the one I might have been
I am this hand, this heart, this skin
All my crooked parts come in
I let them sit beside me
Life keeps opening its door
I don’t need to win that race
The better me can run ahead
I’ll meet myself right here

[Bridge]
Let the unfinished morning find me
Let the wrong turn have its view
I can carry what I’m made of
And still make something new

[Final Chorus]
I am not the one I might have been
I am this hand, this heart, this skin
All my crooked parts come in
I let them sit beside me
Life keeps opening its door
I don’t need to win that race
The better me can run ahead
I’ll meet myself right here

[Outro]
I’ll meet myself right here

title: The Self I Can't Quite Catch
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list inside my coat
Of every way I missed the mark
The ink runs blue against my thumb
I fold it small and carry on

[Pre-Chorus]
There’s someone just ahead of me
With cleaner hands and steadier feet
I watch him take the turning fast
Then choose the road beneath my path

[Chorus]
I’m not the one I meant to be
I’m still the one who’s here
With every crooked, honest piece
I make a life from here
Let that better ghost run on
I have a day to live
I’m done waiting to become
The self I can’t quite catch

[Verse 2]
The kettle clicks, the rent is due
A plant leans hard toward window light
I call my sister back at last
And let the little things count

[Pre-Chorus]
That polished face keeps pace with me
But doesn’t know what I have seen
I’ve made a home with what I’ve got
And learned to love the uneven parts

[Chorus]
I’m not the one I meant to be
I’m still the one who’s here
With every crooked, honest piece
I make a life from here
Let that better ghost run on
I have a day to live
I’m done waiting to become
The self I can’t quite catch

[Bridge]
Let him vanish round the bend
I won’t bargain with the end
This breath, this bruise, this open door
I’m not asking to be more

[Final Chorus]
I’m not the one I meant to be
I’m still the one who’s here
With every crooked, honest piece
I make a life from here
Let that better ghost run on
I have a day to live
I’m done waiting to become
The self I can’t quite catch

[Outro]
I’m here, I’m here
And that is mine to give

title: The Better Ghost
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list behind the kitchen door
The names of all the selves I should have been
One speaks in perfect plans and polished shoes
One never lets the afternoon come in

I spill the tea, I miss the turn
I say too much, then take it back
The good I do is still my own
The crooked line is still my track

[Pre-Chorus]
You don't have to make me new
You can let the whole thing through

[Chorus]
I am not the almost-version
Not the prize I couldn't win
I can live inside this body
With the weather moving in
Let the better ghost keep walking
I won't chase it down the road
I have hands to hold this moment
I have room to bear my own

[Verse 2]
The sink is full, the rent is due
My old blue jacket lost a button
I call my sister just to hear
Her tell the story wrong and laughing

Some days I am a locked-up room
Some days a window left ajar
Both can stand beneath the same sky
Both can make it where they are

[Pre-Chorus]
You don't have to make me new
You can let the whole thing through

[Chorus]
I am not the almost-version
Not the prize I couldn't win
I can live inside this body
With the weather moving in
Let the better ghost keep walking
I won't chase it down the road
I have hands to hold this moment
I have room to bear my own

[Bridge]
I see you at the far end of the hall
With every answer ready, standing tall
But I have grown a life you never knew
A chipped cup, open windows, people who
Know when I go quiet, let me be
And leave a little space beside the tea

[Final Chorus]
I am not the almost-version
Not the prize I couldn't win
I can live inside this body
With the weather moving in
Let the better ghost keep walking
I won't chase it down the road
I have hands to hold this moment
I have room to bear my own

[Outro]
The list can stay behind the door
I don't have to read it anymore

title: Take My Crooked Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep the chipped blue cup you cracked
The one you swore you'd throw away
Some mornings I still talk too fast
Some nights I let the dishes stay

[Pre-Chorus]
There you are in the glass again
Tall and sure with a cleaner name
I take one breath, let the kettle sing
I don't have to become that thing

[Chorus]
I make room for the parts that don't behave
For the tender nerve, for the stubborn stain
That polished ghost can run ahead
I have this life, this skin, this day
I won't wait till I'm fixed to step outside
I'll take my crooked heart along for the ride

[Verse 2]
I missed the call from my sister twice
Then sent a photo of the rain
She sent back her lopsided grin
And asked me over just the same

[Pre-Chorus]
There you are with your measured words
Never late and never lost
I can hear you pacing down the hall
But you don't get to name me all

[Chorus]
I make room for the parts that don't behave
For the tender nerve, for the stubborn stain
That polished ghost can run ahead
I have this life, this skin, this day
I won't wait till I'm fixed to step outside
I'll take my crooked heart along for the ride

[Bridge]
At the sink, I let the warm water run
My hands still shaking, the day's not done
No grand reveal, no perfect start
Just soap on my sleeve and a beating heart

[Final Chorus]
I make room for the parts that don't behave
For the tender nerve, for the stubborn stain
That polished ghost can run ahead
I have this life, this skin, this day
I won't wait till I'm fixed to step outside
I'll take my crooked heart along for the ride

[Outro]
The cup still holds
The morning comes
I am not finished
I am enough

title: Imperfect Stars
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There’s a ghost in the mirror that I can't outrun
Smarter and faster, bright like the sun
He moves through the shadows of choices I missed
Holding a map of a life that doesn't exist

[Pre-Chorus]
He never stumbles, he never breaks down
He wears the quiet like a silver crown
But I’m standing here in the mud and the light
Learning to make peace with the fight

[Chorus]
I'm flawed at the edges, broken inside
Got nowhere to run, nowhere to hide
He’s the better version I’ll never become
But I’m still breathing to the beat of my drum
Embracing the cracks, accepting the scars
Living right here under imperfect stars

[Verse 2]
I used to chase him through every regret
Counting the promises I couldn't keep yet
He walks through the doorway I failed to unlock
While I count the seconds on a rusty old clock

[Bridge]
Let him keep his perfection, let him hold the sky
I’m down in the valley where the wild weeds grow high
I don't need to be golden to feel what is real
I just need to take what this life lets me feel

[Chorus]
I'm flawed at the edges, broken inside
Got nowhere to run, nowhere to hide
He’s the better version I’ll never become
But I’m still breathing to the beat of my drum
Embracing the cracks, accepting the scars
Living right here under imperfect stars

[Outro]
Goodbye to the shadow I couldn't catch
I’m lighting a flame with a single match
Imperfect and present, I am enough
Out in the open, tender and rough

title: A Sky Wide Enough
lyrics:
[Intro: solo piano, distant fretless bass]
[Warm intimate baritone]
I used to think a better world
Was something someone had to build
Some perfect plan, some final answer
Some impossible ideal

[Verse 1: flowing melodic rhythm]
But I have seen a thousand moments
That could change the way we live
A hand extended without asking
What another hand could give
A voice allowed to sound different
A wrong forgiven over time
A door held open for a stranger
A little room for another life

[Pre-Chorus: rising stacked harmonies]
Maybe peace is not a place
Where every difference disappears
Maybe it's the choice we make
To love despite our fears

[Chorus: soaring cinematic major-key lift]
There's a sky wide enough for everyone
A thousand stars and a thousand suns
We can walk a million different roads
And still find somewhere to belong
I don't need to make you just like me
To celebrate the things that make you free
There's a sky wide enough for everyone
And enough light for everyone to see

[Instrumental: melodic bass solo, soaring guitar counterpoint]

[Verse 2: warm baritone, gradually intensifying]
We won't always understand
Every life that passes through
But we can choose a little kindness
When we don't know what to do
No perfect people, no perfection
Just the courage to begin
To make the world a little gentler
With the way we welcome in

[Bridge: beatless piano, layered falsetto]
We can be different
We can be wrong
We can be strangers
And still belong

[Final Chorus: key change, full choir, epic finale]
There's a sky wide enough for everyone
No need to steal another's sun
Let a thousand different futures grow
And let a thousand rivers run
[Half-time, sustained emotional peak]
If we want a world with room for love
Then love is what we have to do
Not just a dream of something better
But the way I treat you

[Outro: piano, warm sustained harmony]
The sky was always wide enough
We only had to look up.

title: Outgrow the Armor
lyrics:
[Intro: distorted 808, distant guitar]

[Verse 1: tense syncopated baritone]
I built a suit of heavy armor
Out of everything I feared
Every stranger looked like danger
Every difference felt severe
Then somebody brought me dinner
When the winter knocked me down
And the first plate in my armor
Fell without a sound

[Pre-Chorus: rising falsetto]
I'd been fighting every shadow
When the sun was all around

[Chorus: explosive soaring harmonies]
We can outgrow the armor
We don't have to live at war
Not every unfamiliar face
Is something we should fear anymore
I can lower my defenses
Without pretending there's no pain
Let a little light come through me
Let somebody in again

[Break: heavy riddim bass, distorted guitar]

[Verse 2: flowing melodic delivery]
I began with little gestures
Just a smile, a question, time
Found a thousand complicated people
Living lives as real as mine

[Bridge: half-time, vulnerable]
Trust isn't blindness
And courage isn't never being scared
It's finding someone worth believing in
And choosing to be there

[Final Chorus: major-key lift, stacked harmonies]
We can outgrow the armor
Let the heavy pieces fall
I would rather build a friendship
Than another fortress wall

[Outro: clean guitar resolves]

title: Every Road Has Room
lyrics:
[Intro: fingerpicked guitar, flowing bass]

[Verse 1: warm conversational melody]
You arrived with two old suitcases
And a language I barely knew
Had a thousand little stories
About the roads that carried you
I offered you a cup of coffee
And a place to rest your feet
By the time the sun was setting
We were laughing in the street

[Pre-Chorus: rising harmonies]
Every stranger has a story
Every journey has a name

[Chorus: soaring expansive melody]
Every road has room for someone
Every sky has space for flight
Every heart deserves a chance
To find a place that feels just right
We can come from different places
And still make a common home
Every road has room for someone
No one dreams of being alone

[Break: melodic guitar solo, rolling toms]

[Verse 2: lilting baritone]
You taught me words I'd never spoken
And a recipe from home
Now your family comes for dinner
And our little table's grown

[Bridge: half-time, delicate harmony]
I don't have to share your history
To make a little room for you

[Final Chorus: choir harmonies, major-key lift]
Every road has room for someone
Let the different stories meet
The world becomes a little warmer
With another chair and seat

[Outro: acoustic guitar and bass fade]

title: Market of Small Wonders
lyrics:
[Intro: funky bass, brass synth accents]

[Verse 1: playful melodic baritone]
I made a little something
Out of everything I knew
You brought a different kind of magic
Made of things I couldn't do
I showed you what I'd been creating
You showed me something new
And what began as two small wonders
Turned to something neither knew

[Pre-Chorus: ascending stacked thirds]
I don't need to take your treasure
To find something good in mine

[Chorus: bright infectious melody]
Come to the market of small wonders
Bring the things you love to make
Every little gift of talent
Is a chance for us to trade
There's a world of hidden riches
In the things we freely share
We can make each other richer
With a little mutual care

[Break: virtuosic slap bass, counterpoint guitars]

[Verse 2: rhythmic sing-rap]
You taught me how to fix the engine
I taught you how to play a song
And somehow both our little worlds
Got bigger as we moved along

[Bridge: half-time, layered melody]
Nobody knows a little bit of everything
Everybody knows a little something

[Final Chorus: triumphant harmony stacks]
Come to the market of small wonders
Every hand has something new
I can build a brighter future
When I make something with you

[Outro: playful fretless bass resolution]

title: Door Inside The Ashes
lyrics:
[Intro: distant crackling, lonely piano]

[Verse 1: fragile baritone]
We said the things that turn to ashes
Burned a bridge we used to cross
Watched the smoke erase the distance
Till we couldn't see what we'd lost
I kept a list of all your failures
Like a book I'd memorized
Then I saw you trying to change
With the sorrow in your eyes

[Pre-Chorus: ascending falsetto]
I won't pretend the fire was kind
But I can leave the flames behind

[Chorus: explosive major-key harmonies]
There's a door inside the ashes
There's a road beyond the pain
We can carry what we've learned
Without carrying every chain
I don't owe you back my trust
You don't owe me who you were
But I can leave a little room
For a better world to occur

[Break: soaring guitar over half-time drums]

[Verse 2: intimate legato]
You said the words without excuses
Then you changed what you could change
I could see a different person
Growing through the wreckage

[Bridge: beatless, sustained melody]
Forgiveness isn't forgetting
And healing isn't always staying
Sometimes it's setting down the fire
And choosing not to feed it

[Final Chorus: stacked choir, cathartic]
There's a door inside the ashes
And a morning past the smoke
We are more than all the moments
When our better selves were broken

[Outro: piano resolves to major]

title: Room Between the Notes
lyrics:
[Intro: two guitars play opposing melodies]

[Verse 1: quick syncopated baritone]
You brought a song I'd never heard
With crooked chords and unfamiliar words
My first reaction was to change
The notes that sounded out of range
But then I heard the rhythm underneath
A different kind of beauty in the beat

[Pre-Chorus: layered counterpoint]
Let me finish what I'm singing
Then I'll listen to your line

[Chorus: bright soaring harmonies]
Leave a little room between the notes

You can sing a song I wouldn't choose
And still have something beautiful to prove
We don't need to sound alike
To make the whole room come alive
Leave a little room between the notes
And let a thousand voices rise

[Break: dueling guitar and bass melodies]

[Verse 2: playful melodic phrasing]
We played our songs across the table
Found some chords we couldn't share
But when the evening turned to morning
Both our melodies were there

[Bridge: half-time, vocal duet]
(You sing yours)
And I'll sing mine
[Harmonies gradually intertwine]
We found a rhythm neither had designed

[Final Chorus: octave lift, rich harmonies]
Leave a little room between the notes

[Outro: unresolved jazz chord resolves]

title: Hands Without Strings
lyrics:
[Intro: muted slap bass, guitar harmonics]

[Verse 1: rhythmic melodic baritone]
I saw you carrying a mountain
With your hands already full
I could offer you a shoulder
Or pretend I didn't know
So I took a little weight
And walked beside you for a while
Didn't ask for your allegiance
Didn't wait to see you smile

[Pre-Chorus: rising gritty harmonies]
If every gift becomes a chain
Then what did anybody gain?

[Chorus: explosive melodic lift]
These are hands without strings
I don't need to pull you close
I can give without collecting
Every favor that you owe
Let the good we do be weightless
Let it travel, let it sing
There's a different kind of freedom
In these hands without strings

[Break: distorted bass and polyrhythmic guitar]

[Verse 2: warm melodic groove]
You might never know my birthday
You might never know my name
But you stood a little taller
And that's reason I came

[Bridge: half-time, fragile]
I don't need to keep a ledger
Of the kindness that I give

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies]
These are hands without strings
Open palms and nothing more
If you're strong enough tomorrow
Help somebody through their door

[Outro: sustained guitar harmonics]
And the good goes on.

title: Borrow Your Eyes
genres: atmospheric trip hop melodic progressive art rock dark idm 124 bpm Trip Hop

lyrics:
[Intro: rain texture, detuned piano]

[Verse 1: intimate, breathy baritone]
You came into the room like thunder
I mistook your fear for rage
Started writing out your character
Before I'd read a single page
Then you told me about your morning
And the nights that came before
Suddenly the stranger standing here
Wasn't strange anymore

[Pre-Chorus: ascending falsetto]
I don't have to feel your pain
To understand it's real

[Chorus: soaring layered melody]
Let me borrow your eyes
For a moment of your life
See the shadows on the walls
That you have learned to live behind
I may never walk your road
But I can meet you where you are
And the distance gets much smaller
When I listen with my heart

[Break: melodic fretless bass, granular drums]

[Verse 2: flowing melodic phrasing]
You don't have to be an angel
I don't have to think you're right
I can see the human being
In the middle of the fight

[Bridge: drums fade, fragile duet]
(You don't know me)
Then let me learn
(You can't fix me)
That's not my turn

[Final Chorus: warm harmonic lift]
Let me borrow your eyes
And lend you mine in return
We may never see alike
But there's so much we can learn

[Outro: piano and bass dissolve]

title: A Thousand Different Windows
lyrics:
[Intro: interlocking guitar harmonics]

[Verse 1: playful syncopated melody]
You see a mountain in the distance
I see a castle in the clouds
Someone else sees coming weather
And somebody sees a way around
We stand before the same horizon
With a thousand different eyes
And every little interpretation
Adds a color to the sky

[Pre-Chorus: ascending vocal counterpoint]
Who says a single pane of glass
Must hold the whole world looking back?

[Chorus: bright soaring harmonies]
A thousand different windows
A thousand shades of blue
The world gets so much bigger
When I see it next to you
We don't have to share a vision
To admire what we see
There's a beauty in the difference
Between your world and me

[Break: 7/8 guitar and fretless bass duet]

[Verse 2: melodic baritone]
You tell me what I've overlooked
I show you something from my view
And neither one must close a window
For the other's light to shine through

[Bridge: suspended chords, layered thirds]
Let every room have different light
Together they illuminate the night

[Final Chorus: explosive octave harmonies]
A thousand different windows
Let the colors come alive
We can love the same horizon
Without seeing the same sky

[Outro: interlocking guitars resolve]

title: Free Enough
lyrics:
[Intro: warm Rhodes, fretless bass]
[Soft melodic baritone]
I never wanted someone
Who was frightened to be free

[Verse 1: syncopated sing-rap]
I could build a thousand fences
Put a lock upon the gate
Call the walls a kind of shelter
Call the keys a kind of fate
But I'd rather watch you wander
Knowing you might come back home
Than keep your heart beside me
When it longs to be alone

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonies]
A hand held open to the sky
Can hold more love than one held tight

[Chorus: soaring, stacked major thirds]
I wanna be free enough to love
And brave enough to let you go
Give you every reason to stay
Without demanding that you do
Love isn't something that we own
It's something beautiful we choose
And every day you choose me
Is a gift I couldn't make you give

[Break: melodic bass solo, chopped vocal accents]

[Verse 2: warm legato]
If tomorrow takes you elsewhere
I will wish you every star
And if our roads keep running parallel
I'll love you as you are

[Bridge: half-time, vulnerable falsetto]
I don't need to own your tomorrow
To treasure who you are today

[Final Chorus: octave lift, epic harmonies]
Free enough to love
Strong enough to trust
A thousand open doors
And still there's room for us

[Outro: sustained major chord]
Come close because you want to.

title: Kite String
lyrics:
[Intro: airy guitar harmonics, fretless bass]

[Verse 1: intimate melodic baritone]
You told me about a distant city
And the work you dreamed you'd do
I felt the selfish little panic
Of a world without you

I could tell you all the reasons
That your dream might be unwise
Or help you fold your wings
And watch you try to fly

[Pre-Chorus: ascending stacked thirds]
I don't have to love the distance
To believe in where you're going

[Chorus: soaring, wide harmonies]
I won't turn the kite string into chains
Won't hold you down to keep things the same
If the wind is calling out your name
I'll cheer you on through all the change
Love is not a hand that closes tight
Sometimes kindness means encouraging flight

[Break: syncopated bass, counterpoint lead guitar]

[Verse 2: warm melodic]
I helped you pack the moving boxes
Found the routes and checked the train
Said I'd miss our little mornings
And I meant it without blame

[Bridge: half-time, emotional falsetto]
I can grieve the space between us
Without making you feel wrong
For following the life you want
Beyond the place where I belong

[Final Chorus: octave lift, epic finale]
I won't turn the kite string into chains
Let your horizon rearrange
If I love the person you can be
I'll make room for what sets you free

[Outro: sustained guitar harmonies]
Fly as far as you can see.

title: Open Up The Toolbox
lyrics:
[Intro: mechanical percussion, slap bass groove]

[Verse 1: playful syncopated baritone]
I've got a drill I use twice a year
A ladder gathering dust in here
My neighbor needs to fix a shelf
But can't afford the tools himself

I carried everything next door
And asked what else he needed for

[Pre-Chorus: ascending guitar counterpoint]
A thing that sits upon a shelf
Could make a difference somewhere else

[Chorus: bright explosive harmonies]
Open up the toolbox
Let the neighborhood get strong
There's enough to build together
When we pass our blessings on
What if all the things we're keeping
Had a thousand lives to live?
A kinder world's constructed
From the things we're glad to give

[Break: interlocking bass and guitar polyrhythms]

[Verse 2: melodic baritone]
He fixed the shelf and helped a friend
Who brought the ladder home again
Now someone shares a sewing kit
And someone else knows how to fix

[Bridge: half-time, warm harmonies]
We built a little more than shelves
We built a way to help ourselves

[Final Chorus: soaring major lift]
Open up the toolbox
Let the good keep passing through
We can build a better neighborhood
With what we already knew

[Outro: bass and guitar in unison]

title: An Arrow I Never Fired
lyrics:
[Intro: distorted staccato guitar, glitch beats]

[Verse 1: tight rhythmic baritone]
I read a comment on my screen
From someone trying to be mean
I wrote a hundred sharpened words
The cleverest ones they'd ever heard

My finger hovered over send
I read the whole thing back again

[Pre-Chorus: tense ascending harmonies]
It would feel so good to strike
But would I like the world I'd make?

[Chorus: explosive major-key hook]
There's an arrow I never fired
There's a wound I chose to spare
I don't need to leave somebody bleeding
Just to prove that I was there
I can argue with conviction
Without poisoning the air
The strongest words I've ever written
Might be the ones I didn't share

[Break: chaotic bass slaps, jagged guitar]

[Verse 2: flowing melodic delivery]
I cleared the page and tried again
Asked a question, not condemned
We still disagreed when we were done
But neither had to claim they'd won

[Bridge: half-time, vulnerable]
A cutting line can win a crowd
And still leave kindness bleeding out

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, cathartic]
There's an arrow I never fired
And a little less damage in the world
Not every weapon in our hands
Deserves the chance to hurt

[Outro: soft guitar resolution]

title: Plant the Shade for a Stranger
lyrics:
[Intro: fingerpicked guitar, melodic bass pulse]

[Verse 1: gentle syncopated baritone]
There's an empty patch beside the road
Where summer burns the earth below
I planted something small today
And watered it before the rain

A neighbor asked me why I'd care
When years must pass before there's shade

[Pre-Chorus: ascending vocal thirds]
Not every gift we leave behind
Is meant to flower in our time

[Chorus: soaring major-key melody]
I'll plant the shade for a stranger
Let the roots grow deep and strong
Someone that I'll never meet
Might rest here when I'm gone
We don't have to see the harvest
To believe the seeds are good
I'll make tomorrow a little kinder
Everywhere I could

[Break: slap bass, polyrhythmic toms]

[Verse 2: warm melodic phrasing]
I picked up litter by the creek
Helped restore the old park seats
Small repairs to places where
A future stranger might find peace

[Bridge: half-time, layered harmony]
Maybe I won't see the branches rise
But someone will enjoy the sky

[Final Chorus: epic cathartic lift]
I'll plant the shade for a stranger
Let the future find a friend
A little care for lives beyond us
Is a kindness without end

[Outro: resolving guitar counterpoint]

title: Net Beneath the Wire
lyrics:
[Intro: tense guitar harmonics, irregular toms]

[Verse 1: intimate rhythmic baritone]
You walked a wire above the floor
With everybody keeping score
One shaky step, your balance broke
And laughter filled the room like smoke

I didn't have a clever line
Just reached my hands out in time

[Pre-Chorus: climbing melodic thirds]
The world has plenty throwing stones
It needs more people catching those

[Chorus: explosive soaring melody]
I'll be the net beneath the wire
Not another voice demanding higher
If you stumble, if you fall
You haven't lost your worth at all
Take a breath and try once more
I'll help you find the steady floor

[Break: distorted rhythm guitar, slap bass]

[Verse 2: conversational melody]
You tried again, your hands still shook
I showed you where to place your foot
No promise that you'd never fall
Just room to learn beyond it all

[Bridge: half-time, fragile baritone]
We cannot take away each risk
But we can change what failure is

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, cathartic]
I'll be the net beneath the wire
Let courage rise above the fear
A kinder world gives people room
To fall and still be welcome here

[Outro: bright major resolution]

title: Bridge Without a Toll
lyrics:
[Intro: melodic fretless bass, rolling toms]

[Verse 1: conversational syncopation]
You needed help across a river
I had timber, rope, and time
I could build a little crossing
And put a price on every stride

But I remember when I struggled
And somebody pulled me through
Never handed me an invoice
Just said, "Someday help someone too"

[Pre-Chorus: rising guitar harmonies]
I don't want to own the road
Just because I helped you go

[Chorus: soaring stacked vocals]
I'll build a bridge without a toll
Let the people come and go
You don't owe me your devotion
You don't owe me what you know
If the world is full of rivers
We can make the crossing free
And the kindness that I give you
Doesn't have to come back to me

[Break: slap bass, 7/8 guitar counterpoint]

[Verse 2: warm melodic baritone]
I gave a friend a ride to work
And turned down what they tried to pay
I needed nothing from the moment
Except to help them on their way

[Bridge: half-time, tender]
Generosity grows smaller
When we turn it into debt

[Final Chorus: epic major lift]
I'll build a bridge without a toll
And leave it standing when I'm gone
Let another soul cross over
And keep the kindness moving on

[Outro: harmonized guitar sustain]

title: Put a Level on the Table
lyrics:
[Intro: odd-meter bass, staccato guitar]

[Verse 1: rhythmic baritone]
I watched the room stand taller
When the boss came walking in
Then shrink around the cleaner
Like they couldn't see his skin
I saw the way our voices changed
Depending who could help us win

[Pre-Chorus: layered ascending thirds]
I don't want my courtesy
To bend toward authority

[Chorus: explosive major-key harmonies]
Put a level on the table
Let the bubble settle true
I won't measure someone's value
By the things they do for you
Every title, every station
Every unfamiliar face
Deserves the same consideration
The same respect, the same grace

[Break: slap bass, counterpoint guitars]

[Verse 2: warm melodic delivery]
I learned the cleaner's name
And asked him how his evening went
Gave the intern time to finish
Every thought she tried to vent

[Bridge: half-time, intimate]
It's easy being gracious
When there's something you might gain
The measure of your kindness
Is how you treat the ones who can't

[Final Chorus: soaring octave harmonies]
Put a level on the table
Let our dignity run straight
Every person is a person
Long before they earn a name

[Outro: bright guitar resolution]

title: Bookmark in Your Story
lyrics:
[Intro: clean guitar arpeggios, warm fretless bass]

[Verse 1: intimate syncopated baritone]
You told me something heavy
On a Tuesday afternoon
I listened till you finished
Then we both left the room
But Wednesday came, and I remembered
That your story wasn't through

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonies]
A conversation shouldn't end
The moment someone's out of view

[Chorus: soaring melodic hook]
I'll leave a bookmark in your story
Come back to see how you've been
Not just there for all the headlines
But the quiet days between
Every chapter matters
Even when the pages turn
I'll remember where you left off
And return

[Break: melodic bass counterpoint, tom fills]

[Verse 2: flowing melody]
I sent a message Thursday
Asked about the thing you feared
You said, "Thanks for remembering"
And I was glad to hear

[Bridge: half-time, vulnerable]
Care is more than being present
For the moments people see

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, cathartic]
I'll leave a bookmark in your story
Keep a place for what comes next
Let my kindness have a memory
Longer than a single text

[Outro: sustained major chord]

title: Countermelody
lyrics:
[Intro: two guitars in contrasting keys]
[Fretless bass finds common pulse]

[Verse 1: syncopated baritone]
You hear the rhythm differently
Your melody collides with mine
I could demand you follow me
Or call your notes a waste of time

But I listened to the shape you made
And found a place where both could play

[Pre-Chorus: ascending counterpoint]
Two different lines, two different views
A richer song than either knew

[Chorus: soaring interwoven harmonies]
Be the countermelody
Not another voice in unison
We don't have to sound the same
To make a song worth listening
Let the tension turn to color
Let the differences remain
If we give each other room
We can harmonize the strange

[Break: dueling guitar leads, syncopated slap bass]

[Verse 2: melodic rhythmic flow]
We disagreed and stayed to hear
The reasons neither one could see
I didn't change my every thought
But changed how you could speak with me

[Bridge: half-time, intimate duet]
(Your truth isn't mine)
But I can hear your line
[Both melodies intertwine]

[Final Chorus: key lift, epic vocal stacks]
Be the countermelody
Let a million voices rise
Not a world without disagreement
But a world that still stays kind

[Outro: guitars resolve in harmony]

title: Be the Greenhouse
lyrics:
[Intro: glass chimes, fretless bass melody]

[Verse 1: intimate melodic phrasing]
You were learning something difficult
And couldn't make the pieces fit
I remembered how it felt
When I was struggling through it

Instead of telling you to hurry
Or comparing you to me
I sat beside you with a pencil
And worked through what you couldn't see

[Pre-Chorus: ascending vocal layers]
A flower doesn't bloom on cue
And neither does the best in you

[Chorus: soaring harmonized melody]
Be the greenhouse, not the stopwatch
Give the roots a little room
Don't confuse a slower season
With a life that cannot bloom
Every mind has different weather
Every heart a different spring
You can help somebody flourish
Without rushing anything

[Break: slap bass in 7/8, flowing guitar]

[Bridge: half-time, warm baritone]
We tried again another day
And found a different kind of way
The joy upon your face was worth
The time it took to understand

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, cathartic]
Be the greenhouse, not the stopwatch
Let their progress be their own
The kindest thing that we can give
Is space for something good to grow

[Outro: melodic bass resolves]

title: Build the Ramp
lyrics:
[Intro: architectural clicks, odd-meter bass]

[Verse 1: rhythmic baritone]
We built a beautiful new room
With windows reaching to the moon
Then someone standing at the stairs
Asked why we hadn't thought of theirs

We said we'd find another way
A temporary fix someday

[Pre-Chorus: rising counterpoint]
But what if from the very start
We made inclusion part of art?

[Chorus: anthemic major-key lift]
Build the ramp before the staircase
Make the welcome part of stone
Don't invite somebody over
To a place they cannot go
Let the doorway tell the story
Of the values that we claim
Everybody's worth designing for
Before we know their name

[Break: syncopated bass, complex guitar harmony]

[Verse 2: melodic conversational]
So we added captions to the screen
Made the instructions clear and clean
Asked who else we'd overlooked
And changed the plans before we booked

[Bridge: half-time, rising choir]
Compassion shouldn't need a plea
To make a place accessible

[Final Chorus: explosive harmonies]
Build the ramp before the staircase
Let belonging be the plan

[Outro: uplifting guitar resolution]

title: One Good Stitch
lyrics:
[Intro: plucked guitar, irregular percussion]

[Verse 1: tender syncopated baritone]
A friendship frayed along the seam
From words that landed carelessly
We both kept pulling at the thread
Until there wasn't much left

I could pretend it didn't matter
Let the fabric fall apart
Or find a needle in the silence
And offer up my heart

[Pre-Chorus: climbing melodic thirds]
I sent a message late that night
Said, "Can we talk and make this right?"

[Chorus: soaring layered harmonies]
One good stitch can hold a seam
One small kindness saves a dream
Not every tear is ours to mend
But we can try before the end
[Melodic octave leap]
The world is made of fragile threads
That need our hands more than our pride

[Break: polyrhythmic toms, fretless bass]

[Verse 2: conversational]
I listened where we disagreed
And let you tell me what you need
No perfect answer, no disguise
Just two people willing to try

[Bridge: half-time, fragile]
Some things cannot be restored
But some deserve an open door

[Final Chorus: cathartic major resolution]
One good stitch, another day
A chance to mend instead of fray

[Outro: guitar harmonics linger]

title: Lend Them Your Ladder
lyrics:
[Intro: tapping bass harmonics, clean guitar]

[Verse 1: syncopated conversational]
I got to climb a little higher
Because somebody held the frame
They said my work was worth a chance
And made sure others knew my name

Now I see somebody waiting
With the talent but no way
To reach the people who decide
Who gets invited in today

[Pre-Chorus: ascending thirds]
I could guard the rung I found
Or help somebody off the ground

[Chorus: explosive melodic lift]
Lend them your ladder
Let them see above the wall
You don't get any shorter
When you help somebody tall
There's a view worth sharing
There's a door beyond the climb
Use the reach that you've been given
To lift somebody else this time

[Break: contrapuntal guitars, slap bass solo]

[Verse 2: warm melody]
I made the call, introduced their name
And let their work speak for itself
No favor owed, no debt to claim
Their future belongs to them

[Bridge: half-time harmony]
I won't decide how high they go
I'll only help them reach the road

[Final Chorus: octave lift]
Lend them your ladder
Then watch them build their own

[Outro: guitar melody ascends]

title: Rain Barrel
lyrics:
[Intro: rain percussion, rolling fretless bass]

[Verse 1: gentle melodic groove]
When the rain was falling heavy
I put buckets underneath
Didn't need another river
Running past my own two feet

When the summer turned to dust
My neighbor's garden couldn't grow
So I carried what I'd gathered
Down the road

[Pre-Chorus: rising guitar harmony]
A little overflow today
Can keep another drought away

[Chorus: soaring layered vocals]
Let your heart become a rain barrel
Save a little when it pours
When the dry days find somebody
Bring the water to their door
If your cup is overflowing
There's a thousand things to do
You can turn a little extra
Into something someone needs

[Break: 138 BPM bass polyrhythm, tom fills]

[Verse 2: rhythmic baritone]
An extra coat, a bag of food
A ride when someone needs to move
I don't need to make a show
Of giving what I can let go

[Bridge: half-time, intimate]
Abundance has a purpose
Beyond collecting what we own

[Final Chorus: epic vocal harmonies]
Let the rain become a river
Running where the ground is dry
A kinder world is watered
By the things we choose to share

[Outro: rain fades into arpeggios]

title: Second Draft
lyrics:
[Intro: reversed piano, tape flutter]

[Verse 1: intimate melodic baritone]
I knew you from a chapter
That you wish you hadn't written
I could quote the worst of you
And pretend that nothing's different

But I watched you do the work
To change the person you had been

[Pre-Chorus: rising falsetto doubles]
I won't erase what came before
But I can see you're writing more

[Chorus: soaring major-key melody]
We are all a second draft
Of the people we once were
Learning how to tell a story
With a little less of hurt
No one gets to change the past
But the future isn't sealed
Let the better version growing
Have a chance to be revealed

[Break: syncopated fretless bass, guitar runs]

[Verse 2: warm conversational]
I won't pretend the pain was small
Or say that trust comes back on call
But I can notice when you change
Instead of keeping you in chains

[Bridge: half-time, layered thirds]
Accountability and grace
Can both belong within one space

[Final Chorus: cathartic lift]
We are all a second draft
And the pages aren't complete
Let the person doing better
Be somebody we can meet

[Outro: piano resolves]

title: Zipper Teeth
lyrics:
[Intro: mechanical rhythm, bouncing bass]

[Verse 1: playful syncopated baritone]
Two lanes squeezing into one
Everybody racing for the sun
I could close the gap and win a foot
Or let somebody in, like someone should

[Pre-Chorus: interlocking guitar lines]
One from yours and one from mine
Funny how we move in time

[Chorus: bright interwoven harmonies]
We fit together like zipper teeth
Making room for what's underneath
You don't have to lose your place
To give another person space
[Octave lift]
A thousand moving pieces flow
When everybody lets somebody go

[Break: alternating 5/4 bass and 4/4 drums]

[Verse 2: melodic conversational]
At the counter, someone's running late
I let them pass, it's fine to wait
Some days I'm the one who needs
A little grace from someone else's speed

[Bridge: half-time vocal duet]
(What if everyone takes?)
Nothing moves
(What if everyone gives?)
We all get through

[Final Chorus: soaring vocal stacks]
We fit together like zipper teeth
Not in competition, but in peace
The road gets wider when we learn
To let each other have a turn

[Outro: interlocking guitar harmonics]

title: Let the Fire End With Me
lyrics:
[Intro: crackling distortion, 7/8 guitar]

[Verse 1: staccato baritone]
A story traveled through the room
Got sharper every time it moved
Somebody added little flames
Until a stranger wore the blame

They handed me another spark
And waited for my part

[Pre-Chorus: rising counterpoint]
I could keep the fire alive
Or leave the match aside

[Chorus: explosive melodic hook]
I'll be the break between the flames
The place where rumors lose their names
Not every story needs a voice
Not every whisper needs a choice
If cruelty needs another hand
To carry it across the land
I'll let the burning end with me

[Drop: syncopated slap bass, IDM edits]

[Verse 2: warm melodic]
I said, "We don't know what is true"
And asked what kindness there could do
If someone's story needs discussing
Let them have a voice in something

[Bridge: half-time, suspended chord]
A reputation takes a life to grow
And seconds just to overthrow

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies]
Let the fire end with me
And leave their dignity intact

[Outro: distorted guitar resolves]

title: Borrow Some Power
lyrics:
[Intro: pulsing synth, melodic fretless bass]

[Verse 1: intimate rhythmic baritone]
You said you're fine, but I could see
The fading charge beneath your smile
You'd been running on an empty tank
And calling every breakdown fine

So I brought dinner to your door
Took one small burden off your floor

[Pre-Chorus: ascending stacked thirds]
You don't need another speech
Just something real within my reach

[Chorus: soaring major-key harmonies]
I've got a little power left
You can borrow some of mine
We don't have to burn alone
To keep each other's worlds alive
When your batteries are fading
And the road is running long
I'll help you find your current
Till your strength comes back on

[Break: slap bass, polyrhythmic guitar]

[Bridge: half-time, fragile melody]
And when my own light starts to dim
I hope I'll let somebody in

[Final Chorus: octave lift, cathartic]
We aren't built to run forever
Without a hand along the way
We can help each other recharge
And face another day

[Outro: warm bass harmonics]

title: Kindness, Pass It On
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You hold the door when the rain comes through
Make room for the stranger beside you
A small hello at the checkout line
Can turn a hard day by half a mile

[Pre-Chorus]
No grand design, no perfect plan
Just one open heart and an outstretched hand

[Chorus]
Kindness, pass it on, pass it on
One little spark and the hurt feels gone
You and me, we can start right here
Make a little more room, make a little less fear
Kindness, pass it on, pass it on
A thousand small acts till the walls come down

[Verse 2]
You learn their name, you listen twice
Share your umbrella, split your fries
When someone’s wrong, don’t close the gate
Leave space for change, leave room to wait

[Pre-Chorus]
No grand design, no perfect plan
Just one open heart and an outstretched hand

[Chorus]
Kindness, pass it on, pass it on
One little spark and the hurt feels gone
You and me, we can start right here
Make a little more room, make a little less fear
Kindness, pass it on, pass it on
A thousand small acts till the walls come down

[Bridge]
If every street gives one more chance
If every table makes more space
The world won’t turn in a single night
But it can bend toward the good we make

[Final Chorus]
Kindness, pass it on, pass it on
One little spark and the hurt feels gone
You and me, we can start right here
Make a little more room, make a little less fear
Kindness, pass it on, pass it on
A thousand small acts till the walls come down

[Outro]
Pass it on, pass it on
Start right here, start right here

title: Kindness Can Turn The World Around
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You hold the door when the rain comes down
Make a little room for a stranger in town
A paper cup, a name remembered

[Pre-Chorus]

A softer way beneath a harder sky
Kindness can turn the world around

A softer way beneath a harder sky

title: Starting With You
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You hold the door when rain comes down
You learn the name the room forgot
A little patience passed around
Can loosen what the anger knots

[Pre-Chorus]
One small hand, then another
Make a place for each other

[Chorus]
Kindness, pass it on
A little can undo the harm
Kindness, carry through
The world gets lighter, starting with you

[Verse 2]
Leave the last seat on the bus
Let the tired stranger sit
Say, “I’m here, you can trust us”

[Pre-Chorus]
One small hand, then another
Make a place for each other

[Chorus]
Kindness, pass it on
A little can undo the harm
Kindness, carry through
The world gets lighter, starting with you

[Final Chorus]

Kindness, carry through
The world gets lighter, starting with you

Starting with you

title: Be Kind, Begin Right Here
lyrics:

You held the door in the pouring rain
For a stranger with a paper bag
A small hello, a little room
Can loosen what the day has dragged

[Pre-Chorus]
We don't need a grand design
Just a hand, a little time

[Chorus]
Be kind, begin right here
One open heart can change the atmosphere
Be kind, pass it along
A little care can make the whole world strong

[Verse 2]
Leave the last seat, learn a name
Call your sister, mend the thread
Listen close when someone hurts
Let the good be what we spread

[Pre-Chorus]
We don't need a grand design
Just a hand, a little time

[Chorus]
Be kind, begin right here
One open heart can change the atmosphere
Be kind, pass it along
A little care can make the whole world strong

[Bridge]

The weight gets lighter in our reach
No perfect words, no grand parade
Just choose the gentler thing today

[Final Chorus]
Be kind, begin right here
One open heart can change the atmosphere
Be kind, pass it along
A little care can make the whole world strong

[Outro]
Start with me, start with you
Small things make a world brand new

title: Starts With Me
lyrics:
[Intro: solo fretless bass, intimate baritone]
I used to wait for better days
For kinder hearts and gentler ways
As though the world would rearrange
Before I had to make a change

[Verse 1: syncopated, guitars enter]
So I called a friend I'd lost
Said I missed them, took the risk
Helped a stranger with their bags
Without a story, without a wish
And nothing grand came raining down
Just little changes all around

[Pre-Chorus: ascending stacked thirds]
Maybe that's the way it starts
Not with speeches, but with hearts

[Chorus: explosive anthem, bright major]
Let it start with me
Let the smallest kindness grow
Let the mercy that I practice
Be the mercy others know
I can't heal the whole world
But I can change the space I fill
And if enough of us keep trying
Then one day maybe we will

[Instrumental: complex bass counterpoint, 138 BPM breakdown]

[Bridge: half-time, vulnerable to soaring]
I won't always get it right
But I'll try again tomorrow
Leave some light for someone else
Who has a road of sorrow

[Final Chorus: key lift, epic harmonies]
Let it start with me
Let it spread beyond my name
We may never see the ending
But we'll never be the same

[Outro: full-band crescendo, sustained]
The world I want to live in
Starts with how I live today.

title: Hand Back the Spotlight
lyrics:
[Intro: funky slap bass, shifting guitar accents]

[Verse 1: bouncing conversational]
They handed me the microphone
Said what a brilliant thing I'd done
I looked across the crowded room
At everyone who helped it bloom
The quiet hands, the late-night calls
The people who had built it all

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonies]
I took a breath and named them there
Let everybody have their share

[Chorus: radiant major hook]
Hand back the spotlight
Let somebody else shine
There's enough room in the heavens
For a thousand stars tonight
Their success is not my failure
Their applause is not my loss
We can lift each other higher
Without counting what it costs

[Break: fretless bass solo, syncopated guitar]

[Verse 2: warm melodic phrasing]
I told a friend how proud I was
And meant each word without a clause
Their face lit up, the whole room changed
And nothing I had lost was gained

[Bridge: half-time, vocal stacks]
Praise is not a finite thing
The more we give, the more we bring

[Final Chorus: epic cathartic lift]
Hand back the spotlight
Let everybody shine
The world grows brighter
When we celebrate each other's light

[Outro: bright guitar resolution]

title: Stand Where They Stand
lyrics:
[Intro: ominous toms, distorted bass]

[Verse 1: restrained baritone]
A joke went flying through the room
At someone standing all alone
Everybody laughed politely
Like the cruelty was unknown
I felt the silence asking me
What kind of person I would be

[Pre-Chorus: guitar ascends]
I didn't need a grand display
Just had to find the words to say

[Chorus: powerful major-key lift]
I'll stand where they stand
When the crowd turns away
I won't let another person's pain
Become the price of fitting in
If kindness has a cost
Then it's one I'm glad to pay
I'll stand where they stand
And ask if they're okay

[Break: polyrhythmic bass, heavy tom fills]

[Verse 2: rising melodic intensity]
I said, "That wasn't funny"
Then I walked across the floor
Asked if they wanted company
And stayed a little more

[Bridge: half-time, gentle]
Courage isn't always loud
Sometimes it's leaving the laughing crowd

[Final Chorus: epic guitar and vocal harmonies]
I'll stand where they stand
Let nobody face it alone
A kinder world begins
When we make each other known

[Outro: sustained gritty vocal]
You don't stand alone.

title: First to Soften
lyrics:
[Intro: aggressive riddim bass, 7/8 guitar riff]

[Verse 1: clipped rhythmic baritone]
A crowded street, a traffic light
Someone cuts me off tonight
My jaw gets tight, my fingers curl
Another little fight against the world

[Pre-Chorus: instruments suddenly drop]
But anger only multiplies
When everybody pays it twice

[Chorus: explosive major-key melody]
I'll be the first to soften
The first to let it go
Not every little battle
Needs another heavy blow
I can break the chain of anger
Before it travels through
And maybe someone else tomorrow
Will remember what to do

[Break: slap bass, glitch edits, tom crescendo]

[Verse 2: warm melodic shift]
At the counter someone's shaking
While the line begins to groan
I say, "Take your time, it's alright"
And the tension starts to go

[Bridge: dramatic half-time]
Gentleness is not defeat
It's strength that doesn't need to beat

[Final Chorus: soaring harmonies]
I'll be the first to soften
When the world begins to burn
And send a little patience
Down every road I turn

[Outro: bass riff resolves to major]

title: Give Away the Map
lyrics:
[Intro: melodic slap bass, clean arpeggios]

[Verse 1: playful syncopated]
I remember being lost
With a question in my hands
Someone took an afternoon
To help me understand
They didn't make me feel ashamed
Or foolish for what I couldn't name

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonies]
Now someone's standing where I stood
I'll give them everything I could

[Chorus: bright anthemic lift]
Give away the map
Show somebody where to go
Every little thing you've learned
Is another seed to sow
There's no shortage of horizons
There's no limit to the sky
When you help another person
Find the courage to fly

[Break: intricate bass-guitar counterpoint]

[Verse 2: warm melodic phrasing]
I shared the trick that saved me time
The failures hiding between the lines
And when they finally figured it out
Their joy became what mine's about

[Bridge: half-time, soaring]
Your success doesn't steal from me
It makes a bigger world to see

[Final Chorus: stacked vocal harmony]
Give away the map
Let the next one journey far
A kinder world is built by people
Who help others reach the stars

[Outro: melodic bass resolves]

title: Doorway to Apology
lyrics:
[Intro: distorted guitar, fractured IDM beats]

[Verse 1: tense rhythmic baritone]
I had a perfect explanation
For the damage I had done
A thousand little reasons
Why I wasn't the guilty one
Then I watched your expression fall
And heard the hurt beneath it all

[Pre-Chorus: rising suspended chords]
I could save my precious pride

[Chorus: soaring gritty vocals]

[Break: chaotic bass polyrhythm, tom-heavy fills]

[Verse 2: vulnerable melodic]

[Bridge: half-time, intimate]

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, triumphant]

lyrics:
[Intro: odd-meter drums, melodic fretless bass]

[Verse 1: intimate conversational]

And a stranger by the wall
Everybody knew somebody
But nobody knew them at all
I caught their eyes across the room
And made a little space for two

[Pre-Chorus: guitar harmonies ascend]
Sometimes belonging starts

[Chorus: soaring bright harmonies]
Pull up another chair
There's always room for one more story
We don't have to be alike

[Break: riddim bass syncopation, explosive toms]

[Verse 2: melodic baritone]

We were grateful for that space

[Bridge: half-time, warm falsetto doubles]

[Final Chorus: epic harmonized lift]

Let the circle stretch and bend
A kinder world is waiting

[Outro: sustained major chord]

title: Everybody Has a Name
lyrics:
[Intro: bright guitar harmonics, rolling toms]

[Verse 1: syncopated baritone]
The woman at the checkout
Has a name above her heart
I read it, say good morning
Ask her how her day's been going
She says nobody has asked
Since her morning shift had started

[Pre-Chorus: rising fretless bass]
A hundred faces passing through
All with lives as real as you

[Chorus: anthemic major-key lift]
Everybody has a name
Everybody has a story
No one's just a moving part
In somebody else's morning
Look them in the eyes
Let their humanity be seen
A little bit of recognition
Changes everything

[Break: slap bass counterpoint, IDM rhythmic edits]

[Verse 2: warm ascending melody]
The cleaner in the hallway
The driver in the rain
I learn their names and thank them
Not because I need a thing

[Bridge: dramatic half-time]
No one should feel invisible
While making someone else's world possible

[Final Chorus: layered harmonies, gritty peak]
Everybody has a name
And dignity belongs to all
The world gets just a little warmer
When we see each other whole

[Outro: guitar harmonics resolve]

lyrics:
[Intro: percussive bass taps, clean guitar]

[Verse 1: conversational rhythmic]
A shopping cart across the lot
A coffee spill, a crowded spot
I put the cart where it belongs
And wipe the mess before I'm gone

[Pre-Chorus: rising vocal doubles]

A little less for someone else to find

[Chorus: bright major hook]

Let the quiet moments count
We don't have to change the universe

Every kindness without witnesses
Every burden lifted free
Makes a world that's just a little

[Instrumental: distorted guitar, syncopated slap bass]

[Verse 2: melodic baritone]
A door held wide, a dropped glove found
A stranger's keys returned from the ground
No grand parade, no camera flash
Just seconds given, never asked back

[Bridge: half-time, piano]
Maybe no one sees the good we do
But someone feels the difference too

[Final Chorus: soaring layered harmonies]
Let the little things be beautiful
Let the smallest gesture shine
A kinder world is built in seconds
One ordinary act at a time

[Outro: warm tape decay]

title: Hear the Whole Sentence
lyrics:
[Intro: fretless bass melody, glitch percussion]

[Verse 1: intimate syncopated baritone]
You stumbled through a story
I was ready with advice
Had my answer halfway loaded
Before you finished the first line
But I put my clever words away
And let the silence have its say

[Pre-Chorus: ascending guitar counterpoint]
And somewhere in the space I made
I heard the things you couldn't say

[Chorus: explosive major-key harmonies]
I'll hear the whole sentence
I'll let your story breathe
You don't need another answer
You need someone who believes
That your words are worth the waiting
And your tears are worth the time
I'll hear the whole sentence
Before I offer mine

[Break: polyrhythmic slap bass, tom fills]

[Verse 2: warm melodic phrasing]
I watched your shoulders settle
Like a weight had disappeared
Didn't fix a single problem
But you finally felt heard

[Bridge: half-time, vulnerable]
Sometimes love is not a speech
It's knowing when to let words cease

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, cathartic]
I'll hear the whole sentence
Let every silence sing
A kinder world begins
With someone listening

[Outro: resolving fretless bass]

title: Kiln by Kiln
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You set the chipped cup by the sink
I found the crack beneath its blue
We held it up against the day
And let the morning travel through

[Pre-Chorus]
A softer word, a steadier hand
Can change the shape of what we mend

[Chorus]
Kiln by kiln, we make it hold
Kindness in the clay, not gold
Turn it slow, let every edge
Meet the next without a wedge
Kiln by kiln, the world can mend
Grace is how we glaze the end

[Verse 2]
You missed the train; I saved your place
You gave the tired cashier time
Small mercies travel hand to hand
Like colored slip along a line

[Pre-Chorus]
A softer word, a steadier hand
Can change the shape of what we mend

[Chorus]
Kiln by kiln, we make it hold
Kindness in the clay, not gold
Turn it slow, let every edge
Meet the next without a wedge
Kiln by kiln, the world can mend
Grace is how we glaze the end

[Bridge]
When the heat climbs, breathe and wait
No piece is made alone

[Final Chorus]
Kiln by kiln, we make it hold
Kindness in the clay, not gold
Turn it slow, let every edge
Meet the next without a wedge
Kiln by kiln, the world can mend
Grace is how we glaze the end

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You left your cart beside the rain
I held the door; you waved me through
A hundred small repairs like that
Can change the grain of what we do

[Pre-Chorus]
A city is a stitched-up coat
Each careful seam can bear the load

[Chorus]
Bend the hinge, don’t break the frame
Pass the kindness down the chain
Step off-beat, but turn as one
Grace is how the work gets done
Bend the hinge, don’t break the frame
Build a world worth handing on

[Verse 2]
At the counter, tempers rise
You let the tired cashier breathe

[Pre-Chorus]
No grand design begins alone

[Chorus]

Pass the kindness down the chain

Grace is how the work gets done
Bend the hinge, don’t break the frame

[Pre-Chorus]
A careful word can alter the measure

[Chorus]

Clearance in the joint!

Clearance in the joint!

[Chorus]
Give a little clearance to the joint!
Let the timber breathe, let the archway curve!
Syncopated friction giving way to the grace we preserve!
Clearance in the joint!

Building up the world through a quiet, steady gift!

title: Give a Little Grace
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held the door when my hands were full
I learned a little from that simple move
A softer answer can turn the tide
Make room for someone standing by

[Pre-Chorus]
One patient word, one moment spared
A kinder world is built from there

[Chorus]
Make a little room, make a little room
For the hearts that beat beside you
Give a little grace, give a little grace

We don’t need grand plans to begin

[Chorus]

Give a little grace, give a little grace

lyrics:

You held the door when my hands were full

[Pre-Chorus]
We don't have to win every turn
Leave a little space, let the whole thing work

[Chorus]
Make it kinder, make it better
One by one, we move together
Give a little, make room for another
Grace goes farther when we carry each other
Make it kinder, make it better
Hand to hand, we build it together

[Verse 2]
You kept your voice low when the room ran hot
You asked what I meant, not what I forgot
A fairer way starts close at home
With the next small choice we make on our own

[Bridge]

Turn the sharp edge into common ground

[Chorus]
Make it kinder, make it better
One by one, we move together
Give a little, make room for another

Make it kinder, make it better

lyrics:

You hold the door when someone's hands are full

[Chorus]
Make a little more room, make a little more room

Make a little more room, make a little more room

Not because it didn't hurt
Let it go, let it go

I can keep my heart wide open
I can set the burden down

I read the words you couldn't say
And let the silence breathe

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]
Let it go, let it go, make room to begin
Step off the old hurt, let the daylight in
I forgive you—not because it was small
But I won't let that moment be all
Let it go, let it go, we can start again

[Verse 2]
The chipped blue cup is on the shelf
Your note is folded there
I don't erase what happened then
I choose what I can spare

[Bridge]
One breath, one step, no debt to keep
A softer promise I can reach

[Final Chorus]
Let it go, let it go, make room to begin
Step off the old hurt, let the daylight in
I forgive you—not because it was small

Let it go, let it go, we can start again

We can start again

lyrics:

In the spaces in between

There is room here for us all
Open minds and open hands
Tolerate across the lands

title: Different Doesn’t Mean
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You hold your ground, I hold mine
Two different maps, one shared line
A word can land like a closed door
Or leave a little room for more

[Pre-Chorus]
Pause before the answer flies
Look again through someone’s eyes

[Chorus]
Make room, make room, let another heart in
We don’t have to match to begin
Make room, make room, let the hard walls bend
Different doesn’t mean we can’t be friends

[Verse 2]
You speak your truth, I’ll hear it through
No need to turn my world to yours
We can disagree and still stay kind
Keep a little space between our lines

[Bridge]
Step aside, step across
Change the angle, not the cost

[Final Chorus]
Make room, make room, let another heart in
We don’t have to match to begin
Make room, make room, let the hard walls bend
Different doesn’t mean we can’t be friends
Make room, make room
Different doesn’t mean we can’t be friends
[Outro]

title: Make a Place for Another Smile
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held the door when my hands were full
No grand parade, just a little room
You said my name like it mattered today
And took one hard hour and softened its edge

[Pre-Chorus]
Small things travel farther than we know
One open hand can change the road

[Chorus]
Be kind, be kind, let the good pass through
A little grace comes back to you
Be kind, be kind, when the day runs wild
Make a place for another smile

[Verse 2]
You let me finish when I lost my words
You saved the seat, you shared what you had
No need to fix every crack in the sky
Just stay beside me and give it some time

[Bridge]
Turn the sharp edge, make it gentle
Leave a little light at the table

[Chorus]
Be kind, be kind, let the good pass through
A little grace comes back to you
Be kind, be kind, when the day runs wild
Make a place for another smile

[Outro]
Be kind, be kind
Make a place for another smile

title: One Gentle Choice
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held the door when my hands were full
Waited while I found the words
No grand speech, no golden rule
Just a little room to be heard

[Pre-Chorus]
Small things travel farther than we know
One gentle choice can change the road

[Chorus]
Be kind, be kind—leave a little room
Be kind, be kind—let somebody bloom
A word, a hand, a moment given freely
Be kind, be kind; it matters more than you see

[Verse 2]
You asked my name and let me finish
You stayed when the easy thing was gone
That quiet care can start a turning
And pass from one heart to another on

[Bridge]
A little patience, a little grace
Can make a shelter in a crowded place

[Final Chorus]
Be kind, be kind—leave a little room
Be kind, be kind—let somebody bloom
A word, a hand, a moment given freely
Be kind, be kind; it matters more than you see

title: It Matters More
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held the door when I came in too fast
Let my sharp words fall and pass
You didn't ask me to be right
Just gave the moment room to breathe tonight

[Pre-Chorus]
We all carry a different load
A little patience lightens the road

[Chorus]
Be kind, be kind, when the pieces don't align
Give a little grace, leave a little time
Forgive, forgive, let the hard edge unwind
We get further when we meet halfway in the mind
Be kind, be kind—make room, make room

[Verse 2]
You heard the story from the other side
Found the hurt beneath the pride
No one has to lose their place
For us to share a little space

[Bridge]
Turn the blame around, set it down
Let a softer answer travel through the town

[Final Chorus]
Be kind, be kind, when the pieces don't align
Give a little grace, leave a little time
Forgive, forgive, let the hard edge unwind
We get further when we meet halfway in the mind
Be kind, be kind—make room, make room

[Outro]
Make room for you
Make room for me

title: Patience Is The Quiet Strength
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Quiet room, a heavy breath
Someone spoke a hasty word
Weighing every wrong they said
Like a ledger best interred
I could build a fortress now
Raise the drawbridge, turn away
Keep the score of every slight
On a bitter, endless day

[Chorus]
Give the grace you hope to find
Let the jagged edges bind
Drop the stone and let it fall
Forgive a little, heal us all
Patience is the quiet strength
We can measure to its length

[Verse 2]
Difference is a quiet grace
Not a battle to be won
Walking gently in their shoes
'Neath an unexpected sun
Listening before we speak
Bridging distances between
Finding common ground we share
Where the quiet truths convene

[Chorus]
Give the grace you hope to find
Let the jagged edges bind
Drop the stone and let it fall
Forgive a little, heal us all
Patience is the quiet strength
We can measure to its length

[Bridge]
Through the shifting meters of our days
We stumble, but we learn new ways
To open up the bolted door
And be the storm-break on the floor

[Chorus]
Give the grace you hope to find
Let the jagged edges bind
Drop the stone and let it fall
Forgive a little, heal us all
Patience is the quiet strength
We can measure to its length

[Outro]
Forgive...
Be kind...
Endless lines unwind
[Instrumental Fade]

title: The Lives I Couldn't Live
lyrics:
[Intro: distant piano, reversed echoes]
[Soft falsetto, intimate]
Somewhere there's a version of me
Who took the road I couldn't see
I wonder if he lies awake
Dreaming of the life I made

[Verse 1: melodic sing-rap, warm bass]
I've got a house full of memories
A thousand reasons to believe
That everything I ever wanted
Found its way somehow to me

But every window holds a highway
Every highway holds a dream
And every dream becomes a person
That I never got to be

[Pre-Chorus: ascending melody, stacked thirds]
I used to think the ache meant something's wrong
That happiness was waiting further on
But every road I might have taken
Would have left another song unsung

[Chorus: soaring falsetto, wide harmonies]
I can love the life I'm living
And mourn the lives I'll never know
I can hold on to this moment
While I dream of letting go
[Octave lift, sustained]
Every choice becomes a lifetime
Every lifetime leaves a ghost
And the lives I couldn't live
Are the ones I wanted most

[Instrumental: melodic 808 solo, syncopated breakbeat]

[Verse 2: flowing melody, rising intensity]
I kept the letters never written
Kept the keys to doors unopened
Built a palace out of maybes
Filled the hallways up with hope

But all the futures I imagined
Never had to face a day
Never had to pay the price
Of all the dreams they'd throw away

[Bridge: beatless, vulnerable duet]
(Was it enough?) It was beautiful
(Was it the best?) I'll never know
[Four-part harmony, crescendo]
Maybe every life worth living
Means a thousand we let go

[Final Chorus: key change, full choir, soaring]
I will love the life I'm living
While I mourn the lives I can't
Every road I leave behind me
Makes me who I really am
[Half-time, triumphant falsetto]
I don't need to stop imagining
Or pretend the longing fades
I can grieve the roads I never took
Without regretting those I made

[Outro: drums fade, solo piano]
[Soft descending melody]
One life to live
A thousand left behind
And maybe that's the beauty
Of having only mine

[Final whispered harmony]
I wouldn't trade this life away...
I just wish I had more time.

[Piano resolves, tape fades]

title: Clay of Yesterday
lyrics:
[Intro: hypnotic piano, rolling 808]

[Verse 1: fluid melodic sing-rap]
I used to be a thousand shapes of clay
Could turn into anything from day to day
Then loving hands and years began to mold
A beautiful creation I could finally hold

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonies]
But every curve that found its place
Made other shapes impossible to trace

[Chorus: soaring falsetto, rich chords]
I'm beautiful because the fire changed me
But sometimes I remember being free
Before the kiln, before the final shape
When every life was waiting there for me
[Melodic 808 counterpoint]
I love the vessel I've become
Why do I miss the shapeless one?

[Break: syncopated breakbeat, shimmering keys]

[Bridge: stripped piano, aching melody]
I couldn't hold the water then
I needed fire to make me strong
But all the shapes I might have been
Still feel like somewhere I belong

[Final Hook: layered octave harmonies]
I wouldn't break what I have made
To be the clay of yesterday

[Outro: sustained unresolved chord]
But sometimes I wish
I could turn the wheel again.

title: Bidding on Another Chance
lyrics:
[Intro: dramatic piano, syncopated 808]

[Verse 1: theatrical rhythmic melody]
The auctioneer is calling out my dreams
A hundred futures shining under beams
A home, a journey, someone else's kiss
A thousand little lives I wouldn't want to miss

[Pre-Chorus: rising intensity]
I raise my hand for something new
But every bid means letting something through

[Chorus: soaring emotional melody]
Going once for the life I wanted
Going twice for what could be
Every dream I buy is haunted
By the ones that won't belong to me
[Halftime drums, layered falsetto]
I have a treasure in my hands
But still keep bidding on another chance

[Break: melodic cowbell, sliding sub-bass]

[Bridge: tender piano, sustained vocal]
I know I can't afford them all
The hammer has to someday fall
And when I leave with what I've won
I'll mourn the things I left undone

[Final Hook: octave harmonies]
I'm rich with all that I possess
And poor with all I'll never get

[Outro: auction gavel]
Sold.
And I still want more.

title: Going Twice
