title: Quilt I'll Never Make
lyrics:
[Intro: warm Rhodes, gentle 808]

[Verse 1: lilting melodic phrasing]
I stitched together everything I love
A little earth, a little sky above
Every patch a memory I wouldn't trade
Every thread a promise that I made

[Pre-Chorus: rising falsetto]
But in a basket by the bed
Are all the colors left unread

[Chorus: lush soaring harmonies]
I've got a blanket warm enough for winter
Every little piece belongs to me
But I keep dreaming of the missing colors
And all the patterns they could be
[Descending vocal melody]
If this is everything I need
Why do those scraps keep calling me?

[Break: syncopated bass, delicate arpeggios]

[Bridge: intimate, sparse percussion]
I couldn't sew them all in place
Without undoing what I've made
And maybe every lovely thing
Requires leaving something incomplete

[Final Hook: stacked harmonies]
My life is warm, my colors bright
I hold it close against the night

[Outro: whispered melody]
Still saving scraps
For a quilt I'll never make.

title: The Pictures Never Taken
genres: Progressive rock with art-rock detail: tape saturation
punchy mix and tape-flutter fade; 108 BPM with shifting odd-meter pulses
interlocking offbeats and syncopated tom fills. Chiming electric guitar states an instantly memorable motif over marimba ostinato
analog synth pads and layered hand percussion; shimmering breakbeat transition
lyrics:
[Intro: dreamy tape hiss, pulsing sub-bass]

[Verse 1: intimate melodic flow]
I watched my life appear beneath the light
A beautiful exposure coming out just right
Every color, every shadow in its place
A thousand little memories I wouldn't erase

[Pre-Chorus: rising airy harmonies]
But hanging on a line behind the door
Are negatives that might contain much more

[Chorus: soaring nostalgic falsetto]
I developed such a beautiful picture
Why am I searching for another frame?
All the moments I could never capture
Still call me by a different name
[Layered harmony, melodic bass]
I love the photograph I see
But wonder what the others might reveal

[Break: shimmering synth, breakbeat fills]

[Bridge: piano and breathy vocal]
The darkroom holds a thousand dreams
That might be better left unseen
The life I have is full of light
Yet I still reach into the night

[Final Hook: suspended melody]
Perhaps the pictures never taken
Are the ones that leave me shaken

[Outro: fading tape flutter]
And I keep holding them to light.

title: somebody else's clothes
lyrics:
[Intro: shimmering synth, funky bass]

[Verse 1: playful melodic rhythm]
I've got a favorite jacket worn just right
It fits me like the morning fits the light
But hanging in the closet, out of view
Are clothes for lives I never followed through

[Pre-Chorus: melodic ascending thirds]
A different fabric, different skin
A thousand people I could've been

[Chorus: bright soaring harmonies]
I'm dressed for the life I chose
But dreaming in somebody else's clothes
A perfect fit, a lovely day
Still wishing I could dress another way
[Syncopated 808, falsetto lift]
I'm happy with the man I see
So why keep trying on another me?

[Break: elastic bass, funky cowbell]

[Bridge: soft stacked vocals]
Some outfits only live in dreams
They fit much better than they seem
And maybe if I wore them out
I'd miss the clothes I wear right now

[Final Hook: warm melodic resolution]
A thousand selves behind the door
I love this one and still want more

[Outro: gentle piano]
Tomorrow I'll wear what I love
And wonder again.

title: Moves Unmade
lyrics:
[Intro: ticking percussion, minor piano]

[Verse 1: precise rhythmic sing-rap]
I made a move and watched the board unfold
A thousand little victories of black and gold
I played the game with everything I knew
And found a winning line that carried me through

[Pre-Chorus: climbing harmonic tension]
But every piece I moved that day
Sent other possibilities away

[Chorus: soaring melancholic melody]
I won the game, so why am I grieving?
For all the moves I didn't make
I have the life that I believed in
And all the others still awake
[Deep 808, suspended vocal]
What good is knowing I have won
If I can't stop imagining another run?

[Break: syncopated bass, staccato piano]

[Bridge: intimate, stripped back]
I cannot play a thousand games
And make them all end just the same
But I keep studying the board
For something that I can't afford

[Final Hook: layered falsetto]
I wouldn't trade the game I've played
Still counting all the moves unmade

[Outro: single chess piece clicks]
Checkmate never felt so strange.

title: Letters Never Sent
lyrics:
[Intro: soft keys, vinyl warmth]

[Verse 1: flowing melodic delivery]
I've got a drawer of letters never sent
Addresses for the places I never went
One says I should wander, one says settle down
One describes a stranger in another town

[Pre-Chorus: rising falsetto]
I read them when the house is still
And feel the things I never will

[Chorus: soaring layered harmonies]
Dear life I never got to live
I wonder what you had to give
I'm writing from a happy place
But wish that I could see your face
[Melodic bass ascends]
If I could send this letter through
Would you be wishing you were me too?

[Break: gentle cowbell, shuffled breakbeat]

[Bridge: emotional vocal duet]
The paper knows my deepest doubt
The things I'm glad I lived without
But every letter ends the same
A different life, a different name

[Final Hook: sustained falsetto]
Dear life I never got to know
I'll keep your letters, let you go

[Outro: piano, soft resolution]
Then open up the drawer again.

title: Dial Back Home
lyrics:
[Intro: radio tuning, lush analog synth]

[Verse 1: syncopated melodic rap]
I found a frequency that speaks to me
A perfect little song in perfect harmony
But somewhere in the static lives another tune
And I keep reaching for the dial each afternoon

[Pre-Chorus: ascending vocal layers]
One little turn and something fades
Another world begins to play

[Chorus: soaring harmonized melody]
I'm listening to everything I wanted
But haunted by the signals passing through
Every time I find a perfect station
I wonder what the others could have been
[808 slides beneath sustained falsetto]
And I can't hear a thousand songs
Without losing the one I'm on

[Break: chopped synth, melodic bass counterpoint]

[Bridge: stripped piano, intimate]
The music isn't incomplete
Just because there's more beyond the beat
But knowing that won't quiet down
The distant songs without a sound

[Outro: fading radio static]
I turn the dial back home
And wonder what I missed.

title: Different Curtain Call
lyrics:
[Intro: theatrical piano, velvet synth]

[Verse 1: melodic conversational flow]
The curtain rose, I stepped into the light
And found a role that somehow fit just right
The audience is warm, the story's sweet
But other scripts are scattered at my feet

[Pre-Chorus: swelling harmonies]
Every line I never got to say
Belongs to someone I could play

[Chorus: dramatic octave leaps]
I'm giving everything to this performance
But dreaming of another stage
I know this story has a happy ending
Still I want to turn another page
[Soaring sustained vocal]
How can I give this life my all
While wishing for a different curtain call?

[Break: half-time 808, cascading keys]

[Bridge: vulnerable falsetto]
There is no understudy for my heart
No second stage where I can restart
And while the crowd is cheering me
I'm mourning who I'll never be

[Final Hook: layered harmonies]
The spotlight's warm, the story's mine
Why do I dream of other lines?

[Outro: piano resolves]
And still I take my bow.

title: Sweep the Floor
lyrics:
[Intro: delicate piano, deep 808 pulse]

[Verse 1: gentle melodic phrasing]
I started with a thousand shapes inside the stone
Every one a future I could call my own
I carved away the pieces till a face appeared
And found a life more beautiful than I had feared

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonies]
But scattered on the studio floor
Are all the things I can't restore

[Chorus: soaring bittersweet melody]
Every masterpiece leaves something behind
A thousand possibilities I'll never find
I love the shape of everything I've made
But mourn the marble that I chipped away
[Layered falsetto, descending run]
How can something look so right
And cost a thousand other lives?

[Break: melodic cowbell, syncopated bass]

[Bridge: intimate, suspended chords]
I couldn't make them all come true
Each little cut was something new
And even if I started clean
I'd lose another world unseen

[Outro: soft falsetto]
The statue stands so beautifully
But I still sweep the floor.

title: My Shadow Has Another Life
lyrics:
[Intro: reversed guitar, whispered doubles]
(me-me, not-me)
[808 heartbeat]

[Verse 1: melancholic melodic rap]
My shadow walks a little out of time
Takes the exits that I leave behind
He kisses strangers, climbs forbidden hills
Lives a thousand lives while I stand still
(oh-oh, look at him go)

[Pre-Chorus: layered ascending thirds]
But when I turn to face the sun
He fades until there's only one

[Chorus: soaring emotional harmonies]
Oh, my shadow has another life
Every dream I couldn't fit in mine
I love the hands that hold me here
But envy everything that disappears
(ah-ah-ah, somewhere else!)
I wouldn't trade the love I've known
So why can't I leave that ghost alone?

[Drop: chopped vocal duet, 808 slides]
(me-me, him-him)
(stay-go, stay-go!)
[Syncopated breakbeat]

[Bridge: fragile falsetto]
(He wants your life) I want his too
(He envies you) Could that be true?
Perhaps we're both convinced somehow
The other knows a better now

[Final Hook: octave harmonies]
I chase the life he gets to live
He chases everything I'd give
(two lives, one light)

[Outro: fading whisper]
We both think the other won.

title: Menu After Dinner
lyrics:
[Intro: clinking glasses, jazzy keys]
(one more taste, one more taste)
[Playful 808 groove]

[Verse 1: bouncy melodic flow]
I ordered everything my heart desired
Every flavor set my soul on fire
Now the plates are empty, feeling fine
But I'm still reading every other line
(what-if, what-if)

[Pre-Chorus: playful falsetto]
I loved each bite, I loved the night
So why's the menu still in sight?

[Chorus: bright stacked harmonies]
I'm reading the menu after dinner
Wondering if another dish was sweeter
Full of everything I ever wanted
Still by everything unchosen haunted
(oh-oh-oh, another bite!)
I know this meal was made for me
Why can't I let the others be?

[Drop: chopped rhythmic vocals]
(taste-taste, waste-waste!)
(bmm-ka-tss, ah-ee-ah!)

[Bridge: stripped keys, reflective]
A thousand dishes, one small life
No second stomach, no rewind
Maybe the hunger never ends
No matter what the table sends

[Outro: gentle falsetto]
Compliments to the chef...
Could I see the menu again?

title: Distant Light
lyrics:
[Intro: cosmic choir, radio static]
(ground control... ooh-ah)

[Verse 1: floating melodic rap]
I've got green grass underneath my feet
People in my arms who make life sweet
But every night another planet glows
A million little places I won't go
(far-far, far away)

[Pre-Chorus: rising celestial harmonies]
I love the gravity of home
But dream of worlds I'll never know

[Chorus: soaring octave leaps]
There's a moon I never landed on
A thousand skies I'll never wake upon
My world is beautiful and bright
But I'm in love with distant light
(ah-ah, beyond the blue!)
How do I stop reaching for the stars
When everything I need is where we are?

[Drop: weightless vocal chops, 808 glide]
(launch-launch, stay-stay!)
(ooh-ee-ah, ah-ee-ah!)

[Bridge: breathy falsetto]
If I could live a thousand years
Would I run out of atmospheres?
Or would each world become a home
With one more moon beyond its glow?

[Outro: radio fading]
Earth is beautiful...
I still look up.

title: Another Staircase
lyrics:
[Intro: ascending synth staircase]
(up-up, never done)
[808 pulse in odd meter]

[Verse 1: syncopated melodic rap]
I climbed a hundred steps to find this view
Built a little heaven painted blue
Everything I wanted waits inside
But there's another staircase on the side
(higher, higher)

[Pre-Chorus: climbing falsetto]
Every landing feels like home
Until I see the steps unknown

[Chorus: soaring ascending melody]
There's always another floor
Another window, another door
I swear this time I'll settle down
Then hear another staircase sound
(ah-ah-ah, going up!)
If happiness is where I stand
Why do I keep reaching with my hands?

[Drop: pitched chops, rising bass]
(up-up, more-more!)
[Glitch breakbeat, melodic cowbell]

[Bridge: beat drops, whispered]
I'm tired of climbing toward the sun
And calling every landing incomplete
What if the highest floor I find
Still leaves a staircase in my mind?

[Outro: descending harmonies]
The view is perfect...
Why am I looking up?

title: So Many Silent Keys
lyrics:
[Intro: wandering piano, offbeat clicks]
(do-mi-sol... no-no)
[Syncopated bass enters]

[Verse 1: lilting melodic rap]
I've written something beautiful in C
A melody that sounds just like me
Every chord belongs exactly where it lands
Still I dream of songs beyond my hands
(ah-ah, unresolved)

[Pre-Chorus: rising stacked thirds]
A hundred keys beneath my fingers
A thousand songs that never linger

[Chorus: soaring falsetto, piano runs]
I'm in love with the song I'm singing
But another melody keeps ringing
Every note I never play
Becomes a ghost that won't decay
(oh-oh-oh, sing it!)
How can I call this music mine
When I hear another all the time?

[Drop: chopped solfege, elastic 808]
(do-do, re-re, mi-ah!)
(bmm-tss-ka, bmm-tss-ka)

[Bridge: key change, delicate duet]
(Play what you love) I always do
(Then why the ache?) There's more that's true
I know one song can fill a room
But not the whole world I imagine

[Outro: suspended piano chord]
One beautiful song...
So many silent keys.

title: My Heart's at Sea
lyrics:
[Intro: foghorn, shimmering arpeggios]
(oh-oh, far away)
[Deep rolling 808]

[Verse 1: melodic low-register groove]
I built a tower on a rocky shore
A steady light through every storm
The ships come home because I'm here
And all the people I hold dear
(stay safe, stay safe)

[Pre-Chorus: falsetto ascent]
But when the sails catch evening gold
I envy everything they hold

[Chorus: expansive harmonies]
I'm a lighthouse dreaming of the sea
Anchored to the life that's good to me
I can see the world but cannot go
And I love this shore more than they'll know
(oh-oh, let me sail!)
How can something built to shine
Still wish for another life?

[Drop: chopped choir, rolling bass]
(sail-sail, stay-stay!)
(boom-ka-tss, ah-ee-ah!)

[Bridge: stripped, emotional]
If I could leave, who'd find their way?
If I remain, what fades away?
There's no horizon I can chase
Without abandoning this place

[Outro: distant falsetto]
My light is bright...
My heart's at sea.

title: The Lives I Never Knew
lyrics:
[Intro: echoing footsteps, music box]
(look-look, that's me?)

[Verse 1: intimate sing-rap]
There's a museum underneath my skin
With every life I never settled in
A painter here, a wanderer there
A stranger wearing my familiar stare
(ooh-oh, who are you?)

[Pre-Chorus: rising falsetto]
And in the biggest gallery
The happiest face belongs to me

[Chorus: soaring octave harmonies]
But I keep visiting the other rooms
Falling for the lives I never knew
Every portrait has a different smile
I could stand before them for a while
(ah-ah, stay with me!)
Why can't I love the art I've made
Without the ghosts of the paintings I gave away?

[Drop: glitchy chopped vocals]
(me-me, who-who?)
[Syncopated bass, staccato keys]

[Bridge: fragile whispered duet]
(Which one is real?) The one I live
(Then why do you ache?) For what I didn't give
To all the versions left behind
Still breathing somewhere in my mind

[Outro: distant piano]
[Gallery doors close]
I never learned to leave.

title: The Orchard of Almost
lyrics:
[Intro: plucked strings, vinyl hiss]
(ripe-ripe, fall-fall)

[Verse 1: bouncing melodic flow]
I've got sweet fruit hanging from my tree
More than enough for a life of plenty
But beyond the fence, another orchard grows
With a thousand flavors that I'll never know
(never know, never know)

[Pre-Chorus: climbing thirds]
Every branch I never climbed
Keeps growing somewhere in my mind

[Chorus: lush melodic harmonies]
Oh, the orchard of almost
The sweetest things I'll never taste
I fill my hands with everything
And still I mourn what goes to waste
(ah-ah, falling down!)
Every fruit I leave behind
Keeps ripening inside my mind

[Drop: chopped falsetto, syncopated 808]
(pick-pick, miss-miss)
(bmm-tss-ka, ooh-ah!)

[Bridge: aching vocal duet]
(You've got enough) I know, I know
(Then let them go) I can't let go
The sweetest harvest still can sting
When autumn takes the other things

[Outro: soft descending melody]
I love the fruit upon my tongue
And grieve the ones forever young.

title: Golden Bowl
lyrics:
[Intro: underwater synth, liquid bass]
(bloop-bloop, ah-ah)

[Verse 1: flowing melodic rap]
Crystal walls and coral gold
Everything a heart could hope to hold
Warmest waters, nothing here to fear
Still I dream of tides that disappear
(far away, far away)

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonies]
I press my face against the glass
And watch a thousand oceans pass

[Chorus: soaring falsetto]
I'm swimming in a golden bowl
With the deepest ocean in my soul
Everything I need is here
So why's the open water calling?
(oh-oh-oh, calling!)
Would I trade this perfect blue
For a world that might break me in two?

[Drop: melodic 808, vocal scat]
(swim-swim, wish-wish!)
(ooh-ee-ah, ooh-ee-ah!)

[Bridge: intimate, beatless]
Maybe freedom tastes like salt
Maybe longing is my fault
But every wave I cannot ride
Leaves another ocean trapped inside

[Outro: whispered]
The water's warm...
So why am I cold?

title: Why Am I Cold
lyrics:
[Intro: underwater synth, liquid bass]
(bloop-bloop, ah-ah)

[Verse 1: flowing melodic rap]
Crystal walls and coral gold
Everything a heart could hope to hold
Warmest waters, nothing here to fear
Still I dream of tides that disappear
(far away, far away)

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonies]
I press my face against the glass
And watch a thousand oceans pass

[Chorus: soaring falsetto]
I'm swimming in a golden bowl
With the deepest ocean in my soul
Everything I need is here
So why's the open water calling?

Would I trade this perfect blue
For a world that might break me in two?

[Drop: melodic 808, vocal scat]

Maybe freedom tastes like salt

So why am I cold?

title: Next Stop, Never
lyrics:
[Intro: distant train, reversed piano]
(choo-choo, ooh-ah-ah)
[Warm 808 pulse]

[Verse 1: melodic syncopated flow]
Got a window seat in paradise
Beautiful companions, beautiful ride
Every station glows with somewhere new
Every passing face, a life I never knew
(oh-oh, never knew)

[Pre-Chorus: climbing falsetto]
The tracks are golden underneath
So why's the leaving haunting me?

[Chorus: soaring layered harmonies]
Every town is calling my name
Every road's a beautiful shame
I'm on the train I wanted to ride
But I'm falling for the passing countryside
(ah-ah-ah, let me go!)
How can I love where I belong
And still want every place that's gone?

[Drop: pitched vocal chops, sliding bass]
(stay-stay, go-go)
(bmm-ka-tss, ah-ee-ah!)

[Bridge: stripped piano, fragile]
I know a thousand destinations
Can't fit inside a single life
But knowing doesn't stop the ache
Of every turn I didn't take

[Outro: descending falsetto]
(Next stop... never)
[Train fades]

title: Paper Room
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I gave my name to every open door
Left little pieces on a hundred floors
I promised mornings I could never keep
And taught my restless heart to lose its sleep

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you arrived, the answer in your hands
While I was tangled in the vows I made

[Chorus]
I found the one too late, too late to turn
A paper room where every promise burns
I see the life we might have had go by
And wear my borrowed face; I can’t say why
Am I confused, or past redemption now?
I’m boxed inside the choices I made somehow

[Verse 2]
You held the key; I couldn’t name the lock
I watched the seasons gather on the clock
You took the road that should have been our own
I stayed behind, surrounded but alone

[Bridge]
If I could give back every careless yes
Would there be room for one true tenderness?

[Final Chorus]
I found the one too late, too late to turn
A paper room where every promise burns
I see the life we might have had go by
Still wearing all the words I can’t untie
Am I confused, or past redemption now?
I’m boxed inside the choices I made somehow
[Outro]
The life meant for us passes by

title: Found You Too Late
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I gave my best in borrowed rooms
Made forever sound like something I could do
Every promise took a piece I couldn't keep
Now your name is where the silence gets too deep

[Pre-Chorus]
I was handing out the keys
To a house that wasn't mine
Now the door swings in the wind
And you're standing on the other side

[Chorus]
I found you too late, too late to be free
Too many vows have a hold over me
I watch the life I was meant to live pass by
In this little box, with the whole world outside
I found you too late—tell me, how do I undo?
I gave away the part that should've belonged to you

[Verse 2]
I wore each goodbye like a promise in disguise
Kept saying I was fine till I believed the lie
Now I can't tell the guilty from the true
Or if there's anything left worth giving you

[Bridge]
If I break these walls, who pays for what I've done?
If I stay inside, I lose the only one

[Final Chorus]
I found you too late, too late to be free
Too many vows have a hold over me
I watch the life I was meant to live pass by
In this little box, with the whole world outside
I found you too late—tell me, how do I undo?
I gave away the part that should've belonged to you

[Outro]
Too late, too late—still reaching for you

title: Stuck in a Box
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Clipped electronic percussion, tense fretless bass accent]

[Verse 1]
Too many names written in the sand
Too many promises I couldn't keep
I gave away pieces of who I am
Left myself hollow, left myself deep
Now every word feels borrowed and old
A bank of debt that I can't clear
Standing outside in the bitter cold
Watching the ghost of what's right here

[Pre-Chorus]
I build the walls of my own wooden shell
Cardboard corners and a heavy key
I know your eyes and I know them well
But there is nothing left inside of me

[Chorus]
Stuck in a box, watching you pass by
Watching the love that was meant for us die
I gave it all away to the wrong ones first
Now I'm unredeemable, bound by the curse
Stuck in a box, watching you pass by
Yeah, watching the love that was meant for us die

[Verse 2]
Syncopated shadows on the bedroom floor
Every past mistake is a closed-up door
I see your silhouette, clear as day
Holding the key that I threw away
Lost in the puzzle, confused in the dark
No spark left to light up your mark

[Chorus]
Stuck in a box, watching you pass by
Watching the love that was meant for us die
I gave it all away to the wrong ones first
Now I'm unredeemable, bound by the curse
Stuck in a box, watching you pass by
Yeah, watching the love that was meant for us die

[Bridge]
[Odd-meter instrumental turn, elastic fretless bass fills, shifting signatures]
Unredeemable... confused in the light...
I used up my heart before you arrived tonight...

[Chorus]
Stuck in a box, watching you pass by
Watching the love that was meant for us die
I gave it all away to the wrong ones first
Now I'm unredeemable, bound by the curse
Stuck in a box, watching you pass by
Yeah, watching the love that was meant for us die

[Outro]
Too late, too late...
Stuck in a box...
Watching you pass by...
[Fade out with syncopated slap bass and clipped electronic beats]

title: Heart in a Box
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I gave my name to every passing hand
Made little vows I couldn't understand
Now every promise has a lock and key
And every room is closing in on me

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you arrived, clear as a morning bell
I knew your heart; I knew myself too well

[Chorus]
I found the one too late, too late
The door swings wide, but I can't escape
I watch the life we might have made
Go by the window, bright and untouchable
I found the one too late, too late
A heart in a box with no way to change

[Verse 2]
I count the yeses tangled in my sleeve
The borrowed futures I was meant to leave
You turn the corner, sunlight at your side
I call myself a thing I can't absolve

[Bridge]
Which way is out? Which way is true?
I built this cage; it holds me through

[Final Chorus]
I found the one too late, too late
The door swings wide, but I can't escape
I watch the life we might have made
Go by the window, bright and untouchable
I found the one too late, too late
A heart in a box with no way to change

[Outro]
Too late, too late
I watch you pass; I stay

title: Pieces in the Wrong Places
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I spent my yes on borrowed nights
Kept every door a little wide
Gave out the parts I meant to save
Made promises I couldn't keep

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you arrived, and all at once
The room went still, the years stood up
I knew your name before you spoke
But every vow was already broke

[Chorus]
I feel like a puzzle with the pieces in the wrong places
You’re the picture I can see, but I can’t make the shapes fit
I found the one too late, with my hands full of old promises
Now I’m boxed in, watching my life’s love pass me by

[Verse 2]
I gave my best to passing flames
And wore their endings like my name
You hold the future I once drew
While all my past keeps pulling through

[Bridge]
If I could turn the years around
I’d leave those empty vows face down
But time has locked the frame in place
And I can only watch your face

[Final Chorus]
I feel like a puzzle with the pieces in the wrong places
You’re the picture I can see, but I can’t make the shapes fit
I found the one too late, with my hands full of old promises
Now I’m boxed in, watching my life’s love pass me by

[Outro]
The picture’s clear
The pieces aren’t

title: The Good Man
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I spent my yes on borrowed fires,
Kept every promise, fed each flame.
Now you arrive with open hands,
And I can’t meet you without blame.

[Pre-Chorus]
There’s a door I could step through,
But every hinge remembers who
I swore I’d never leave behind.

[Chorus]
How do I become the good man
If loving you breaks someone else?
You’re the life I should have chosen,
But I locked myself inside this shell.
I see our almost passing by—
The one I found too late, too late.

[Verse 2]
I watch your train pull out at dawn,
My old vows rattling in the cage.
I gave away the room for us
Before I knew your face or name.

[Pre-Chorus]
If I reach now, somebody falls;
If I stay, I lose it all.

[Chorus]
How do I become the good man
If loving you breaks someone else?
You’re the life I should have chosen,
But I locked myself inside this shell.
I see our almost passing by—
The one I found too late, too late.

[Bridge]
No clean escape, no harmless way,
Just all the words I can’t unsay.

[Final Chorus]
How do I become the good man
If loving you breaks someone else?
You’re the life I should have chosen—
I watch you go, and keep the cell.
The one I found too late, too late.

title: Too Late to Open the Door
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You found me after all the vows
Were scattered in too many rooms
I gave away the parts of me
I should have saved to bring to you

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every promise has a name
Every door remembers blame

[Chorus]
How do I stay the good man I planned to be
If loving you makes somebody bleed?
You’re the life I should have chosen, right in front of me
And I’m boxed in by the hurt I’d leave
How do I love you without breaking what I swore?
I found the one—too late to open the door

[Verse 2]
I watch the years I might have had
Go walking past with your hand in mine
But I can’t call a clean beginning
When my old words are still alive

[Bridge]
I built this box with promises
And now the hinges hold me fast

[Final Chorus]
How do I stay the good man I planned to be
If loving you makes somebody bleed?
You’re the life I should have chosen, right in front of me
And I’m boxed in by the hurt I’d leave
I found the one—too late to open the door

title: Evil for Falling
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I gave my Saturdays away
To every hand that asked me to stay
I signed my name beneath their plans
And learned to leave before I can

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you came in, quiet and sure
And every old door held its cure

[Chorus]
Am I evil for falling in love too late?
I wasn’t sure what love was meant to feel like
Now I’m locked away, watching you pass by
The life I should have held is waving goodbye
Am I evil for falling in love too late?

[Verse 2]
Too many promises tied my shoes
Too many borrowed lives to lose
You stood there with the room to stay
I watched my chance roll clean away

[Bridge]
I built the box from yes and maybe
Now the walls are all I have

[Final Chorus]
Am I evil for falling in love too late?
I wasn’t sure what love was meant to feel like
Now I’m locked away, watching you pass by
The life I should have held is waving goodbye
Am I evil for falling in love too late?
[Outro]
Too late, too late—still I know your name

title: I’m Just the Shell
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I spent my yes on borrowed names,
Made every promise sound like home.
Then you arrived without a warning,
And I was bound to what I’d sworn.

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every door remembers me,
Every key turns in the wrong.

[Chorus]
I found you late, I found you late,
With half a heart behind the gate.
I’m just the shell of who you could have had,
I’m sorry, love—I’ll give you what I have.
Every morsel left, every breath I save,
If I ever reach you through this box I made.
I found you late, I found you late,
And watch the life we might have had escape.

[Verse 2]
I see your hand pull back from mine,
Not from a lack of wanting to.
I filled my pockets up with promises,
Now none of them can carry me to you.

[Bridge]
I gave away the living parts,
Kept the outline, kept the name.
If there’s a road that leads to you,
I’ll bring what’s left, though it’s not the same.

[Final Chorus]
I found you late, I found you late,
With half a heart behind the gate.
I’m just the shell of who you could have had,
I’m sorry, love—I’ll give you what I have.
Every morsel left, every breath I save,
If I ever reach you through this box I made.
I found you late, I found you late,
And watch the life we might have had escape.

[Outro]
If I ever get to you,
I’ll give you what is left.

title: The Leftovers
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept my word till the calendar tore
Left little pieces at every door
I learned to say yes when I wanted to stay
Now you’re here and I’m worn thin from yesterday

[Pre-Chorus]
You came when my hands were already tied
With all those promises knotted inside

[Chorus]
I gave the best of me away
Now I’ve got the leftovers for you
You’re the one I wanted to save
But I’m too late to give you what I meant to
I gave the best of me away
And I can’t make those old vows come untrue

[Verse 2]
I’m boxed in by the names I tried to keep
A stack of borrowed dreams too tall to sleep
You’re standing just beyond the closing frame
And every road I chose keeps calling my name

[Pre-Chorus]
I see the life we might have had in view
While all my yesterday stands between me and you

[Chorus]
I gave the best of me away
Now I’ve got the leftovers for you
You’re the one I wanted to save
But I’m too late to give you what I meant to
I gave the best of me away
And I can’t make those old vows come untrue

[Bridge]
If I could take one promise back
I’d bring my whole heart through the crack
But time won’t bend, the door swings wide
And you keep moving with your life

[Final Chorus]
I gave the best of me away
Now I’ve got the leftovers for you
You’re the one I wanted to save
But I’m too late to give you what I meant to
I gave the best of me away
The life meant for us passes through

[Outro]
I wish I’d saved the best for you

title: Behind This Little Wall
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I spent my yes on borrowed rooms
Left pieces where the strangers stayed
Made vows beneath a passing moon
Then watched the promise turn to shade

[Pre-Chorus]
Now you arrive with open hands
And I am tied to what I gave

[Chorus]
I want to mold the fabric of the universe
Make our paths cross before the years run out
I found the one too late, too late
Now I’m behind this little wall
Watching the life we could have had
Go by, go by, beyond my call

[Verse 2]
I gave my best to every door
Kept every promise like a chain
You’re standing where I dreamed before
But I can’t ask you to wait again

[Bridge]
If time could loosen every thread
I’d pull the whole sky into place
Turn every road I took instead
And meet you early, face to face

[Final Chorus]
I want to mold the fabric of the universe
Make our paths cross before the years run out
I found the one too late, too late
Now I’m behind this little wall
Watching the life we could have had
Go by, go by, beyond my call

[Outro]
Too late, too late
I see you pass me by

title: Almost
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I spent my yes like borrowed cash
Signed my name on promises
Held every hand that reached for mine
Till there was nothing left to give
Then you arrived, the quiet truth
The door I should have found before
I see the life we might have had
From the wrong side of a closing door

[Pre-Chorus]
I built this box from every vow
And now I can’t climb out

[Chorus]
I’d teleport around the world to you
Freeze the clock the moment I got through
But all my roads are tied to yesterday
And you’re the love I can’t make stay
I’d cross the earth, I’d stop the sky
If time would let me reach your side
I found the one too late, too late
Now I watch our almost-love slip away

[Verse 2]
Your train pulls out; I miss the wave
My hands are full of debts I made
I’d trade the years I gave away
For one unpromised day with you

[Bridge]
If I could fold the miles in two
I’d step outside this life and choose you
One breath, one pause, one open gate
One little moment before too late

[Final Chorus]
I’d teleport around the world to you
Freeze the clock the moment I got through
But all my roads are tied to yesterday
And you’re the love I can’t make stay
I found the one too late, too late
Now I watch our almost-love slip away

[Outro]
Too late, too late
I watch you slip away

title: Bend Space and Time
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I spent my name on borrowed promises
Left little pieces in too many hands
Then you arrived, the quiet answer
And I was bound by all the words I’d planned

[Pre-Chorus]
I see the door, I know the way
But every vow has made me stay

[Chorus]
I wish I could bend space and time
Bring me closer to you for eternity
I found the one too late, too late
Now I watch my life pass by in front of me
I wish I could bend space and time
Undo the years I gave away
I found the one too late, too late
And I can’t make the box give way

[Verse 2]
Your hand is near, the glass is steady
My old commitments keep the lock in place
I gave away the parts I needed
Now I can only learn your face

[Pre-Chorus]
I see the door, I know the way
But every vow has made me stay

[Chorus]
I wish I could bend space and time
Bring me closer to you for eternity
I found the one too late, too late
Now I watch my life pass by in front of me

[Bridge]
If one small second could turn around
I’d meet you before I let myself be bound

[Final Chorus]
I wish I could bend space and time
Bring me closer to you for eternity
I found the one too late, too late
Still every part of me is reaching you

title: Split Into Two
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I spent my yes on borrowed years,
Made promises I couldn't keep.
I learned to leave before the tears,
Then found you while the debts ran deep.

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every door I ever opened
Has somebody holding the key.
I see the life I should have given you
Moving just beyond my reach.

[Chorus]
I wish I could split into two,
Give you a me that's all for you.
One heart to stay, one heart to choose,
A whole unbroken life with you.
I wish I could split into two—
But all I have is what I used.

[Verse 2]
I'm boxed in by the words I gave,
By names that still depend on me.
You turn toward a brighter day;
I watch the one we might have been.

[Bridge]
If I could cut the past in half,
I'd send the better part to you.
But every vow keeps pulling back—
I can't make one life into two.

[Final Chorus]
I wish I could split into two,
Give you a me that's all for you.
One heart to stay, one heart to choose,
A whole unbroken life with you.
I wish I could split into two—
I found my home too late for you.

[Outro]
Too late for you.

title: Another Life
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I gave my weekends, gave my name
Made forever sound the same
Every promise tied a knot
Till I forgot what I had not

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you came with open hands
And I was bound by older plans

[Chorus]
If I could live another life
I’d find you at the other side
Before I gave my heart away
Before I let the years decide
If I could start the world anew
I’d save the part that leads to you
You came too late, but still I know
You’re the only place I’d go

[Verse 2]
I watch the door I cannot take
A quiet room, a clean mistake
I meant each word I used to say
Now they’re the walls that make me stay

[Bridge]
Somewhere there’s a version of me
Who kept one promise just for you
He’s walking in before the ending
And reaching out when I reach too

[Final Chorus]
If I could live another life
I’d find you at the other side
Before I gave my heart away
Before I let the years decide
If I could start the world anew
I’d save the part that leads to you
You came too late, but still I know
You’re the only place I’d go

[Outro]
Another life, I’d choose you first

title: If I Had Another Life
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned to say forever with a suitcase by the door
Left pieces of my name in rooms I don't visit anymore
I gave my best yes to a hundred almosts
Kept every promise like a key I couldn't toss

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you arrived with nothing left to spend
And every road I'd taken bent toward you again

[Chorus]
If I had another life, I'd find you there
With open hands and time enough to spare
But this one keeps me boxed behind the things I swore
I watch the love I was made for walk out the door
If I had another life, another try
I'd get to you before goodbye

[Verse 2]
Your laugh came through the doorway like a song I almost knew
I held my breath, already bound to what I said I'd do
No villain, no mistake to blame it on
Just years of being needed, and the years already gone

[Pre-Chorus]
You looked at me like I could still be free
I wanted to say, “Come build a life with me”

[Chorus]
If I had another life, I'd find you there
With open hands and time enough to spare
But this one keeps me boxed behind the things I swore
I watch the love I was made for walk out the door
If I had another life, another try
I'd get to you before goodbye

[Bridge]
Maybe somewhere I arrive with nothing owed
No borrowed vows, no crowded road
I turn toward you before the years begin
And get to choose the life we're standing in

[Final Chorus]
If I had another life, I'd find you there
With open hands and time enough to spare
But this one keeps me boxed behind the things I swore
I watch the love I was made for walk out the door
If I had another life, another try
I'd get to you before goodbye
If I had another life—
I'd spend it by your side

[Outro]
I'd spend it by your side

title: Leash Knotted to the Past
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
At the county pound, you pressed your hand to glass
I had learned to sit still, let the wrong ones call me theirs
One took me home for a season, one for a year
I kept my paws on the door, kept hoping you'd appear

[Pre-Chorus]
I gave away my good years, my collar, every name
Made promises I couldn't keep, then carried all the blame

[Chorus]
You came when I was boxed in, leash knotted to the past
I see the home we could have had go slowly rolling past
I was yours before I knew it, but I waited far too long
Now the right one stands outside while I keep living wrong

[Verse 2]
You had a quiet kitchen, a patch of afternoon
A place beside your chair, a bowl beneath the moon
I learned to love the lock, the narrow little view
And watched your taillights disappear with all I couldn't undo

[Pre-Chorus]
I spent my yes on strangers, wore my sorry thin
Now you're holding out your hand; I can't get out again

[Chorus]
You came when I was boxed in, leash knotted to the past
I see the home we could have had go slowly rolling past
I was yours before I knew it, but I waited far too long
Now the right one stands outside while I keep living wrong

[Outro]
At the county pound, the door swings wide
I know your face; I stay inside

title: The Leash Tied Tight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They put a paper tag around my neck,
said, “Good dog, this one’s easy to keep.”
I learned the shape of every stranger’s hand,
then watched their car lights leave the street.
I spent my yes on borrowed forever,
left little pieces in every room.
Now you’re standing there with the right kind eyes,
and I’m behind a door I helped them build too soon.

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear your keys turn in the lock,
but every promise holds me fast.

[Chorus]
I was yours too late, too late,
with the leash tied tight to yesterday.
You were the home I waited for;
I’m watching through the pound’s front door.
I was yours too late, too late,
all my good years given away.
The right one came, the gate stayed closed—
I see you go. I see you go.

[Verse 2]
They called me family till the rent came due,
then passed me on like a favor gone bad.
I kept my tail up, learned not to ask,
made every almost-home feel like all I had.
You stop outside; I know your shoes.
I know the pause before you turn.
I’ve got a heart that still runs to you,
but nowhere left to put what I have learned.

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear your keys turn in the lock,
but every promise holds me fast.

[Chorus]
I was yours too late, too late,
with the leash tied tight to yesterday.
You were the home I waited for;
I’m watching through the pound’s front door.
I was yours too late, too late,
all my good years given away.
The right one came, the gate stayed closed—
I see you go. I see you go.

[Bridge]
If I could bark the years back loose,
I’d run to you with nothing owed.
But I’m still wearing every name
of every hand that let me go.

[Final Chorus]
I was yours too late, too late,
with the leash tied tight to yesterday.
You were the home I waited for;
I’m watching through the pound’s front door.
The right one came, the gate stayed closed—
I see you go. I see you go.

title: Recipe for My Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I spent my yes on borrowed names,
Kept every promise burning bright.
Then you came in, flour on your sleeve,
And made the kitchen feel like home.

[Pre-Chorus]
The jar was sealed before I knew
What I was saving it all for.

[Chorus]
I’m past the date, still on the shelf,
The missing taste in somebody’s meal.
You’re the one I should have met
Before I gave the best of me away.
Now I’m boxed up, watching you go,
The perfect table set below.
I found my life too late to start—
You were the recipe for my heart.

[Verse 2]
I gave my hands to other fires,
Said “always” till the word wore thin.
Now there’s a lock across the door,
And all my good intentions spoil within.

[Pre-Chorus]
You laugh; the room turns warm and wide.
I’m sealed behind the glass tonight.

[Chorus]
I’m past the date, still on the shelf,
The missing taste in somebody’s meal.
You’re the one I should have met
Before I gave the best of me away.
Now I’m boxed up, watching you go,
The perfect table set below.
I found my life too late to start—
You were the recipe for my heart.

[Bridge]
If time could take one vow back,
I’d keep my name, my hands, my hunger.
But every label has its fact:
Some doors close while you’re getting younger.

[Final Chorus]
I’m past the date, still on the shelf,
The missing taste in somebody’s meal.
You’re the one I should have met
Before I gave the best of me away.
Now I’m boxed up, watching you go,
The perfect table set below.
I found my life too late to start—
You were the recipe for my heart.

[Outro]
You were the recipe for my heart.

title: Locked Gate
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept a spare key for every almost,
left my name in rooms I won't go back to.
Said “forever” like a coat I could lend,
then watched the seams come loose again.

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the door clicks shut from the outside,
and your light lands just beyond my reach.

[Chorus]
I found you too late, too late,
with my hands full of promises I can't unmake.
You were the life I was meant to choose,
now I'm boxed in, watching you move.
I found you too late, too late—
right love, wrong hour, locked gate.

[Verse 2]
I gave away the parts I meant to save,
made a home in every passing wave.
You say my name; the walls say nothing back,
while the road you wanted fades to black.

[Pre-Chorus]
There you go, with the whole sky open;
here I am, still holding every key.

[Chorus]
I found you too late, too late,
with my hands full of promises I can't unmake.
You were the life I was meant to choose,
now I'm boxed in, watching you move.
I found you too late, too late—
right love, wrong hour, locked gate.

[Bridge]
If I could empty out this crowded room,
would there be enough of me for you?
The latch won't turn. The street keeps going.
I know the way. I just can't go.

[Final Chorus]
I found you too late, too late,
with my hands full of promises I can't unmake.
You were the life I was meant to choose,
now I'm boxed in, watching you move.
I found you too late, too late—
right love, wrong hour, locked gate.

[Outro]
Your taillights cross the ceiling.
I count them till the room goes blue.

title: House of Borrowed Words
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You found me where the old vows gather dust
I’d spent my yes on names I barely knew
I gave away the rooms inside my chest
Then left one narrow door to open for you

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every promise has a borrowed key
And every road I took runs back through me

[Chorus]
I found the one too late, too late to turn
A house of borrowed words, a bridge I burned
I’m boxed behind the life I made before
Watching the love I meant for pass my door
Too late, too late—I know what I let go
You were the place my restless heart could go

[Verse 2]
I kept my calendar in other hands
Kept saying “soon” until the seasons changed
You stood there with your coat beneath your arm
While I rehearsed the reasons I was chained

[Pre-Chorus]
All those little yeses fill the room
I didn’t know they’d leave no space for you

[Chorus]
I found the one too late, too late to turn
A house of borrowed words, a bridge I burned
I’m boxed behind the life I made before
Watching the love I meant for pass my door
Too late, too late—I know what I let go
You were the place my restless heart could go

[Bridge]
If I could lift one promise from the pile
I’d give you back the years, not just a while
But there you go, the morning at your heels
And I’m still here, learning what this box feels

[Final Chorus]
I found the one too late, too late to turn
A house of borrowed words, a bridge I burned
I’m boxed behind the life I made before
Watching the love I meant for pass my door
Too late, too late—I know what I let go
You were the place my restless heart could go

[Outro]
You were the place
I couldn’t reach in time

title: How I Tried (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list beside the sink
Of little things I meant to do
A call returned, a door held open
A borrowed coat brought back to you

[Pre-Chorus]
Some nights I count the good I gave
Some nights the names I let down
Which one will carry past my hands
When I am quiet, when I am gone?

[Chorus]
If love is what I leave behind
Let it be more than what I broke
A place to rest, a little help
A promise kept, a truth I spoke
But every tender thing I tried
Sits next to every time I failed
Tell me which story takes my name
When all the telling has gone still

[Verse 2]
I remember your unanswered call
The kitchen clock, the blue mug cracked
I said I’d come, I didn’t come
And you stopped asking after that

[Pre-Chorus]
I’ve tried to make a useful life
To leave the room a little kind
But every good thing has a seam
Where all my worst days show inside

[Chorus]
If love is what I leave behind
Let it be more than what I broke
A place to rest, a little help
A promise kept, a truth I spoke
But every tender thing I tried
Sits next to every time I failed
Tell me which story takes my name
When all the telling has gone still

[Bridge]
Maybe no single story wins
Maybe both are true at once
The hands that held, the hands that hurt
The words I gave, the ones I swallowed

[Final Chorus]
If love is what I leave behind
Let it be something people use
A meal, a ride, a patient ear
A second chance I didn’t lose
And when my last day comes around
I hope the whole of me is seen
Not only where I fell short
But how I tried to make amends

[Outro]
How I tried
How I tried

title: Storm Behind My Confidence (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I walk into rooms like I know where I’m going,
chin up, voice steady, every weakness hidden.
I know what I’ve built, I know what I’m worth,
but somehow none of it quiets the hurt.

There’s always another road calling my name,
another version of me I could chase.
I should be grateful, I should feel complete,
but satisfaction keeps moving its feet.

[Pre-Chorus]
So I build myself up,
then tear it apart,
pride in my head,
static in my heart.

[Chorus]
There’s a storm behind my confidence,
a question underneath my pride.
I keep saying that I know myself
while changing every road I drive.

And everyone around me
gets caught inside the rain.
They didn’t make this chaos,
but they still absorb the pain.

I hate that my confusion
has consequences too.
I’m trying to find myself
without losing all of you.

[Verse 2]
Some days I feel unstoppable,
like every risk is mine to take.
Other nights I stare at everything
and wonder if I chose by mistake.

I want more life, more love, more motion,
more proof I didn’t waste my time.
But every hunger has a shadow
when somebody else is standing nearby.

[Pre-Chorus]
I call it ambition,
I call it being free,
but sometimes I can’t tell
if I’m running toward or fleeing me.

[Chorus]
There’s a storm behind my confidence,
a question underneath my pride.
I keep saying that I know myself
while changing every road I drive.

And everyone around me
gets caught inside the rain.
They didn’t make this chaos,
but they still absorb the pain.

[Bridge]
I’m sorry for the mixed signals,
for the doors I open then close.
For loving people honestly
while never knowing where I’ll go.

I’m sorry when my restlessness
makes your ground feel insecure.
You deserve more than explanations
from someone who is never sure.

But I can’t fake a destination
just to make the map look clean.
I have to live through all this noise
to learn what any of it means.

[Final Chorus]
There’s a storm behind my confidence,
but I’m learning not to hide.
Pride can keep me standing,
but it cannot be my guide.

I may never find one answer,
one straight road, one perfect view.
But I can own the damage
when my chaos reaches you.

I’m trying to become someone
who can wander without harm.
Someone strong enough to question,
and still safe enough to hold.

title: Ghosts of Choices (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Somewhere I was more ordinary,
same street, same bed, same town.
Somewhere I learned how roots feel
instead of always moving around.

Somewhere I chose one direction,
one love, one version of my name.
Somewhere I stopped reinventing
every time the future changed.

[Chorus]
I miss the lives I never lived,
though they were never really mine.
Ghosts of choices haunt the corners
of a life that turned out fine.

That is the cruel geometry:
one body, one stretch of time.
You can love the road you traveled
and still grieve the roads declined.

[Verse 2]
I chose curiosity often,
chose motion, risk, and reach.
But sometimes I wonder what stability
might have had to teach.

[Bridge]
There is no perfect timeline.
Every paradise has cost.
Every life becomes a cemetery
for possibilities we lost.

[Final Chorus]
So I’ll raise a glass to all of them,
the selves I’ll never meet.
They didn’t die for nothing.
They made this version of me.

title: I Wish I'd Saved a Life (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept the good parts folded in my coat
Spent every promise just to stay afloat
Then you came in with patient, open hands
And I had dust where all the gardens ran

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “I’m here, you don’t have to pretend”
I wanted to begin again
But every room inside me had been cleared
Before the one who mattered ever appeared

[Chorus]
I spent my heart before you found me
Gave it away till nothing stayed
Now you’re the one I’d choose completely
And I’m too worn to make it new again
You deserve the whole of me, not pieces
Not this quiet that I can’t undo
I wish I’d saved a life for loving you

[Verse 2]
Your Sunday coat hangs by my kitchen door
You leave your book beside the grocery list
I watch you laugh and feel the distance grow
Between the man you need and what I’ve got

[Pre-Chorus]
You never asked me to be healed or bright
You only asked me in tonight
I reach for you, then stop before I start
There’s no fresh blood left to give my heart

[Chorus]
I spent my heart before you found me
Gave it away till nothing stayed
Now you’re the one I’d choose completely
And I’m too worn to make it new again
You deserve the whole of me, not pieces
Not this quiet that I can’t undo
I wish I’d saved a life for loving you

[Bridge]
If I could pull the years back from my hands
I’d leave some breath, some tenderness intact
But time won’t turn because I finally know
You’re not too late—the part of me is gone

[Final Chorus]
I spent my heart before you found me
Gave it away till nothing stayed
Still, you’re the one I’d choose completely
Though I’m too worn to make it new again
You deserve the whole of me, not pieces
And I hate that this is all I do
I wish I’d saved a life for loving you
I wish I’d saved a life for loving you

[Outro]
Your Sunday coat still by the door
I wish I had a little more

title: Where the Map Runs Thin (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You call it odd; I call it Tuesday
A paper crown on a crooked chair
I take the side road past the hardware store
With one bright question rattling there

[Chorus]
I’m fine out here on the strange edge
Turning where the map runs thin
You’ll find me when the road bends over
I’ll be somewhere new again

[Verse 2]
The old ideas fit like borrowed jackets
Sleeves too short, the seams pulled wide
I leave them folded by the doorway
And follow what I haven’t tried

[Chorus]
I’m fine out here on the strange edge
Turning where the map runs thin
You’ll find me when the road bends over
I’ll be somewhere new again

[Bridge]
No grand reveal, no final answer
Just a door I haven’t opened yet
I like the little click of knowing
There’s more ahead than I can guess

[Outro]
Keep your place; I’ll send a postcard
From the next uncharted bend
Glad to meet what’s waiting for me
Glad the road won’t have an end

title: Say My Name (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I check my name
Like it's oxygen
Count the views
Like prayer beads in my hand
I want the room
To turn when I enter it
Want a gold light
That I can stand in

[Pre-Chorus]
But I know the stone
Will cool my hands
And all these crowns
Will turn to sand
Still I chase
What slips away
Still I want
To be today

[Chorus]
Say my name, say my name
Make me mean something
Make me worth the flame
I know it fades
I know it fades
But I still reach for the frame
(Still reach for the frame)

[Verse 2]
I keep receipts
For every little win
A compliment
Pinned to the inside of me
I feed the beast
Till it knows my face
Then I hate myself
For needing it

[Pre-Chorus]
'Cause a thousand years
Will wash this clean
No trophy gleam
No magazine
No crowd that swore
They'd never leave
Will hear my voice
Or remember me

[Chorus]
Say my name, say my name
Make me mean something
Make me worth the flame
I know it fades
I know it fades
But I still reach for the frame
(Still reach for the frame)

[Bridge]
If I disappear
Would the world keep turning?
Would my whole life
Still feel worth burning?
I laugh it off
Then I bite my tongue
'Cause I want forever
From a borrowed sun

[Final Chorus]
Say my name, say my name
Make me mean something
Make me worth the flame
I know it fades
I know it fades
But I still reach for the frame
Say my name, say my name
I know it won't stay
Still I want the blaze
(Still reach for the frame)

title: Gold Under Skin (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I met you in your laugh
Before I saw your face
You wore your truth so plain
It changed the whole damn place

The way you hold a room
The way you don’t pretend
You feel like something rare
That I could learn from again

[Pre-Chorus]
And I don’t come to keep
I come to know
The shape of your heart
The way it grows

[Chorus]
Good soul, good soul
I want the whole you
Beautiful boys, beautiful girls
I want the whole world through you
Good soul, good soul
I keep coming back
For the fire in your eyes
And the tenderness you have

[Verse 2]
One day you pull me close
One day you pull away
Still every little side
Feels like a holy day

I love the laugh you hide
I love the ones you show
Every version of you
Makes my own love grow

[Pre-Chorus]
No need to be one thing
No need to stay
I like the way you change
And stay the same

[Chorus]
Good soul, good soul
I want the whole you
Beautiful boys, beautiful girls
I want the whole world through you
Good soul, good soul
I keep coming back
For the fire in your eyes
And the tenderness you have

[Bridge]
Some hearts are one door
Yours is a million
Every room I enter
Feels like I’m beginning

And if you turn a new page
I’ll still want in
I don’t just love your face
I love where you’ve been

[Chorus]
Good soul, good soul
I want the whole you
Beautiful boys, beautiful girls
I want the whole world through you
Good soul, good soul
I keep coming back
For the fire in your eyes
And the tenderness you have

title: Paper Walls (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They feed us fear in a polished suit
Pointing fingers like they know the truth
Paint the neighbors like a threat in the hall
Then act surprised when the bridges fall

They draw a line in the dirt and grin
Tell us the other side is born to sin
But I’ve seen better in the broken places
A little grace on a thousand faces

[Pre-Chorus]
If they want a flame, we water it down
If they want a crowd, we slow it down
We can break that spell
We can choose it well

[Chorus]
Kindness over hate
We can change the shape
Forgive, then let it go
Let the whole world know

Kindness over hate
We can change the shape
One heart, one human race
We all deserve a place

[Verse 2]
You got your father and I got mine
Different prayers at a different time
Still you laugh when the rain comes down
Still you bleed when the world goes down

I’ve held a hand in the hospital light
I’ve seen a stranger make a wrong thing right
No badge, no flag, no color line
Can measure what it means to be kind

[Pre-Chorus]
If they want a wall, we open the gate
If they want revenge, we learn to wait
We can break that spell
We can choose it well

[Chorus]
Kindness over hate
We can change the shape
Forgive, then let it go
Let the whole world know

Kindness over hate
We can change the shape
One heart, one human race
We all deserve a place

[Bridge]
Say it again when the room gets cold
Say it again when the lie gets sold
No more poison on the wire
No more feeding the fire

I can reach you
You can reach me too
If we make some room
Love can make us new

[Final Chorus]
Kindness over hate
We can change the shape
Forgive, then let it go
Let the whole world know

Kindness over hate
We can change the shape
One heart, one human race
We all deserve a place

Kindness over hate
Kindness over hate
We all deserve a place
We all deserve a place

title: Let Them Bloom (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You don't have to fit
in my hands
I can hold your name
without a plan

Wear your colors loud
let them show
I don't need to map
the way you grow

[Pre-Chorus]
Take your time
take the whole road
I can love you
and let you go

[Chorus]
Be you, be you
I love that, I do
Be you, be you
that's the best part of you
Take your shape
take your space
I won't ask you
to change your face
Be you, be you
I love that, I do

[Verse 2]
If you need the room
I'll step back
If you need the sun
I'll share that

If you need to fall
on your own
I'll be right here
when you come home

[Pre-Chorus]
Take your time
take the whole road
I can love you
and let you go

[Chorus]
Be you, be you
I love that, I do
Be you, be you
that's the best part of you
Take your shape
take your space
I won't ask you
to change your face
Be you, be you
I love that, I do

[Bridge]
I don't want a copy
I want your heart
I want the wild
and the awkward parts

The quiet truth
the brave and new
Every piece of you
gets to be you

[Chorus]
Be you, be you
I love that, I do
Be you, be you
that's the best part of you
Take your shape
take your space
I won't ask you
to change your face
Be you, be you
I love that, I do

title: LET IT GO, LET IT GROW (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Intro: mellow keys, vinyl crackle, restrained beat]

Yeah

Some things stay heavy
Only because we keep carrying them

Some names stay loud
Only because we keep saying them in our head

Forgiveness ain’t forgetting

It’s freedom

[Verse 1]

I used to keep a record
Every wrong, every slight
Every word that hit different
Every sleepless night

Had a courtroom in my mind
And I played every role
Judge, jury, witness
Still losing control

Thought anger made me stronger
Thought revenge made me whole
But the fire I was feeding
Was just burning my soul

You can win every argument
Still lose your peace
You can hold onto the grudge
While your happiness leaves

So I had to ask myself
What am I protecting?
A wound from the past
Or a future I’m neglecting?

I can name what you did
I can say it was wrong
And still choose not to drag it
Every place that I’m going

[Hook]

Let it go
Let it grow

You don’t have to carry
What somebody did years ago

Let it breathe
Let it leave

Forgiveness ain’t weakness
It’s choosing to be free

We all fall
We all break

We all got some damage
And some damage that we make

So forgive
When you can

Give somebody room
To become a better human again

[Verse 2]

I’m not saying trust everybody
That would be a lie

Some bridges need distance
Some doors need goodbye

Forgiveness doesn’t mean
You invite them back inside

You can wish somebody healing
From the other side

That’s power

To stop needing them to suffer
To stop feeding all the poison
Just to prove that you were tougher

Because pain gets inherited
If nobody ends the chain

One person drops the weapon
Now the future starts to change

Think of every apology
You hoped somebody heard

Every stupid thing you did
Every careless word

Would you want one bad decision
To define your whole name?

Then maybe we can offer
Other people the same

Not excuses

Not pretending

Not erasing what occurred

Just refusing to make hatred
The last and final word

[Hook]

Let it go
Let it grow

You don’t have to carry
What somebody did years ago

Let it breathe
Let it leave

Forgiveness ain’t weakness
It’s choosing to be free

We all fall
We all break

We all got some damage
And some damage that we make

So forgive
When you can

Give somebody room
To become a better human again

[Bridge: beat drops, spoken flow]

And maybe the hardest one

Is the face in the mirror

For every chance you wasted
Every time you disappeared

Every person you disappointed
Every promise you broke

Every moment you knew better
But still chose what you chose

You can learn without living
With your hands around your throat

Guilt can teach the lesson

Then you gotta let it go

You are more than your worst day

They are more than theirs too

Maybe mercy is the bravest thing
A wounded heart can do

[Beat returns harder]

[Verse 3]

Imagine if we practiced it
Before the anger spread

Before one careless sentence
Turned to ten years left unsaid

Before families became strangers
Before friends became names

Before pride made us prisoners
Inside somebody else’s mistake

Somebody has to be first
Somebody lowers the shield

Somebody says, “Yeah, you hurt me
But I still want us to heal”

title: THE HOLE STILL KNOWS MY NAME (acoustic)
lyrics:
THE HOLE STILL KNOWS MY NAME

[Intro: soft piano, distant room tone]

[Verse 1: intimate, almost conversational]

I like the way a kindness lands
So lightly in another’s hands
A coffee bought, a door held wide
A little warmth against the tide

I like to catch somebody’s eyes
Just when they’re trying not to cry
To say the thing they needed said
To leave a little light instead

[Soft strings enter]

And when they smile
Something in me lifts

For half a second
Everything fits

[Pre-Chorus]

I give because it feels like air
I give because I want to care
I give because the world gets cold
And someone’s got to make it warm

[Chorus: drums and strings swell]

But the hole still knows my name
Even when the room is full of love

Even when somebody holds me close
And tells me I am enough

I believe them
God, I do

I feel the kindness coming through

But somewhere underneath the flame
The hole still knows my name

[Verse 2: fuller arrangement]

I love it when they think of me
A message sent at half past three
A hand upon my shoulder when
I didn’t know I needed one again

I keep those moments like small charms
Proof the world has gentle arms
And every time somebody stays
I think perhaps this time it fades

[Backing Vocal, soft]
Maybe now
Maybe now

[Lead]
But happiness can fill the room
And emptiness still finds the gloom

[Pre-Chorus]

It isn’t that the love feels false
It isn’t that I miss it all
I taste the sweetness
Feel it bloom

And still there’s one unfilled room

[Chorus]

The hole still knows my name
Even when the room is full of love

Even when somebody holds me close
And tells me I am enough

I believe them
God, I do

I feel the kindness coming through

But somewhere underneath the flame
The hole still knows my name

[Instrumental Break: piano melody, restrained guitar swells]

[Bridge: drums drop out]

Maybe I’m a house with open doors
Giving shelter from the storm

Maybe everybody leaves a flower
But the basement stays unborn

Maybe kindness isn’t meant to fix me
Maybe love is not repair

Maybe some things don’t stop hurting
Just because somebody cares

[Pause]

And maybe that can still be beautiful

[Strings rise]

Maybe meaning isn’t cure

Maybe being held inside the darkness
Still matters when the dark endures

[Final Chorus: huge, emotional]

SO THE HOLE STILL KNOWS MY NAME
AND THE ROOM IS STILL FULL OF LOVE

Someone takes my shaking hand
And somehow that is still enough

Not enough to make me whole
Not enough to fill the space

But enough to make me want to stay
And put some kindness in its place

[Choir]
Give it away
Let it return

[Lead]
Even if some corners never learn

[Choir]
Give it away
Let it remain

[Lead]
Love does not have to erase the pain

[Final Refrain: instruments pull back]

The hole still knows my name

But so do you

[Soft backing vocals]
So do you
So do you

[Lead]
And tonight

Maybe that’s enough
To get me through

[Outro: piano only]

I like the way a kindness lands
So lightly in another’s hands

[Long pause]

Maybe tomorrow
I’ll give another one

[Final unresolved piano chord]

title: Half Truth Lantern (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a tray of glass in my chest
one wrong step and the whole thing cracks
I smile with a paper mouth
while the basement floods my shoes

A lamp in the corner knows too much
it leans when I walk by
every secret wears a different coat
every coat has my name inside

[Pre-Chorus]
If you could see
the knots in me
you’d find the thread
and not let go

I’m split clean down
the middle line
still asking love
to touch both sides

[Chorus]
Hold all of me
hold all of me
the safe and the ruin
the bruise and the bloom

Hold all of me
hold all of me
I’m half a storm
and half coming home

[Verse 2]
I juggle matchbooks in a raincoat pocket
send sparks through the fabric seams
my alibis are hummingbirds
with mirrors tied to their knees

I built a little stage of bones
where my fears wear better clothes
then I bowed to the empty room
like it might say, stay

[Pre-Chorus]
If you could see
the static lace
around my thoughts
when you get near

I’m a locked door
with a window bent
I want your hand
to pass right through

[Chorus]
Hold all of me
hold all of me
the safe and the ruin
the bruise and the bloom

Hold all of me
hold all of me
I’m half a storm
and half coming home

[Bridge]
I am the altar
I am the ash
I am the coin
with two bright faces

If you stay close
don’t flinch at the shape
I come in fragments
and that’s the point

[Final Chorus]
Hold all of me
hold all of me
the safe and the ruin
the bruise and the bloom

Hold all of me
hold all of me
I’m half a storm
and half coming home

Hold all of me
hold all of me
I’m a cracked bowl
still carrying light

title: I Rise. (Acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wore my fear like rain
Cold on my back
Doors kept slamming shut
Still I came back

My hands were torn up bad
From holding on
Every “you can’t” I heard
Turned into song

[Pre-Chorus]
I was bent, not broken
I was bruised, not gone
Heard that little voice say
Keep moving on

[Chorus]
I rise, I rise
Out of the dust
I rise, I rise
Stronger than before
You threw the weight
I built my wings
I rise, I rise
I’m mine to keep

[Verse 2]
I slept on hard floors
Counted the cracks
Made a map of pain
Then I walked back

The dark had my name
For a little while
But I learned how to breathe
And I learned how to smile

[Pre-Chorus]
I was bent, not broken
I was bruised, not gone
Heard that little voice say
Keep moving on

[Chorus]
I rise, I rise
Out of the dust
I rise, I rise
Stronger than before
You threw the weight
I built my wings
I rise, I rise
I’m mine to keep

[Bridge]
Call it hard luck
Call it a fight
I took the worst
And made it light

Every scar says
I’m still here
Every tear dropped
Turned into fire

[Final Chorus]
I rise, I rise
Out of the dust
I rise, I rise
Stronger than before
You threw the weight
I built my wings
I rise, I rise
I’m mine to keep

I rise, I rise
Watch me now
I rise, I rise
I don’t back down

title: Second Stair Creak (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My knees talk back now
When I stand too fast
My hands keep dropping
What they used to catch
I bend to tie my shoes
And I need that pause
Like my body’s asking
Who gave you these laws?

[Pre-Chorus]
And every little ache
Starts a bigger thought
That I laugh off first
Then I don’t

[Chorus]
Am I gonna die?
Am I gonna die?
Say it plain, say it plain
When the room gets quiet
Am I gonna die?
Am I gonna die?
I’m still right here
But I feel time bite

[Verse 2]
My back wakes up sore
Before the day begins
I hear my joints complaining
Through my skin
The mirror keeps a record
I can’t unsee
A slower walk
A stranger in me

[Pre-Chorus]
And every little crack
Turns into a flame
I brush it off
Then I say the name

[Chorus]
Am I gonna die?
Am I gonna die?
Say it plain, say it plain
When the room gets quiet
Am I gonna die?
Am I gonna die?
I’m still right here
But I feel time bite

[Bridge]
Last week it was nothing
Now I’m counting breaths
A bill in the drawer
A call I haven’t made yet
I don’t need forever
Just a little more grace
To wake up tomorrow
And still know my face

[Chorus]
Am I gonna die?
Am I gonna die?
Say it plain, say it plain
When the room gets quiet
Am I gonna die?
Am I gonna die?
I’m still right here
But I feel time bite

[Outro]
My knees talk back now
When I stand too fast
I’m learning how to live
With the fact it won’t last

title: Nap Away (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You got that look again
Like the day won't start
Shoes by the door
Keys in your hand
But your mind's still parked

A stubborn sky above
A heavy little load
I see you drag it home
Like a grocery bag
Full of stones

[Pre-Chorus]
Come sit by the fan
Let the minutes slow
Lay your head down
Let the hard stuff go

[Chorus]
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away
Hope and Clarity
Let the whole room fade
Close your eyes on me
Let the daylight break
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away

[Verse 2]
You don't need a speech
You don't need a plan
One soft landing spot
And that tight knot loosens
In your chest and hands

I'll keep the porch quiet
I'll keep the phone low
You can drift off first
I'll watch the clock
And guard the door

[Pre-Chorus]
Come sit by the fan
Let the minutes slow
Lay your head down
Let the hard stuff go

[Chorus]
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away
Hope and Clarity
Let the whole room fade
Close your eyes on me
Let the daylight break
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away

[Bridge]
When you wake up, baby
The edges won't bite
Same old world, but lighter
Same old you, but bright

[Final Chorus]
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away
Hope and Clarity
Let the whole room fade
Close your eyes on me
Let the daylight break
Hope and Clarity
Is just a nap away

title: Back To Empty (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I got the keys, the view, the plan
Warm food on the counter, name in the bank
People who love me, calling my phone
Still I sit there, feeling alone

[Verse 2]
Every good day leaves a little trace
A flicker on my face, then it slips away
I tell myself, "This should be enough"
But my mind keeps checking for some missing stuff

[Pre-Chorus]
And I hate how fast it goes
Joy in one hand, then it folds
I reach, I reach, I reach
It drifts right through me

[Chorus]
I want to be content
I want to be content
Stay in the moment
Stay in the moment

But I fall back down
Back to bored and afraid
Back to the hollow sound
Back where the worry stays

[Verse 3]
I stack up wins like plates on a shelf
Then stare at the space and forget myself
Soft little wins, big promises too
Still my chest goes tight when the room goes blue

[Pre-Chorus]
And I hate how fast it goes
Joy in one hand, then it folds
I reach, I reach, I reach
It drifts right through me

[Chorus]
I want to be content
I want to be content
Stay in the moment
Stay in the moment

But I fall back down
Back to bored and afraid
Back to the hollow sound
Back where the worry stays

[Bridge]
Maybe peace is a practice
Not a prize I can hold
Maybe this heart needs patience
More than gold

So I breathe in the small things
The cup, the light, the rain
If the void comes back again
I’ll still say

[Final Chorus]
I want to be content
I want to be content
Stay in the moment
Stay in the moment

I may fall back down
Back to bored and afraid
But I’m learning how
To let one good thing stay

I want to be content
I want to be content

title: Paper Prison (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wear my own weird name
Like a stain on a white shirt
You see me turn one way
Then the whole room says, "Fall in line"

My pockets full of sparks
But my shoes stay in the row
Every day I make a face
For the box they made me grow

[Pre-Chorus]
I am a storm in a badge
A thread pulled through a chain
I twist, I split, I shine
Then I hear that iron refrain

[Chorus]
Paper prison, paper prison
Everybody signed the wall
Paper prison, paper prison
I can hear the same clock call
I break shape, you make shape
Still we wear the same old skin
Paper prison, paper prison
Chaos trying to get in

[Verse 2]
Some days I bloom in noise
Some days I fold to fit
I got a hundred little selves
And every one of them is lit

But the hallway wants one step
One voice, one perfect line
They hand me the same gray suit
And call it being fine

[Pre-Chorus]
I am a storm in a badge
A thread pulled through a chain
I twist, I split, I shine
Then I hear that iron refrain

[Chorus]
Paper prison, paper prison
Everybody signed the wall
Paper prison, paper prison
I can hear the same clock call
I break shape, you make shape
Still we wear the same old skin
Paper prison, paper prison
Chaos trying to get in

[Bridge]
If I scream, they call it trouble
If I bend, they call it grace
I keep finding all my colors
In the cracks beneath the place

[Final Chorus]
Paper prison, paper prison
Everybody signed the wall
Paper prison, paper prison
I can hear the same clock call
I break shape, you make shape
Still we wear the same old skin
Paper prison, paper prison
Chaos trying to get in

title: Blow All The Anchors Away (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Chopped, rhythmic vocal cuts repeating like a phonk chant)
Own it, change it, never stay still...
Own it, change it, never stay still...

[Verse 1]
There is a blueprint they drew on your skin
But it doesn't match the fire that is burning within
They want you quiet, they want you to stay
In the comfortable cage of yesterday
But you don't owe them a single design
You are the architect of your own timeline

[Pre-Chorus]
No, don't you freeze now, don't let the rust take hold
This story isn't written, it is waiting to be told

[Chorus]
Be comfortable right where you stand today
But ready to blow all the anchors away!
Don't bend for the crowd, don't change for their eyes
Just climb your own mountain, watch your own sunrise
Stagnation is a silent thief in the dark
You are the flame, you are the spark!

[Verse 2]
(Chopped vocal stutter behind the beat)
It's okay to love who you've always been
And still want to rewrite the chapters within
Let them whisper, let them make their demands
Your evolution is in your own hands
A shifting current, a beautiful storm
You don't need a mold to keep yourself warm

[Chorus]
Be comfortable right where you stand today
But ready to blow all the anchors away!
Don't bend for the crowd, don't change for their eyes
Just climb your own mountain, watch your own sunrise
Stagnation is a silent thief in the dark
You are the flame, you are the spark!

[Outro]
(Vocal chops fading out over dynamic drum fills)
Change for yourself...
Never stay still...
Be who you are.

title: The One Who Stays In Here (Acoustic Version)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I let the room go still
And count the cracks above me
Every voice begins to climb
Every fear comes looking for me

I don't swing at every sound
I don't feed the old alarm
I let the whole procession pass
Then place my hand upon the calm

[Pre-Chorus]
Come closer, little tyrants
Say the names you came to claim
I know the shape of every threat
I know you feed on shame

[Chorus]
I can sit with the screaming
I can look into the red
You can rattle every locked door
You don't get to steer my head

I can name you without kneeling
I can hear you without fear
Take your seats along the walls
I'm the one who stays in here

[Verse 2]
The worst of you wears my voice
And borrows all my reasons
It turns a bruise into a law
Then calls the sentence treason

So I breathe beneath the noise
Till the sharpness loses shape
A thought is only passing weather
Not a hand around my neck

[Pre-Chorus]
Come closer, little tyrants
Show me everything you hide
I won't make a throne from panic
I won't hand you either side

[Chorus]
I can sit with the screaming
I can look into the red
You can rattle every locked door
You don't get to steer my head

I can name you without kneeling
I can hear you without fear
Take your seats along the walls
I'm the one who stays in here

[Bridge]
If the dark wants a witness
I'll give it both my eyes
If the old alarms awaken
I'll let them spend their lives

No war cry, no surrender
No bargain in the flame
Just a quiet hand returning
To the wheel beneath my name

[Final Chorus]
I can sit with the screaming
I can look into the red
You can rattle every locked door
You don't get to steer my head

I can name you without kneeling
I can hear you without fear
Take your seats along the walls
I'm the one who stays in here

[Outro]
The room is still breathing
The voices lose their claim
I don't have to banish them
To know who holds the reins

title: Stay Strange, Stay Kind (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You fold your map the other way
And take the path behind the wall
You ask the question no one asks
Then grin when every answer stalls
Your paper crown, your sideways shoes
The names you give the clouds at noon
You make a room for odd-shaped thoughts
