And suddenly there’s room for two

[Chorus]
Stay strange, stay bright, stay beautifully you
There’s more than one way a thing can be true
If your idea takes the long way around
I’ll walk beside you; we’ll turn it upside down
Stay strange, stay kind, let the curious through
The world gets wider when we make room

[Verse 2]
You save the buttons from old coats
And build a city on the sill
I bring my half-formed paper boats
You show me how to bend the hill
No need to smooth the jagged parts
Or hide the colors we invent
A little courage passed between us
Can change the shape of what comes next

[Chorus]
Stay strange, stay bright, stay beautifully you
There’s more than one way a thing can be true
If your idea takes the long way around
I’ll walk beside you; we’ll turn it upside down
Stay strange, stay kind, let the curious through
The world gets wider when we make room

[Outro]
So bring your crooked little compass
I’ll bring my unfinished view
We’ll make a path that fits us both
And leave the gate unlatched for you

title: Piece by Piece (Acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found a box of screws
Beneath the kitchen chair
A pencil on the windowsill
And sawdust in my hair

I drew the shape at breakfast
By noon I cut the frame
The first attempt leaned sideways
But I built it up again

[Pre-Chorus]
Every crooked corner
Taught my hands a way
Every failed beginning
Made room for what I'd make

[Chorus]
I can build it, piece by piece
Give the hidden thing a place to breathe
From a sketch no one could see
To a door that opens out for me
I can build it, let it stand
Turn a small idea into something grand
If the first shape breaks apart
I will start again with both hands on my heart

[Verse 2]
You brought the faded fabric
I brought the borrowed thread
We spread the plan across the floor
And changed it as we read

The motor coughed at sunset
The paint ran down the side
We laughed until the workbench shook
Then stayed to make it right

[Pre-Chorus]
There is no perfect blueprint
Waiting in the dark
There is only one more measure
And one more honest mark

[Chorus]
I can build it, piece by piece
Give the hidden thing a place to breathe
From a sketch no one could see
To a door that opens out for me
I can build it, let it stand
Turn a small idea into something grand
If the first shape breaks apart
I will start again with both hands on my heart

[Bridge]
Dreams are not delivered
In a shining finished crate
They arrive as loose directions
And a willingness to wait

So bring me all the splinters
Bring the parts that do not fit
We will name the next small action
Then we will begin with it

[Final Chorus]
I can build it, piece by piece
Give the hidden thing a place to breathe
From a sketch no one could see
To a door that opens out for me
I can build it, let it stand
Turn a small idea into something grand
When the shape becomes a room
There is space enough for every dream to bloom

[Outro]
Leave the pencil on the table
Let the morning find the plan
What we make with patient hands
Can become what we once imagined

title: Better Parts (acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept a chair for every name
Made room until the walls gave way
I learned the shape of every hurt
Then wore their weather like a shirt

I answered calls beneath the rain
Held every promise through the strain
They took the warmth I couldn't spare
And left me measuring empty chairs

[Pre-Chorus]
Now every hand that reaches out
Feels like a debt I can't work out
I call it kindness, call it proof
Then wonder why I have no room

[Chorus]
I gave away my better parts
To too many hands, too many hearts
Now when you tell me I am loved
I look for what you want from us

I poured myself through every door
Till I was less than I was before
If love can leave a person bare
Maybe I'm not worthy anywhere

[Verse 2]
I know their birthdays, know their scars
Which late-night diner, which parked car
I kept the details, kept the trust
While mine grew thin and turned to dust

A borrowed coat, a midnight ride
A thousand ways I stepped aside
They called me strong, I let it land
Like strength was something I had planned

[Pre-Chorus]
Now kindness sounds like coming clean
A room with nothing in between
I can't tell giving from goodbye
Or being needed from being mine

[Chorus]
I gave away my better parts
To too many hands, too many hearts
Now when you tell me I am loved
I look for what you want from us

I poured myself through every door
Till I was less than I was before
If love can leave a person bare
Maybe I'm not worthy anywhere

[Bridge]
But you don't have to pay my past
Or prove your staying will outlast
The ones who took and disappeared
The years I spent becoming useful here

Leave one small light beside the sink
Give me the time to stop and think
If you can hold me without a claim
I might relearn my own name

[Breakdown]
Not a vessel
Not a remedy
Not the hands that rescue everybody
Not a vacancy
Not a borrowed flame
I am more than what I gave away

[Final Chorus]
I gave away my better parts
To too many hands, too many hearts
But you don't ask me to perform
You meet me where the walls are torn

I poured myself through every door
Now I can choose what love is for
The worth I thought I had to earn
Was waiting underneath the burn

[Outro]
If I have less, let less be true
A little left to give to you
Not as a debt, not as a plea
Just something living, left in me

title: Just Ahead of My Time (Acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They called it strange when I changed the design
Said keep it simple, stay inside the line
I kept a notebook full of crooked plans
And bolts and sketches scattered on my hands

[Pre-Chorus]
What looks out of place today
Could be the shape of things by May

[Chorus]
How the weird becomes tomorrow’s norm
I’m just ahead of my time
They’ll call it ordinary when the world catches on
I’m just ahead of my time

[Verse 2]
A paper prototype, a borrowed room
The first small test went up in smoke too soon
You saw a flaw; I saw a different door
So I went back and built a little more

[Pre-Chorus]
What sounds impossible right now
May be the thing they’re asking for somehow

[Chorus]
How the weird becomes tomorrow’s norm
I’m just ahead of my time
They’ll call it ordinary when the world catches on
I’m just ahead of my time

[Breakdown]
Not wrong—just early
Not lost—just turning
Not wrong—just early
Watch the whole room learn it

[Bridge]
Keep the rough draft, keep the bent first frame
A future’s never born with a familiar name
If they need a minute, let the minute pass
I’ll be here making what they haven’t asked

[Final Chorus]
How the weird becomes tomorrow’s norm
I’m just ahead of my time
They’ll call it ordinary when the world catches on
I’m just ahead of my time
How the weird becomes tomorrow’s norm
I’m just ahead of my time
They’ll call it ordinary when the world catches on
I’m just ahead of my time

[Outro]
Just ahead of my time
Just ahead of my time

title: The Other Side (Acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found that tape in a shoebox by the stairs
Your handwriting crooked, ’91 in blue
A dozen little chapters pressed between the reels
And every one still sounds like you

[Pre-Chorus]
The radio missed them, the world moved on
But I know every turn, every wrong-way song

[Chorus]
Flip it over, there’s another side
Little lost songs that I keep inside
Not the one they played, not the one they knew
Every B-side takes me back to you
Turn, turn—let the years rewind
Every chapter has a song they left behind
Flip it over, let the whole thing ride
My favorite song’s on the other side

[Verse 2]
The bus-stop summer, your coat in the rain
The first small room with the furnace that clanged
That long goodbye we couldn’t get right
Each had a tune we kept out of sight

[Pre-Chorus]
No golden record, no polished refrain
Just the sound of us, still warm in the grain

[Chorus]
Flip it over, there’s another side
Little lost songs that I keep inside
Not the one they played, not the one they knew
Every B-side takes me back to you
Turn, turn—let the years rewind
Every chapter has a song they left behind
Flip it over, let the whole thing ride
My favorite song’s on the other side

[Bridge]
Somewhere between the hiss and the pause
A whole life waits without applause
I press play on the parts we saved
The quiet tracks that made us brave

[Final Chorus]
Flip it over, there’s another side
Little lost songs that I keep inside
Not the one they played, not the one they knew
Every B-side takes me back to you
Turn, turn—let the years rewind
Every chapter has a song they left behind
Flip it over, let the whole thing ride
My favorite song’s on the other side

[Outro]
One more side, one more try
Our best songs never had to fly

title: God In My Hands (Acoustic)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wish you could stay
Right here in the room
Love me while it’s here
Not only when I move

I hand out my warm
Like water in a cup
And when I turn away
You tell me it’s not enough

[Pre-Chorus]
I give and I give
Till my chest feels light
But the second I’m gone
You want me back tonight

[Chorus]
Love me while I’m here
Love me while I’m here
Don’t wait for the ache
Don’t wait for the tear

Love me while I’m here
Love me while I’m here
I break when you miss
What you had right here (right here)

[Verse 2]
I want to hold more hearts
Than my hands can keep
I want to mend the hurt
That lives too deep

But if I split myself
Across every door
I lose the one thing
I was trying to give you for

[Pre-Chorus]
I give and I give
Till my chest feels bare
Then I hear my name
Like a prayer in the air

[Chorus]
Love me while I’m here
Love me while I’m here
Don’t wait for the ache
Don’t wait for the tear

Love me while I’m here
Love me while I’m here
I break when you miss
What you had right here (right here)

[Bridge]
If I’m the hand you hold
When the room goes cold
Don’t turn me to a ghost
When the story grows old

Let me be enough
For one honest night
Let me be loved now
While I’m still in sight

[Final Chorus]
Love me while I’m here
Love me while I’m here
Don’t wait for the ache
Don’t wait for the tear

Love me while I’m here
Love me while I’m here
I break when you miss
What you had right here (right here)

title: Gray Child (Acoustic Version)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When your inner child turns gray
The swing set rusts in your chest
You count the cracks in the floor
Like they’re miles from the last
Hope sits small in the drawer
Wander lost its shoes

[Pre-Chorus]
And I know that look
In your tired-eyed face
Like the map got folded
And the road washed away

[Chorus]
Don’t let it all turn gray
Don’t let it all turn gray
Hold that little light
Hold that little light
We can still run wild
We can still run wild
Even now, even now
Even now

[Verse 2]
You used to chase the creek
Barefoot through the cane
Now the weeks stack high
Like rain on a pane
But there’s still a spark
In the back of your mind
Still a kid in there
Trying to survive

[Pre-Chorus]
So when the night gets long
And the doubts come loud
Let me be the hand
Pulling you out

[Chorus]
Don’t let it all turn gray
Don’t let it all turn gray
Hold that little light
Hold that little light
We can still run wild
We can still run wild
Even now, even now
Even now

[Bridge]
If the years took color
We can steal it back
From the red in your cheeks
To the beat in your step
Say my name out loud
Let it crack that shell
There’s a younger you
You can save as well

[Final Chorus]
Don’t let it all turn gray
Don’t let it all turn gray
Hold that little light
Hold that little light
We can still run wild
We can still run wild
Even now, even now
Even now

title: Left-Handed Lightning Bolt
lyrics:
[Intro: thunder rolls, reversed electric guitar]
(zig-zag, z-z-zap!)

[Verse: staccato melodic rap]
They drew the lightning straight across the sky
Said electricity should never question why
But I zigged when every other current zagged
Left a glowing signature across the black

[Pre-Chorus: ascending falsetto]
You can trace the way I went
But never where the spark was sent

[Chorus: explosive harmonies, octave leap]
I'm a left-handed lightning bolt
A beautiful electric jolt
Never taking the expected line
Still illuminating everything I find
(zap-zap, ah-ee-ah!)
If I strike a different way
I'll make a brand-new kind of day

[Drop: chopped electric vocals]
(zig-zig, zag-zag!)
[Distorted 808, frantic breakbeat]

[Outro: fading electric hum]
Different path. Same thunder.

title: Neon Scarecrow
lyrics:
[Intro: wind through corn, electric hum]
(glow-glow, hey!)

[Verse: funky syncopated rap]
They dressed me up in leftovers and straw
Put me in a field to frighten what they saw
But I stitched neon lights into my coat
Now the lonely birds come singing every note

[Pre-Chorus: layered falsetto]
They thought I'd keep the world away
Instead I made a place to stay

[Chorus: soaring soulful harmonies]
I'm a neon scarecrow in the rain
Lighting up the fields again
Every strange and wandering soul
Finds a little warmth inside my glow
(hey-hey, come along!)
I was built to stand apart
Now I've got a gathering of hearts

[Drop: chopped vocal hooks]
(glow-glow, crow-crow!)
[Sliding 808, syncopated cowbell]

[Outro: warm whispered harmony]
Nobody's strange out here.

title: Backwards Telescope
lyrics:
[Intro: spacey arpeggio, reverse cymbal]
(look-look, turn around!)

[Verse: lilting melodic rap]
They point their telescopes into the night
Hunting for a distant little light
I turned mine backward toward the ground
And saw a universe in things around

[Pre-Chorus: soft ascending thirds]
A galaxy inside a leaf
A solar system in belief

[Chorus: soaring bright harmonies]
I'm a backwards telescope
Finding galaxies in hope
Every tiny little thing
Has a universe to sing
(ooh-ah, look again!)
You can chase the stars above
I'll find infinity in love

[Drop: pitched chops, 808 melody]
(zoom-zoom, flip-flip!)
[Glitch breakbeat]

[Outro: whispered]
The cosmos was here all along.

title: I'm Already Complete
lyrics:
[Intro: clicking pieces, soft synth]
(click-click... no fit)

[Verse: intimate syncopated melody]
They laid a thousand pieces on the floor
Said I'd find my place if I just looked some more
But every little corner felt too tight
So I turned my edges toward the light

[Pre-Chorus: rising vocal layers]
What if I'm not missing a part?
What if I'm a picture from the start?

[Chorus: soaring harmonized hook]
I'm the puzzle piece that won't fit in
And I love the shape of my own skin
Don't need to finish someone else's scene
I've got a whole new picture underneath
(oh-oh, let me be!)
You can keep your painted frame
I'll make a masterpiece without a name

[Drop: chopped vocal clicks]
(click-click, break-free!)
[808 slides, melodic cowbell]

[Outro: gentle falsetto]
I'm already complete.

title: Runaway Carousel Horse
lyrics:
[Intro: warped carnival organ]
(round-round... break out!)

[Verse: theatrical melodic rap]
Painted golden hooves on a wooden floor
Round and round forever, never asking more
Then I felt a little thunder in my feet
And jumped the painted circle to the street

[Pre-Chorus: accelerating harmonies]
They said the ride's not meant to end
I said the world's around the bend!

[Chorus: soaring theatrical falsetto]
I'm the runaway carousel horse
Finally choosing my own course
All the pretty lights behind
Can't compete with what I'll find
(ride-ride, ah-ah!)
I was made for something wild
Not another painted mile

[Drop: carnival chops, distorted 808]
(round-round, run-run!)
[Breakbeat, galloping syncopation]

[Outro: music-box slowdown]
The ride goes on without me.

title: The Misprinted Stamp
lyrics:
[Intro: paper rustle, record scratch]
(wrong-way, rare-rare!)

[Verse: swaggering melodic rap]
They printed out a million all the same
Perfect little borders, perfect little names
But my picture landed slightly upside down
Now the collectors come from every town

[Pre-Chorus: ascending playful harmonies]
They called it a mistake
Until they saw what rare could make

[Chorus: bouncing layered falsetto]
I'm the misprinted stamp
One of one, no second chance
You can keep your perfect rows
I'll be something no one knows
(rare-rare, oh-oh!)
If the press can't get me right
That's what makes me worth the sight

[Drop: chopped vocal hooks]
(one-one-one!) (flip-flip!)
[808 bounce, offbeat cowbell]

[Outro: whispered]
No reprint necessary.

title: Jellyfish Orchestra
lyrics:
[Intro: underwater bells, liquid synth]
(wub-wub, ooh-ah)

[Verse: flowing melodic sing-rap]
They march like soldiers on the ocean floor
I float through currents looking for much more
Transparent heart and tentacles of light
I turn the deepest darkness into bright

[Pre-Chorus: breathy stacked vocals]
No bones to hold me in a line
Just waves conducting my design

[Chorus: liquid falsetto harmonies]
I'm a jellyfish orchestra
Pulsing where the silence was
Every strange vibration sings
Through my thousand glowing strings
(ooh-ee-ooh, drift with me!)
I don't need to walk like you
To make the ocean dance in blue

[Drop: liquid bass, chopped vowels]
(bloop-bloop, ah-ah!)
[Breakbeat, syncopated 808]

[Outro: shimmering harmonics]
Soft doesn't mean ordinary.

title: Elevator to a Secret Floor
lyrics:
[Intro: elevator chime, rising arpeggio]
(ding! going up!)

[Verse: rhythmic melodic delivery]
Everybody takes the stairs from one to ten
Working through the same old floors again
I found a little button marked with stars
Now I'm visiting the rooftops of Mars

[Pre-Chorus: layered ascending thirds]
They say those floors don't exist
Then what is this? (ding-ding!)

[Chorus: soaring octave jumps]
I'm the elevator to a secret floor
Every time you think there's nothing more
I'll find another level in the sky
Another hidden door to try
(going up, up, up!)
You can call my thinking strange
I call it extra room for change

[Drop: elevator dings, chopped falsetto]
(ding-ding, ah-ee-ah!)
[808 slides up chromatically]

[Outro: whisper]
Next stop: impossible.

title: Upside-Down Umbrella
lyrics:
[Intro: rainfall, plucked synth]
(drip-drop, up-up!)

[Verse: bouncing melodic rap]
Everybody holds their umbrellas down
Hiding from the weather all around
Mine turned inside out against the breeze
Now I'm catching raindrops like memories

[Pre-Chorus: rising harmonies]
They laugh because I'm getting wet
I laugh at all the drops I've kept

[Chorus: soaring falsetto]
I'm an upside-down umbrella
Catching everything that falls
While they're hiding from the weather
I'm collecting waterfalls
(ooh-ah, let it rain!)
Every storm's a chance to see
What the clouds will give to me

[Drop: pitched vocal chops, 808 bounce]
(drip-drip, flip-flip!)
(bmm-tss-ka, bmm-tss-ka)

[Outro: gentle harmony]
Maybe wrong-side-up is right.

title: Uninvited Firework
lyrics:
[Intro: distant crowd, rising whistle]
(shhh... boom!)

[Verse: playful syncopated sing-rap]
They planned a quiet evening under gray
I showed up with a pocket full of May
A thousand little sparks beneath my skin
They said to keep the fireworks within

[Pre-Chorus: ascending falsetto]
But how do you contain a sky?
(ah-ah) I was born to fly!

[Chorus: explosive melodic harmonies]
I'm the uninvited firework
Bursting where the shadows lurk
If I light the night too bright
Close your eyes or enjoy the sight!
(oh-oh-oh, shine!)
I won't apologize for sparks
That draw a masterpiece in dark

[Drop: chopped choir, cowbell rolls]
(boom-boom, ah-ee-ah!)
[808 glides, breakbeat]

[Outro: whispered, smiling]
Surprise!

title: The Color With No Name
lyrics:
[Intro: prism bells, whispered choir]
(name it, name it... can't)

[Verse: playful sing-rap]
They gave each color one familiar name
Put them in their boxes, called the rainbow tame
But I live somewhere between the gold and green
In a shade their little charts have never seen

[Pre-Chorus: stacked major thirds]
Don't need a label to be bright
Don't need a box to hold my light

[Chorus: soaring key lift, harmonized]
I'm the color with no name
I'm the spark outside the frame
If your palette runs out of room
I'll paint the ceiling into bloom
(ooh-ee-ah, vivid!)
Call me strange, I call me free
The spectrum isn't done with me

[Drop: chopped choir, elastic bass]
(red-blue-who?) (me-me-me!)
[Syncopated cowbell, melodic breakbeat]

[Outro: unaccompanied falsetto]
There's room for one more hue.

title: Different Trajectory
lyrics:
[Intro: wide synth pads, distant whistle]
(whoosh-ah, whoosh-ah)

[Verse: floating melodic phrasing]
They all revolve around the same old sun
Same little circles till the day is done
I came across the darkness on a slanted line
With a tail of sparks that I could call mine

[Pre-Chorus: choral ascent]
You can say I'm passing through
I still leave some light with you

[Chorus: expansive soaring duet]
I'm a comet with no circular plan
Writing golden commas where the night began
I don't owe the heavens a familiar route
Watch the whole horizon when I'm breaking out
(oh-oh, here I glow!)
I may never orbit where you do
But I can make the darkness new

[Drop: vocal chops, 808 glides]
(zoom-zoom) (ah-ee-ah!)
[Half-time drums, sparkling arpeggios]

[Outro: whispered]
Different trajectory. Same sky.

title: Beautiful Anomaly
lyrics:
[Intro: digital artifacts, soft choir]
(error-error... beautiful)

[Verse: chopped sing-rap]
They wrote a little script for how a life should run
Smile on cue, stay in frame, never come undone
I skipped a line and made the colors bleed
Now there's a sunset where a wall should be

[Pre-Chorus: glitched harmonies]
I'm not the bug they meant to fix
I'm all the magic in the mix

[Chorus: bright layered falsetto]
I'm the glitch that grew a garden
In the middle of the code
Every unexpected blossom
Shows another way to grow
(la-la-la, reload!)
Don't patch the wonder out of me
I'm the beautiful anomaly

[Drop: chopped syllables, syncopated bass]
(gli-gli-glitch) (bloom-bloom)
[Breakbeat cuts to silence]

[Outro: whisper]
Feature, not a flaw.

title: Odd-Shaped Key
lyrics:
[Intro: rattling keys, deep sub pulse]
(click-click... not yet)

[Verse: melodic low-register groove]
They tried me in a hundred ordinary doors
Said I had too many teeth and edges to ignore
So I stopped pretending I was cut the wrong way
Kept my crooked edges, let the bright brass stay

[Pre-Chorus: ascending harmonic doubles]
Not every lock is mine to turn
Not every room is mine to earn

[Chorus: huge melodic lift]
I'm an odd-shaped key with a golden shine
I was never made for every lock in line
Somewhere there's a door with a shape like me
And I won't file down my identity
(key-key, let me be!)
When I turn, the whole world sings
Strangeness opens stranger things

[Drop: pitched clicks, syncopated 808]
(click-ah, click-ah) (open!)

[Outro: soft latch sound]
Hear that? Perfect fit.

title: Thirteenth Hour
lyrics:
[Intro: clockwork tick, pitch-bent chimes]
(twelve... thirteen!)

[Verse: playful rapid sing-rap]
They schedule every minute, color-code the day
But I find hidden evenings tucked along the way
A midnight made for dancing in a grocery-store aisle
An extra hour for an unexpected smile

[Pre-Chorus: cascading harmonies]
They swear the dial is all there is
I hear another number click

[Chorus: soaring ascending hook]
I'm the thirteenth hour on the clock
A little more wonder than the world can count
If I don't fit inside their time
I'll make a minute that's entirely mine
(tick-tock, tick-TA!)
Let the ordinary hands stand still
I've got impossible hours to fill

[Drop: stuttered ticks, 808 slides]
(thirteen-thirteen) (woo-ah!)

[Outro: clock chimes]
Too much life for twelve.

title: Stained-Glass Hurricane
lyrics:
[Intro: glass harmonics, whispered vowels]
(ooh, red-blue-gold)

[Verse: velvet sing-rap]
They wanted clear windows, nothing in the way
I came in with a thousand shards of yesterday
Odd little angles, colors out of tune
Then the morning sun came spilling through the room

[Pre-Chorus: layered thirds]
Every jagged edge I own
Throws a color all its own

[Chorus: soaring falsetto stacks]
I'm a stained-glass hurricane
Every fracture catching flame
I don't need to be transparent
I was born to bend the day
(shine-shine, let it shine!)
If my pieces don't align
Watch them turn the light divine

[Drop: choir chops, bouncing sub-bass]
(ah-ee-ah) (gold-gold-gold)
[Breakbeat through shimmering bells]

[Outro: tender unison]
Nothing broken about my design.

title: Draw Another Geography
lyrics:
[Intro: paper flutter, reversed piano]
(turn it round, turn it round)

[Verse: intimate melodic rap]
They handed me a map in black and white
Every destination numbered, every turn just right
But mine has oceans drawn across the sky
And a secret city where the mountains fly

[Pre-Chorus: ascending arpeggios]
They say those roads are make-believe
Then why do they keep calling me?

[Chorus: weightless layered vocals]
I'm a map of places no one's seen
A thousand roads to what could be
Fold me wrong, I'll still unfold
Into worlds you can't control
(ah-ah, follow me!)
If there isn't room for what I see
I'll draw another geography

[Drop: panned vocal chops, 808 slide]
(map-map) (where-where?)
[Glitchy melody blooms]

[Outro: fading hum]
The blank space is my favorite part.

title: The Beat Between The Beats
lyrics:
[Intro: metronome clicks, then skips]
(tick-tick, ta-ka-TICK!)

[Verse: syncopated sing-rap]
The whole parade is stepping left on one
I put a little pause where they put the drum
They say I missed the beat, I say I found
A secret little rhythm underneath the sound

[Pre-Chorus: call-response]
(You're off time!) I'm right on mine
(Too strange!) That's my design

[Chorus: soaring melody, polyrhythm]
I'm the beat between the beats
I'm the skip beneath your feet
If my heart won't march in line
I'll make the crooked rhythm shine
(ta-ka, ta-ka, hey!)
No need to straighten what can swing
Hear the whole wide weird world sing

[Drop: chopped scats, breakbeat]
(boom-ka-tss) (bmm-tss-ka)
[808 bass answers vocal hook]

[Outro: unexpected clap]
That's my downbeat.

title: Flower in the Concrete
lyrics:
[Intro: concrete taps, distant music box]
(crack-crack... bloom!)

[Verse: rhythmic whisper to melody]
They laid the sidewalk smooth and gray
Measured every inch to keep the wild away
But something underfoot refused to sleep
Pushed a purple anthem through the seam

[Pre-Chorus: climbing harmonies]
No garden gate, no velvet rope
Just stubborn roots and reckless hope

[Chorus: soaring falsetto]
I'm the flower in the concrete
Growing where I shouldn't be
If the world was built too narrow
That's a problem with the street
(oh-oh, let me grow!)
You can call me out of place
I'll put color in the cracks you made

[Drop: pitched chops, sliding 808]
(bloom-bloom) (break-break)
[Half-time kick, shimmering synth]

[Outro: whispered, smiling]
Watch the pavement learn my name.

title: Crooked Compass
lyrics:
[Intro: warped synth, 808 heartbeat]
(north-north? nah-nah)

[Verse: elastic sing-rap]
They drew a little arrow, said, "Follow that"
I spun it toward a rooftop full of alley cats
Their straight line led to doors already known
My crooked little needle found a road of its own

[Pre-Chorus: rising thirds]
Let the needle dance (dance-dance)
I don't need their chance

[Chorus: bright falsetto, stacked harmonies]
I'm a crooked compass, spinning toward the strange
I don't need permission for a beautiful change
Call it getting lost, I call it coming home
The world gets bigger when I roam
(way-way-way out!)

[Drop: chopped vocals, syncopated cowbell]
(no-map, no-map) (ah-ee-ah!)

[Outro: whispered harmony]
True north never knew me anyway.

title: Be Bright and Odd
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You fold your map the other way
You name the clouds above the train
You keep a marble in your coat
For luck, or just because it’s smooth

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to hide the parts that didn’t fit
Till you made room beside you

[Chorus]
Be strange with me, be bright and odd
Let every crooked line belong
If your idea bends the frame
I’ll hold the door and say your name
We’re better when we make some space
For every different kind of shape

[Verse 2]
You grow tomatoes in a boot
I save the jokes that miss the room
You paint one fingernail electric blue
And suddenly I’m braver too

[Pre-Chorus]
No need to sand the edges down
We’re more ourselves together

[Chorus]
Be strange with me, be bright and odd
Let every crooked line belong
If your idea bends the frame
I’ll hold the door and say your name
We’re better when we make some space
For every different kind of shape

[Outro]
Keep your odd little compass near
I’ll walk beside you, glad you’re here

title: Building Something New
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep your paper crowns in a kitchen drawer
I keep a map with a made-up shore
They say, “Pick a lane, make your edges behave”
But the best ideas don’t know how to wave

[Pre-Chorus]
When your odd little compass spins
I’ll walk beside you, not pull you in

[Chorus]
Be strange, be bright, take up your space
There’s room for every crooked shape
If you see me building something new
I’ll make a little room for you

[Verse 2]
You name the clouds like old friends passing through
I wear mismatched socks because they feel true
We trade our sketches over lunch at noon
And turn the quiet table into a moon

[Pre-Chorus]
When the old rules crowd the door
We make a window, then one more

[Chorus]
Be strange, be bright, take up your space
There’s room for every crooked shape
If you see me building something new
I’ll make a little room for you

[Bridge]
No need to sand the corners down
No need to earn a different crown
Your way of seeing changes mine
Your strange and mine can intertwine

[Final Chorus]
Be strange, be bright, take up your space
We make a wider, kinder place
If you see me building something new
I’ll make a little room for you

[Outro]
A little room for you
A little room for me

title: Make Some Room
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You fold your map along the wrong crease
And find a field the roads forgot
You keep a jar of buttons by the door
Each one from somewhere you were not

[Pre-Chorus]
When you show me what you found
I feel my own edges loosen

[Chorus]
Stay strange, stay bright, keep your shape
There’s room enough for every kind of brave
If your idea bends the frame, let it
I’ll stand beside you while you make it
Stay strange, and make some room for me

[Verse 2]
You paint the kitchen chairs in mismatched blues
I bring a poem with no ending line
We trade the things we nearly hid away
And make a little space for both our minds

[Bridge]
No one has to fit the mold alone
We can hold the door and widen it

[Final Chorus]
Stay strange, stay bright, keep your shape
There’s room enough for every kind of brave
If your idea bends the frame, let it
I’ll stand beside you while you make it
Stay strange, and make some room for me

[Outro]
Make some room
I’ll make some room

title: Wonderfully Out of Line
genres: Experimental New Wave With Deathcore-Trap Tension And Cinematic Ballad Swell; Slow Heavy Groove In E Minor With Down-Tuned Guitar Chugs
And Post-Rock Space. Verse Rides Low And Claustrophobic
Pre-Chorus Tightens With Rising Pulse And Falsetto Cracks
Stacked Low Tenor And Ghostly High Tenor Doubles. Vocal Chain Is Intimate And Distressed
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep your lunchbox full of tiny painted moons
I name the clouds like animals on Tuesday afternoons
They say, “Pick a lane,” as if the road were drawn in stone
But you make room beside your strange and I don’t feel alone

[Pre-Chorus]
When the room says “settle down”
You turn the question upside down

[Chorus]
Stay wonderfully out of line
Make your crooked little sparks meet mine
If you’re different, I’ll make space
We can redraw this place
Stay wonderfully out of line
There’s more than one way to shine

[Verse 2]
You wear two different shoes and tell me both are right
I bring a paper crown to work and wear it through the night
Your laugh arrives a second late, then fills the whole cafe
I save a seat for every thought that doesn’t fit the frame

[Pre-Chorus]
When the room says “settle down”
We lift each other off the ground

[Chorus]
Stay wonderfully out of line
Make your crooked little sparks meet mine
If you’re different, I’ll make space
We can redraw this place
Stay wonderfully out of line
There’s more than one way to shine

[Bridge]
No need to sand the edges smooth
No need to ask permission to move
I’ll cheer your bright, unlikely view
And when I stumble, cheer me too

[Final Chorus]
Stay wonderfully out of line
Make your crooked little sparks meet mine
If you’re different, I’ll make space
We can redraw this place
Stay wonderfully out of line
There’s more than one way to shine

[Outro]
Your way, my way—room for all
We make a wider world together

title: Stay Strange
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You fold your maps in crooked ways
You keep a pebble from the bay
You ask the questions no one planned
And draw new doors where walls began

[Pre-Chorus]
When they say, “Be easier to read”
I’ll save a seat beside me

[Chorus]
Stay strange, stay bright in your own way
There’s room for every shape we make
If you step out past the painted lines
I’ll step out too, you can borrow mine
Stay strange, and help the next one see
The world gets wider when we’re free

[Verse 2]
You wear the jacket inside out
You hum a tune and change the route
They call it odd; I call it brave
A little space is ours to make

[Pre-Chorus]
When you’re the only one who sees
I’ll stand beside your certainty

[Chorus]
Stay strange, stay bright in your own way
There’s room for every shape we make
If you step out past the painted lines
I’ll step out too, you can borrow mine
Stay strange, and help the next one see
The world gets wider when we’re free

[Bridge]
No measuring tape, no narrow frame
No need to sand away your name
We make a place by making room
For every color, every tune

[Final Chorus]
Stay strange, stay bright in your own way
There’s room for every shape we make
If you step out past the painted lines
I’ll step out too, you can borrow mine
Stay strange, and help the next one see
The world gets wider when we’re free

[Outro]
Stay strange—there’s room for you and me

title: Paper Planets
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You kept your paper planets in a shoebox by the stairs
Drew a map of nowhere with a purple marker there
They said, “Pick a lane, be normal, make your edges disappear”
But you wore that crooked jacket like you meant to keep it weird

[Pre-Chorus]
I see the part you hide away
I like it better when it stays

[Chorus]
Be strange, be bright, be beautifully out of line
Make room for every shape that doesn’t fit the design
If you bring your odd little wonder, I’ll bring mine
We’ll make a wider world by standing side by side

[Verse 2]
You talk to every houseplant, give the pigeons little names
I collect old buttons, sort them by their made-up games
We don’t need permission slips to be the way we are
There’s more than one direction to get where you are going

[Final Chorus: key lift, countermelody]
Blank, blank canvas, calling me
(ah-ah-ah) So close to free!
A perfect line, an open plain
But who am I if nothing remains?

[Outro: descending falsetto melisma]
(Ooh-ah-ah-ah)
[808 decays, music-box resolves]

title: Paint It White
lyrics:
[Intro: reversed piano, distant whisper]
(erase... erase...)
(white-white-white)
[808 swell, vinyl crackle]

[Verse 1: syncopated melodic rap]
I've got a hundred lives I barely hold
A hundred stories tangled in my soul
Every doorway opens to a different face
Every promise keeps me anchored in a place
(tied up, tied up)

[Pre-Chorus: rising harmonies]
There's something sweet about a match
When every thread's too tight to catch
(burn it down... down...)

[Chorus: soaring falsetto, heavy 808]
Paint it white, let the colors run
Tear the pages, leave the story undone
I could walk where nobody knows my name
No more guilt and no one left to blame
(oh-oh-oh)
A clean horizon, empty skies
Could I find peace if I erased my lives?

[Drop: chopped vocals, cowbell]
(wipe-wipe-clean)
(blank-blank-dream)
(boom-ka-tss, bmm-tss-ka)
[Sliding sub-bass, frantic breakbeat]

[Verse 2: double-time, layered whispers]
I fantasize about the great escape
No loose ends and no mistakes
But every bridge I'd leave in flames
Has someone standing there who knows my name
(my name, my name)

[Bridge: beat cuts, fragile falsetto]
Maybe freedom isn't starting new
Maybe peace is making room for truth
But God, the silence looks so sweet
On a road with nothing at my feet

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, halftime]
Paint it white, let the colors run
Tear the pages, leave the story undone
I want a future without yesterday
But would I love the man who walked away?
(walk away, fade away)
A perfect canvas, empty skies
Why does peace look so much like goodbye?

[Outro: tape slowdown, whispered]
(erase... erase...)
[Single piano note]
(I can't...)

title: One Star, No Sky
lyrics:
[Intro: reversed choir, vinyl crackle]
(one star... one sky...)
(choose-choose-choose)
[Deep 808 pulse]

[Verse 1: melodic rhythmic flow]
I never meant to build a universe
Where every orbit makes the others hurt
A thousand little lights inside my chest
How do I tell one it outshines the rest?
(shine-shine-shine)

[Pre-Chorus: rising falsetto]
They say my heart should know its place
But I see galaxies in every face
And I can feel the heavens shake
(shake-shake-break)

[Chorus: soaring layered vocals]
If I choose one, I lose the sky
Watch a thousand little stars go blind
Every love is real, every goodbye
Leaves another constellation dying
(fall apart, fall apart)
I could hold one close tonight
But who will catch the falling lights?

[Drop: chopped vocals, distorted cowbell]
(one-one-one) (gone-gone-gone)
(star-star, scar-scar)
(bmm-ka-tss, bmm-ka-tss)
[Sliding 808, frantic breakbeat]

[Verse 2: double-time, vocal doubles]
I rehearse the words a thousand times
Every ending feels like doing crimes
I see their faces when I close my eyes
Every future ends in different cries
(no-no-no)

[Bridge: beat cuts, fragile whisper]
And if I never choose at all
I still become the cause they fall
No harmless road, no clean escape
Just different hearts that I might break

[Final Chorus: falsetto, halftime bass]
If I choose one, I lose the sky
Watch a thousand little stars go blind
Could I live beneath a single light
Knowing all the ones I left behind?
(behind-behind)
I could hold one close tonight
But who will catch the falling lights?

[Outro: pitch-down, tape stop]
(one star... no sky...)
[Silence]

title: Falling Knife
lyrics:
[Intro: reversed choir, vinyl hiss]
(don't make me... don't make me...)
[Detuned keys, sliding 808]

[Verse 1: syncopated melodic rap]
I keep a different sunrise in each room
A different flower fighting through the gloom
They all grew roots around a piece of me
Now someone's asking which one gets the tree
(oh-oh-oh)

[Pre-Chorus: accelerating, layered]
One little word, one little name
And nothing ever stays the same
(same-same-same)

[Chorus: soaring falsetto, heavy 808]
Don't make me be the falling knife
That cuts the color from somebody's life
I know the walls are paper thin
But every heart is living in them
(hold-hold-hold)
One card pulled, the ceiling breaks
How many loves can one choice take?

[Drop: cowbell melody, vocal chops]
(stay-stay, go-go)
(fall-fall, no-no)
(boom-ka-tss, bmm-tss-ka)
[808 glide, chopped scream]

[Verse 2: double-time, distorted doubles]
I see the future in a shattered frame
A dozen faces learning how to hate my name
And one beside me trying not to see
The empty chairs that used to comfort me
(used to, used to)

[Bridge: stripped beat, intimate whisper]
Maybe mercy isn't keeping everyone
Maybe waiting does what choosing would have done
But every road has someone left behind
And every exit lives inside my mind

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, halftime]
Don't make me be the falling knife
That cuts the color from somebody's life
If I choose one, the others fade
And I must own the mess I've made
(oh-oh-oh)
The house comes down, the echoes call
Who gets my hand when the last cards fall?

[Outro: tape decay, whispered]
(stay... go...)
[One card hits the floor]

title: Subtract Somebody's Sun
lyrics:
[Intro: reversed piano, whispered]
(one plus one... minus you)
(minus me... minus everything)
[808 glissando, cowbell]

[Verse 1: syncopated melodic rap]
I've got a thousand ways to say I care
And not a single way to make it fair
Every kiss becomes a debt unpaid
Every promise casts another shade
(ah-ah-ah)

[Pre-Chorus: rising harmonies]
They say the answer should be clear
But every answer disappears
When I imagine all the tears
(tears-tears-tears)

[Chorus: soaring falsetto, heavy bass]
Love doesn't divide so easily
Every heart's a whole infinity
How can I subtract somebody's sun?
Just to prove my love for only one
(only one, only one)
If choosing means somebody has to bleed
What does that make me?

[Drop: pitched vocal chops, cowbell rolls]
(one-one-one) (gone-gone-gone)
(choose-lose, choose-lose)
(bmm-tss-ka, bmm-tss-ka)
[808 slides, breakbeat fills]

[Verse 2: double-time, layered whispers]
Every door I close becomes a scar
Every heart I leave still beats afar
I could name the one and end the war
But hear the others crying through the floor
(no-no-no)

[Bridge: stripped piano, fragile vocal]
I know that love can't promise no one pain
And standing still can wound them just the same
I'm counting stars I cannot rearrange
Afraid the sky will never look the same

[Final Chorus: stacked harmonies, halftime]
Love doesn't divide so easily
Every heart's a whole infinity
How can I subtract somebody's sun?
Just to prove my love for only one
(one-one-one)
The numbers never tell me what to do
When every number's you

[Outro: tape-stop, distant falsetto]
(minus you... minus me...)
[Silence]

title: Thousand of Aches
lyrics:
[Intro: detuned piano, vinyl crackle]
(one-one-one...)
(choose... choose...)
[Sub-bass swell, heartbeat kick]

[Verse 1: rhythmic melodic rap]
I built a kingdom out of paper hearts
Every room a different work of art
Every touch a truth I can't erase
Every love a home, a time, a place
(hold on, hold on)

[Pre-Chorus: rising falsetto, stutter]
If I pull one card from underneath
How many hearts collapse with me?
(fall-fall-falling)

[Chorus: soaring layered vocals, heavy 808]
How do I choose who gets to stay?
When every yes takes love away
One heart saved, another breaks
One little choice, a thousand aches
(oh-oh-oh)
I see the cards begin to fall
To save one love, I lose them all

[Drop: chopped vocals, sliding bass]
(choose-one, lose-one)
(hearts-fall-down)
(bmm-ka-tss, bmm-ka-tss)
[Distorted cowbell, syncopated breaks]

[Verse 2: double-time, whispered doubles]
Every smile's a promise I can't keep
Every goodbye's a ghost that doesn't sleep
They say a choice is how you prove you're true
But what if truth is loving more than two?
(more-more-more)

[Bridge: beat cuts, fragile falsetto]
I'm not afraid of being alone
I'm scared of breaking every home
I'd rather carry all this pain
Than watch their tears fall like rain

[Final Chorus: octave harmonies, halftime]
How do I choose who gets to stay?
When every yes takes love away
One heart saved, another breaks
One little choice, a thousand aches
(choose-one, lose-one)
I feel the cards begin to fall
And I'm the hand that drops them all

[Outro: tape slowdown, whispered]
(one... one... none...)
[Silence]

title: Drawn Blueprint
lyrics:
[Intro: vinyl hiss, pitched-down whisper]
(come home... come home...)
[808 slide, cowbell triplets]

[Verse 1: melodic rap]
I'd draw a room for every name
A thousand windows sharing one flame
Coffee in the kitchen, shoes beside the stairs
No one has to vanish just to make room there
(oh-oh) Leave the porch light on

[Pre-Chorus: rising doubles]
But the locks come out when lovers speak
They ask which one gets the only key
(key-key-key)

[Chorus: sung, distorted 808]
I wanna build a home for every heart I hold
One roof, open doors against the cold
No one gets a deed to the warmth in me
But they call it love if they own the key
(you're mine! mine-mine-mine)
Then I wake where love means choosing sides

[Drop: chopped pitched vocal, cowbell]
(home-home-home) (no-no-no)
(ki-ki-key) (let me breathe)
(bmm-tss-ka, bmm-tss-ka)

[Verse 2: double-time]
They want fences round a thing that needs air
Make a courtroom out of how much I care
If I hold two hands, they count who I betray
So I fold my blueprint, hide the dream away
(away-way-way) [hard cut]

[Bridge: filtered piano, bare vocal]
Just enough heat for the ones in the rain
But a house without borders scares the street
Nobody moves in if the cost is grief

[Final Chorus: harmonies, halftime]
I wanna build a home for every heart I hold
One roof, open doors against the cold
But they call it love if they own the key
So the house stays drawn where no one can see

[Outro: tape-stop, whisper]
(come home... in another life)

title: Open Door Policy
lyrics:
[Verse 1: Female]
If I had a house with a hundred doors
I’d leave every latch turned loose
Set a place for the ones I adore
And a blanket warm from my room
You could laugh in the kitchen, rest in the hall
No one keeping score of the space
I would make enough room for us all
And still know each face

[Pre-Chorus: Female]
But you draw a line when I reach for your hand
Say my love needs a lock and a name

[Chorus: Duet]
I’d build a home for every heart I hold
Room to come and go, room to still belong
Share my warmth, let the whole house breathe
No one owned, no one asked to leave
But love gets claimed like a deed in the ground
So we dream of a door that won’t shut us out
I’d build that home if the world let it be
All of us here, all of us free

[Verse 2: Male Rap]
You say “mine” like a fencepost driven deep
Like a promise is a key you get to keep
Every kindness gets a border, every touch gets filed
Every open hand gets read as running wild
I’m not asking for a throne or a title on the wall
Just a table with enough room when the late ones call
But the rules say choose a side, draw the map, hold tight
So the house in my head stays lit out of sight

[Pre-Chorus: Female]
If I reach for you, must I close every door?
Can’t a heart make room for more?

[Chorus: Duet]
I’d build a home for every heart I hold
Room to come and go, room to still belong
Share my warmth, let the whole house breathe
No one owned, no one asked to leave
But love gets claimed like a deed in the ground
So we dream of a door that won’t shut us out
I’d build that home if the world let it be
All of us here, all of us free

[Bridge: Male Rap, Female answers]
[Male] No deed, no fence, no numbered key
[Female] Just a chair pulled close when you need to breathe
[Male] No claim that turns a welcome to a chain
[Female] Just warmth enough to share the cold days
[Duet] Maybe somewhere hearts can stay unowned
Maybe someday no one has to choose alone

[Final Chorus: Duet]
I’d build a home for every heart I hold
Room to come and go, room to still belong
Share my warmth, let the whole house breathe
No one owned, no one asked to leave
But love gets claimed like a deed in the ground
Still I keep that open door in my sound
I’d build that home if the world let it be
All of us here, all of us free
[Ad-libs: Female]
Room for you, room for me
[Male]
No one owns what love can be
[Duet]
All of us here, all of us free

title: House of Glass
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Concrete walls and a blueprint in my head
Building rooms out of everything you ever said
A roof of gold where the stray emotions land
Every soul that I'm holding in my hand
Tenants of my pulse sleeping in the hall
No lock on the door and no shadows on the wall
Just an endless fire keeping out the cold
Everyone I love safely in the fold

[Pre-Chorus]
But the map was drawn by someone else's hand
Drawing lines across the promised land
They want a deed, they want a signed decree
They want to cage the bird that flies for free

[Chorus]
You call it yours, I call it letting go
A house of glass where the wild orchids grow
You stake your claim with a hammer and a chain
I built a home where nobody wears a name
We could share the warmth, we could share the light
Instead you build a fence to conquer the night
Coexistence is a ghost we chase in vain
Love is just a weapon in a hurricane

[Verse 2]
Stamping feet on the pavement of my chest
Everyone's a landlord, nobody's a guest
You want the key to the chambers of my spine
Saying what is yours and pointing out what's mine
A fortress built from the vanity of pride
Now there's nowhere left for the gentle hearts to hide
Every open window traded for a door
Walking on the shards of a broken hardwood floor

[Pre-Chorus]
And the map was drawn by someone else's hand
Drawing lines across the promised land
They want a deed, they want a signed decree
They want to cage the bird that flies for free

[Chorus]
You call it yours, I call it letting go
A house of glass where the wild orchids grow
You stake your claim with a hammer and a chain
I built a home where nobody wears a name
We could share the warmth, we could share the light
Instead you build a fence to conquer the night
Coexistence is a ghost we chase in vain
Love is just a weapon in a hurricane

[Bridge]
Tear the shingles down, let the weather in
Show me where the borders and the bloodlines end
If I can't provide a sanctuary space
Then burn the foundation down without a trace

[Chorus]
You call it yours, I call it letting go
A house of glass where the wild orchids grow
You stake your claim with a hammer and a chain
I built a home where nobody wears a name
We could share the warmth, we could share the light
Instead you build a fence to conquer the night
Coexistence is a ghost we chase in vain
Love is just a weapon in a hurricane

[Outro]
Just a hurricane
No keys, no walls
Just the falling rain
(Fade out)

title: A Little Border
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I brought you every open door
And wondered why you stepped away
I thought that love meant asking more
Until you named your need for space

[Pre-Chorus]
A promise needs a little edge
A yes means more when no is safe
I’m learning how to meet you there
And leave enough room for your shape

[Chorus]
My love runs wide, but I can learn
Where your horizon starts to turn
A line between us isn’t loss
It gives our meeting somewhere to land
I can be whole and still be near
Hold what is yours, say what I fear
If we can choose the terms we keep
There’s room for something real and deep

[Verse 2]
We make our rules from borrowed words
From little scripts we didn’t write
But we can ask which ones still serve
And build a way that fits us right

[Pre-Chorus]
A promise needs a little edge
A yes means more when no is safe
I’m learning how to meet you there
And leave enough room for your shape

[Chorus]
My love runs wide, but I can learn
Where your horizon starts to turn
A line between us isn’t loss
It gives our meeting somewhere to land
I can be whole and still be near
Hold what is yours, say what I fear
If we can choose the terms we keep
There’s room for something real and deep

[Bridge]
I won’t call every limit cruel
Or make my hunger your command
We’ll write the measure as we go
Two living hearts, two open hands

[Final Chorus]
My love runs wide, and now I know
A river needs its banks to flow
A line between us isn’t loss
It gives our meeting somewhere to land
I can be whole and still be near
Hold what is yours, say what I fear
If we can choose the terms we keep
There’s room for something real and deep

[Outro]
Room to arrive, room to depart
A little border, an open heart

title: Hold You Close Without
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I brought the whole sea to your small front door
You had a key, but you needed a shore
I called every limit a failure to care
You said, “I’m still here, but I need some air”

[Pre-Chorus]
So I’m learning the shape of a yes and a no
How a door can stay open and still close slow

[Chorus]
I can love you wide, I can love you well
Keep one hand on the line where our two lives dwell
Not a cage, not a wall, just a place to begin
I can meet you at the edge and still let you in
Boundless heart, bring it down to a human size
Make a little room for your truth and mine
If I want us to grow, if I want this to last
I can hold you close without holding you fast

[Verse 2]
I used to think care meant never to part
Like proof was the weight of a hand on a heart
Now I ask what you need, and I tell you mine
There’s a freedom in drawing a steady line

[Pre-Chorus]
Not every rule is a lock on the door
Some make a bridge we can both walk toward

[Chorus]
I can love you wide, I can love you well
Keep one hand on the line where our two lives dwell
Not a cage, not a wall, just a place to begin
I can meet you at the edge and still let you in
Boundless heart, bring it down to a human size
Make a little room for your truth and mine
If I want us to grow, if I want this to last
I can hold you close without holding you fast

[Bridge]
This world has measures, names, and gates
We can curse the frame or learn its shape
My love can be huge; it can also hear
The small honest sentence: “I need you near, not here”

[Final Chorus]
I can love you wide, I can love you well
Keep one hand on the line where our two lives dwell
Not a cage, not a wall, just a place to begin
I can meet you at the edge and still let you in
Boundless heart, bring it down to a human size
Make a little room for your truth and mine
If I want us to grow, if I want this to last
I can hold you close without holding you fast

[Outro]
Wide heart, steady hands
Love can live inside the plans

title: With the Edges On
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I brought a sea to a kitchen sink
You drew a line where the water could be
I called it fear when you asked me to think
You called it care when you let me breathe

[Pre-Chorus]
I can’t make every door swing wide
I can’t call every limit a lie

[Chorus]
So I’ll love you with the edges on
Hold the shape that lets us both belong
All this heart can’t flood the room
I’ll meet you where the walls make room
If I want your hand to stay in mine
I have to honor where you draw the line

[Verse 2]
I used to think that a promise meant more
If it could break every rule in its way
Now I can knock, I can wait by the door
And hear your yes without asking it to stay

[Pre-Chorus]
I can keep my wide-open heart
And still leave space for where you are

[Chorus]
So I’ll love you with the edges on
Hold the shape that lets us both belong
All this heart can’t flood the room
I’ll meet you where the walls make room
If I want your hand to stay in mine
I have to honor where you draw the line

[Bridge]
Love isn’t proof that I can cross
Every boundary at any cost
I can be whole and still be near
I can want you and hear you clear

[Final Chorus]
So I’ll love you with the edges on
Hold the shape that lets us both belong
All this heart can’t flood the room
I’ll meet you where the walls make room
If I want your hand to stay in mine
I have to honor where you draw the line

[Outro]
My love is wide; it can learn the shore
I’ll meet you there, and ask for more

title: Wide Enough to Pass
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I came in with a map that had no edges
A heart that kept on asking for more
You said, “We can meet where the ground is steady”
I heard the limit, then I heard the door

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t have to make the whole world smaller
To make a place where we can stand
Some lines are not a wall between us
They’re how we keep our hands in hand

[Chorus]
I’ll meet you where the rules can hold us
I’ll let the shape of this be true
My love can overflow the borders
But it can still come home to you
I’ll meet you where the rules can hold us
Not less, just made to last
A boundless heart can learn a doorway
And still be wide enough to pass

[Verse 2]
I used to call the open field a promise
And every fence a thing to tear apart
Now I can hear the careful in your silence
And choose the words that let us both have heart

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t have to make the whole world smaller
To make a place where we can stand
Some lines are not a wall between us
They’re how we keep our hands in hand

[Chorus]
I’ll meet you where the rules can hold us
I’ll let the shape of this be true
My love can overflow the borders
But it can still come home to you
I’ll meet you where the rules can hold us
Not less, just made to last
A boundless heart can learn a doorway
And still be wide enough to pass

[Bridge]
If I give you all the sky, you’ll lose the ground beneath your feet
If I give you room to breathe, we might have something real to keep
So I’ll bring the whole of me, and leave a little space for you
That’s not a smaller love—that’s how it gets to see you through

[Final Chorus]
I’ll meet you where the rules can hold us
I’ll let the shape of this be true
My love can overflow the borders
But it can still come home to you
I’ll meet you where the rules can hold us
Not less, just made to last
A boundless heart can learn a doorway
And still be wide enough to pass

[Outro]
Wide enough to pass
Wide enough to stay

title: That House Inside My Song
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
If I had a house with a door for every name
I’d keep the kettle singing, keep the windows warm
You could bring your whole weather, every bruise and flame
There’d be room at the table when the night rolled on

[Pre-Chorus]
No one taking attendance
No one drawing a line
Just your laugh in the kitchen
Next to hers next to mine

[Chorus]
I’d build a home for everyone who has my heart
A hundred open rooms, no one asked to choose
We’d share the heat and let the separate lives be ours
But love gets called a title, and a title says, “You’re mine”
So I keep that house inside a song I can’t live in

[Verse 2]
You say a heart should have a fence, a single key
As if a welcome could be stolen by the air
I wish the words came easy: stay, and still be free
I wish the world could hold us without keeping score

[Pre-Chorus]
No one taking attendance
No one drawing a line
Just your laugh in the kitchen
Next to hers next to mine

[Chorus]
I’d build a home for everyone who has my heart
A hundred open rooms, no one asked to choose
We’d share the heat and let the separate lives be ours
But love gets called a title, and a title says, “You’re mine”
So I keep that house inside a song I can’t live in

[Bridge]
Maybe every wall would lean
Maybe every roof would part
Still I’d set another place
For the ones who know my heart
But the world keeps naming borders
Where I only see a door
And the dream keeps making room
While the locks keep asking for more

[Final Chorus]
I’d build a home for everyone who has my heart
A hundred open rooms, no one asked to choose
We’d share the heat and let the separate lives be ours
But love gets called a title, and a title says, “You’re mine”
So I keep that house inside a song I can’t live in

[Outro]
I can’t live in
That house inside my song

title: Unowned, Alive
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
If I had the lumber, if I had the land
I’d raise a room for every hand I understand
A table long enough for all the names I keep
A fire that stays kind while the whole house sleeps

[Pre-Chorus]
No keys to copy, no line to draw
No one held here by a hidden law

[Chorus]
Come in, come close, there’s room enough to stay
I’d give you warmth and let you keep your way
But hearts get measured like a deed, a claim, a prize
We build our little borders where the open doorway lies
I dream us side by side, unowned, alive
I dream us side by side

[Verse 2]
You could leave at sunrise, come back when you choose
Bring your changing weather, bring your different truths
I’d never call your freedom proof that love was wrong
I’d want the door to welcome you, not make you belong

[Pre-Chorus]
No keys to copy, no line to draw
No one held here by a hidden law

[Chorus]
Come in, come close, there’s room enough to stay
I’d give you warmth and let you keep your way
But hearts get measured like a deed, a claim, a prize
We build our little borders where the open doorway lies
I dream us side by side, unowned, alive
I dream us side by side

[Bridge]
I can picture every chair pulled near
Every voice still sounding clear
No one asked to shrink or choose
No one loved by what they lose
Then the world says, “Mine or gone,”
And the house I drew comes down

[Final Chorus]
Come in, come close, there’s room enough to stay
I’d give you warmth and let you keep your way
But hearts get measured like a deed, a claim, a prize
We build our little borders where the open doorway lies
I dream us side by side, unowned, alive
I dream us side by side

[Outro]
If I could build it, you’d be free
And still there’d be a place for me

title: Every Door Unclosed
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I drew a house with every door unlocked
A long table, room enough to talk
You’d bring your laugh, they’d bring their stubborn grace
And nobody would have to choose a place

[Pre-Chorus]
I’d keep the kettle warm, the windows wide
Let every dear one come and sit inside

[Chorus]
If I could build a home for everyone I love
I’d set a place for all of us, enough is enough
No one gets a deed to the people they hold
We’d share the same shelter, not turn hearts to gold
But love gets called a claim, a key, a name

title: Too Many Doors
genres: Lo-Fi Math-Rock Production With Saturated Low Mids

lyrics:

title: Goodbye to the People I Could
lyrics:
