Pick one road
Let the others close
One true step
Is a door that goes

[Final Chorus]
The prison built of open doors
I can leave a thousand ways
But a road is just a road now
When I choose it and I stray
The prison built of open doors
I give one answer, let it stand
I take the path beneath my feet
And leave the rest unmanned
[Outro]
One step, one step
The doorway opens when I go

title: A Thousand Necks
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I poured Monday into a maybe
Tuesday split itself in two
Every door wore my own handwriting
Every room had a different view
I kept one hand on the turning glass
One hand reaching for the frame
All those lives were waiting gladly
None of them could learn my name

[Pre-Chorus]
Each narrow throat says, hurry through
But every grain divides in two

[Chorus]
A thousand necks, one falling sand
A thousand maps in a single hand
I chase each life as it slips away
No one gets all of me today
A thousand necks, the glass runs dry
I cannot live every life I try

[Verse 2]
There’s a kitchen where I keep the garden
A stage where I never miss my cue
A quiet coast where I mend the old boat
A desk where the whole world comes through
I set a place for every future
Set the table wide and long
Then the evening takes the candles
And the plates are all still gone

[Bridge]
Turn it over—hear the grains collide
One small current, let the rest subside
Choose a door and let it close behind
Give one life the weight of time

[Final Chorus]
A thousand necks, one falling sand
A thousand maps in a single hand
I choose one road; I let it stay
And give one life the whole of today
A thousand necks, the glass runs dry
One living heart can still reply

[Outro]
One road, one name
One life, fully claimed

title: The Bookmark Dare
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You wrote “Once upon” in the margin of a receipt
A little blue morning, a door in the heat
Every first sentence had somewhere to go
But you kept them all open, afraid to say so

[Pre-Chorus]
The bookmark waits like a dare in your hand
One page ahead, a whole other land

[Chorus]
Turn it, turn it—wait, not yet
One good beginning I can’t forget
Page goes over, worlds go still
I want every ending, I want the thrill
Turn it, turn it—hold that place
A hundred first chapters, none to erase

[Verse 2]
There’s a king with a teacup, a fox in a suit
A sea made of stairs and a talking old boot
Each one says, “Stay, there’s more you could see”
And the next little chapter keeps calling to me

[Pre-Chorus]
The bookmark slips, the paper bends
How many beginnings can one heart defend?

[Chorus]
Turn it, turn it—wait, not yet
One good beginning I can’t forget
Page goes over, worlds go still
I want every ending, I want the thrill
Turn it, turn it—hold that place
A hundred first chapters, none to erase

[Bridge]
Maybe a story is not what we save
Maybe it grows when we give it a page
Some doors close gently; some worlds remain
In the shape of a sentence we dared to explain

[Final Chorus]
Turn it, turn it—here we go
Let one small story become what it knows
Page goes over, the others stay
Folded like maps for another day
Turn it, turn it—make it real
I can’t live every beginning I feel

[Outro]
The bookmark rests; the ink runs on
One page behind, one page beyond

title: Turn It, Turn It
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep the first page folded in your coat
A little gold-edged promise, soft and warm
Every new beginning wears a borrowed face
You love the opening, then you lose the nerve

[Pre-Chorus]
The ink is dry, the room is still
You know the next line might be real

[Chorus]
Turn it, turn it—let the old page fall
One more first chapter, one more brave call
You can’t keep every story in your hands
Turn it, turn it—make a place to stand

[Verse 2]
A thousand little endings wait in rows
Each one a door you never let you through
You call it keeping every possibility
But the book stays shut, and so do you

[Pre-Chorus]
The ink is dry, the room is still
You know the next line might be real

[Chorus]
Turn it, turn it—let the old page fall
One more first chapter, one more brave call
You can’t keep every story in your hands
Turn it, turn it—make a place to stand

[Bridge]
Maybe the page is blank for a while
Maybe the next line takes its time
But a story isn’t saved by staying still
You’re allowed to leave the first page behind

[Final Chorus]
Turn it, turn it—let the old page fall
One more first chapter, one more brave call
You can’t keep every story in your hands
Turn it, turn it—make a place to stand
Turn it, turn it—let the old page fall
One more first chapter, one more brave call
You can’t keep every story in your hands
Turn it, turn it—make a place to stand

[Outro]
Make a place to stand
Turn it, turn it

title: Every Plate Is My Favorite
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Every plate is my favorite, bring another, bring it near
Sweet, salt, sour, sugar—still the empty waits right here
Fork goes left, heel goes right, let the table rearrange
I can taste the whole world, but the wanting doesn’t change

[Verse 1]
A silver cart rolls in with a parade of tiny suns
Pear tart, peppered peaches, noodles curled like question marks
You say, “Pick one.” I say, “I’ve been waiting all my life.”
Then the waiter lifts the lid; I ask what’s coming after that

[Chorus]
Every plate is my favorite, bring another, bring it near
Sweet, salt, sour, sugar—still the empty waits right here
Fork goes left, heel goes right, let the table rearrange
I can taste the whole world, but the wanting doesn’t change

[Verse 2]
There’s a throne made out of napkins, there’s a moat of melted cheese
A little brass bell rings whenever I say, “Please, please, please”
The menu folds forever, accordion in my hand
I’m chewing through the options, not a bite of where I am

[Bridge]
Pass the peaches, pass the pie
Pass the reason I came by
All this plenty, plate on plate
Still I’m hungry at the gate

[Chorus]
Every plate is my favorite, bring another, bring it near
Sweet, salt, sour, sugar—still the empty waits right here
Fork goes left, heel goes right, let the table rearrange
I can taste the whole world, but the wanting doesn’t change

[Outro]
Clear the table, set it new
Leave one place and hunger too

title: Hunger Wears a Paper Hat
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Every plate is piled with paradise,
Still my empty mouth keeps asking twice.
Forks collide on the one-and-three,
Feast forever, starve beside me.

[Verse 1]
A silver spoon knows every name,
The gravy map repeats the same.
I taste the dish I dreamed about,
Then dream of what I haven't found.

[Pre-Chorus]
One more course, the bells insist,
One more bite I can't resist.

[Chorus]
Every plate is piled with paradise,
Still my empty mouth keeps asking twice.
Forks collide on the one-and-three,
Feast forever, starve beside me.

[Verse 2]
The waiter wheels a newer sun,
Its little moons are portioned fun.
I praise the chef, I praise the tray,
Then mourn the flavor on its way.

[Bridge]
Count the candles, count the chairs,
Count the wishes in the air.
When desire gets served as fact,
Want becomes the only snack.

[Chorus]
Every plate is piled with paradise,
Still my empty mouth keeps asking twice.
Forks collide on the one-and-three,
Feast forever, starve beside me.

[Outro]
Clear the table, bring it back,
Hunger wears a paper hat.

title: King of Unclaimed Kingdoms
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A hundred gates swung open wide,
Each little kingdom dressed to shine.
They set the keys beside my plate,
I counted crowns and called it fate.

[Pre-Chorus]
One throne means choosing where to sit,
One flag means standing under it.
I smiled and sent the page away—
I’d rather rule the maybes anyway.

[Chorus]
King of unclaimed kingdoms, crown me none,
A hundred doors and I walk past each one.
Ninety-nine crowns in a velvet row—
I keep the princehood; I let them go.
King of unclaimed kingdoms, proud and free,
I want every throne, not one over me.

[Verse 2]
A harbor offered me its tide,
A mountain town, a country side.
The royal tailor pinned my sleeve;
I chose the road before the leave.

[Pre-Chorus]
One map means picking just one shore,
One golden seal shuts ninety-nine doors.
So let the herald read my name—
I keep the game, I skip the reign.

[Chorus]
King of unclaimed kingdoms, crown me none,
A hundred doors and I walk past each one.
Ninety-nine crowns in a velvet row—
I keep the princehood; I let them go.
King of unclaimed kingdoms, proud and free,
I want every throne, not one over me.

[Bridge]
The crown is heavy, the choices are light;
I trade one kingdom for all in my sight.
My little sash says “almost the king”—
I guard that almost like everything.

[Final Chorus]
King of unclaimed kingdoms, crown me none,
A hundred doors and I walk past each one.
Ninety-nine crowns in a velvet row—
I keep the princehood; I let them go.
King of unclaimed kingdoms, proud and free,
I want every throne, not one over me.

[Outro]
Not one over me—
I keep the key.

title: Ninety-Nine Crowns
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Ninety-nine crowns on the marble floor
I won't trade my freedom for a hundred more
Keep the whole empire, leave the throne behind
Prince of the wild in an unclaimed mind!
Ninety-nine crowns, let 'em tumble down
Rather be a prince than a heavy-headed crown!

[Verse 1]
They offered me the silver and the gold-trimmed hall
A hundred velvet banners hanging on the wall
"Just sign your name," they whispered, "take the royal key"
But ninety-nine kingdoms is a trap for me.
I hold the map of nowhere in a velvet sleeve
I ruler of the quiet, I'm the one who leaves.

[Chorus]
Ninety-nine crowns on the marble floor
I won't trade my freedom for a hundred more
Keep the whole empire, leave the throne behind
Prince of the wild in an unclaimed mind!
Ninety-nine crowns, let 'em tumble down
Rather be a prince than a heavy-headed crown!

[Verse 2]
A hundred titles heavy on a paper scroll
Nine-and-ninety taxmen collecting on the soul
I’d rather wear a feather than a iron rim
I keep the empty border where the dusk grows dim.
No sceptre in my palm, no statues in the square
Just a single prince breathing open air.

[Chorus]
Ninety-nine crowns on the marble floor
I won't trade my freedom for a hundred more
Keep the whole empire, leave the throne behind
Prince of the wild in an unclaimed mind!
Ninety-nine crowns, let 'em tumble down
Rather be a prince than a heavy-headed crown!

[Outro]
Unclaimed kingdoms...
Leave the ninety-nine crowns.
Prince forever.
Glitch out, drop down.

title: One Looks Back
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A thousand grins crowd the silver pane
Each one wearing my Sunday name
They wave from a life I haven't begun
Bright little answers, every one

[Pre-Chorus]
I count the doors in the glassy wall
Every face says, “Pick me,” all
But the room stays still, the room stays still
Till I give one face my will

[Chorus]
Pick one—look back!
Choose one—snap!
A thousand futures in a polished frame
One turns around when I call its name
Pick one—step through!
Make it true!
All those happy faces, lined in a row
One looks back when I say, “Let’s go”

[Verse 2]
One wears my coat in a seaside town
One takes the train and never gets down
One tells a joke at a crowded table
One makes a mess, then calls it a fable

[Pre-Chorus]
I could keep every maybe in sight
A perfect parade that lasts all night
But the room stays still, the room stays still
Till I give one face my will

[Chorus]
Pick one—look back!
Choose one—snap!
A thousand futures in a polished frame
One turns around when I call its name
Pick one—step through!
Make it true!
All those happy faces, lined in a row
One looks back when I say, “Let’s go”

[Bridge]
Mirror, mirror, hold your pose
You can’t choose where my footsteps go
I’ll take the grin with the crooked tooth
And trade the perfect for something true

[Final Chorus]
Pick one—look back!
Choose one—snap!
A thousand futures in a polished frame
One turns around when I call its name
Pick one—step through!
Make it true!
All those happy faces, let them go
One looks back—and I say, “Hello”

[Outro]
One looks back
I look too

title: Lives Not Lived
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You gave the almost-me a velvet rope
A docent badge, a room to pace
The pilot with the perfect coat
The painter with a borrowed face
You dust each frame, you check the light
You know their names, their dates, their art
The doors swing shut at closing time
You’re still outside your own heart

[Pre-Chorus]
Little brass plaque, polished bright
“Could have been” in black and white
Every label, every part
None of them can take your heart

[Chorus]
Welcome to the lives not lived
Pick a frame and watch it kick
Bassline sideways, heels don’t land
You’re the guard who missed the grandstand
All these selves behind the glass
Wave goodbye as hours pass
Close the book, unlock the door
You are here—what are you waiting for?

[Verse 2]
A tiny astronaut floats in a jar
A chef serves menus made of air
The almost-famous, almost-far
Have perfect hair and vacant stares
You keep the tickets in a drawer
For every train you didn’t ride
But one small hand is on the door
And one real day is still outside

[Pre-Chorus]
Little brass plaque, polished bright
“Could have been” in black and white
Every label, every part
None of them can take your heart

[Chorus]
Welcome to the lives not lived
Pick a frame and watch it kick
Bassline sideways, heels don’t land
You’re the guard who missed the grandstand
All these selves behind the glass
Wave goodbye as hours pass
Close the book, unlock the door
You are here—what are you waiting for?

[Bridge]
The curator clears his throat
The velvet rope slips from his hand
No grand reveal, no secret note
Just dust, a key, and solid land
You don’t need a better name
You don’t need their perfect view
Turn the sign around today:
“Open. Come on through.”

[Final Chorus]
Welcome to the lives not lived
Leave the frames; the door gives in
Bassline sideways, heels don’t land
Take your place, take your chance
All those selves behind the glass
Let them keep their polished past
Close the book, unlock the door
You are here—go live some more

[Outro]
You are here
The door is yours
You are here

title: Honey's Gone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You land on a buttercup, taste what it could be
Then spot a blue bell two rows down the field
You leave the first promise hanging in the breeze
And chase the sweeter story it might yield

[Pre-Chorus]
One petal says wait, one petal says fly
You keep both wings busy asking why

[Chorus]
Pick one, pick one—no, that one’s brighter
Left, right, compare till the comb runs drier
Round and round where the blossoms sway
You count every honey and give none away
Pick one, pick one—your wings beat faster
The hive stays hollow beneath the flower laughter
Every bloom says, “I could be the one”
You’re rich in choices, but the honey’s gone

[Verse 2]
You make a little chart on a leaf in the sun
Rank each golden cup by its promised taste
The workers come home with the evening begun
You’re still on the hill with the list half erased

[Pre-Chorus]
One petal says wait, one petal says fly
You keep both wings busy asking why

[Chorus]
Pick one, pick one—no, that one’s brighter
Left, right, compare till the comb runs drier
Round and round where the blossoms sway
You count every honey and give none away
Pick one, pick one—your wings beat faster
The hive stays hollow beneath the flower laughter
Every bloom says, “I could be the one”
You’re rich in choices, but the honey’s gone

[Bridge]
The meadow doesn’t owe you a perfect flower
The clock keeps chewing through the golden hour
Land on a bloom, let the question rest
A little gathered sweetness beats a flawless guess

[Final Chorus]
Pick one, pick one—no, that one’s brighter
Left, right, compare till the comb runs drier
Round and round where the blossoms sway
You count every honey and give none away
Pick one, pick one—your wings beat faster
The hive stays hollow beneath the flower laughter
Every bloom says, “I could be the one”
You’re rich in choices, but the honey’s gone

[Outro]
One small flower, one little flight
A drop in the comb before the night

title: Wish One
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I had a wish halfway written
When the first white spark came down
By the time I found the ending
Three more scribbled up the clouds
I aimed my thumb at the heavens
Like a clerk with forms to file
But the sky kept changing numbers
And I lost my place in line

[Pre-Chorus]
One for the cat with the velvet crown
One for the rent to forget my name
One for a Tuesday that stays put
One for the whole world to behave

[Chorus]
Wish one—wait, wish two—falling through
I can’t finish asking before the next comes due
Bassline buckles, my brave plans tumble
Every bright little promise makes the whole list double
Wish one—wish two—there goes three
I’m still picking a subject when the sky picks me
So I fold up my hands, then I open them wide
There’s another one burning before I decide

[Verse 2]
I wished for a pocket-sized ocean
Then a spoon that could stir the moon
A seven-day weekend in April
And a kettle that sings in tune
I tried to be grateful in order
Made a neat little numbered parade
Then a star cut across my sentence
And the ink ran away

[Pre-Chorus]
One for the keys I keep misplacing
One for my courage to call you back
One for a map with no wrong turns
One for a snack that’s a full meal, perhaps

[Chorus]
Wish one—wait, wish two—falling through
I can’t finish asking before the next comes due
Bassline buckles, my brave plans tumble
Every bright little promise makes the whole list double
Wish one—wish two—there goes three
I’m still picking a subject when the sky picks me
So I fold up my hands, then I open them wide
There’s another one burning before I decide

[Bridge]
Maybe the point isn’t getting them granted
Maybe it’s how the wanting keeps me awake
I’ll wish for a pause—
Oh, there goes another
I’ll wish for a pause—
Well, that one can wait

[Final Chorus]
Wish one—wait, wish two—falling through
I can’t finish asking before the next comes due
Bassline buckles, my brave plans tumble
Every bright little promise makes the whole list double
Wish one—wish two—there goes three
I’m still picking a subject when the sky picks me
So I fold up my hands, then I open them wide
There’s another one burning—let it decide

[Outro]
I had a wish halfway written
Now the page is full of sky

title: Pick One, Pick Two
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You kept each seed in a silver tin,
Every road got a map pinned in.
You said, “One more branch, then I’ll decide,”
While the roots pulled hard from either side.

[Pre-Chorus]
A little yes to every door,
A little room for something more.
The trunk kept trying to hold them all—
Now every choice leans toward the fall.

[Chorus]
Pick one, pick two—your branches sway,
Too much sky and you bow that way.
Tick-tock, kick back, the roots dig deep,
You can’t grow every dream you keep.
Pick one, pick two—let some leaves go,
You’re not the whole forest, you know.

[Verse 2]
You grew a ladder beside the stairs,
A spare set of wings for the office chairs.
You planted a future in every pot,
Then wondered why the soil was not.

[Pre-Chorus]
A little yes to every door,
A little room for something more.
The trunk kept trying to hold them all—
Now every choice leans toward the fall.

[Chorus]
Pick one, pick two—your branches sway,
Too much sky and you bow that way.
Tick-tock, kick back, the roots dig deep,
You can’t grow every dream you keep.
Pick one, pick two—let some leaves go,
You’re not the whole forest, you know.

[Bridge]
The gardener brings a paper crown,
Says, “Choose a limb or lie face-down.”
You laugh, then hear the timber complain—
Every maybe has a weight and a name.

[Final Chorus]
Pick one, pick two—your branches sway,
Too much sky and you bow that way.
Tick-tock, kick back, the roots dig deep,
You can’t grow every dream you keep.
Pick one, pick two—let some leaves go,
Stand up straight with room to grow.

[Outro]
One branch reaches; one branch stays.
The tree can breathe when it makes its choice.

title: The Leaning Tree
lyrics:
[Chorus]
I kept every branch, every maybe, every door
Now the whole tree’s leaning, roots can’t hold no more
Pick one, pick two—no, I’ll keep them all
I grew so much future I can’t stand tall

[Verse 1]
There’s a map in my pocket with a hundred red routes
A shelf full of selves I could still turn out
I said, “Leave them alive; let the whole thing grow”
Now the limbs scrape the dirt everywhere I go

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “Choose what can carry you”
I laughed like a fool with a forest to prove

[Chorus]
I kept every branch, every maybe, every door
Now the whole tree’s leaning, roots can’t hold no more
Pick one, pick two—no, I’ll keep them all
I grew so much future I can’t stand tall

[Verse 2]
One branch wants a stage, one wants a quiet room
One’s building a boat, one’s planting in June
I water them all till the bucket runs dry
Then blame the poor ground when the green starts to lie

[Bridge]
Little scissors on the table, shining like a dare
One clean cut could give the other branches air
But I name each twig a promise, each leaf a perfect plan
Now I’m holding up the orchard with two shaking hands

[Final Chorus]
I kept every branch, every maybe, every door
Now the whole tree’s leaning, roots can’t hold no more
Pick one, pick two—let the rest fall
I can grow toward the sunlight without growing them all

[Outro]
One good branch
One open sky
The roots hold fast
I don’t have to be every life

title: Blossoms Under Glass
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You pin each petal to the calendar page
Tell the warm wind, “Wait your turn”
The garden’s wearing its Sunday best
While the peaches hang green and learn

[Pre-Chorus]
You count the buds like borrowed gold
And keep the gate on a chain
But every little bloom you save
Is asking for the rain

[Chorus]
Stay, stay, spring—don’t turn the page
You keep the blossoms under glass
Stay, stay, spring—hold back the days
But summer’s tapping through the grass
One-two, skip—your careful heart says “wait”
One-two, skip—the fruit won’t hesitate
You clutch each flower till the colors drain
Then call it love when the season stays the same

[Verse 2]
You dress the roses in tiny coats
And scold the bees for moving on
The clock wears petals over its face
You swear the year has simply paused

[Pre-Chorus]
You count the buds like borrowed gold
And keep the gate on a chain
But every little bloom you save
Is asking for the rain

[Chorus]
Stay, stay, spring—don’t turn the page
You keep the blossoms under glass
Stay, stay, spring—hold back the days
But summer’s tapping through the grass
One-two, skip—your careful heart says “wait”
One-two, skip—the fruit won’t hesitate
You clutch each flower till the colors drain
Then call it love when the season stays the same

[Bridge]
A blossom isn’t happier pressed
Between the dates you wouldn’t cross
The branch can bend and still be blessed
A little change is not a loss

[Final Chorus]
Stay, stay, spring—don’t turn the page
You keep the blossoms under glass
Stay, stay, spring—now let the days
Bring all the sweetness they can pass
One-two, skip—your careful heart says “wait”
One-two, skip—the fruit won’t hesitate
You can love the bloom and let it wane
The year keeps turning; let it change

[Outro]
Let it change
Let it change

title: I Circle the Garden
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Every flower says, “Come down, come taste”
I beat my wings in a nervous haste
If I choose this bloom, all the others close
So I circle the garden and nobody knows

[Verse 1]
A tulip holds a tiny cup of rain
A daisy deals in gold and pollen grain
The rose has velvet tucked behind its thorns
I make a map, then tear it up by dawn

[Pre-Chorus]
You say, “The sweetest thing is here”
I say, “But what’s beyond the sphere?”
My feet stay folded, wings run wild
A very busy, undecided child

[Chorus]
Every flower says, “Come down, come taste”
I beat my wings in a nervous haste
If I choose this bloom, all the others close
So I circle the garden and nobody knows

[Verse 2]
The violet nods like it has heard this speech
The foxglove keeps its counsel out of reach
I’ve sampled every scent from up above
And never once got pollen on my gloves

[Bridge]
Maybe one small landing won’t erase the sky
Maybe every “what if” doesn’t have to fly
You hold out your hand; I hover, then descend
A whole wide garden doesn’t vanish at the end

[Final Chorus]
Every flower says, “Come down, come taste”
I beat my wings, but I slow my haste
I choose this bloom; the others still can grow
There’s more than one way for a heart to know

[Outro]
One petal, one breath, the garden stays wide
I land for a moment—then open my eyes

title: Facing Both Suns
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You leaned toward the promise on either side
Two bright mouths saying, “Come inside”
One warmed your leaves, one warmed your roots
Both kept asking for a better view
You turned a little, then turned some more
Till your green neck rasped against the floor
Now every petal points somewhere new
And neither sun can tell what you’re loyal to

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “More heat means more alive”
You said it twice to stay convinced
The stem kept score beneath the soil
A hairline crack, a little twist

[Chorus]
Two suns, two suns—pick a side, pick a side
Left foot, right foot, split your stride
Turn, turn, turn till the green goes thin
Warm on both cheeks, cold within
Two suns, two suns—what a lovely deal
One for the dream and one for the peel
You bent for the blessing, you snapped at the seam
Now you’re facing both suns in a field of your own scheme

[Verse 2]
The garden clerk brought a clipboard round
“Which golden source should we write down?”
You gave each orb a polished grin
And hid the splinter under your skin
The bees flew off with the afternoon
Your shadow wore a bent little crown
You called it balance, called it choice
Then lost the use of your turning voice

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “More heat means more alive”
You said it twice to stay convinced
The stem kept score beneath the soil
A hairline crack, a little twist

[Chorus]
Two suns, two suns—pick a side, pick a side
Left foot, right foot, split your stride
Turn, turn, turn till the green goes thin
Warm on both cheeks, cold within
Two suns, two suns—what a lovely deal
One for the dream and one for the peel
You bent for the blessing, you snapped at the seam
Now you’re facing both suns in a field of your own scheme

[Bridge]
If one had set, you might have slept
If one had dimmed, your roots could rest
But every promise wore a crown
And every crown kept pulling down

You said, “Take the long way, we’ve got time”
That’s the line I hear whenever I stop to think

[Pre-Chorus]
Years change the edges, not the room
And suddenly I see you there

[Chorus]
Look again, look again
The picture keeps developing
One little moment, inked beneath the skin
Look again, look again
The ordinary opens up again
I was there, but I didn’t know what it meant then

[Bridge]
No grand goodbye, no painted sign
Just your hand passing me the keys
A plain old Tuesday, a yellow kitchen
Turns out it was holding everything

[Final Chorus]
Look again, look again
The picture keeps developing
One little moment, inked beneath the skin
Look again, look again
The ordinary opens up again
I was there, now I know what it meant then
Look again, look again
The picture keeps developing

title: That Little Sidequest
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I beat the old game, crossed the finish line
They called my name, took the photograph
But one small marker on a side-road map
Still keeps me wondering what came after that

[Pre-Chorus]
A locked blue door, a note in the grass
One last little task I let go past
Why does that tiny thread still pull me back?

[Chorus]
I still wonder what was waiting there
One more turn, one more answer in the air
I won the crown, I took the long way home
But that small unfinished road won’t leave me alone
Tap it, turn it, let the question run
The biggest win is done and gone
I still wonder what was waiting there
That little side quest follows everywhere

[Verse 2]
A coin I missed beneath the market stairs
A stranger’s name I meant to ask about
The grand parade is folded into frames
But little loose ends keep their quiet flame

[Pre-Chorus]
A map half-read, a gate left shut
A simple thing I never followed up
Why does that tiny thread still pull me back?

[Chorus]
I still wonder what was waiting there
One more turn, one more answer in the air
I won the crown, I took the long way home
But that small unfinished road won’t leave me alone
Tap it, turn it, let the question run
The biggest win is done and gone
I still wonder what was waiting there
That little side quest follows everywhere

[Bridge]
Maybe it was nothing, maybe it was gold
Maybe just a story I was meant to know
I can’t replay the day or change the route
Still, that little question keeps finding me out

[Final Chorus]
I still wonder what was waiting there
One more turn, one more answer in the air
I won the crown, I took the long way home
But that small unfinished road won’t leave me alone
Tap it, turn it, let the question run
The biggest win is done and gone
I still wonder what was waiting there
That little side quest follows everywhere

[Outro]
One more turn… what was waiting there?

title: Pick One Platform
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Glass walls carry every view
A hundred towns come sliding through
A harbor bell, a mountain pass
My face floats back against the glass

[Pre-Chorus]
The map keeps opening its hands
Each mile asks where I will stand

[Chorus]
Pick one platform, let the rest roll by
One door open, a whole sky saying goodbye
Every road is calling, every sign is bright
I can’t ride every tomorrow in a single night
Pick one platform, let the wheels decide
All those other lives still streaming outside
I’ll step down, I’ll step down
While the train keeps carrying the maybe-me around

[Verse 2]
A red-roof town, a winter shore
The life I’ve never tried before
They flash like rooms I might have known
Then vanish past the window’s chrome

[Pre-Chorus]
The map keeps opening its hands
Each mile asks where I will stand

[Chorus]
Pick one platform, let the rest roll by
One door open, a whole sky saying goodbye
Every road is calling, every sign is bright
I can’t ride every tomorrow in a single night
Pick one platform, let the wheels decide
All those other lives still streaming outside
I’ll step down, I’ll step down
While the train keeps carrying the maybe-me around

[Bridge]
No window can hold every view
No choice can make the others untrue
I’ll take the street beneath my shoes
And let the passing worlds keep moving too

[Final Chorus]
Pick one platform, let the rest roll by
One door open, a whole sky saying goodbye
Every road is calling, every sign is bright
I choose this morning, I choose this life
Pick one platform, let the wheels decide
All those other lives still streaming outside
I’ll step down, I’ll step down
And carry what I chose when the train rolls out of town

[Outro]
One door open
One road begun

title: The Arcade Never Closes
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Little hands on the cabinet edge
Quarter warm in a small closed fist
Pixel dragons cross the screen
You swear you know where the secret door is

[Pre-Chorus]
Years roll by, the room gets still
But somewhere you’re leaning in
One more turn, one more try
That kid still asks, “What’s next?”

[Chorus]
Come on, come on, the arcade never closes
One more life and the whole world opens
Left-right, leap, let the old world wait
You’re still the kid at the start of the game
Come on, come on, the arcade never closes
Hit that button, see where it goes then
Heart keeps time with the cabinet flames
You’re still the kid at the start of the game

[Verse 2]
Dust on the tokens, names worn thin
Your grown-up coat on the chair beside you
Behind your eyes, the colors spin
A map unfolds where the walls once hid you

[Pre-Chorus]
Years roll by, the room gets still
But somewhere you’re leaning in
One more turn, one more try
That kid still asks, “What’s next?”

[Chorus]
Come on, come on, the arcade never closes
One more life and the whole world opens
Left-right, leap, let the old world wait
You’re still the kid at the start of the game
Come on, come on, the arcade never closes
Hit that button, see where it goes then
Heart keeps time with the cabinet flames
You’re still the kid at the start of the game

[Bridge]
You don’t have to win every round
You only have to stay curious
That small brave spark is still around
Calling you toward the next unknown

[Final Chorus]
Come on, come on, the arcade never closes
One more life and the whole world opens
Left-right, leap, let the old world wait
You’re still the kid at the start of the game
Come on, come on, the arcade never closes
Hit that button, see where it goes then
Heart keeps time with the cabinet flames
You’re still the kid at the start of the game

[Outro]
One more turn, one more try
That kid still asks, “What’s next?”

title: Tick-Tock, Tuck It In
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You brought home a ticket stub
From a train that crossed the rain
A chipped blue cup from Lisbon
A map with salt along the frame
Each little thing says, “Look how far”
Each little mark says, “Look how long”
You set them by the kitchen clock
And hear the years inside their song

[Pre-Chorus]
The hands keep turning, soft and sure
While all your treasures gather dust
You count the miles that made them yours
And feel the wonder with the cost

[Chorus]
Tick-tock, tuck it in the drawer
One more little world you wore
Every keepsake, every mile
Takes a minute, leaves a smile
Tick-tock, turn the brass key round
Hear the years in what you found
Life keeps time in what we keep
Beautiful and bittersweet

[Verse 2]
A pressed leaf from the mountain road
A paper crown from your child’s parade
The tiny shell you carried home
From the summer you both stayed
You hold them up against the light
And see the days that made them shine
The clock collects your souvenirs
Then lends their weight back to your time

[Pre-Chorus]
The hands keep turning, soft and sure
While all your treasures gather dust
You count the miles that made them yours
And feel the wonder with the cost

[Chorus]
Tick-tock, tuck it in the drawer
One more little world you wore
Every keepsake, every mile
Takes a minute, leaves a smile
Tick-tock, turn the brass key round
Hear the years in what you found
Life keeps time in what we keep
Beautiful and bittersweet

[Bridge]
Don’t throw the ticket, don’t erase the stain
Don’t wish away the miles that made it yours
The clock can count, but it can’t explain
Why one small thing can open every door

[Final Chorus]
Tick-tock, tuck it in the drawer
One more little world you wore
Every keepsake, every mile
Takes a minute, leaves a smile
Tick-tock, turn the brass key round
Hear the years in what you found
Life keeps time in what we keep
Beautiful and bittersweet

[Outro]
Keep the shell, keep the ticket stub
Keep the days that made you love

title: Choose One Horizon
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I drew a line at the harbor wall
A little red route where the gulls wheel tall
One road opened like a morning door
One stayed folded in the atlas drawer

[Pre-Chorus]
Every yes is a compass turning
Every no leaves a page unburning
I can’t be the sea, the shore, the sky
Still, there’s a whole new world nearby

[Chorus]
Go where the map breaks, go where it bends
Take the bright road; let the lost roads end
Step on the one, let the other ones be
No one can sail every blue on the sea
Oh, the world is wide, and my hands are small
I choose one horizon—and love it all

[Verse 2]
There’s a warm green coast I’ll never know
And a mountain pass under winter snow
But this little town has a bell at noon
And a window full of orange bloom

[Pre-Chorus]
Every yes is a compass turning
Every no leaves a page unburning
I can’t be the sea, the shore, the sky
Still, there’s a whole new world nearby

[Chorus]
Go where the map breaks, go where it bends
Take the bright road; let the lost roads end
Step on the one, let the other ones be
No one can sail every blue on the sea
Oh, the world is wide, and my hands are small
I choose one horizon—and love it all

[Bridge]
Fold the paper, keep the crease
Let the far-off islands keep their peace
What I leave is not a debt to pay
I’m here, I’m moving, I’m on my way

[Final Chorus]
Go where the map breaks, go where it bends
Take the bright road; let the lost roads end
Step on the one, let the other ones be
No one can sail every blue on the sea
Oh, the world is wide, and my hands are small
I choose one horizon—and love it all

[Outro]
One bright harbor, one open door
I don’t need to visit every shore

title: The Other Side
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found that tape in a shoebox by the stairs
Your handwriting crooked, ’91 in blue
A dozen little chapters pressed between the reels
And every one still sounds like you

[Pre-Chorus]
The radio missed them, the world moved on
But I know every turn, every wrong-way song

[Chorus]
Flip it over, there’s another side
Little lost songs that I keep inside
Not the one they played, not the one they knew
Every B-side takes me back to you
Turn, turn—let the years rewind
Every chapter has a song they left behind
Flip it over, let the whole thing ride
My favorite song’s on the other side

[Verse 2]
The bus-stop summer, your coat in the rain
The first small room with the furnace that clanged
That long goodbye we couldn’t get right
Each had a tune we kept out of sight

[Pre-Chorus]
No golden record, no polished refrain
Just the sound of us, still warm in the grain

[Chorus]
Flip it over, there’s another side
Little lost songs that I keep inside
Not the one they played, not the one they knew
Every B-side takes me back to you
Turn, turn—let the years rewind
Every chapter has a song they left behind
Flip it over, let the whole thing ride
My favorite song’s on the other side

[Bridge]
Somewhere between the hiss and the pause
A whole life waits without applause
I press play on the parts we saved
The quiet tracks that made us brave

[Final Chorus]
Flip it over, there’s another side
Little lost songs that I keep inside
Not the one they played, not the one they knew
Every B-side takes me back to you
Turn, turn—let the years rewind
Every chapter has a song they left behind
Flip it over, let the whole thing ride
My favorite song’s on the other side

[Outro]
One more side, one more try
Our best songs never had to fly

title: No Empty Slots
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep the summer folded in a file
Your red scarf caught in sunlight by the pier
A ticket stub, your crooked little smile
The kind of proof that says we made it here

[Pre-Chorus]
Every frame is precious, every name still clear
But the little meter says there’s barely room in here

[Chorus]
No empty slots, no empty slots
I save the sparks, I save the stops
Every old adventure locked and shining bright
But where will the next one fit tonight?
No empty slots, the red bar climbs
I keep our yesterday in perfect lines
I love each little piece, but I’m learning what it costs
To keep a card with no empty slots

[Verse 2]
The mountain pass, the diner after rain
Your paper map with coffee on the fold
A voice note laughing through a midnight train
A thousand tiny things I can’t let go

[Pre-Chorus]
Every frame is precious, every name still clear
But the little meter says there’s barely room in here

[Chorus]
No empty slots, no empty slots
I save the sparks, I save the stops
Every old adventure locked and shining bright
But where will the next one fit tonight?
No empty slots, the red bar climbs
I keep our yesterday in perfect lines
I love each little piece, but I’m learning what it costs
To keep a card with no empty slots

[Bridge]
Maybe keeping you means letting something breathe
Not every moment needs a place beneath the screen
I’ll keep the ones that taught my heart to roam
And leave a little space to bring new stories home

[Final Chorus]
No empty slots? I’ll make one now
Set down the weight, remember how
Every old adventure still can live inside
While fresh roads open up before our eyes
No empty slots, then make some room
A blank can be a door, not a tomb
I love each little piece, and I can hold them all
Without saving every second that I saw

[Outro]
A little room, a road ahead
I carry what I love, not every thread

title: Aisle Seat to Infinity
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Boarding pass folded in my coat
Seat 18A, a paper boat
Clouds peel back like pages turning
Somewhere below, the rivers are burning
A kid counts fields through oval glass
A cart rolls by, the moments pass
I keep collecting borrowed views
And little lives I’ll never choose

[Pre-Chorus]
A hundred miles of almost-known
Each window frames a world alone

[Chorus]
Aisle seat to infinity, carry me through
Past a thousand little worlds I never knew
Kick, turn, stumble—then we’re airborne again
Strangers trading small goodbyes between the bends
Aisle seat to infinity, mile after mile
A whole life passing by in a half-second smile

[Verse 2]
A woman sleeps with her book held wide
Two paper cups sway side to side
A mountain flashes, then it’s gone
The cabin hums and the day moves on
Someone laughs at a message received
Someone watches the coastline recede
I’m traveling far, but what stays with me
Is the brief, bright ordinary

[Pre-Chorus]
A hundred miles of almost-known
Each window frames a world alone

[Chorus]
Aisle seat to infinity, carry me through
Past a thousand little worlds I never knew
Kick, turn, stumble—then we’re airborne again
Strangers trading small goodbyes between the bends
Aisle seat to infinity, mile after mile
A whole life passing by in a half-second smile

[Bridge]
No map can hold the passing faces
No clock can keep these borrowed places
A tiny wave, a shared refrain
Then clouds close up and we’re gone again

[Final Chorus]
Aisle seat to infinity, carry me through
Past a thousand little worlds I never knew
Kick, turn, stumble—then we’re airborne again
Strangers trading small goodbyes between the bends
Aisle seat to infinity, mile after mile
A whole life passing by in a half-second smile

[Outro]
Between the cart and the clouds above
I watch the world—and call it enough

title: One Pass, One Seat
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
At Gate 9, a younger me is waving through the glass
With a pilot's coat and silver wings, a future moving fast
Gate 12 has paint beneath my nails, a room above the sea
Gate 4 says, “Take the train tonight—come find the rest of me”

[Pre-Chorus]
Every screen says boarding soon
Every life calls out my name
I can’t stand in every doorway
I can’t leave the same

[Chorus]
One pass, one seat, one sky to cross
Pick a gate, accept the cost
Bass-line heart and drums that race
All these lives, one leaving place
Run, run—doors are closing now
Choose the why, forget the how
One pass, one seat, one sky to cross
I can’t live them all—I’m off

[Verse 2]
A little brass key hangs from Gate 3, a bakery at dawn
At Gate 15, a crowded stage keeps pulling the curtains on
A quiet house, a different name, a hand I almost held
Each window shows a whole new world I’ll never get to tell

[Pre-Chorus]
Every screen says boarding soon
Every life calls out my name
I can’t stand in every doorway
I can’t leave the same

[Chorus]
One pass, one seat, one sky to cross
Pick a gate, accept the cost
Bass-line heart and drums that race
All these lives, one leaving place
Run, run—doors are closing now
Choose the why, forget the how
One pass, one seat, one sky to cross
I can’t live them all—I’m off

[Bridge]
I press my thumb against the glass
The other selves don’t disappear
They turn away, they wave me on
The chosen road is waiting here

[Final Chorus]
One pass, one seat, one sky to cross
Pick a gate, accept the cost
Bass-line heart and drums that race
All these lives, one leaving place
Run, run—doors are closing now
Choose the why, forget the how
One pass, one seat, one sky to cross
I can’t live them all—I’m off

[Outro]
Gate lights dim behind my back
One pass in my hand
One life, and now it starts

title: A Living, Unfinished Face
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I sketched the face they said I ought to wear
Measured every angle, held my breath
Then scraped away the crooked little grin
And brushed a blankness over what was left

[Pre-Chorus]
Five notes circling the page
A staircase cut from dusk
I chased the cleanest outline
Till the colors turned to dust

[Chorus]
I paint myself, erase myself
Till no one knows the name
The truest lines were trembling there
Before I hid the flame
I paint myself, erase myself
A careful, empty frame

[Verse 2]
I took the ink-stained thumb, the crooked ear
The laugh that never landed on the beat
I covered every mark that made me mine
And called the pale result complete

[Bridge]
Leave one rough edge
Leave one wrong shade
The hand that shook
Was the hand that made

[Breakdown]
Five notes, one breath
A smudge I won't correct
Five notes, one breath
A face I can accept

[Final Chorus]
I paint myself, but keep the marks
That never fit the frame
The truest lines were trembling there
I won't erase their name
I paint myself, I let it show
A living, unfinished face

[Outro]
A living, unfinished face

title: Life Between the Cues
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned the room by the turn of a head
Kept every answer polished and ready
I wore a smile like a borrowed coat
And checked the seams whenever you spoke

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept asking, was that enough?
Made every quiet moment perform
Then the curtain shifted, the house went still
And I heard my own pulse under the din

[Chorus]
I forgot the audience could leave
Forgot I had a life beneath the scene
No more counting every face I please
I can miss a cue and still be me

[Verse 2]
There’s soup on the stove, a book by the sink
A Sunday afternoon I never let in
I called it selfish to want what I want
While saving my best laugh for someone else’s front row

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept asking, was that enough?
Made every quiet moment perform
Now the stage door’s open, the air tastes plain
I step outside and say my own name

[Chorus]
I forgot the audience could leave
Forgot I had a life beneath the scene
No more counting every face I please
I can miss a cue and still be me

[Bridge]
If you love me, let me be unfinished
Let me choose the song I hum alone
I am not a role that needs permission
I can take my ordinary hours home

[Final Chorus]
I forgot the audience could leave
Now I feel the day come back to me
No more counting every face I please
I can miss a cue and still be me

[Outro]
The room is empty
The kettle sings
I stay for the life
That happens between

title: Hollow Center
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They pinned my name beneath the glass
Another date, another brass-bright pass
You smiled and said, “You earned your place”
I learned to wear the frame like a face

[Pre-Chorus]
The room applauds, the curtains fall
I hear the quiet after all

[Chorus]
This trophy has a hollow center
A polished cup I can’t disappear in
I stack the proof where everyone can see
But nothing in it answers me
You say I’ve won, you say I’m enough
Why does the inside stay untouched?

[Verse 2]
The gold leaf flakes beside my bed
A list of names runs through my head
I count each finish, each new height
Then wake with nothing changed inside

[Pre-Chorus]
The room applauds, the curtains fall
I hear the quiet after all

[Chorus]
This trophy has a hollow center
A polished cup I can’t disappear in
I stack the proof where everyone can see
But nothing in it answers me
You say I’ve won, you say I’m enough
Why does the inside stay untouched?

[Bridge]
Maybe worth is not a score
Not the keys to one more door
If I set the shining weight down here
Will you meet me as I am, not what I’ve cleared?

[Final Chorus]
This trophy has a hollow center
A polished cup I can’t disappear in
I stack the proof where everyone can see
But you sit close and answer me
No final prize, no perfect climb
Just your hand finding mine

[Outro]
The room goes still, the medals rest
You ask what’s left when I’m not best
I let the silence have its say
And leave the empty cup away

title: The Narrow Balance
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I set the brass pan on the kitchen scale
One side holds the promise I meant to keep
The other takes the names I let go pale
And every little weight runs twice as deep

[Pre-Chorus]
I count the calls I made, the ones I missed
A careful hand can still leave fingerprints

[Chorus]
If I leaned toward good, does that count for something?
If I failed again, does the trying weigh less?
I keep setting my heart on the narrow balance
While the needle trembles under every guess

[Verse 2]
At dawn I find the ledger by the sink
Beside a chipped blue cup and yesterday’s bread
I write down what I did before I think
Then cross out every mercy that I said

[Pre-Chorus]
You tell me worth is not a perfect sum
But I still wait to see which side will come

[Chorus]
If I leaned toward good, does that count for something?
If I failed again, does the trying weigh less?
I keep setting my heart on the narrow balance
While the needle trembles under every guess

[Bridge]
Maybe the scale was never built for grace
Maybe the hand that lifts it leaves a mark
You can watch me choose the harder kindness
Even when the answer stays in the dark

[Final Chorus]
If I leaned toward good, let that count for something
If I failed again, let me try once more
I’ll keep setting my heart beside the balance
Not to prove I’m pure, but to choose what’s for

[Outro]
The brass pan swings, then settles into place
I leave the ledger open by the sink

title: The Parliament of One
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Desire takes the chair by the window
Says, “Open the door, let the whole world in”
Duty lays a ledger on the table
Love keeps turning every page back again
Pride clears its throat, demands the final word
And every voice has learned to sound like law
I sit beneath their portraits in the hallway
Holding the life they’re voting on

[Pre-Chorus]
Hands go up around the chamber
Names are called, the tally’s read
I can hear them choose my future
I’m the only one who isn’t heard

[Chorus]
The parliament of one convenes inside my head
Desire, duty, love, and pride decide instead
They draw the lines, they raise the walls, they call the motion through
But I’m the one who wakes tomorrow
Living with what they choose

[Verse 2]
Desire wants the bright road past the harbor
Duty says the bridge is mine to mend
Love asks who will still be there beside me
Pride says never let them see you bend
They trade my hours like a stack of paper
They spend my yes before I know the cost
Then morning finds me at the open doorway
Counting what was chosen, what was lost

[Pre-Chorus]
Hands go up around the chamber
Names are called, the tally’s read
I can hear them choose my future
I’m the only one who isn’t heard

[Chorus]
The parliament of one convenes inside my head
Desire, duty, love, and pride decide instead
They draw the lines, they raise the walls, they call the motion through
But I’m the one who wakes tomorrow
Living with what they choose

[Bridge]
Let the record show: I was here
With my own pulse beneath the noise
Let the record show: the cost was mine
Though I never cast a choice
I won’t silence every counsel
I won’t burn the chamber down
I will take the chair among them
And make my vote count now

[Final Chorus]
The parliament of one convenes inside my head
Desire, duty, love, and pride can speak—but not decide instead
They draw their lines; I hear them all; I choose what carries through
I’m the one who wakes tomorrow
And I will choose what I live through

[Outro]
One chair pulled close
One hand raised
The life is mine
The vote is mine

title: Two Norths
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
One needle favors the laugh in your chest
One keeps a promise you made when you were rested
Both turn beneath the glass, neither settles down
You take one step, and the map turns round

[Pre-Chorus]
You can’t pin a heart to a single degree
The hand keeps asking who you want to be

[Chorus]
Two norths in the compass, turning in my hand
One toward the joy I can’t command
One toward the good I said I’d stand for
Both keep moving, both ask for more
Two norths in the compass, no final line
I choose, then choose again in time

[Verse 2]
The old brass case warms against your palm
A good road bends; a bright road calls
You weigh the cost, then hear both names
No needle breaks, no needle stays

[Pre-Chorus]
You can’t pin a heart to a single degree
The hand keeps asking who you want to be

[Chorus]
Two norths in the compass, turning in my hand
One toward the joy I can’t command
One toward the good I said I’d stand for
Both keep moving, both ask for more
Two norths in the compass, no final line
I choose, then choose again in time

[Bridge]
If I follow pleasure, what do I leave?
If I follow duty, what do I grieve?
The needle trembles; the choice is still mine
I walk between them, one step at a time

[Final Chorus]
Two norths in the compass, turning in my hand
One toward the joy I can’t command
One toward the good I said I’d stand for
Both keep moving, both ask for more
Two norths in the compass, no final line
I choose, then choose again in time

[Outro]
Both keep moving
I keep choosing

title: The Program in My Hand
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned the bows before I learned your name
Counted every face that turned my way
The house lights rose; I held my practiced grin
Then walked alone through the side door again

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept the program folded in my coat
A list of rooms where strangers learned my name

[Chorus]
The clapping fills the room, then disappears
I turn to tell you, but you’re not here
A thousand hands can crown a borrowed name
Still, no one’s waiting when I leave the stage

[Verse 2]
