[Pre-Chorus]
I turn the dial to find a place to stand
But every voice keeps reaching for my hand

[Chorus]
Every station sings through me
Every color, every key
I can hear the whole world calling
Till my own note disappears
Turn it down, let silence find me
Let one true sound come clear
Every station sings through me
I’m still here, I’m still here

[Verse 2]
Your laugh comes in like summer from a passing car
Her sorrow holds a compass, points me where you are
I keep the scraps of songs in jars beside the sink
And lose the little melody I meant to sing

[Pre-Chorus]
The dial spins faster than my hands can move
I know the words, but not the way they’re mine

[Chorus]
Every station sings through me
Every color, every key
I can hear the whole world calling
Till my own note disappears
Turn it down, let silence find me
Let one true sound come clear
Every station sings through me
I’m still here, I’m still here

[Bridge]
One voice, one breath
A room with nothing left to prove
One voice, one breath
A small clear note I choose

[Final Chorus]
Every station sings through me
Every color, every key
I can hear the whole world calling
Now I let it pass through me
Turn it down, let silence find me
Let one true sound come clear
Every station sings around me
I’m still here, I’m still here

[Outro]
The dial rests beneath my hand
A quiet song begins again

title: Another Chair
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I set the table for two
Then three more came through
A laugh, a name, a ring
A hand on the edge of everything

A plate for the old friend
A cup for the new one
I kept pulling up wood
Like my heart had room for everyone

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the corners are crowded
And the edges lean in
I look at the places
Where the silence used to sit

[Chorus]
Another chair, another chair
I pull one up, I pull one up
Another chair, another chair
I want to give enough

Another chair, another chair
Tell me where my hands should go
Another chair, another chair
When all these hearts say home

[Verse 2]
You tell me your hard days
I tell you mine too
And each new story
Adds a little more weight to the room

I love how it grows
I love what it means
But some nights I count the faces
And I lose sight of me

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the corners are crowded
And the edges lean in
I look at the places
Where the silence used to sit

[Chorus]
Another chair, another chair
I pull one up, I pull one up
Another chair, another chair
I want to give enough

Another chair, another chair
Tell me where my hands should go
Another chair, another chair
When all these hearts say home

[Bridge]
If I miss your eyes
If I answer late
If I grow too tired
Please don't call it fate

I’m learning the table
Can bend under care
Love keeps bringing company
And I keep making room there

[Final Chorus]
Another chair, another chair
I pull one up, I pull one up
Another chair, another chair
I want to give enough

Another chair, another chair
Take my hand and stay with me
Another chair, another chair
We can share the ache and the tea

title: Every Station
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep a hand on the dial
Like maybe your love is there
You catch a laugh from the hallway
A prayer in the static air

You take in everyone softly
Their colors, their little burns
And while you tune into them
Your own voice fades in the turns

[Pre-Chorus]
Too many signals in the room
Too many hearts out loud
You hear them all so clearly
You get lost inside the crowd

[Chorus]
Every station, every station
You hear them shine
Every station, every station
But you go blind
I want your signal
I want your song
Turn back to you
Where you belong

Every station, every station
Let the noise fall away
Every station, every station
I want your day

[Verse 2]
You know the shape of their heartbreak
The crack in a smiling face
You make a home for their fallout
Then leave your own side blank space

But I can hear what you hide from
The tremble under your calm
There’s a whole small storm inside you
Still waiting for your palm

[Pre-Chorus]
Too many signals in the room
Too many names in flight
You don’t have to catch them all
To make your heart sound right

[Chorus]
Every station, every station
You hear them shine
Every station, every station
But you go blind
I want your signal
I want your song
Turn back to you
Where you belong

Every station, every station
Let the noise fall away
Every station, every station
I want your day

[Bridge]
Let the others pass through
Let their voices blur
You don’t owe the whole world
Your attention, every word

If your hand starts shaking
I’ll sit with you awhile
We can find your frequency
One slow mile by mile

[Final Chorus]
Every station, every station
You hear them shine
Every station, every station
But you go blind
I want your signal
I want your song
Turn back to you
Where you belong

Every station, every station
Let the noise fall away
Every station, every station
Come back today

title: Wait By The Rows
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You planted your laugh in the late thaw mud
I kept the gate while the cold held on
One branch gave fruit in the middle of frost
One held its breath with the green still gone

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to call it leaving
When a root went deep and quiet
Now I know the earth is working
Even when I cannot find it

[Chorus]
You bloom when you bloom, I’ll wait by the rows
Some hearts take the rain, some need the snow
No clock for the garden, no debt to repay
I love you in winter, I love you in May
Different seasons, one ground beneath us
Different seasons, still reaching through dust

[Verse 2]
You came back laughing with pears in your coat
She sent one green leaf through a crack in the stone
I learned not to tug at the sleeping vine
Or measure your spring by the spring of my own

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to call it leaving
When a root went deep and quiet
Now I know the earth is working
Even when I cannot find it

[Chorus]
You bloom when you bloom, I’ll wait by the rows
Some hearts take the rain, some need the snow
No clock for the garden, no debt to repay
I love you in winter, I love you in May
Different seasons, one ground beneath us
Different seasons, still reaching through dust

[Bridge]
If your branches are bare, you can rest here
If your petals fall, I’ll keep the place
Nothing living owes me a timetable
Nothing true arrives at the same pace

[Final Chorus]
You bloom when you bloom, I’ll wait by the rows
Some hearts take the rain, some need the snow
No clock for the garden, no debt to repay
I love you in winter, I love you in May
Different seasons, one ground beneath us
Different seasons, still reaching through dust

[Outro]
I’ll leave the gate unlatched
Till your season comes

title: Every Heart I Love
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You were the first light over the harbor wall
I learned your name before I knew the stars
Then came the ones who stayed through every fall
Each hand a compass, each laugh a spark

[Pre-Chorus]
No border holds the shape we make
No printed line can say what we became

[Chorus]
Every heart I love becomes a star
A constellation no map can chart
Drawn together by the roads we crossed
A sky made whole from all we are
Every heart I love becomes a star

[Verse 2]
Your old blue scarf still hangs beside the door
A note from you is tucked inside my book
The miles between us matter less and less
I find your pattern everywhere I look

[Pre-Chorus]
No border holds the shape we make
No printed line can say what we became

[Chorus]
Every heart I love becomes a star
A constellation no map can chart
Drawn together by the roads we crossed
A sky made whole from all we are
Every heart I love becomes a star

[Bridge]
Some shine near, some burn far away
Still their light arrives and knows my name
I won’t ask the heavens where we belong
We make our own shape by carrying on

[Final Chorus]
Every heart I love becomes a star
A constellation no map can chart
Drawn together by the roads we crossed
A sky made whole from all we are
Every heart I love becomes a star

[Outro]
A sky made whole from all we are

title: A Sky Without Borders
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You left your coat on the kitchen chair
Your laugh still turns up in the things I wear
A friend from the coast, my brother from home
Each one a compass that points where I roam

[Pre-Chorus]
No border can tell me where we belong
I trace your names and the lines turn to song

[Chorus]
Every heart I hold becomes a star
You are the pattern, wherever you are
No map could draw the way we connect
A sky made of all the loves I protect
Every heart I hold becomes a star

[Verse 2]
Your note in my book, that call on the train
The quiet old promise that steadied my name
Some crossed an ocean, some stayed down the street
Still every road finds the same constellation in me

[Pre-Chorus]
No border can tell me where we belong
I trace your names and the lines turn to song

[Chorus]
Every heart I hold becomes a star
You are the pattern, wherever you are
No map could draw the way we connect
A sky made of all the loves I protect
Every heart I hold becomes a star

[Bridge]
If distance draws a river through the night
Your voice still finds me, clear and bright
Not one of us is lost or alone
We make a wider sky than any known

[Final Chorus]
Every heart I hold becomes a star
You are the pattern, wherever you are
No map could draw the way we connect
A sky made of all the loves I protect
Every heart I hold becomes a star

[Outro]
A sky without borders, a home made of hearts

title: A Room With My Name
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I drew you a room with a window of blue
A shelf for your letters, a chair just for you
Then someone came knocking with rain in their hair
I opened the hallway and made them a stair

[Pre-Chorus]
Every wall learns a name
Every door takes a frame
I keep adding on
Till the map is gone

[Chorus]
This house has infinite rooms
One for the lost, one for the returning
I keep a place for you
While my own door stays unturned
So many keys in my hand
So many beds made warm
This house has infinite rooms
But where do I sleep when the guests are gone?

[Verse 2]
I built you a kitchen that smelled like your June
A quiet back room where you could outgrow the moon
I tucked all your worries beneath painted stairs
And called every corner a proof that I cared

[Pre-Chorus]
Every wall learns a name
Every door takes a frame
I keep adding on
Till the map is gone

[Chorus]
This house has infinite rooms
One for the lost, one for the returning
I keep a place for you
While my own door stays unturned
So many keys in my hand
So many beds made warm
This house has infinite rooms
But where do I sleep when the guests are gone?

[Bridge]
I found a small room behind the blue hall
No photograph hung there, no hook on the wall
I sat on the floor and let nobody in
The quiet felt strange, then it started to fit

[Final Chorus]
This house has infinite rooms
One for the lost, one for the returning
I’ll keep a place for you
And turn my own key in the morning
So many keys in my hand
One door I can call my own
This house has infinite rooms
And I’m learning to come home

[Outro]
A room with my name
A room with my name

title: I Built You a Room
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I framed a little room for you
With blue tile saved from the kitchen floor
A lamp that leans, a shelf of books
A key that fits your hand and nothing more

[Pre-Chorus]
Then someone came in out of weather
I moved the chairs and made more space
The hallway learned another doorway
The house kept changing shape

[Chorus]
I build you a room, I build you a room
With a window cut to fit your view
Every heart I carry gets a place to bloom
But I keep walking past the room I meant for me
I build you a room, I build you a room
And the walls keep growing, warm and wide
If I leave one door unlocked for me
Will I know which one is mine?

[Verse 2]
Your coat hangs by the stairwell now
Your laughter gathers in the dining room
I know the creak beneath your step
The quiet corners where you come to lose the gloom

[Pre-Chorus]
I draw a line around a small patch
Then hear your name beyond the wall
I make the opening a little wider
And lose my place again in it all

[Chorus]
I build you a room, I build you a room
With a window cut to fit your view
Every heart I carry gets a place to bloom
But I keep walking past the room I meant for me
I build you a room, I build you a room
And the walls keep growing, warm and wide
If I leave one door unlocked for me
Will I know which one is mine?

[Bridge]
Maybe mine is not a room with a lock
Maybe mine is the pause before I answer
A square of floor with nothing on it
A breath that doesn’t have to hold another

[Final Chorus]
I built you a room, I built you a room
Now I’m setting down the keys awhile
Every heart I carry has a place to bloom
And I’ll stay here long enough to feel my own
I built you a room, I built you a room
There is space beneath the open sky
I leave one door unlocked for me
And step inside

[Outro]
The house can wait
I’m home inside

title: Vanish Inside
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your hand found mine beneath the sheets
A little warmth, a second beat
Then every nerve began to ring
As if my body learned your name

[Pre-Chorus]
Your pulse ran wild beneath my skin
My breath came back from deep within
We laughed, then felt the seam give way
And held on harder anyway

[Chorus]
Come closer, closer—where do I end?
Your heart in my chest, my ache in your hands
We open, we alter, we pull apart
Two names still beating in one body’s heart
If love is the door, if love is the tide
Do we become one—or vanish inside?

[Verse 2]
Your fingers traced a borrowed bone
I felt your fear as if my own
When morning split our joined-up shape
The empty halves could barely wake

[Pre-Chorus]
Each time we meet, the borders thin
Each time we part, we lose our skin
You ask me what I’m willing to be
I ask what remains of you and me

[Chorus]
Come closer, closer—where do I end?
Your heart in my chest, my ache in your hands
We open, we alter, we pull apart
Two names still beating in one body’s heart
If love is the door, if love is the tide
Do we become one—or vanish inside?

[Bridge]
Say my name while there are two
I’ll say yours and answer too
If we cross the final line
Will your life still answer mine?
Hold me here, but leave a space
For the shape of my own face

[Final Chorus]
Come closer, closer—where do I end?
Your heart in my chest, my ache in your hands
We open, we alter, we pull apart
Two names still beating in one body’s heart
If love is the door, if love is the tide
Choose me as yours—but let me survive

[Outro]
Your hand in mine, the seam held wide
Two breaths, two names, one changing tide

title: The Seam Still Tender
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your hand found mine beside the bedroom door
A seam of warmth ran underneath my skin
My heartbeat stumbled, then I felt yours answer
Two separate maps beginning to wear thin

[Pre-Chorus]
Your grief came through my ribs like weather
My joy was suddenly in your mouth
We pulled apart; the tender places opened
And neither of us knew how to back out

[Chorus]
If I let you in until there’s no dividing line
Will we be one bright body, or will yours erase mine?
Every part of me remembers every part of you
I want the whole of us—and fear what whole can do
Hold me close, but leave a little room to breathe
Tell me love can join us without making one of me

[Verse 2]
Your pulse kept time beneath my collarbone
My nerves lit up with every hurt you hid
I tasted salt before your eyes were spilling
And knew the ache before you said it did

[Pre-Chorus]
We found the edges thinning in the morning
A borrowed hand, a borrowed breath, a name
Each time we separate, the tearing lingers
Each time we meet, we come back less the same

[Chorus]
If I let you in until there’s no dividing line
Will we be one bright body, or will yours erase mine?
Every part of me remembers every part of you
I want the whole of us—and fear what whole can do
Hold me close, but leave a little room to breathe
Tell me love can join us without making one of me

[Bridge]
There is a door inside this wanting
There is a self I cannot lend
If we dissolve the space between us
Will we still know where you begin?

[Final Chorus]
If I let you in until there’s no dividing line
Will we be one bright body, or will yours erase mine?
Every part of me remembers every part of you
I want the whole of us—and fear what whole can do
Stay with me, and let the border softly bend
Love me without asking either life to end

[Outro]
Your hand in mine, the seam still tender
Two names, still spoken, still our own

title: The End of the Page
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There’s a mug by the sink with a ring of tea
A red-tab envelope staring back at me
Two calls I meant to make, one shirt on the chair
And a little list growing legs everywhere

[Pre-Chorus]
I cross one thing off, three more appear
The day folds up, but the work stays here

[Chorus]
Will I ever reach the end of the page?
Set down the pen, let the room be still
Will I ever get everything done
And feel, for once, that I’ve done enough?
The boxes keep multiplying
While the evening slips out of my hands
Will I ever get everything done
Or is “enough” a place I only imagine?

[Verse 2]
The laundry’s a mountain in yesterday’s blue
The plant by the window needs water too
I answered one message, forgot what I’d read
Now tomorrow is tapping its list in my head

[Pre-Chorus]
I make a neat plan, then the plan comes undone
The clock takes a bow as the daylight is gone

[Chorus]
Will I ever reach the end of the page?
Set down the pen, let the room be still
Will I ever get everything done
And feel, for once, that I’ve done enough?
The boxes keep multiplying
While the evening slips out of my hands
Will I ever get everything done
Or is “enough” a place I only imagine?

[Bridge]
Maybe the last task is not on the list
Maybe it’s letting one small thing exist
Unfinished, unfiled, not asking me why
While I sit by the window and watch the clouds slide

[Final Chorus]
I may never reach the end of the page
But I can set down the pen for a while
I may never get everything done
Still, I am here, and the day is done
Let the boxes keep multiplying
I don’t have to answer them all tonight
I may never get everything done
But maybe enough is this breath, this life

[Outro]
The mug can wait by the sink till the morning
The list can rest where I left it
The room is still
And I am here

title: Paper Mountain
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The list is breathing under my door
Ink leaking out on the hardwood floor
Ten thousand boxes waiting for a check
I wear the deadlines like a heavy wrecking chain
Sunrise is breaking, I haven't slept
Counting the promises I never kept

[Chorus]
Will the horizon ever stand still?
Will I climb every imaginary hill?
Or am I running on a treadmill of stone
Building a kingdom where I'm all alone?
Tell me the threshold where the striving is done
And I can rest underneath a quiet sun

[Verse 2]
Check off the margin, add three more lines
Chasing the ghosts of the old designs
My hands are shaking, the coffee is cold
Trading my youth for a story untold
If I reach the bottom, what will I find?
Just another paper mountain left behind

[Chorus]
Will the horizon ever stand still?
Will I climb every imaginary hill?
Or am I running on a treadmill of stone
Building a kingdom where I'm all alone?
Tell me the threshold where the striving is done
And I can rest underneath a quiet sun

[Bridge]
(Vocoder choir)
Is it finished? Is it finished?
Did the mountain disappear?
(Belting)
Every time I clear the table
Another task appears!

[Chorus]
Will the horizon ever stand still?
Will I climb every imaginary hill?
Or am I running on a treadmill of stone
Building a kingdom where I'm all alone?
Tell me the threshold where the striving is done
And I can rest underneath a quiet sun

[Outro]
Just one more thing...
Just one more line...
(Whispering)
Is it ever... done?
[Instrumental fade out]

title: The Page Can Wait
genres: forward solo male lead soaring in an emotionally urgent delivery; four-on-the-floor pulse; polished punchy mix that opens lean in the verse
then widens into a high-lift chorus and rising final refrain; bright driving synth chords
melodic bass guitar anchoring the low end.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I made a list on the back of a receipt
Crossed out the calls, then the sink started to leak
The laundry’s folded, but the floor needs sweeping
I shut the door and hear tomorrow speaking

[Pre-Chorus]
Every little finish opens up a new beginning
How do I know when I can stop?

[Chorus]
Will I ever get it all done?
Will the last small task give way to the sun?
I keep reaching for the moment when the running is through
But the list keeps growing while I’m getting to you
Will I ever get it all done?

[Verse 2]
There’s a form on the table, a light left on
A message I’ve been meaning to answer all week long
I tell myself, just one more thing, then I’ll rest
But the next thing’s waiting in the corner of my desk

[Pre-Chorus]
Every little finish opens up a new beginning
How do I know when I can stop?

[Chorus]
Will I ever get it all done?
Will the last small task give way to the sun?
I keep reaching for the moment when the running is through
But the list keeps growing while I’m getting to you
Will I ever get it all done?

[Bridge]
Maybe done is not a place I arrive at
Maybe it’s a breath in the middle of the day
A cup left warm, your hand in mine
A little unfinished, and still we’re okay

[Final Chorus]
Will I ever get it all done?
Maybe not, but I can still choose someone
Let the last small task wait while I’m here with you
There’s a life in the spaces the list can’t get through
Will I ever get it all done?
Maybe this moment can be enough

[Outro]
The page can wait till morning
I’m here, and that is something

title: I Let the Hard Parts Soften
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The kettle clicks beside the sink
A patch of morning crosses the floor
I used to count the things I lacked
Now I can name what’s here and more
The coat you left across the chair
The lemon tree that made it through
A little room, a little time
A hand that reaches out to you

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t need the road I missed
To prove this road is real
I can let the old wish rest
And keep the good I feel

[Chorus]
This is the life I’ve got
These are the days I’m living
A table, a door, a heart that’s still willing
I take it as it comes
I let the hard parts soften
Nothing to win, nowhere I have to be
I’m here, and here is enough for me

[Verse 2]
The bus runs late; we laugh and wait
Rain gathers silver on your sleeve
The bills are stacked beside the fruit
Still, there’s a song we both believe
Some plans dissolved like chalk in rain
Some seeds came up where none were sown
I’m done demanding every turn
Should lead me somewhere grander than home

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t need a perfect past
To bless the ground I stand
I can meet the day I have
With open, ordinary hands

[Chorus]
This is the life I’ve got
These are the days I’m living
A table, a door, a heart that’s still willing
I take it as it comes
I let the hard parts soften
Nothing to win, nowhere I have to be
I’m here, and here is enough for me

[Bridge]
For every door that didn’t open
For every name I couldn’t keep
I lay the wanting down beside me
And let it finally go to sleep
Not every answer needs a reason
Not every ending needs a sign
I can be grateful without pretending
That every mile was kind

[Final Chorus]
This is the life I’ve got
These are the days I’m living
A table, a door, a heart that’s still willing
I take it as it comes
I let the hard parts soften
Nothing to win, nowhere I have to be
I’m here, and here is enough for me

[Outro]
The kettle cools beside the sink
The evening settles, plain and sweet
I have this life, I hold it gently
And let it be

title: Home Inside My Hands
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to count the doors I couldn’t open
Keep a list of all the roads I’d take
Now the kettle clicks, the morning settles
And I let the day arrive its own way

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t have to name the whole horizon
I can meet this hour where it is

[Chorus]
This is the life I got, and I can hold it
Not a perfect map, but a place to stand
I can love the small and ordinary
I can make a home inside my hands
No more asking what I should have been
I’m here, I’m breathing, I’m enough again

[Verse 2]
There’s a chipped blue cup beside the window
Your old coat still hangs behind the door
I used to think that peace meant leaving
Now I know it’s what I’m here for

[Pre-Chorus]
I don’t have to turn the past to treasure
I can let it be, and still move on

[Chorus]
This is the life I got, and I can hold it
Not a perfect map, but a place to stand
I can love the small and ordinary
I can make a home inside my hands
No more asking what I should have been
I’m here, I’m breathing, I’m enough again

[Bridge]
If the road bends, let it bend
If the answer takes its time
I can set the table, open up the curtains
And begin with what is mine

[Final Chorus]
This is the life I got, and I can hold it
Every imperfect mile has brought me here
I can love the small and ordinary
I can meet the day without a fear
No more asking what I should have been
I’m here, I’m breathing, I’m enough again

[Outro]
I’m here, I’m breathing
I’m enough again

title: Every Love Grows Roots
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I loved you and a root took hold
A red thread buried under bone
It learned your name, it learned your shape
And pushed its knuckles through my veins

[Pre-Chorus]
Small green fingers under my skin
I hid the wounds and let you in
You drank the warmth I couldn’t save
I called it shelter, called it brave

[Chorus]
Every love grows roots in me
Through the heart and arteries
They break the skin to reach your hands
And feed you from where I still stand
If you pull away, they tear
At the lungs, the gut, the tender prayer
Do I let you go, let the red run free
Or bleed myself dry so you’ll stay with me?

[Verse 2]
Your chair went quiet by the door
The roots kept reaching, wanting more
They hooked beneath my ribs and strained
As if my body could make you remain

[Pre-Chorus]
I held the thread until it snapped
My hands came back in thorn and sap
You never asked for all this blood
I gave it anyway, called it love

[Chorus]
Every love grows roots in me
Through the heart and arteries
They break the skin to reach your hands
And feed you from where I still stand
If you pull away, they tear
At the lungs, the gut, the tender prayer
Do I let you go, let the red run free
Or bleed myself dry so you’ll stay with me?

[Bridge]
I can cut the roots
I can keep the wound
I can close my fists
And still feel you move
Let the branches ache
Let the blood run slow
Love is not a leash
I can loosen, let you go

[Final Chorus]
Every love grew roots in me
Some still drink; some set me free
They broke the skin to find your hands
Now I can loosen where I stand
If you pull away, I’ll bear
The tearing without calling it a prayer
I will let you go, though the red runs free
And keep enough of myself to breathe

[Outro]
Under the scar, the roots still turn
Some things live on; some things must burn

title: Come Apart With Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your mouth found mine beside the kitchen sink
A bright, sweet spark before I had time to think
By morning, your small laugh lived under my tongue
And my pulse kept the rhythm of the songs you’d sung

[Pre-Chorus]
We called it a fever, we called it a dare
Then your heartbeat answered from somewhere in there

[Chorus]
Kiss me till the old parts loosen
Till my heart forgets its own name
Your blood is learning my seasons
My lungs are breathing your flame
It hurts where the borders are breaking
It’s joy with a tooth in the seam
I love you past what I was made of
Come closer—come apart with me

[Verse 2]
Your left hand woke with a scar like mine
My ribs made room for a second spine
The doctor said, “Your bodies don’t agree”
But your borrowed breath kept reaching for me

[Pre-Chorus]
My heart throws a fit when it hears your name
Your heart does the same, and we call it a flame

[Chorus]
Kiss me till the old parts loosen
Till my heart forgets its own name
Your blood is learning my seasons
My lungs are breathing your flame
It hurts where the borders are breaking
It’s joy with a tooth in the seam
I love you past what I was made of
Come closer—come apart with me

[Bridge]
I spit out a tooth; you catch it and grin
You say, “That one was yours when we both came in”
Now your pulse is the drum in my wrist
And my eyes see the world through the shape of your kiss
If our bodies refuse what our hearts have begun
Let them fight till there’s only one beating as one

[Final Chorus]
Kiss me till the old parts loosen
Till our hearts forget their own names
Your blood is rewriting my seasons
My lungs are breathing your flame
It hurts where the borders are breaking
Still I reach through the fever and seam
I love you past what I was made of
Come closer—come apart with me

[Outro]
Come closer—come apart with me
One pulse, two names, and nowhere to be

title: Voice in the Blood
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You slipped beneath the skin of my wrist
A small red thought I couldn’t resist
Now every pulse carries your name
A tender fever I can’t contain

[Pre-Chorus]
You say, “I’m here,” where the vessels divide
A sweet little truth with nowhere to hide

[Chorus]
You live in my blood, you answer each beat
You love me from places I’ll never reach
I want you close, I want you gone
You keep me warm while you wear me down

[Verse 2]
You ride the current behind my eyes
You turn my hunger to your replies
I press my hand to the hollow of my chest
You count the seconds I try to rest

[Pre-Chorus]
Your voice runs deep; I can’t make it cease
Your hand in my heart, your mouth in my sleep

[Chorus]
You live in my blood, you answer each beat
You love me from places I’ll never reach
I want you close, I want you gone
You keep me warm while you wear me down

[Bridge]
If I could drain you, would I miss the sound?
Would this body be mine when you’re not around?
I curse the red river, then beg it to stay
Your soft little “darling” keeps pulling me away

[Final Chorus]
You live in my blood, you answer each beat
Your love is a wound that won’t let me leave
I want you close, I want you gone
You keep me warm while you wear me down

[Outro]
One last pulse, and you’re still there
A voice in the blood, a love I wear

title: The Hunger Wears My Face
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found you in the bathroom glass
With my same split lip, my same tired eyes
You leaned toward the door before I moved
And asked the empty room to let you inside

[Pre-Chorus]
You wear my face like a borrowed coat
You learned my hands, you learned my name
I want your warmth; you want it faster
You run ahead and take the blame

[Chorus]
The hunger wears my face
It reaches where I cannot go
It begs you for a place to stay
While I’m still learning how to ask you slow
I love the mouth that calls you mine
I hate the teeth beneath the plea
Come close, come close—then hold me back
From the thing that learned to look like me

[Verse 2]
At dinner, you sat in my chair
Smiled with my dimples, swallowed your words
You touched their sleeve; I felt the touch
A tender little theft nobody heard

[Pre-Chorus]
You bring home scraps of being wanted
A kind reply, a hand held still
Then press them deep beneath my ribs
And tell me love is something to fill

[Chorus]
The hunger wears my face
It reaches where I cannot go
It begs you for a place to stay
While I’m still learning how to ask you slow
I love the mouth that calls you mine
I hate the teeth beneath the plea
Come close, come close—then hold me back
From the thing that learned to look like me

[Bridge]
If you kiss me, kiss the wound awake
If you leave, don’t feed the shape I make
I can feel it pacing in my skin
I can hear it practice saying, “Let me in”

[Breakdown]
Not my hands
Not my voice
Not my choice
Still it reaches
Still it reaches

[Final Chorus]
The hunger wears my face
But it is not the whole of me
I’ll let you see the shaking hands
And ask for love without its teeth
I love you fierce; I love you hurt
I won’t make you the cure I need
Stay if you can, and if you can’t
I’ll call myself back piece by piece

[Outro]
In the mirror, I hold my ground
It mouths your name; I turn around

title: Love Me in Pieces
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held your hand out, I gave you a thumb
A small red promise, warm from the drum
You said, “It’s nothing,” and kissed where it bled
I smiled like a saint with a storm in my head

[Pre-Chorus]
Every vow has a price at the seam
Every touch takes a thread from the dream

[Chorus]
Take what you need, I can bear the pain
Love me in pieces, call it by name
I gave you my hands, then the skin from my chest
Now I’m all open doors and an unquiet nest

[Verse 2]
You kept my laugh in a jar by the bed
My sharp little anger, the words I never said
I kept your coat when the winter was gone
And wore it like proof I could still carry on

[Pre-Chorus]
Every goodbye leaves a mark in the grain
Every return asks me over again

[Chorus]
Take what you need, I can bear the pain
Love me in pieces, call it by name
I gave you my hands, then the skin from my chest
Now I’m all open doors and an unquiet nest

[Bridge]
Who am I, when the giving is done?
A shape made of holes where the warmth used to run
Still, when you reach, I lean into you
Though I know what the reaching will do

[Final Chorus]
Take what you need, but look at my face
Joy and hurt braided tight in one place
I gave you my hands, and I gave you my breath
You left me the parts you could not take yet

[Outro]
If nothing is mine, let this be true:
I chose every piece I gave to you

title: Same Blood, Same Bruise
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Stuttering electronic glitches, low sludge metal bass drone)
Two beats, one stream.
Can you feel it?
Our pressure's rising.

[Verse]
I cut my wrist and you began to bleed
An intimate infection, a desperate, parasitic need
We bypassed the vessels, we soldered the vein
A shared circulation to manage the pain
Your right atrium, my left ventricle wall
Two independent engines driving one collapse and fall
The pulse is erratic, IDM glitches in the flow
If you pull away now, the oxygen levels go low

[Chorus]
We share the same blood, we share the same bruise!
If we cut the connection, we both of us lose!
Your heart beats in shadow, mine screams in the light
One collective body fading into the night!
(Heavy sludge guitars crashing, grime-tempo syncopation)

[Verse 2]
Now I taste your adrenaline before you even speak
Your panic in my capillaries making me weak
An aggressive filtration, our kidneys aligned
A physical devotion, horribly designed
I feel your fever creeping up my spine
Your sickness is yours, but the poison is mine
Two separate minds, one systemic choke
Bound by a crimson thread that never can be broke!

[Bridge]
(Tempo slows, heavy melodic sludge rock atmosphere)
Screaming through the valves.
Pumping through the dark.
We are one machine.
Without a spark.
If you stop... I stop.

[Chorus]
We share the same blood, we share the same bruise!
If we cut the connection, we both of us lose!
Your heart beats in shadow, mine screams in the light
One collective body fading into the night!

[Outro]
One system.
One pulse.
We can't survive... apart.
(Glitched heartbeat sound fading into heavy guitar noise)

title: One River Under the Skin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You let me hear the small clock under your ribs
I laid my ear there; mine answered from within
A fine red seam crossed the bedsheets by dawn
One pulse went north, one pulse carried on
Your blood found my hands like it knew the way
My blood learned your name and refused to stray

[Pre-Chorus]
We laughed when the monitor counted us wrong
Two separate heartbeats, one current strong
Then the surgeon said, “There’s no clean divide”
And I felt your fear move alive inside mine

[Chorus]
We share one river under the skin
Two hearts still racing, both pulling us in
Hold me together; I’m terrified, glad
The sweetest ache is the life that we have
If they draw the line, if they pull us apart
The blood goes quiet in both of our hearts

[Verse 2]
You steal the warm blanket; I steal it back
We bicker at breakfast, then share the same glass
Your fingers go cold when my fever climbs
I taste your salt before you say you’re not fine
Some nights I resent every borrowed breath
Then you squeeze my hand, and I choose it again

[Pre-Chorus]
No neat little answer, no painless repair
Just your pulse in my wrist and my pulse in your care
We know what it costs; we know what we chose
A knot made of vessels that nobody knows

[Chorus]
We share one river under the skin
Two hearts still racing, both pulling us in
Hold me together; I’m terrified, glad
The sweetest ache is the life that we have
If they draw the line, if they pull us apart
The blood goes quiet in both of our hearts

[Bridge]
When your heart runs ahead, mine answers late
When mine stumbles, yours keeps the gate
I hate how the tether can hurt when it pulls
I love how your hand finds mine through it all
No saint, no cure, no clean way through
Just this strange red promise: I live with you

[Final Chorus]
We share one river under the skin
Two hearts still racing, still pulling us in
Hold me together; I’m terrified, glad
The hardest, kindest life I ever had
If they draw the line, if they pull us apart
The blood goes quiet in both of our hearts
So stay through the shaking, stay through the scar
Two separate rhythms, one place where we are

[Outro]
Your pulse in my wrist
My pulse in your hand
Two hearts, one current
Still here, still we stand

title: The Cord Still Wound
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You tied a thread beneath my ribs
So fine I called it air
It tugged whenever you went quiet
I felt you everywhere

[Pre-Chorus]
Your pulse pulled mine through paper walls
A living line beneath the skin
I held you up; you held me down
And neither knew where we began

[Chorus]
I love you with the cord still wound
A tender knot, a tightening sound
If I cut free, you bleed with me
If I stay bound, I cannot breathe
I want you whole, I want me too
What does a clean cut make of you?

[Verse 2]
We fed it every swallowed word
It thickened, warm and red
A soft anatomy of need
That grew between our beds
You smiled; the tether cinched again
I smiled so you would stay
The hurt was proof we mattered
Until it took the day

[Pre-Chorus]
Your pulse pulled mine through paper walls
A living line beneath the skin
I held you up; you held me down
And neither knew where we began

[Chorus]
I love you with the cord still wound
A tender knot, a tightening sound
If I cut free, you bleed with me
If I stay bound, I cannot breathe
I want you whole, I want me too
What does a clean cut make of you?

[Bridge]
Look at me—this isn’t all your fault
Look at me—I’m not your only ground
One hand shaking, one hand on the blade
One small mercy neither of us made
I’ll take the wound; you take the air
We can grieve the thread and still be there

[Final Chorus]
I loved you with the cord still wound
A tender knot, a tightening sound
I cut us loose; we both still bleed
But now there’s room for either need
I want you whole, I want me too
The scar can hold what love once knew

[Outro]
The line is gone
The ache is real
Your hand is yours
My heart can heal

title: One Scar, Two Histories
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They wheeled me in beneath the paper moon,
A borrowed pulse stitched under my ribs.
The nurse said, “Someone loved you enough to leave this,”
Then the monitor counted out what I could not give.

[Pre-Chorus]
At first it beat like a guest in the room,
A second fist knocking against the bone.
Then every time I reached for you,
Its old ache answered as my own.

[Chorus]
I feel you where my heart used to be,
Your joy climbs in and your grief takes the seat.
I love you—though the love came sewn in,
Your hands in my chest, your hurt under my skin.
If I open up, will I still be me?
Or just the life you left beating in me?

[Verse 2]
Your favorite song makes my throat go tight,
I miss a town I’ve never seen.
I wake with your name behind my teeth,
And cry for a stranger in a dream.
You loved somebody before you were gone;
Now I flinch when they say that name.
I want to give this heart back to the dark,
But it keeps choosing you all the same.

[Pre-Chorus]
It kicks when your picture comes into view,
It folds when your old friends talk.
I thought that I was learning to love you—
Now I feel you learning how I walk.

[Chorus]
I feel you where my heart used to be,
Your joy climbs in and your grief takes the seat.
I love you—though the love came sewn in,
Your hands in my chest, your hurt under my skin.
If I open up, will I still be me?
Or just the life you left beating in me?

[Bridge]
Some mornings your sorrow is a warm red tide,
Some mornings your happiness pulls me outside.
I hate that I’m grateful; I hate that I know
The shape of your longing, the weight of your no.
But when I hold them, the ache loosens its grip—
Your heart says stay, and my own answers it.

[Final Chorus]
I feel you where my heart used to be,
Your joy climbs in and your grief takes the seat.
I love you—now the love has grown roots,
Two lives beating hard in one borrowed suit.
If I open up, I can finally see:
You’re not replacing me—you’re changing what “me” can be.

[Outro]
One scar, two histories,
One beat learning how to be free.

title: Grafted In
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came in quiet, a seed beneath my ribs
By morning, roots had wrapped around my breath
I learned your pulse beside my own
A second heart that beat in borrowed flesh

[Pre-Chorus]
They say the body knows what it can lose
But nobody tells the wound what it remembers

[Chorus]
I grew you in the hollow under my sternum
Soft as a bud, stubborn as bone
I can live without the piece you’ve become
But I’ll never be the shape I was alone
Love is a garden that takes what it needs
And leaves its roots when somebody leaves

[Verse 2]
Your laugh took hold behind my teeth
Your absence keeps flowering when I sleep
I carry every name in muscle and scar
A crowded little orchard under the skin

[Grime Break]
You were not a guest, you were grafted in
Thread by thread, where the old walls split
Now the surgeon asks what I want to save
I say your name—and the whole room shakes

[Bridge]
If I cut you out, I’ll keep on breathing
If I keep you, I keep on bleeding
Tell me which hurt means I loved you more
Tell me what a body is for

[Final Chorus]
I grew you in the hollow under my sternum
Soft as a bud, stubborn as bone
I can live without the piece you’ve become
But I’ll never be the shape I was alone
Love is a garden that takes what it needs
And leaves its roots—
Leaves its roots in me

[Outro]
Still breathing
Still changed
Still making room

title: Choir Beneath My Skin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came in laughing, rain in your hair
Now every quiet has you in there
A little pulse under my tongue
A borrowed word I almost sung

[Pre-Chorus]
I love the way you change my shape
I hate the noise I cannot escape

[Chorus]
You are the choir beneath my skin
Your voices rise; they crowd me in
I hold you close, I split apart
A thousand mouths around one heart
I want you here, I want me back
Your song runs bright along the crack

[Verse 2]
Your mother’s sigh, your brother’s joke
A friend’s last “stay” caught in my throat
Each tenderness takes root and sings
A crowded room beneath my ribs

[Pre-Chorus]
I love the ache that proves you’re near
I hate that I can’t find myself in here

[Chorus]
You are the choir beneath my skin
Your voices rise; they crowd me in
I hold you close, I split apart
A thousand mouths around one heart
I want you here, I want me back
Your song runs bright along the crack

[Bridge]
If I cut the noise, would I cut you too?
If I keep the wound, can I keep me through?
I press my palm where the voices meet
And hear your name in my own heartbeat

[Final Chorus]
You are the choir beneath my skin
Your voices rise; I let them in
I hold you close, though I come apart
A thousand mouths, one beating heart
I want you here; I want me too
I make a little room for you

[Outro]
When the chorus swells and my thoughts disappear
I know your voices mean you were here

title: Mirror Tumor
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Glitchy IDM beats stuttering)
(Distant distorted screams)

[Verse 1]
There’s a swelling in my chest, a quiet little spark
A glass-like nodule pushing through the dark
I looked into the scan and saw a face looking back
Flawless, silver, everything I lack
It has your smile, the version that you love
The gentle shape of who I should be capable of
I fed it my tomorrow, I let it drink my pride
A shining mirror growing deep inside

[Chorus]
But the mirror tumor eats me alive!
To keep you happy, I cannot survive!
It drinks my marrow, it steals my breath
This perfect reflection is a beautiful death!
The more I nurture what you want to see
The less there is of actual me!

[Verse 2]
(Phonk cowbells, fast grime flow)
Splitting at the seams, yeah, my skin is getting tight
The silver replica is pushing for the light
My fingers turning glassy, my joints begin to lock
It’s taking over every single cell upon the block
You hold my hand, but it’s the tumor that you squeeze
A polished metal statue brought down to its knees
I’m fading to a shadow behind a looking glass
Watching my own organic tissue turn to ash!

[Chorus]
But the mirror tumor eats me alive!
To keep you happy, I cannot survive!
It drinks my marrow, it steals my breath
This perfect reflection is a beautiful death!
The more I nurture what you want to see
The less there is of actual me!

[Bridge]
(Tempo switches, heavy IDM/grime beat stutter)
(Screamed vocals)
Do you love the mirror?
Or do you love the host?
You’re kissing a reflection!
You’re hugging a ghost!
It’s beautiful, it’s painless, it’s cold to the touch
I gave up my body because I loved you too much!

[Outro]
Just a shell...
Just a shining, silver shell...
Perfect.
Empty.
(Static fade out)

title: Mirror Image
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You found a face growing under my skin
A clean little portrait of who I could have been
You held up the glass; I looked almost complete
While the thing learned my shape and got hungry beneath

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “Let it bloom, let it make you whole”
I fed it my sleep, I fed it control
It smiled like me with a brighter design
And took another inch every time I called it mine

[Chorus]
I love you for seeing the best in my face
I hate what it takes when it grows in its place
That mirror keeps shining; my body wears thin
You kiss the reflection, I’m vanishing in
Hold me while I’m breaking, don’t call it a cure
I wanted to be someone you could be sure of

[Verse 2]
It learned how you laugh, learned the tilt of your head
Wore all of my wishes like a crown on its stem
You touched it so gently, I couldn’t say stop
Till my own hands trembled and the mirror fed off

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “You’re so close to the person you need”
I watched my old heartbeat go quiet beneath
It gave me the outline, the posture, the grace
Then left me a stranger behind its bright face

[Chorus]
I love you for seeing the best in my face
I hate what it takes when it grows in its place
That mirror keeps shining; my body wears thin
You kiss the reflection, I’m vanishing in
Hold me while I’m breaking, don’t call it a cure
I wanted to be someone you could be sure of

[Bridge]
If I cut it away, will you still know my name?
If I let it keep growing, there’ll be nothing to save
You say you love me—look past what it shows
Put your hand on my pulse, find the part that still knows

[Final Chorus]
I love you for seeing the best in my face
I hate what it takes when it grows in its place
That mirror keeps shining; I’m still breathing in here
Don’t love the reflection and leave me to disappear
Hold me while I’m breaking, stay close, stay unsure
I wanted your love—not a perfect contour

[Outro]
Turn the glass toward the room
Let it show what it cost
If you love what is living
Love me as I am, not what I almost was

title: A Thousand Eyes
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You liked the way I laughed, so I kept it on my face
A small wet lid opened underneath my ribs
Then your approval found me in the grocery store
And one more eye blinked awake beside my hip
I learned to turn my shoulders toward the room
To catch each little verdict as it fell
Now every time you tell me I look fine
Another pupil takes up residence in my skin

[Pre-Chorus]
I wanted you to stay
I wanted you to see me
I gave the wanting eyes
And they all turned to you

[Chorus]
A thousand eyes, and none of them are mine
I see myself the way you do, the way you do
Your love can stitch me up, then split the seam
I want your hands; I want to disappear from view
A thousand eyes, all asking what to be
I look for me in you, in you, in you

[Verse 2]
You kissed the scar and called it beautiful
I almost felt my own skin soften there
Then watched your face to learn if I believed it
And found another eyelid in my hair
I love you for the warmth inside your palms
I hate the little courtroom in my chest
You say my name; the crowded faces turn
Each one insists it knows me best

[Pre-Chorus]
I wanted you to stay
I wanted you to see me
I gave the wanting eyes
And they all turned to you

[Chorus]
A thousand eyes, and none of them are mine
I see myself the way you do, the way you do
Your love can stitch me up, then split the seam
I want your hands; I want to disappear from view
A thousand eyes, all asking what to be
I look for me in you, in you, in you

[Bridge]
If I close every eye, will you still know me?
If I stop being easy to admire?
Hold my face without correcting its shape
Tell me I am here when I am not on fire
I want to love you without becoming
A room full of witnesses wearing my skin
So take my hand, not the image I offer
Let me be ugly, uncertain, and in

[Final Chorus]
A thousand eyes, and one of them is mine
I see you seeing me, but I can choose
Your love can stitch me up; I’ll hold the thread
I want your hands, and I don’t want to disappear from view
A thousand eyes, but I can turn away
And find my face beneath the borrowed view
I look for me—and this time, I look through

[Outro]
Stay while I learn the shape
Stay while I learn what’s true
I’m more than what you see
I’m still here, looking through

title: Butterfly Beneath My Skin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You laughed, and something under my ribs took root
A warm little ache with a silver tooth
It curled in the dark where my heartbeat turns
Fed on every promise, fed on every burn
You held my hand; I felt it kick and bloom
A soft-winged hunger in the locked-up room

[Pre-Chorus]
I wanted the sweetness, I wanted the scar
I wanted the door and the creature behind it

[Chorus]
There’s a butterfly beneath my skin
It beats when you leave, it breaks when you come in
Joy in its wings, pain in its mouth
It’s growing toward the shape I can’t live without
When it tears through, let it carry my name
I loved you in tenderness, I loved you in pain

[Verse 2]
It learned your voice from the walls of my chest
Turned every goodbye to a nest in my flesh
I tried to be careful, I tried to be kind
But desire has teeth when you keep it confined
You kissed the small wound and called it a start
Now something with my face is tugging at my heart

[Pre-Chorus]
I wanted the sweetness, I wanted the scar
I wanted the truth with its hands full of hunger

[Chorus]
There’s a butterfly beneath my skin
It beats when you leave, it breaks when you come in
Joy in its wings, pain in its mouth
It’s growing toward the shape I can’t live without
When it tears through, let it carry my name
I loved you in tenderness, I loved you in pain

[Bridge]
If it comes out beautiful, don’t turn away
If it comes out monstrous, love it anyway
It is every locked wish, every swallowed plea
The shape of the life you awakened in me

[Final Chorus]
There’s a butterfly beneath my skin
It beats like a vow, it bites like a sin
Joy in its wings, pain in its mouth
Now it’s unfolding, now it’s coming out
I’ll meet its eyes; I won’t call it a stain
I wanted you wholly—the pleasure, the pain

[Outro]
You touched the wound; it opened like a flower
I feel it breathe; I feel it take its power

title: Engine Hate Bruise
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came around the bend too fast
I wore the road like a second skin
Your headlights split the rain in half
And left your name beneath my ribs

[Pre-Chorus]
I should hate the shape you made of me
But every mile keeps pulling you near

[Chorus]
I love the car that broke me open
I love the engine, hate the bruise
You leave me scattered on the shoulder
I crawl back just to follow you
I know your wheels will take me under
Still I lean into the sound
You made a wreckage of my body
And I keep calling that devotion now

[Verse 2]
The crows know every part of me
The ditch keeps secrets in the weeds
You slow down when you pass this way
Like you can hear my heart still beat

[Pre-Chorus]
I should hate the shape you made of me
But every mile keeps pulling you near

[Chorus]
I love the car that broke me open
I love the engine, hate the bruise
You leave me scattered on the shoulder
I crawl back just to follow you
I know your wheels will take me under
Still I lean into the sound
You made a wreckage of my body
And I keep calling that devotion now

[Bridge]
You stop beside me, doors locked tight
I press my face against the glass
Your hands are warm behind the wheel
Mine are the marks you couldn’t wash

[Final Chorus]
I love the car that broke me open
I love the engine, hate the bruise
You leave me scattered on the shoulder
I crawl back just to follow you
I know your wheels will take me under
Still I lean into the sound
You made a wreckage of my body
And I keep calling that devotion now

[Outro]
Past the ditch, past the county line
I’d choose your tires every time

title: Fungus on My Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came in soft as rain through a cracked-up door
Left a pale little garden where my ribs meet the floor
Now the roots lace tight round the beat in my chest
And every thought bends toward the place you rest

[Pre-Chorus]
I know what you’re doing, I still let it grow
Your name in the marrow, your shape in the spores

[Chorus]
There’s fungus growing on my heart
Soft white fingers pulling me apart

I taste the rot and still want more of us
You hurt like a fever, you heal like a drug
I’m losing my head to the thing that I hug

The kitchen clock skips when you’re gone for a day
I count every stain where your shadow once lay
A sweet little bloom climbs the back of my tongue

There’s fungus growing on my heart
Soft white fingers pulling me apart
It takes my mind, but I call it love

I’m losing my head to the thing that I hug

[Final Chorus]
There’s fungus growing on my heart
Soft white fingers pulling me apart
It takes my mind, but I call it love
I taste the rot and still want more of us

I’m losing my head to the thing that I hug

title: Beautiful Ache
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your thumb leaves a crescent pressed into my wrist
I keep that small bruise like a note I can’t miss
We trade our old names in the kitchen light
Your breath in my lungs feels wrong and right

[Pre-Chorus]
Every seam gives way when you pull me near
I want the hurt, I want you here

[Chorus]
Melt through my ribs, let the borders come undone
Your pulse in my chest, my blood learning your run
It’s heaven in the fever, it’s a beautiful ache
We’re two hearts caught in one body that we made

[Verse 2]
Your laugh slips out through my teeth when I speak

Still I reach for your hand when the red river flows

[Pre-Chorus]
Every seam gives way when you pull me near
I want the hurt, I want you here

[Chorus]
Melt through my ribs, let the borders come undone

If I lose my outline, say my name against my skin
If you lose your breath, I’ll make room and pull you in
No clean way back, no untouched place to start
Your scar is my map; my ache is your heart

[Final Chorus]
Melt through my ribs, let the borders come undone
Your pulse in my chest, my blood learning your run
It’s heaven in the fever, it’s a beautiful ache
We’re two hearts caught in one body that we made

[Outro]
Stay where the edges used to be
Stay where you’re changing me

title: Second Skin Growing Wrong
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You laugh and my ribs turn to little white birds

[Pre-Chorus]
You pull me close, I come apart
Red thread winding through my heart

[Chorus]
I love you like a second skin growing wrong

[Verse 2]
At breakfast my fingers keep reaching for yours

[Pre-Chorus]
You pull me close, I come apart
Red thread winding through my heart

[Chorus]
I love you like a second skin growing wrong

I ache where you hold me, I heal where it shows

If loving you hurts, let it hurt honest

[Final Chorus]
I love you like a second skin growing wrong
Too tight in the morning, too soft when you're gone
You kiss the bruise and it blooms like a rose
I ache where you hold me, I heal where it shows

[Outro]
I heal where it shows
I heal where it shows

title: Let the Stitches Show
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You came in laughing with a split-lip grin,
I let your name crawl under my skin.
Now every heartbeat pulls a bright red thread,
A little more alive, a little more bled.

[Pre-Chorus]
You say, “Stay close,” and I do, though it stings;
Love is a mouth with a hundred small wings.

[Chorus]
I love you like a heart turned inside out,
Tender as a bruise, too loud to doubt.
You stitch me up, then pull the seam,
I ache, I bloom, I bite the dream.
If joy has teeth, let it chew through me—
I want your hands where the hurt should be.

[Verse 2]
We share one coat in the cold by the shop,
Your thumb on my pulse till the tremors stop.
I keep your voice in the hollow of bone,
A warm little creature that won’t leave alone.

[Pre-Chorus]
You say, “Stay close,” and I do, though it stings;
Love is a mouth with a hundred small wings.

[Chorus]
I love you like a heart turned inside out,
Tender as a bruise, too loud to doubt.
You stitch me up, then pull the seam,
I ache, I bloom, I bite the dream.
If joy has teeth, let it chew through me—
I want your hands where the hurt should be.

[Bridge]
When you go, the quiet grows a second face,
It wears your smile in the wrong place.
Come back, come close, let the stitches show—
I’d rather hurt with you than heal alone.

[Final Chorus]
I love you like a heart turned inside out,
Tender as a bruise, too loud to doubt.
You stitch me up, then pull the seam,
I ache, I bloom, I bite the dream.
If joy has teeth, let it chew through me—
I want your hands where the hurt should be.

[Outro]
Stay close. Stay close.
Let the stitches show.

title: Good With The Bad
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Look at the names that I crossed off the list
Doors I shut, and the hands that I missed
Still brought soup when the old man got ill
Still held my nerve when the room went still
Two sides of the book, both written in ink
One says I helped, one says stop and think
If I weigh every deed till the scales hit the floor
Can I call myself good, or just ask for more?

[Chorus]
Tell me, can I be good with the bad in my past?
Can I own what I broke and still learn how to last?
I won’t scrub out the marks, I won’t dress up the truth
I’ll be judged by the choices I make from this booth

[Verse 2]
I said the wrong thing when my temper ran hot
Kept quiet too long when I should’ve spoke up
But I went back around, put the truth on the table
Said, “I did you wrong,” when I was finally able
No halo to claim, no clean slate to show
Just a heart that can bend and a will that can grow
If I face what I’ve done, then repair what I can
Is that enough to say I’m a decent man?

[Chorus]
Tell me, can I be good with the bad in my past?
Can I own what I broke and still learn how to last?
I won’t scrub out the marks, I won’t dress up the truth
I’ll be judged by the choices I make from this booth

[Bridge]
Maybe good isn’t spotless, maybe it’s care
A call that you make, a weight that you share
Not the story you tell when you’re saving your pride
But the work you still do when there’s nowhere to hide

[Outro]
I can’t change the page that I wrote yesterday
But tomorrow’s a choice, and I’m making it straight

title: Tomorrow’s Still a Door
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found your old notes in the kitchen drawer
A list of names and apologies
Some lines crossed out, some left waiting
Like doors I never learned to close

[Pre-Chorus]
You say the good should count for something
I say the hurt still has a name
Can one kind hand undo the damage?
Can one bad night define the whole frame?

[Chorus]
Can I call myself a good person
When I know the ways I let you down?
I’ve held somebody up through winter
I’ve left somebody cold somehow
If I face the whole of what I’ve done
And try to make the next thing right
Can I be more than my worst moment?
Can I earn that name tonight?

[Verse 2]
I took the late bus back to your street
With the book you lent me in the rain
I didn’t knock; I stood there thinking
An apology can’t cancel pain

[Pre-Chorus]
You say the good should count for something
I say the hurt still has a name
Maybe change is not a clean slate
Maybe it’s choosing not to do it again

[Chorus]
Can I call myself a good person
When I know the ways I let you down?
I’ve held somebody up through winter
I’ve left somebody cold somehow
If I face the whole of what I’ve done
And try to make the next thing right
Can I be more than my worst moment?
Can I earn that name tonight?

[Bridge]
No halo, no excuse
Just the truth I have to use
I can’t rewrite what came before
But I can choose what I’m here for

[Screamo]
I AM NOT THE HARM I CAUSED!
I’LL OWN THE DEBT, I’LL FACE THE COST!

[Final Chorus]
I won’t call myself a good person
Just to bury what I put you through
I’ll show up where I failed you
And let my actions speak the truth
If I face the whole of what I’ve done
And keep on trying to make things right
Maybe goodness is a practice
I can choose again tonight

[Outro]
The list stays in the drawer
But tomorrow’s still a door

title: Scales Tipping Back
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Looking back at the ledger of my life
Counting up the darkness, counting up the light
Heavy on the left, heavy on the right
Standing in the mirror in the middle of the night

[Chorus]
Can you call yourself a good person
When you balance out the good and the bad?
Is it the mercy that you gave away,
Or the quiet little damage that you had?
Can you call yourself a good person
When the scales keep tipping back?

[Verse 2]
Stumbled in the shadows, built a couple bridges too
Fixed a couple broken hearts, broke a couple through
Every shadow leaves a trace, every act stays true
Who is looking back at me, who is looking back at you?

[Chorus]
Can you call yourself a good person
When you balance out the good and the bad?
Is it the mercy that you gave away,
Or the quiet little damage that you had?
Can you call yourself a good person
When the scales keep tipping back?

[Outro]
Good and bad, light and shade
Counting every promise made
Are we good, or just trying to be?
Standing in the mirror, set me free

title: The Good, The Bad
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Baby voices whispering)
Good and bad...
Can you look inside?
Yeah

[Verse]
Looking at the ledger, checking off the deeds
Sifting through the hunger, measuring the needs
Every hand I lifted, every heart I broke
Shadows in the corner, fading like a smoke
Are we just the sum of the wreckage we have made?
Or the quiet promises whispered in the shade?
A balance in the dark, spinning out of line
A human heart designed to search for a sign

[Chorus]
Can you call yourself a good person?
When the scales are weighing down the soul
Can you call yourself a good person?
When the fragments never make a whole
(Distorted female voice: Are you good? Are you bad?)

[Drop]
(Heavy phonk beat, epic choir swells, baby vocal chops)

[Outro]
(Vocoder voice)
The good, the bad...
Still looking.

title: The Page Stays Open
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found the note beneath the drawer,
A list of promises from years before.
Some I kept, some slipped away,
Some still ask me what I’ll do today.

[Pre-Chorus]
I count the hands I held too tight,
The doors I closed, the times I tried.
If I can face the whole of me,
Is there room for who I’m trying to be?

[Chorus]
Can I call myself a good person
With both sides of the ledger in view?
All the harm I wish I could undo,
All the small good things I followed through.
I’m more than the worst thing I have done,
More than every bright thing I’ve begun.
Can I live with the truth and still choose
To be someone kinder than I used to?

[Verse 2]
I remember how I let you down,
The hurried words that cut too loud.
I remember stopping in the rain
To help a stranger lift a broken frame.

[Pre-Chorus]
Neither cancels out the other one;
The tally isn’t finished when the day is done.
I can name the wreckage, make repair,
And keep showing up with honest care.

[Chorus]
Can I call myself a good person
With both sides of the ledger in view?
All the harm I wish I could undo,
All the small good things I followed through.
I’m more than the worst thing I have done,
More than every bright thing I’ve begun.
Can I live with the truth and still choose
To be someone kinder than I used to?

[Bridge]
Not a pardon carved in stone,
Not a verdict made alone.
I’ll ask, I’ll listen, I’ll make amends,
Then meet the morning and begin again.

[Final Chorus]
I won’t call myself a good person
Just to make the harder questions small.
I’ll own the hurt, repair what I can,
And answer with my actions after all.
I’m more than the worst thing I have done,
Still responsible for what comes next.
If goodness lives in choices made,
Let tomorrow find me trying again.

[Outro]
The page stays open on the table.
I’ll write the next line as I’m able.

title: Can You Call Yourself Good
genres: and tense minor-key synth stabs; verse rides sparse kick-snare pockets with clipped triplets
pre-chorus tightens with rising choir textures
chorus slams in with gang-vocal chants and an octave-bent lead. Razor-close male vocal with doubled lows
and delay throws on key punches; ear candy includes reverse cymbal lifts
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You count every kindness, then tally the harm,
The ride you gave home, the lie that raised alarm.
You kept that old promise, then broke one by choice,
Now both sit together, each carrying your voice.
Your sister still trusts you; your friend keeps his distance,
You want one clean answer, some final assistance.
But goodness ain’t spotless, and guilt isn’t proof—
You’re looking for verdicts beneath your own roof.

[Pre-Chorus]
When the room goes quiet, what do you defend?
Can a heart do wrong and still learn how to mend?

[Chorus]
Can you call yourself good when you know what you’ve done?
Can you face every scar, not just count what you won?
You are more than your worst, but the worst still is yours—
Own the hurt, make it right, keep your hand on the door.
Can you call yourself good? Don’t run from the truth.
Let the next thing you choose be the proof.

[Verse 2]
That winter you vanished when he needed a ride,
You said you were busy; you knew that you lied.
Then months later, showed up, sat through the whole night,
No speech, no excuse, just stayed till daylight.
You can’t trade one good deed for the damage you made,
Can’t erase what you said with the plans that you laid.
But you can name the wound, hear the answer come back,
And stop making someone else carry the facts.

[Pre-Chorus]
When the room goes quiet, what do you defend?
Can a heart do wrong and still learn how to mend?

[Chorus]
Can you call yourself good when you know what you’ve done?
Can you face every scar, not just count what you won?

Own the hurt, make it right, keep your hand on the door.
Can you call yourself good? Don’t run from the truth.
Let the next thing you choose be the proof.

[Bridge]
No halo to borrow, no sentence to dodge,
Just names you remember, the weight you acknowledge.
Ask what they needed; don’t ask to be praised.
A better tomorrow is built in the ways
You listen, return, tell the truth when it costs—
You don’t become clean by pretending you’re not.

[Final Chorus]
Can you call yourself good when you know what you’ve done?
Face every scar, and don’t hide from a one.
You are more than your worst, but the worst still is yours—
Own the hurt, make it right, keep your hand on the door.
Can you call yourself good? Let the answer be proof:
What you choose from this moment is what you do.

Not innocent. Not finished.
Look at what you did—and what you do next.

title: Good Person Inside
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Granular textures, bowed bass pulses)

[Verse 1]
Tallying up the ledger in the dark
Counting every strike and every mark
A heavy weight against a subtle grace
Reflected in an unforgiving space

Are you defined by what has come to pass?

[Chorus]
Can you call yourself a good person tonight?
Looking at the dark, looking at the light
Weighing up the damage against the grace
Searching for the truth behind the face

Every broken promise, every hand you held

[Chorus]
Can you call yourself a good person tonight?
Looking at the dark, looking at the light

title: The Whole of Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Can I call myself a good one
When I count the things I’ve done?
Every hand I held up gently
Every time I turned and ran

[Pre-Chorus]
I keep both sides before me
No clean page, no easy sum
If I name the harm I caused
Is that where the change begins?

[Chorus]
Tell me, can I still be good
With the bad I know I’ve done?
I won’t hide behind the better
I won’t say the worst is all I am
Can I face the whole of me
And choose what I become?

[Verse 2]
There’s the promise I remembered
There’s the call I let go by
There’s the truth I said too late
There’s the time I chose to try

[Pre-Chorus]
I can’t undo the damage
I can own the weight it brings
Maybe goodness isn’t spotless
Maybe it’s the next right thing

[Chorus]
Tell me, can I still be good
With the bad I know I’ve done?
I won’t hide behind the better
I won’t say the worst is all I am

[Bridge]
No verdict from a mirror
No pardon from a page

And do more than feel ashamed

[Final Chorus]
I can try to be more honest
With the bad I know I’ve done
Keep the good from turning into cover
Let repair be where I start

And choose what I become

[Outro]
One choice, then another

title: House of Cards
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned to make the careful answer
Before you even asked the question
Kept every promise in the open
Kept every fracture out of sight

[Pre-Chorus]
I wanted kindness to be honest
I wanted love to make me clean
But every little thing I buried
Still stands between you and me

[Chorus]
Can I be good when I keep this from you?
Can I be kind with a locked room inside?
I built a house of cards around the truth
And every breath could bring it down tonight
I tried so hard to love you gently
Now I’m afraid of what you’ll find

[Verse 2]
You trust the version I rehearsed here
The steady hands, the open door
I hear the floorboards shift beneath us
I can’t pretend they won’t anymore

[Pre-Chorus]
I wanted kindness to be honest
I wanted love to make me clean
But every little thing I buried
Still stands between you and me

[Chorus]
Can I be good when I keep this from you?
Can I be kind with a locked room inside?
I built a house of cards around the truth
And every breath could bring it down tonight
I tried so hard to love you gently
Now I’m afraid of what you’ll find

[Bridge]
If I tell you, I could lose you.
If I don’t, I lose you slowly.
I keep calling silence mercy.
Maybe that’s just fear in nice clothes.

[Final Chorus]
Can I be good if I stand here and tell you?
Can I be kind if I let the whole thing fall?
I built a house of cards around the truth
And I can’t ask you to live beneath it all
I tried so hard to love you gently
Now I have to let you see it all

[Outro]
Let it fall
Let it fall

title: House of Cards in the Dark
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept the porch light burning
While I learned to lock the door
You brought your Sunday flowers
I hid the papers on the floor
I said the right things softly
I remembered every date
But there’s a stack of little lies
Leaning hard against the gate

[Pre-Chorus]
I want to call myself good

[Chorus]
I tried so hard to love you
I tried so hard to be kind
But this house I built from secrets

If it falls, it falls between us
If it lands, it leaves a mark
I tried so hard to be good
With a house of cards in the dark

[Verse 2]
You laugh beside the sink now
With your sleeves rolled to the seam
I watch you trust the quiet
Like it’s something we both mean
There’s a name I never mentioned
There’s a night I rearranged
I can’t keep calling silence
Just another kind of grace

[Pre-Chorus]
I want to call myself good
I want to meet your eyes

[Chorus]
I tried so hard to love you
I tried so hard to be kind

I could tell you in the kitchen

We tried so hard to love here
We tried so hard to be kind
But this house I built from secrets

Now I’m telling you the hard part

[Outro]
I’m telling you the hard part
I’m telling you the hard part

title: Honest Light
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I held the door when your hands were full

[Pre-Chorus]
I can name every kindness

I watched your face go still at my excuse

[Pre-Chorus]
I can’t undo the damage
I can choose what follows now

[Chorus]
Am I good, am I trying?
I have loved and I have lied
I have left you with the pieces
I have stayed here by your side

And make the next thing right
Is there room for me to change
Without calling wrong things right?

[Bridge]
Maybe goodness isn’t spotless
Maybe it’s the work I do
When the mirror shows the damage
I don’t turn away from you

[Final Chorus]
I am flawed, I am trying
I won’t hide behind the good
I will name the ways I failed you
And repair what can be stood
I can’t promise I’m an angel

There is room for me to change
If I keep making it right

[Outro]
One true word, one step, one day

title: Open The Gate
lyrics:

No scale can hold what a heart can hold

[Verse 2]
You can keep your stories, I’ll keep mine

No need to cut a branch to prove

[Pre-Chorus]
No scale can hold what a heart can hold
No single hand has to close

[Chorus]
Every love is its own wild garden
Different roots, different names
We don’t have to rank what’s growing
Or make one bloom take all the space
Open the gate, let the whole heart breathe
There’s room for every kind of seed
Every love, every love—beautiful, free

Let the fence come down, let the ground be wide

Every love is its own wild garden
Different roots, different names

Open the gate, let the whole heart breathe

title: No One Has To Shrink
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You bring your weather in with you

Some nights I need the winter air

[Pre-Chorus]
No tally marks, no winner’s crown

Different roots, different flowers in bloom!

No one light takes the whole sky away!
There is room in the earth for every kind of wonder—

[Verse 2]
You laugh like seeds across the table
I take the long way home alone
Neither path becomes a verdict
Neither one makes less a home
We can tend what asks for tending
Leave some ground untouched and free
Love is not a single harvest
It’s the space to let things be

[Bridge]
[Half-time, rising into a huge theatrical build]
Open the gate—let the wild things in!

title: A Thousand Small Vows
lyrics:

title: A Little Time
lyrics:

[Chorus]

A hand on the table

title: Infinite Space

Some days confidence is quiet
Like a shirt that fits just right
A joke that only I find funny

I can own the things I've broken

I'm a work that's never finished
Not a debt I have to pay

[Bridge: Half-time, intimate to explosive]
(Too much?) Maybe sometimes
(Too strange?) In someone's eyes

[Final Chorus: Key lift, euphoric harmonies]
I'M COMFORTABLE INSIDE MY SKIN!
Every scar and contradiction!
I can grow without erasing
Every beautiful distinction!

[Outro: 7/8, fading vocal chops]

(Bmm-tss-ka, bmm-tss-ka)

title: The World Gave Me You
lyrics:
[Intro: 7/8, bright guitar, elastic bass]
(Bmm-tss-ka, bmm-bmm-tss)

[Bridge: Half-time, tender piano]

[Final Chorus: Key lift, explosive harmonies]

AND THE WORLD GAVE ME YOU!

[Outro: 7/8, vocal chops fading]
(You-you-you!)

title: The Beautiful Detour
lyrics:
[Intro: 7/8, bright arpeggios, elastic bass]
(Tika-tika-boom, tss-ka-tss)
(Wonder, wonder, wander!)
[Glitched vocal chops]

[Verse 1: Playful, rhythmic]
I went looking for an answer
Found a question hiding there
Pulled a thread into a universe
I never knew was there
From the stars to ancient cities
From a circuit to a song
Every door became a hallway
And I followed it along

[Pre-Chorus: Rising falsetto, 5/4]
One discovery becomes another
One more spark beneath the skin
(Where does it go?)
(Let me in!)

[Chorus: Soaring, anthemic, layered]
Oh, the beautiful detour!
All the things I never knew!
Every question is a window
With a million different views!
I don't need to find an ending

[Break: IDM drums, funky bass solo]
(Bmm-ka-tss, bmm-bmm-ka)
(Know-know-know, wanna know!)
[Phonk vocal chops, stereo stutters]

[Verse 2: Bouncing 9/8 groove]
I learned a little about everything

Where the old becomes the new
Every skill became a language
Every failure left a clue
Now a thousand distant subjects
Make a picture coming through

[Bridge: Half-time, intimate to explosive]

[Final Chorus: Key lift, huge harmonies]

[Outro: 7/8, fading vocal loops]
(Why-why-why? Because!)
(Tika-boom, tss-ka-tss)

title: Something Makes me Feel Alive
lyrics:
[Intro: 7/8, warm synth arpeggios, funky bass]
[Glitched vocal chops]
(Feel it, feel it, feel it now)
(Ooh-ah, something new!)

[Verse 1: Playful, syncopated]
I took a road without a reason
Bought a ticket just to see
If a stranger kind of rhythm
Could awaken something in me
I've collected little passions
Like souvenirs along the way
Some were gone before the morning
Some are burning still today

[Pre-Chorus: Rising falsetto, 5/4]
And I don't know what I'm missing
Till I stumble into light
(Ooh, into light!)

[Chorus: Explosive, soaring harmonies]
So let me try another life!
Another sound, another sky!
I wanna find the little things
That make my sleeping heart ignite!

[Break: Phonk vocal chops, glitch percussion]

[Verse 2: Melodic, bouncing bass]
Maybe dancing, maybe painting

Every failure is a doorway
Every whim a little spark

[Bridge: Half-time, intimate vocals]
(What if nothing moves you?)

[Final Chorus: Key change, layered counterpoint]

[Outro: 7/8, fading chopped harmonies]

title: I know What I’m For
lyrics:
[Intro: 7/8, shimmering arpeggios, syncopated bass]
(Count the lights, count the miles)
(Still no sign of home)

[Verse 1: Intimate, restrained]
There's a wall of things I've finished
And a list of things to do
People say I found my calling
And for once I know it's true
I can tell you why I'm running
I can name the lives I've touched
But when the room goes dark around me
Why is enough never enough?

[Pre-Chorus: Rising harmonies, tom build]
Every door I dreamed of opened
Every horizon moved away
(Always further, always further)

[Chorus: Soaring 4/4, stacked harmonies]
I know what I'm for!
But I don't know where I'm going
I've built a thousand lanterns
Still can't see what they're showing
I've got purpose in my hands
And this static in my chest
How can I be right where I should be
And still feel like a guest?
(Still feel like a guest!)

[Instrumental Break: 7/8 bass solo, guitar counterpoint, polyrhythmic drums]

[Verse 2: Rhythmic, building intensity]
A handshake in a crowded hallway
A name printed on a page
A thousand small impossibles
Became an ordinary day
I believed the climb was meaning
That the summit held the key
Now the view goes on forever
And I wonder where is me?

[Bridge: 5/4, whispered call and response]
(What do you want?)
Not another shining thing
(What do you need?)
A little room to hear me sing
[Half-time, swelling strings]
