[Instrumental Crescendo: Ascending guitar, syncopated bass, crashing cymbals]

[Final Chorus: Key change, explosive harmonies]
I KNOW WHAT I'M FOR!
But I don't know where I'm going!
I've built a thousand lanterns
And their light just keeps on growing!
I've got purpose in my hands
But no peace inside my chest
Maybe I can know just who I am
Without knowing what comes next!

[Outro: Return to 7/8, fading vocal layers]
(I know what I'm for)
(But where am I going?)
I know what I'm for...
(Still searching, still growing)

[End: Single unresolved piano chord]

title: The Story After All
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept the medal in a kitchen drawer
Beside the keys I never learned to mend
Some doors swung wide; some closed before I knocked
I called them endings, then began again

[Pre-Chorus]
You can see the whole road from the last page
Every wrong turn had a name

[Chorus]
So read me as I was, not as I meant to be
A hand that held, a hand that let things fall
The good I gave, the hurt I couldn't see
All of it belongs inside the story after all

[Verse 2]
Your old blue cup still wears a hairline crack
The shelf we built leans slightly to the left
I missed the years that asked me to come back
Then learned to stay, though nothing paid me back

[Pre-Chorus]
You can see the whole road from the last page
Every wrong turn had a name

[Chorus]
So read me as I was, not as I meant to be
A hand that held, a hand that let things fall
The good I gave, the hurt I couldn't see
All of it belongs inside the story after all

[Bridge]
If I could speak across those paper years
I'd tell that younger heart: keep room for change
No life is only triumph or regret
The sum is more than either one can claim

[Final Chorus]
So read me as I was, and let the pages close
The brave, the vain, the tender, and the small
I made a life from choices, some well made, some not
And every line became the story after all

[Outro]
Set the book beside the window
Let the final sentence rest

title: Let the Rain Fall Where It
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The river keeps its own counsel
The weather won’t take my side
I spent a year asking the locked door
To explain why it stayed shut tight

[Pre-Chorus]
I can’t command the clouds to part
Or make the past undo
But I can choose the ground I stand on
And what I’m going to do

[Chorus]
Let the rain fall where it falls
Let the loose ends drift away
I will put my hands to what is mine
I will make a path today
I can’t steer the turning season
I can choose the seed I sow
I’ll release what won’t be moved
And take the reins where I can go

[Verse 2]
The train leaves when the signal changes
The tide won’t wait for me
But there’s a list beside the kettle
And one hard call I need to make

[Pre-Chorus]
I can’t command the clouds to part
Or make the past undo
But I can choose the ground I stand on
And what I’m going to do

[Chorus]
Let the rain fall where it falls
Let the loose ends drift away
I will put my hands to what is mine
I will make a path today
I can’t steer the turning season
I can choose the seed I sow
I’ll release what won’t be moved
And take the reins where I can go

[Bridge]
Not every answer belongs to me
Not every burden needs my name
I’ll stop wrestling with the open sea
And row the boat I have today

[Final Chorus]
Let the rain fall where it falls
Let the loose ends drift away
I will put my hands to what is mine
I will make a path today
I can’t steer the turning season
I can choose the seed I sow
I’ll release what won’t be moved
And take the reins where I can go

[Outro]
One clear choice, then one more
My hands are on the oars

title: The Hand Is Mine
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hope keeps a blueprint folded in my coat
Fear counts the exits every time I speak
Ambition pins a bright name to my throat
Desire says the locked door isn’t locked

[Pre-Chorus]
They take turns holding the wheel
They trade their faces when I blink
I call the bargain free will
While every hand tightens its grip

[Chorus]
Who chose the step I’m standing on?
Who taught my hunger what to want?
Pride wears my jacket, walks me home
I say I’m steering—then I’m gone

[Verse 2]
Envy measures rooms I’ve never entered
Shame keeps receipts beneath the bed
Anger makes a judge of every stranger
Love can turn a promise into thread

[Pre-Chorus]
They take turns holding the wheel
They trade their faces when I blink
I call the bargain free will
While every hand tightens its grip

[Chorus]
Who chose the step I’m standing on?
Who taught my hunger what to want?
Pride wears my jacket, walks me home
I say I’m steering—then I’m gone

[Bridge]
I name each force and watch it shrink
A little less when brought to light
But naming isn’t cutting every string
And knowing isn’t choosing right

[Outro]
Hope draws the map
Fear marks the ground
Desire calls
Pride answers loud
I hold the wheel
I feel it turn
The hand is mine
The lesson burns

title: Take Your Own Hand
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You kept your plans folded in a coat
A paper map with one bold road
They called it luck when you stood tall
But you built each step before the fall

[Pre-Chorus]
The doubt can talk, let it pass through
There’s a steady hand inside of you

[Chorus]
Believe in yourself when the ground feels thin
You have the strength to begin again
One small yes can turn the whole tide
Take your own hand; walk on your side

[Verse 2]
You learned the weight of a locked door
Then made a key from what you knew before
Each hard no taught your aim to hold
Each quiet try put steel in your soul

[Pre-Chorus]
The doubt can talk, let it pass through
There’s a steady hand inside of you

[Chorus]
Believe in yourself when the ground feels thin
You have the strength to begin again
One small yes can turn the whole tide
Take your own hand; walk on your side

[Bridge]
When the old voice says you’re not enough
Name every mile you crossed through rough
You don’t need proof from every face
Your next brave step can claim its place

[Final Chorus]
Believe in yourself; let the whole room know
You have a fire that you chose to grow
One small yes can turn the whole tide
Take your own hand; walk on your side
Believe in yourself, believe and begin
The force you were waiting for lives within

[Outro]
Lives within
You can begin

title: Save a Quiet Light
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Funky syncopated bass groove with chopped breakbeats and breath ad-libs)

[Verse 1]
I spent the years pouring water into broken jars
Reaching out to catch the falling of another's stars
Stretching my hands until the fingers started to fray
Giving every piece of my own warmth away
But you cannot light the dark if you are burning out
Whispering belief into another's doubt

[Chorus]
There is a reservoir, a deeper well inside
Don't let the river run completely dry
Fierce and gentle, let the circle turn
A lesson that the heart must slowly learn
To keep enough love for everyone
And save a quiet light for yourself when day is done

[Verse 2]
(Bass slides and intricate beatbox transitions)
It is not selfish to protect the spark you hold
To wrap your own cold shoulders in the velvet fold
A quiet room where no one else can make demands
Rebuilding courage with your own two hands
For how can you hold up the world when you start to fall?
You have to love the one who answers when they call

[Chorus]
There is a reservoir, a deeper well inside
Don't let the river run completely dry
Fierce and gentle, let the circle turn
A lesson that the heart must slowly learn

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]
There is a reservoir, a deeper well inside
Don't let the river run completely dry
Fierce and gentle, let the circle turn
A lesson that the heart must slowly learn
To keep enough love for everyone
And save a quiet light for yourself when day is done

[Outro]
(Stop-start rhythmic fake-outs, fading bass harmonics and chopped syllables)
Keep a light for yourself...
When the day is done.

title: Leave Some Waiting Here
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep a chair pulled out for every tired friend
You learn the shape of all their storms before they end
But when the room goes quiet and the last coat’s gone
You leave your own heart waiting with the porch light on

[Pre-Chorus]
You don’t have to empty every cup
To prove that you can care
There’s a place inside your open hands
For something of you there

[Chorus]
Save a little love for yourself
You’re not the last name on the list
Give it freely, give it well
But keep a little kindness in your grip
There’s enough to go around
No one has to disappear
Love them with your whole wide heart
And leave some waiting here

[Verse 2]
You remember how your sister takes her tea
You call your father back before he has to ask you twice
You carry extra groceries up the narrow stairs
Then skip the meal you made because you’re sure somebody else needs yours

[Pre-Chorus]
You don’t have to earn a softer day
By fixing every ache
Even roots need rain before they lift
The branches others take

[Chorus]
Save a little love for yourself
You’re not the last name on the list
Give it freely, give it well
But keep a little kindness in your grip
There’s enough to go around
No one has to disappear
Love them with your whole wide heart
And leave some waiting here

[Bridge]
When you say, “I need a minute,”
That’s not turning love away
It’s a door you leave unlatched
So you can meet them whole someday
Take the long way home at sunset
Let the unanswered message wait
You are someone worth returning to
Not only someone others save

[Final Chorus]
Save a little love for yourself
You’re not the last name on the list
Give it freely, give it well
Keep your own name in the kindness
There’s enough to go around
Let the good come back in here
Love them with your whole wide heart
And leave some waiting here

[Outro]
Leave some waiting here
For you

title: Laying Down the Weight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I carried every deadline like a stone inside my coat
Kept my smile in working order, kept the worry in my throat
Every little red flag waving, every voice that said, “Be more”
I made it through the hours, now I’m closing up the door

[Pre-Chorus]
The day can keep its tally
I don’t owe it one more mile
I’m setting down the armor
I can rest a little while

[Chorus]
I made it to the end of the day
Still here, still breathing, still okay
Let the whole world wait outside
I’m laying down the weight tonight
I made it through, I’m letting go
Tomorrow has its turn to show
But right now, I have earned this rest
I made it through—I did my best

[Verse 2]
All those careful little measures, all the boxes I had to fill
All the plans that changed at noon, all the pressure standing still
Now the quiet finds my shoulders, and my hands unclench at last
I don’t have to solve tomorrow while today is in the past

[Pre-Chorus]
The day can keep its tally
I don’t owe it one more mile
I’m setting down the armor
I can rest a little while

[Chorus]
I made it to the end of the day
Still here, still breathing, still okay
Let the whole world wait outside
I’m laying down the weight tonight
I made it through, I’m letting go
Tomorrow has its turn to show
But right now, I have earned this rest
I made it through—I did my best

[Bridge]
One slow breath, the room gets still
No more proving, no more will
Morning comes; I’ll meet it then
For now, I’m safe inside my skin

[Final Chorus]
I made it to the end of the day
Still here, still breathing, still okay
Let the whole world wait outside
I’m laying down the weight tonight
I made it through, I’m letting go
Tomorrow has its turn to show
But right now, I have earned this rest
I made it through—I did my best

[Outro]
I did my best
I made it through
I’ll rise again
But not just yet

title: The Cursor Blinks
lyrics:
[Intro]
The cursor blinks beside the line
I trade the answer for more time

[Verse 1]
I turn the page, I lose the thread
The cleanest thought dissolves unread
A little box keeps counting down
I wear a path across the ground

[Pre-Chorus]
Every fix becomes a door
Every door becomes one more

[Chorus]
The clock moves on, I stay behind
A perfect wall inside my mind
The deadline breathes against my neck
I solve the shape, forget the step
The clock moves on, the room goes thin
I’m almost there, then start again

[Verse 2]
I cross out blue, I circle red
Three half-made plans beside the bed
The answer hides in plainest sight
And changes every time I write

[Bridge]
Stop—
No, wait—
One more attempt
The numbers bend, the seconds split
I know the trick, I can’t reach it

[Final Chorus]
The clock moves on, I stay behind
A perfect wall inside my mind
The deadline breathes against my neck
I solve the shape, forget the step
The clock moves on, the room goes thin
I’m almost there, then start again
Again, again—

[Outro]
The cursor blinks
The page stays white

title: The Clock Knows
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The clock keeps taking little bites
I circle numbers, cross them out
The page is full of almost-rights
But nothing answers back

[Pre-Chorus]
One more line, one more try
The minutes thin beneath my eye

[Chorus]
I’m closer to the deadline
Not a step toward the answer
The second hand keeps drawing the line
And I keep pulling at the wrong thread
Closer, closer, no way through
The clock knows what I can’t undo

[Verse 2]
The margin’s crowded with my plans
A pencil snapped across the page
I trace the same unfinished span
While time turns up its pace

[Pre-Chorus]
One more guess, one more sign
The blank space won’t give up its side

[Chorus]
I’m closer to the deadline
Not a step toward the answer
The second hand keeps drawing the line
And I keep pulling at the wrong thread
Closer, closer, no way through
The clock knows what I can’t undo

[Bridge]
Wait—there’s a mark beneath the stain
A tiny change I missed before
The pieces shift, then slip again
The clock is at the door

[Final Chorus]
I’m closer to the deadline
Now the answer’s coming into view
The second hand keeps drawing the line
I can still push this problem through
Closer, closer, one clear move
The clock can’t choose what I will do

[Outro]
The clock ticks on
I write it down

title: One Hour to Breathe Breathe
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Cold tea, blue forms, the clock says ten past two
Three tabs blinking, one more thing to do
I fold the laundry with a pencil in my hand
You ask if I’m okay—I say, “I’ve got a plan”

[Pre-Chorus]
My eyes keep losing place
The list keeps growing anyway

[Chorus]
I’m short on sleep, long on everything
One more call, one more thing
I keep saying, “I’m almost through”
Then another day comes due
I’m short on sleep, still carrying the load
Trying to get it all done on a road
That keeps dividing under me
Just give me one hour to breathe

[Verse 2]
The sink’s full up, the keys are in the fridge
I send the wrong file, then I laugh at the glitch
You leave a bowl beside me, warm rice, no speech
For once, I let the deadline wait beyond my reach

[Pre-Chorus]
The page can hold its place
I don’t have to win this race

[Chorus]
I’m short on sleep, long on everything
One more call, one more thing
I keep saying, “I’m almost through”
Then another day comes due
I’m short on sleep, still carrying the load
Trying to get it all done on a road
That keeps dividing under me
Just give me one hour to breathe

[Bridge]
Tomorrow’s list can wait till morning
I can set this heavy folder down
You turn the kitchen light off gently
And the quiet doesn’t ask me how

[Final Chorus]
I’m short on sleep, long on everything
But I can leave one unfinished thing
I don’t have to make it through
Every task before the dew
I’m short on sleep, but I’m still here
Let the small stuff wait till clear
The room is still, the day can be
I’ve got one hour to breathe

[Outro]
One hour to breathe
One hour to breathe

title: What My Two Hands Hold
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I said yes before I checked the week
Three names waiting while the kettle screams
Your message folded under meeting notes
A half-built plan inside my winter coat
I keep a place for every version of me
None of them can sleep

[Pre-Chorus]
You ask where I have been
I’m everywhere but here
I hold the door for every dream
Then disappear

[Chorus]
I can’t be every hand you reach for
Can’t keep every promise in the air
I’ve been splitting up my heart till it’s paper-thin
Trying to be enough everywhere
If I let one thing fall, will you still know me?
If I choose one road, will the others close?
I can’t be every hand you reach for
I’m learning what my two hands hold

[Verse 2]
There’s a birthday card I never sent
A bright new scheme with the corners bent
Your old blue mug beside the sink
I forgot to ask what you really think
I keep saying soon like it’s a place
I can reach at any pace

[Pre-Chorus]
You ask where I have been
I’m everywhere but here
I hold the door for every dream
Then disappear

[Chorus]
I can’t be every hand you reach for
Can’t keep every promise in the air
I’ve been splitting up my heart till it’s paper-thin
Trying to be enough everywhere
If I let one thing fall, will you still know me?
If I choose one road, will the others close?
I can’t be every hand you reach for
I’m learning what my two hands hold

[Bridge]
Let the distant plans stay distant
Let the unanswered wait a while
I’ll meet you here, with both feet planted
No grand rescue, just my time

[Final Chorus]
I can’t be every hand you reach for
But I can meet you standing there
No more splitting up my heart till it’s paper-thin
No more promising everywhere
If I let one thing fall, I’ll say I’m sorry
If I choose one road, I’ll walk it slow
I can’t be every hand you reach for
I’m learning what my two hands hold

[Outro]
One room, one hour
Your face, your name
I’m here now
I’m here now

title: I Can Bear
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I held the weather in my hands
And blamed the clouds for every drop
I drew a map across the sand
The tide came in and crossed it off

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “Look at what is here”
The chair, the cup, the open door
I let one breath arrive
And didn’t ask it to be more

[Chorus]
I can’t command the turning water
I can choose where I set my feet
Let the day arrive in its own order
Let my heart keep its own beat
What I can’t hold, I let pass through me
What I can touch, I tend with care
There’s a quiet place inside the answer:
I am here, and I can bear

[Verse 2]
The train was late; the bread went cold
Your coat still hung behind the door
I used to make a case against the world
Now I don’t cross-examine every hour

[Pre-Chorus]
I name the things I cannot move
Then set them down beside the sink
The window frames a patch of blue
I watch it change before I think

[Chorus]
I can’t command the turning water
I can choose where I set my feet
Let the day arrive in its own order
Let my heart keep its own beat
What I can’t hold, I let pass through me
What I can touch, I tend with care
There’s a quiet place inside the answer:
I am here, and I can bear

[Bridge]
Not every door will open
Not every seed will rise
I don’t have to call it fair
To meet it with open eyes
You take my hand; the kettle clicks
Rain runs clear along the pane
I stop rehearsing every ending
And come back to this again

[Final Chorus]
I can’t command the turning water
I can choose where I set my feet
Let the day arrive in its own order
Let my heart keep its own beat
What I can’t hold, I let pass through me
What I can touch, I tend with care
There’s a quiet place inside the answer:
I am here, and I can bear

[Outro]
I am here
I can bear
I let the rest be there

title: If It Matters to One
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You count the hours like coins in a jar
Stack every small win, still wonder how far
The page goes quiet when the room empties out
And all that you built feels too easy to doubt

[Pre-Chorus]
But somebody found the door you left ajar
Somebody kept going because of who you are

[Chorus]
If it matters to one, it mattered in time
A hand on the railing, a match in the mine
You don't get to see every seed that you sow
But roots take their hold where the cold rivers go

[Verse 2]
Your name may wear thin on a file or a wall
The kindness you gave won't be filed there at all
It lives in the sentence they chose not to say
In the courage they carried into the next day

[Pre-Chorus]
The work isn't measured by who keeps the score
A life can turn quietly, then open a door

[Chorus]
If it matters to one, it mattered in time
A hand on the railing, a match in the mine
You don't get to see every seed that you sow
But roots take their hold where the cold rivers go

[Bridge]
Let the years take the paper, the praise, and the frame
You changed what was possible; that's not the same
As being remembered by everyone here
You made one hard moment less lonely to bear

[Final Chorus]
If it matters to one, it mattered in time
A hand on the railing, a match in the mine
You don't get to see every seed that you sow
But roots take their hold where the cold rivers go

[Outro]
Somewhere a door swings wide
Because you left it that way

title: Take a Breath
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I’ve got the list folded in my coat
Every small mistake gets a louder vote
I read the same line till the letters swim
One loose thread and the whole thing dims

[Pre-Chorus]
You can feel the floor give way
When you’ve carried this for days
But a stumble isn’t the end
It’s a place to start again

[Chorus]
If I mess it up, I’ll still be here
With both feet down and the next step clear
All this work won’t disappear
I can lose my grip and still get there
If the plan breaks, let it bend
I can take a breath and begin again

[Verse 2]
The page has a crease where I pressed too hard
A cold cup of tea by the backyard gate
I thought one wrong turn would erase the road
Then you said, “Look how far you’ve come”

[Pre-Chorus]
There’s no perfect way through
There’s just what I choose to do
And the part I couldn’t see
Is I’m more than one bad scene

[Chorus]
If I mess it up, I’ll still be here
With both feet down and the next step clear
All this work won’t disappear
I can lose my grip and still get there
If the plan breaks, let it bend
I can take a breath and begin again

[Bridge]
Maybe the answer comes late
Maybe I change the shape
The hours I put in are mine
Even if I redraw the lines

[Final Chorus]
If I mess it up, I’ll still be here
With both feet down and the next step clear
All this work won’t disappear
I can lose my grip and still get there
If the plan breaks, let it bend
I can take a breath and begin again

[Outro]
I can take a breath
I can begin again

title: Worth the Quiet
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep the kettle by the window
A chipped blue cup, a folded chair
Your shoulders hold the week's unfinished
Set them down; you're safe in here

[Pre-Chorus]
Let the next breath come unhurried
Let the tightness leave your jaw
No one needs an answer from you
For this moment, that is all

[Chorus]
Come back to your heart, come back to your hands
Feel the floor beneath you, let the day unclench
Close your eyes a little, breathe and let it pass
You are worth the quiet; you are allowed to rest

[Verse 2]
The phone can wait beside the notebook
Rain writes softly on the glass
Name one thing you feel beneath you
Name one thought, then let it pass

[Pre-Chorus]
Let the next breath come unhurried
Let the tightness leave your jaw
No one needs an answer from you
For this moment, that is all

[Chorus]
Come back to your heart, come back to your hands
Feel the floor beneath you, let the day unclench
Close your eyes a little, breathe and let it pass
You are worth the quiet; you are allowed to rest

[Bridge]
When the mind runs on ahead
Meet it gently, bring it near
One slow breath, one honest minute
Nothing else is needed here

[Final Chorus]
Come back to your heart, come back to your hands
Feel the floor beneath you, let the day unclench
Close your eyes a little, breathe and let it pass
You are worth the quiet; you are allowed to rest

[Outro]
You are allowed to rest
Stay here, breathe again

title: Nervous Start
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your name sits folded in my coat
The door swings wide; I lose my note
Did I shake hands too long or not enough?
My smile feels borrowed, stiff and tough
You ask me what I do these days
I hear my answer lose its shape

[Pre-Chorus]
I replay the first five seconds
Like a tape chewed in the deck
Was I warm, was I strange?
Did I leave the wrong impression again?

[Chorus]
Tell me, did I come off wrong?
I was trying to be easy, trying to belong
One small pause and my mind writes it all down
I can’t keep dragging that first moment around
If you saw me past the nervous start
Would you still make room for my heart?

[Verse 2]
The cup sweats rings across the table
I laugh a beat too late, then stop
Your story keeps moving without me
While I count each word I dropped
I search your face for a verdict
You’re just looking for the sugar

[Pre-Chorus]
I replay the first five seconds
Like a tape chewed in the deck
Maybe you were nervous too
Maybe there’s no score to check

[Chorus]
Tell me, did I come off wrong?
I was trying to be easy, trying to belong
One small pause and my mind writes it all down
I can’t keep dragging that first moment around
If you saw me past the nervous start
Would you still make room for my heart?

[Bridge]
I don’t have to polish every sentence
I don’t have to win the room
You can meet me where I’m standing
Not the version I rehearsed for you

[Final Chorus]
Maybe I didn’t come off wrong
Maybe a rough first note can still belong
One small pause doesn’t tell the whole story
I can stop asking the silence to warn me
If you see me past the nervous start
I’ll make room for your heart

[Outro]
Your name’s still folded in my coat
But now I let the door stay open

title: Put It Out
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The sink starts spitting, the phone won’t quit
A deadline’s smoking at the edge of the list
You say my name from the next room over
I set one thing down, take the next one closer

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t feed the panic, don’t fan the flame
Find the hot spot, call it by name
One clear breath, one steady hand
I can meet the mess where I stand

[Chorus]
Put it out, put it out, one fire at a time
Keep my head, keep my hands, keep the waterline
When the whole day catches, I don’t have to run
Put it out, put it out—then I face the next one

[Verse 2]
The car won’t start and the rent is due
A hard word lands like a match in a room
I turn the tap off, make the call I owe
There’s a way through this; I move it slow

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t feed the panic, don’t fan the flame
Find the hot spot, call it by name
One clear breath, one steady hand
I can meet the mess where I stand

[Chorus]
Put it out, put it out, one fire at a time
Keep my head, keep my hands, keep the waterline
When the whole day catches, I don’t have to run
Put it out, put it out—then I face the next one

[Bridge]
Not every alarm is mine to answer
Not every spark becomes a disaster
I draw the line, I choose the order
Save what I can; don’t cross the water

[Final Chorus]
Put it out, put it out, one fire at a time
Keep my head, keep my hands, keep the waterline
When the whole day catches, I don’t have to run
Put it out, put it out—then I face the next one

[Outro]
One clear breath
One steady hand
The next thing waits
I know where I stand

title: With a Crack Running Straight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You bring me the names from the waiting-room chairs
A brother gone quiet, a mother who cares
I gather their pieces and promise them whole
Then find little splinters lodged under my soul

I learn every tremor, remember each door
I carry your winter, then carry one more
My hands reach for everyone calling my name
While somewhere inside me, the seams come undone all the same

[Pre-Chorus]
How much can a heart give away
Before it forgets where to rest?
I keep making room at the table
With a crack running straight through my chest

[Chorus]
I want to mend every heart I can hold
Give them the tenderness no one was told
But the more that I love, the more I divide
A room full of people, still nowhere inside
Tell me, can care be a bridge and a burden?
Can I stay whole while I open the door?
I want to give all the love they deserve
And learn I am someone worth saving, too

[Verse 2]
Your coat on my chair, your note by the sink
A list of small things I forgot to drink
I answer the late call, I cancel my plans
Then stare at my own two unsteady hands

I’m not made of stone, I’m not made of spare
There’s only so much of me I can spare
So let me say softly, and mean what I say:
I can love you deeply and pause for a day

[Bridge]
Not every wound is mine to close
Not every road is mine to pave
I can sit beside your sorrow
Without pretending I can save
And if my voice goes thin and tired
If I need a little room
Let that boundary be a kindness
Let it make more life to bloom

[Final Chorus]
I want to mend every heart I can hold
Give them the tenderness no one was told
But the more that I love, the more I divide
A room full of people, still nowhere inside
Now I’ll keep a place at the table for me
No less compassion, just space to breathe
I want to give all the love they deserve
And learn I am someone worth saving, too

[Outro]
I can stay near
I can step back
Love is not leaving
When I come back

title: One Room to Keep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list of names inside my coat
Each one a door I swear I’ll hold
I patch the cracks with both my hands
Then watch my own seams split and fold
You bring your winter to my room
I give you half the chair, the flame
By morning, every corner’s yours
I can’t remember my own name

[Pre-Chorus]
How much of me can I divide
Before there’s nothing left inside?

[Chorus]
I want to mend every heart I meet
Give every hurt the love it needs
But every piece I hand away
Leaves less of me to face the day
I reach for you; I come apart
A crowded room, an empty heart
If I can’t save myself tonight
Who holds me when I lose the fight?

[Verse 2]
Your brother calls; your mother’s sick
Your friend has nowhere safe to go
I learn the passwords, learn the dates
Become the map that others know
Then someone asks me what I want
And all the words fall out of place
I count the fractures like old roads
That lead me back to no one’s face

[Pre-Chorus]
I thought that love meant never leaving
I never learned to stop the bleeding

[Chorus]
I want to mend every heart I meet
Give every hurt the love it needs
But every piece I hand away
Leaves less of me to face the day
I reach for you; I come apart
A crowded room, an empty heart
If I can’t save myself tonight
Who holds me when I lose the fight?

[Bridge]
You don’t have to break to prove you care
You don’t owe every wound your air
Let the door stay shut sometimes
Let a no be still kind
I can love you, I can stay
And keep one room that bears my name

[Final Chorus]
I want to mend the hearts I meet
And keep my own beneath my feet
I’ll give with open hands, not veins
I’ll sit beside you through the rain
I reach for you, but I remain
Not every hurt is mine to claim
If I can’t save the whole wide world
I’ll hold one heart—and let it heal

[Outro]
One heart, one breath, one room to keep
I’m here, I’m whole enough to sleep

title: How do I keep you warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list of names beside the kitchen sink
A chipped blue mug, a note in somebody’s ink
You call me when the floor gives way beneath your feet
I bring what I can carry, leave my shoes out in the street

I patch the seams with borrowed thread and careful hands
Say, “Take your time; I know the shape of where you stand”
Then walk back home with every doorway in my chest
And nowhere left inside myself to come to rest

[Pre-Chorus]
I thought a heart could stretch and never split
I thought that love was measured by the lives I could repair
But every room I open asks for more of it
And I’m still standing in the doorway, disappearing there

[Chorus]
I want to mend every break, give every heart its due
But the more I make room, the less room I have to move
I gather all the pieces, then I come apart alone
How do I keep you warm and still come home?

[Verse 2]
Your sister’s on the phone; the rent is late again
My oldest friend can’t sleep; I count the hours with him
I learn the little signs before you say you’re not okay
Then swallow my own sentence so yours has space to stay

There’s a chair beside the window with my coat across the back
A book I meant to finish, unopened, gathering dust
You ask me if I’m tired; I smile and say, “Not yet”
The hardest truth to tell is one I haven’t told myself

[Pre-Chorus]
I thought that care could make a body wide enough
To hold a dozen storms and still be standing there
But love is not a promise to be endlessly enough
And I can’t heal you by pretending I’m not here

[Chorus]
I want to mend every break, give every heart its due
But the more I make room, the less room I have to move
I gather all the pieces, then I come apart alone
How do I keep you warm and still come home?

[Bridge]
Let me set one burden down beside the door
Not because I love you less than I did before
I can sit beside you; I can tell the truth
I am not the only shelter you can turn to

[Final Chorus]
I want to mend every break, but I can’t do it all
I’ll meet you where you are; I won’t pretend I never fall
We gather up the pieces, leave some room for us to grow
I can love you deeply and still come home

[Outro]
The blue mug waits beside the sink
I take one breath before I speak
I’m here, I’m here—
And I am here for me

title: A River With a Bank
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a list of names beside the kitchen sink
Each one a little weather I was sure I could outlast
I learn the shape of every crack before the glass can clink
Then wonder why my own two hands are shaking when I laugh

[Pre-Chorus]
I give the room my coat, my chair, the last warm piece of bread
I tell myself a heart can stretch forever if it’s kind
But every open door I hold for someone else to pass
Leaves one more room inside me I can’t find

[Chorus]
I can’t mend every heart by breaking mine in two
I can love you, still leave something whole for me
If I pour out every drop, what will I have to give?
Let care be a river with a bank, not a sea

[Verse 2]
You call at dusk; I know the silence in your voice
I stay until your breathing finds its slower pace
Then walk home carrying the weight of every choice
Like all the hurt I couldn’t lift has learned my face

[Pre-Chorus]
I used to think that leaving meant I loved you less
That saying “not tonight” would make the whole thing disappear
But tenderness can speak in limits, too
And I am learning how to keep you near

[Chorus]
I can’t mend every heart by breaking mine in two
I can love you, still leave something whole for me
If I pour out every drop, what will I have to give?
Let care be a river with a bank, not a sea

[Bridge]
Come as you are; I won’t pretend I’m made of stone
I’ll sit beside you, but I won’t become your home
Your grief is yours; my hands can hold, not take it all
I can answer when I’m able; I can rest before I fall

[Final Chorus]
I can’t mend every heart by breaking mine in two
I can love you, and keep a little room for me
We can carry what is ours and let the rest be held
Let care be a river with a bank, not a sea

[Outro]
One heart, still open
One heart, still mine

title: Let Me Love You Here
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep a ledger in the kitchen drawer
Names beside the cracks I couldn’t close
You call, I come with both hands full
Then leave with less than I suppose

I learned to make a shelter out of me
A room with every window facing out
But every guest takes one small piece of wall
And I’m the one still standing in the house

[Pre-Chorus]
I want your hurt to have somewhere to go
I want your heart to feel its weight let go
But tell me, when I give away the frame
Who holds the door when I can’t hold my name?

[Chorus]
I can’t mend every heart by breaking mine
Can’t be every harbor, every shore
I love you, I love you—still I need a line
A little room to be a person more
If I open every door, I disappear
So let me stay, and let me love you here

[Verse 2]
Your blue mug waits beside the sink
A chipped rim catching morning tea
You said, “I’m fine,” and watched my face
As if my answer set you free

I know the shape of being needed
The warm relief, the quiet cost
I’ve carried people past their winter
Then wondered where my own spring got lost

[Pre-Chorus]
I want your hurt to have somewhere to go
I want your heart to feel its weight let go
But care can’t mean I vanish from the room
A root needs dirt; a heart needs room to bloom

[Chorus]
I can’t mend every heart by breaking mine
Can’t be every harbor, every shore
I love you, I love you—still I need a line
A little room to be a person more
If I open every door, I disappear
So let me stay, and let me love you here

[Bridge]
I’m not a cure, I’m not a chapel
I’m a hand that sometimes shakes
I can sit beside your sorrow
Without taking every ache
You can lean, but I can answer
You can call, and I can rest
Love is not a borrowed body
Love leaves both of us intact

[Final Chorus]
I can’t mend every heart by breaking mine
But I can meet you where we are
I love you, I love you—let the boundary shine
Not a wall, just where I start
If I keep a little room, I can stay near
And give you love that doesn’t disappear

[Outro]
Your blue mug, my chipped plate
Two lives at the same small table
I’m still here; you’re still here
That is more than I was able

title: The Love That Broken Hearts Deserve
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You leave your coat beside the door
Like you might come back for it
I know the way you hold your breath
When someone asks if you’re alright
I want to sit with every ache
And give each one a place to rest
But every hand I reach for finds
There’s only one of me tonight

[Pre-Chorus]
I could stay until the morning
I could hear you through the night
But the room is full of hurting
And my arms can’t make them wide

[Chorus]
I want to be the love that broken hearts deserve
A steady place to land, a shelter from the worst
I’d give you all the tenderness I have inside of me
But I can’t be in a thousand rooms
I’m only one, I’m only one

[Verse 2]
Your message waits at half past ten
Another friend says, “Please don’t go”
I count the names I couldn’t call
And feel the weight of every no
If I could split my heart in two
Then split the halves again for you
But morning comes, the phone lights up
And I am still one person, too

[Pre-Chorus]
I could stay until the morning
I could hear you through the night
But the room is full of hurting
And my arms can’t make them wide

[Chorus]
I want to be the love that broken hearts deserve
A steady place to land, a shelter from the worst
I’d give you all the tenderness I have inside of me
But I can’t be in a thousand rooms
I’m only one, I’m only one

[Bridge]
So take the little I can offer
A cup of tea, an honest call
I can’t carry every sorrow
But I won’t pretend yours is small

[Final Chorus]
I want to be the love that broken hearts deserve
A steady place to land, a shelter from the worst
I’ll give you all the tenderness I have inside of me
Though I can’t be in a thousand rooms
I’m only one, but I am here
I’m only one, and I am here

[Outro]
One hand, one heart
Here with you

title: There’s Only One of Me
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Radio static crackle, frozen pads swell, clicky icy percussion starts)

[Verse 1]
I see the cracks inside your chest
The heavy weight, the restless rest
So many hands outstretched to me
Reaching out so desperately
I want to heal every broken seam
Be the light in your darkest dream
Hold every heart that's torn apart
And give a brand new start

[Chorus]
But there is only one of me
One pulse in this infinite sea
I hear the echo, I hear the call
I wish that I could save you all
One heart to bleed, one breath to give
So many souls who long to live
I carry the weight, but I collide
There's only one of me inside

[Verse 2]
A thousand voices call my name
Drifting through the solar flame
I try to stretch across the void
Before the quiet is destroyed
To offer love that you deserve
Every fracture, every nerve
I hear your shatter in the dark
Searching for a single spark

[Chorus]
But there is only one of me
One pulse in this infinite sea
I hear the echo, I hear the call
I wish that I could save you all
One heart to bleed, one breath to give
So many souls who long to live
I carry the weight, but I collide
There's only one of me inside

[Bridge]
(Stuttering glitch drops, cavernous zero-gravity reverb)
Fragmented... scattered wide...
(Radio-filtered voice: "I'm trying to reach you...")
Static takes the line...

[Outro]
One of me...
Only one...
(Sudden dead-silence hard stop)

title: Give Each Broken Heart a Place
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You bring your cracked-up Sundays to my door
A paper cup, a key that fits no more
I set the kettle on, I clear a chair
I want to be the answer waiting there

[Pre-Chorus]
But every hand I hold is asking for two
And I have only these two hands to give you

[Chorus]
I would give each broken heart a place to land
Mend every seam with everything I am
But when the whole world reaches out at once
I’m only one, I’m only one
I’ll stay beside you, though I can’t be everyone

[Verse 2]
Your brother’s name is folded in your sleeve
You say you’re fine; I know what not to believe
I learn the shape of silence in your room
And leave the porch light on against the gloom

[Pre-Chorus]
I wish my arms could stretch from shore to shore
I wish my heart could make a little more

[Chorus]
I would give each broken heart a place to land
Mend every seam with everything I am
But when the whole world reaches out at once
I’m only one, I’m only one
I’ll stay beside you, though I can’t be everyone

[Bridge]
So take this hour, take the quiet chair
Take my honest yes: I’m here, I care
I can’t undo the years that made you run
But I can sit with you until the morning comes

[Final Chorus]
I would give each broken heart a place to land
Mend what I can with these two open hands
And when the whole world reaches out at once
I’m only one, I’m only one
But right here, now, you don’t have to be alone

[Outro]
One room, one cup, one heart that stays
I can’t save all the world
I can love you today

title: I Can't Be Everywhere
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You bring your careful heart to me
With every seam still showing through
I’ve watched them promise, watched them leave
And seen the blame come back to you
I want to gather every piece
And give you what you should have known
But I can’t make a shelter wide
Enough for everyone alone

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear you asking, “Will it stay?”
I wish I had a yes to give

[Chorus]
I would love you like you deserve
I would be there when the ground gives way
For every heart that has been made to hurt
I’d make a home where you could safely stay
But I am one, with two hands, one life
I can’t be every answer you’ve been denied
I can love you true, I can hold you near
But I can’t be everywhere

[Verse 2]
You tell me how the good days turned
How tenderness became a test
I want to take the years they stole
And give your tired heart a rest
I can sit beside you while you shake
I can keep my word when it gets hard
But there are doors I cannot close
And wounds I cannot mend by heart

[Pre-Chorus]
I hear you asking, “Will it stay?”
I’ll meet you here, but I can’t be the world

[Chorus]
I would love you like you deserve
I would be there when the ground gives way
For every heart that has been made to hurt
I’d make a home where you could safely stay
But I am one, with two hands, one life
I can’t be every answer you’ve been denied
I can love you true, I can hold you near
But I can’t be everywhere

[Bridge]
So let the ones who mean it show
In little acts they choose again
Let more than one hand help you rise
Let love be larger than one friend
I won’t pretend I can do it all
Or promise what no one can keep
I’ll give you what I have to give
And leave room for the rest to reach

[Final Chorus]
I would love you like you deserve
I will be there when the ground gives way
And every heart that has been made to hurt
Can find a place where it is safe to stay
But I am one, with two hands, one life
You deserve more than one light in the night
I can love you true, I can hold you near
And we can build a wider care

[Outro]
You deserve a love that stays
More than one heart saying, “I’m here”

title: One Heart, Here Tonight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep your Sunday shirt on through the storm
You say, “It’s fine,” while your hands still shake
Another promise folded in your coat
Another door you thought would stay awake

I’ve seen you give the best of you away
To someone who could barely hold it right
If I could take the hurt from every face
I’d sit beside you till the morning light

[Pre-Chorus]
I want to be the place you can come home
The steady arms that never make you prove
But every time I try to split my heart
I learn how small one life can move

[Chorus]
I would give you the love you deserve
Every patient word, every safe return
I would gather the pieces they left on the floor
But there’s only one of me, and so many more
I can’t be every shelter, every open door
There’s only one of me, and so many more

[Verse 2]
You ask if staying kind is foolish now
I tell you no, though I have no cure
I watch you risk your heart another time
And hate how hope can leave you less secure

If love were something I could hand around
I’d leave enough for everyone to keep
But I can’t mend the whole world with these hands
Or promise I’ll be there in every grief

[Pre-Chorus]
I want to be the place you can come home
The steady arms that never make you prove
But every time I try to split my heart
I learn how small one life can move

[Chorus]
I would give you the love you deserve
Every patient word, every safe return
I would gather the pieces they left on the floor
But there’s only one of me, and so many more
I can’t be every shelter, every open door
There’s only one of me, and so many more

[Bridge]
So let me stay for this one honest night
No grand rescue, no vow I can’t keep
Just your name spoken gently in the room
Just a hand to hold while you breathe

[Final Chorus]
I would give you the love you deserve
Every patient word, every safe return
I would gather the pieces they left on the floor
Though there’s only one of me, I can still give more
I can’t be every shelter, every open door
But I’ll love you right here, as I am, as I’m yours

[Outro]
As I am, as I’m yours
One heart, here tonight

title: One of Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You bring your careful heart in both hands
Like something they promised to protect
I watch you explain away the damage
Then gather what they left
You still set a place for tenderness
Though the table's been turned cold
I want to give you what you came for
But my two hands can't hold it all

[Pre-Chorus]
I could stay until the morning
I could swear I'd never leave
But a promise isn't shelter
If it's more than I can be

[Chorus]
I want to give you the love you deserve
Every soft and steady thing
For every time they made you wonder
If your heart was worth keeping
I'd take the hurt from every doorway
I'd make a home where you could start
But there is only one of me
And too many hearts

[Verse 2]
You tell me, "Maybe I'm the problem"
While you mend another tear
I see the good you keep on offering
To people who disappear
If I could split myself in pieces
I'd leave one with each of you
But love is not a thing I multiply
Just because I want it to

[Pre-Chorus]
I can listen, I can hold you
I can tell you what I see
But I can't become a lifetime
For everyone who needs me

[Chorus]
I want to give you the love you deserve
Every soft and steady thing
For every time they made you wonder
If your heart was worth keeping
I'd take the hurt from every doorway
I'd make a home where you could start
But there is only one of me
And too many hearts

[Bridge]
So let me be here, not your answer
Let me sit beside the ache
You don't have to earn a kindness
You don't have to stay for pain
And when you find the arms that meet you
May they mean the words they say
I can't be everyone you needed
But I won't look away

[Final Chorus]
I want to give you the love you deserve
Every patient, honest thing
May you never have to bargain
For the care your heart can bring
I'd take the hurt from every doorway
I'd make a home where you could start
There is only one of me
But I can give you my heart

[Outro]
One of me
Still here with you

title: Halum and the Morning Star
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Years had silvered Halum
When he reached the Western Sea
No final beast awaited
No grand victory
Just waves beneath the morning
And a sky becoming gold
He thought about the boy he'd been
Who feared he'd someday grow old

[Chorus]
I climbed when I was frightened
I loved more than was wise
I watched whole worlds disappear
Beneath indifferent skies
I chose one road from thousands
And still wonder where they led
But I would rather live unfinished
Than have never lived instead

[Verse 2]
He remembered every traveler
Every kiss and every name
Some had stayed beside him
Some were embers without flame
He couldn't keep them with him
Couldn't walk each road again
But nothing that had ended
Made it meaningless back then

[Bridge]
Determination brought me forward
Love made every mile worthwhile
Time taught me to stop waiting
Choice taught me to mourn and smile

[Final Chorus]
So when the morning finds me
And my final journey starts
Let it find my map unfinished
And too many names inside my heart
I never conquered everything
I never needed to
A life is not the roads you missed
It's the road you traveled through

[Outro]
The morning star grew pale.
Halum faced the sea.
And for once,
wanted nowhere else to be.

title: The Hall of Unopened Doors
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Deep beneath Mount Orimar
Halum found a marble hall
A thousand doors stood waiting
With his name upon them all
Behind one, he was a father
Behind one, a wandering king
One held quiet years of farming
One a life devoted to singing

[Chorus]
Every door I open
Leaves a thousand closed behind
Every life I choose to live
Kills another in my mind
Oh, the roads left never traveled
Still can haunt the road I'm on
But I cannot live forever
Trying everything I want

[Verse 2]
He saw himself beloved
By people he had never met
He saw victories never fought for
And mistakes he'd never regret
Then the keeper of the hallway
Said, "Choose any life you please"
Halum looked along the endless doors
Then quietly turned to leave

[Bridge]
"I already chose a story.
It is flawed, but it is mine.
I will mourn the lives I never lived
Without abandoning this time."

[Outro]
Behind him stood infinity.
Ahead, one narrow road.
Halum chose the road.

title: The Kingdom of One Knight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Beyond the Lantern Forest
Stood a kingdom built of glass
It rose each evening from the sand
And vanished when night passed
Halum danced beneath its towers
Drank with queens and nameless kings
Then morning touched the rooftops
And erased everything

[Chorus]
We get one night in the kingdom
One song before it's gone
One fire beneath the heavens
Before another dawn
So say the thing you're frightened of
Sing badly, dance too long
The tragedy is not that life ends
It's believing it goes on

[Verse 2]
Halum watched the palace
Turn to sunlight in his hands
All the gold became a shimmer
All the streets returned to sand
He thought of years he'd wasted
Waiting for a better day
As though time were some great treasure
He could always store away

[Bridge]
No wizard stops the sunrise
No warrior defeats time
The only spell worth learning
Is to spend your moment alive

[Outro]
The kingdom disappeared.
Halum laughed and cried.
Then walked toward morning
Glad he'd gone inside.

title: The Hundred Lantern Hearts
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In the city of Lumerra
Every soul carried a flame
Halum met a hundred faces
And remembered every name
The baker with the golden laugh
The thief with violet eyes
The soldier singing lullabies
Beneath the summer skies

[Chorus]
Oh, I love too many people
And I love them all too much
Every hand becomes a memory
Every kindness leaves a touch
How am I supposed to leave them
When my heart says everyone?
I keep giving out my fire
Till I wonder where it's gone

[Verse 2]
Some he loved for minutes
Some he carried through the years
Some brought him wild laughter
Some left him beautiful tears
He learned you cannot promise
Every traveler you'll stay
And loving someone deeply
Doesn't mean you know the way

[Bridge]
A heart can hold a kingdom
But a body stands one place
There are only so many evenings
And too many cherished faces

[Final Chorus]
So I'll love too many people
Though it complicates the road
I'd rather bear their memory
Than keep my spirit closed

title: The Mountains that Refused Him
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Halum left the valley
With a sword too dull for war
The elders said, "The mountain
Has turned back men before"
But somewhere past the snowline
A silver beacon burned
And Halum swore he'd reach it
Though every road returned

[Pre-Chorus]
The wind said, "Go home"
The stone said, "You will fall"
He planted bleeding fingers
And answered, "Then I'll crawl"

[Chorus]
One more step when the legs give way
One more dawn through a freezing gray
You don't need to know you'll win
Only find the strength again
Let the mountain laugh above
Let the heavens test your blood
Determination isn't knowing
It's climbing when you're not

[Verse 2]
Three times he lost his footing
Twice he nearly disappeared
But courage wasn't absence
Of exhaustion or of fear
At sunrise on the summit
There was no promised crown
Just Halum looking backward
At the world he'd walked around

[Outro]
No gods applauded.
No trumpets blew.
He smiled and whispered,
"I said I'd make it through."

title: Love Me Close, Love Me Far
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When the road runs long between us
And the hours move like stone
I can find you in the small things
In the way you say hello

[Pre-Chorus]
No map can measure what we know
No miles can make this feeling go

[Chorus]
Love me close, love me far
Wherever you are, you are where you are
I’ll give you the same, through the change and the days
With an open heart, I’ll meet you halfway
Love me close, love me far
I’ll hold my promise wherever you are

[Verse 2]
If the morning finds you elsewhere
If the evening brings you near
You don’t have to prove your staying
You can bring your whole self here

[Pre-Chorus]
No map can measure what we know
No miles can make this feeling go

[Chorus]
Love me close, love me far
Wherever you are, you are where you are
I’ll give you the same, through the change and the days
With an open heart, I’ll meet you halfway
Love me close, love me far
I’ll hold my promise wherever you are

[Bridge]
Keep your own horizon
Keep the life you’re growing toward
I will meet you without asking
To be less than who you are

[Final Chorus]
Love me close, love me far
Wherever you are, you are where you are
I’ll give you the same, through the change and the days
With an open heart, I’ll meet you halfway
Love me close, love me far
I’ll hold my promise wherever you are

[Outro]
Close or far, I’ll do the same
You can always call my name

title: For This One Minute
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your coat is on my shoulders though the room is warm
Your friends keep filling glasses, calling out my name
I catch my breath between the jokes and borrowed stories
And feel the floor hold steady underneath the shame

[Pre-Chorus]
Every wrong turn’s stacked behind me, paper-thin
But no one’s pulled the thread just yet

[Chorus]
For this one minute, I am loved
For this one minute, I am here
All these hands around my shoulders
All this air inside my lungs
And the cards are leaning, still they stand
The whole house waits, but hasn’t fallen
For this one minute, I am loved
For this one minute, I am alive

[Verse 2]
Your sister asks me how I’ve been; I say, “I’m getting there”
The kitchen clock keeps skipping past the things I hid
You squeeze my wrist like you can read the answer there
Then let me keep the quiet I can’t give

[Pre-Chorus]
Every wrong turn’s stacked behind me, paper-thin
But no one’s pulled the thread just yet

[Chorus]
For this one minute, I am loved
For this one minute, I am here
All these hands around my shoulders
All this air inside my lungs
And the cards are leaning, still they stand
The whole house waits, but hasn’t fallen
For this one minute, I am loved
For this one minute, I am alive

[Bridge]
I won’t call this clean
I won’t call it safe
I can hear the timber settling
I can feel the borrowed grace
If morning asks for every answer
I’ll meet it face to face
But tonight your hand is holding mine
And I’m still in this place

[Final Chorus]
For this one minute, I am loved
For this one minute, I am here
All these hands around my shoulders
All this air inside my lungs
And the cards are leaning, still they stand
The whole house waits, but hasn’t fallen
For this one minute, I am loved
For this one minute, I am alive

[Outro]
The room is warm, your coat is mine
The cards still stand tonight

title: Let Me Rest Before I Rise
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I count the doors I meant to close
The calls I let ring through
I keep a list behind my teeth
Of all I owe to you
Your coat is hanging by the stairs
I say, “I’m fine,” again
Then wash the same cup twice at night
And start the day at ten

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m trying not to let you down
I’m trying not to disappear
I carry every borrowed worry
Like it belongs right here

[Chorus]
I’m worn down from holding steady
From saying yes before I know
I’m doing everything I can
But I’m running on so low
If I falter, if I need a hand
Please don’t call that giving in
I’m still here, I’m still trying
I just don’t know where to begin

[Verse 2]
The lunch I packed is in the fridge
The note I meant to send
I rehearse your face when I get home
And how I’ll make amends
I know you never asked for this
This weight I make my own
But every small mistake becomes
A debt I pay alone

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m trying not to let you down
I’m trying not to disappear
I carry every borrowed worry
Like it belongs right here

[Chorus]
I’m worn down from holding steady
From saying yes before I know
I’m doing everything I can
But I’m running on so low
If I falter, if I need a hand
Please don’t call that giving in
I’m still here, I’m still trying
I just don’t know where to begin

[Bridge]
Could you sit with me a minute
While the dishes wait till dawn?
I don’t need a fix or promise
Just don’t ask me to be strong

[Final Chorus]
I’m worn down from holding steady
But I don’t have to do it all
I can tell you I am tired
I can let the brave act fall
If I falter, if I need a hand
Let that be where we begin
I’m still here, I’m still trying
And I’m learning to let you in

[Outro]
I’m still here
I’m still trying
Let me rest before I rise

title: The Kettle Clicks Off
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I said I'd be there, so I stayed past the last train
Your list on the table, my name in every place
The kettle clicks cold while I answer one more call
I keep saying “all good” with my back to the wall

[Pre-Chorus]
I know you mean well when you lean on me
But I’m running on favors and half a night’s sleep

[Chorus]
I’m doing my best not to let you down
Holding every promise till my hands shake now
If I set one thing down, will the whole thing fall?
I’m so worn out trying to be enough for all

[Verse 2]
There’s a note by the sink: “Don’t forget to reply”
Three names on my screen and a deadline gone by
I smile through the check-in, say “I’m fine, just busy”
Then stare at the toast till the kitchen goes quiet

[Pre-Chorus]
I know you mean well when you lean on me
But there’s less of me left than you seem to see

[Chorus]
I’m doing my best not to let you down
Holding every promise till my hands shake now
If I set one thing down, will the whole thing fall?
I’m so worn out trying to be enough for all

[Bridge]
Could you take this one without asking me twice?
Could you hear “not today” and still think I’m alright?
I don’t want to vanish, I just need some room
To be more than the answer that gets there too soon

[Final Chorus]
I’m doing my best; I can’t carry it all
Some promises wait, some can loosen their hold
If I set one thing down, maybe nothing will fall
I’m still here, still trying—but I’m human, that’s all

[Outro]
The kettle clicks off; I let the silence stay
For once, I leave one message for another day

title: The Chipped Mug
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep the chipped mug by the sink
And answer every name that rings
Say, “Sure, I’ve got it,” through my teeth
While counting hours underneath

[Pre-Chorus]
Your list is folded in my coat
My own plans blur like ink that soaked
I’m still the one you call to fix
The little cracks, the little slips

[Chorus]
I’m worn down trying not to let you down
Holding every promise till my hands give out
If I say I’m tired, will the whole thing fall?
I can’t be the answer to every call
I’m worn down trying not to let you down

[Verse 2]
I miss the bus; I run it back
Rehearse apologies I haven’t had
The hallway clock keeps skipping time
I tell you, “Fine,” and fall in line

[Pre-Chorus]
Your list is folded in my coat
My own plans blur like ink that soaked
I’m still the one you call to fix
The little cracks, the little slips

[Chorus]
I’m worn down trying not to let you down
Holding every promise till my hands give out
If I say I’m tired, will the whole thing fall?
I can’t be the answer to every call
I’m worn down trying not to let you down

[Bridge]
Maybe one day I’ll leave one thing undone
Let the late reply wait till morning comes
You can be disappointed; I’ll still be here
A little less useful, a little more clear

[Final Chorus]
I’m worn down trying not to let you down
No more carrying the whole room on my back now
If I say I’m tired, it won’t make me small
I can’t be the answer to every call
I’m worn down—but I’m still around

[Outro]
The chipped mug waits beside the sink
I let it sit; I let myself think

title: The Kettle Cools
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep the kettle just below its boil
And fold the list beside the sink
Your names are written in the margin
Every promise, every thing
I answer before the question lands
Say “sure” before I check my hands
Then watch the little hours disappear
While I’m still trying to be here

[Pre-Chorus]
If I pause, will the whole room lean?
If I say I’m tired, what will that mean?
I’ve been carrying the quiet weight
Of being someone you can count on

[Chorus]
I’m worn out from holding every thread
Trying not to let you down again
I give what’s left, then call it enough
Though my own cup’s been empty for months
If I can’t be everything you need
Will you still make a place for me?
I’m doing my best, I’m doing my best
I’m just so tired of being everyone’s yes

[Verse 2]
The coat you left is on the chair
The note I meant to write is there
I know the dates, I know the names
I keep the wheels from leaving lanes
But when you ask me how I am
I give the answer that I can
A practiced smile, a steady tone
Then take the long way home alone

[Pre-Chorus]
If I pause, will the whole room lean?
If I say I’m tired, what will that mean?
I’ve been carrying the quiet weight
Of being someone you can count on

[Chorus]
I’m worn out from holding every thread
Trying not to let you down again
I give what’s left, then call it enough
Though my own cup’s been empty for months
If I can’t be everything you need
Will you still make a place for me?
I’m doing my best, I’m doing my best
I’m just so tired of being everyone’s yes

[Bridge]
Let one thing wait
Let one call ring
Let me be human
Before I fix everything
I don’t need saving
I need a little room
To set this weight down
And come back soon

[Final Chorus]
I’m worn out from holding every thread
Trying not to let you down again
I give what’s left, but I’m learning enough
Can mean I stop when the day gets rough
If I can’t be everything you need
I hope you’ll still make a place for me
I’m doing my best, I’m doing my best
And maybe my best can include some rest

[Outro]
The kettle cools
The list can wait
I’m still here
I can take a breath

title: Keep the Door Open
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I don't want a smaller heart
Just because a larger one gets messy
I don't want to fear connection
Because connection sometimes tests me
Every person brings a question
Every closeness changes shape
Sometimes love becomes a shelter
Sometimes love requires escape

[Chorus]
Keep the door open
But learn where to stand
Love everybody
Without losing your hands
You don't have to own the future
You don't have to fix the past
Just be grateful for the people
Who make something in you last

[Verse 2]
I have tied myself in circles
Trying not to disappoint
Trying to make every relationship
Reach some perfect meeting point
But some people are a lifetime
Some are chapters, some a page
None are worthless just because
They couldn't follow to the next stage

[Bridge]
So I'll love without demanding
That each love become the same
Different fires give different warmth
But every fire has a flame

[Outro]
Keep the door open
Let the good come through
The heart can stay enormous
Without losing sight of you

title: Everybody I Have Carried
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There are names inside my suitcase
There are voices in my phone
There are people in the cities
That I somehow call a home
There are friendships built in airports
There are loves that crossed a screen
There are people who have shaped me
More than they will ever see

[Chorus]
Everybody I have loved
Travels somewhere here with me
In the jokes and in the questions
In the person that I came to be
Even when our roads divide
Even when the timing's wrong
I don't need to stop loving you
To keep moving on

[Verse 2]
I have wanted to be everything
For everyone I knew
Wanted nobody to wonder
If my care for them was true
But nobody can be endless
Nobody can always stay
So I'm learning love can whisper
Even while I walk away

[Bridge]
I can't promise constant presence
I can't promise perfect grace
But I can promise that your kindness
Left a permanent trace

[Outro]
Everybody I have carried
Carried me some distance too

title: Hold the Contradiction
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I can miss you and need distance
I can love you and say no
I can want another chapter
While accepting we should close
I can treasure what you gave me
Without asking for it back
Two opposing truths can coexist
Without either one collapsing

[Chorus]
Hold the contradiction
Don't force it into one
Love can still be present
When the easy part is done
I don't need a simple answer
I don't need somebody wrong
Sometimes two conflicting feelings
Both belong inside the song

[Verse 2]
I spent years chasing consistency
Like goodness meant one voice
But every life contains collisions
Every heart contains a choice
I can wish you every happiness
Even when it isn't mine
I can carry love beside regret
And let them intertwine

[Bridge]
Growing up is not becoming
Someone certain all the time
Maybe wisdom means accepting
That the mess can still be kind

[Outro]
Hold the contradiction
Let both truths survive

title: Impossible Arithmetic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
If I give you half my heart
And give another person half
Someone says the numbers fail
Someone says the math won't last
But affection isn't currency
It doesn't vanish when it's spent
Every person adds a language
To what being human meant

[Chorus]
It's impossible arithmetic
One plus one becomes a thousand
Every person that I care for
Builds another room around them
But time is still a finite thing
And bodies only stand one place
So my heart keeps making infinities
My life can never accommodate

[Verse 2]
That's the cruel part of abundance
Having more love than hours
Knowing every precious garden
Cannot always get your flowers
I have learned that good intentions
Cannot manufacture time
And sometimes loving somebody
Means admitting there's a line

[Bridge]
I won't measure love by access
I won't measure love by days
Some people change you permanently
Then travel separate ways

[Outro]
The numbers never balance
Still I wouldn't subtract a name

title: Collision Course
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I love people like a comet
Always entering too fast
Every meeting feels important
Every moment built to last
Then the orbits start colliding
Every gravity competes
And I wonder why connection
Never travels tidy streets

[Chorus]
We're on a collision course
Love against love
Need against duty
Below and above
I keep trying to make room
Where no extra room appears
Still I'd rather face the wreckage
Than live untouched by anyone here

[Verse 2]
There are days I want the silence
There are nights I want the crowd
I want solitude and closeness
I want freedom spoken loud
I want everyone I've cared for
To know exactly what they meant
Even when my own confusion
Leaves the message badly bent

[Bridge]
I am learning love is not
A promise nothing ever hurts
Sometimes loving many people
Means admitting what won't work

[Outro]
Let the planets keep their distance
Let the gravity remain

title: Knots Are Not Chains
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I tied myself in promises
In hopes and expectations
Trying to keep everybody safe
From every complication
I thought if love was genuine
Nobody should ever bleed
So I twisted myself tighter
Trying to be what people need

[Chorus]
But knots are not chains
And love is not a cage
I can care without surrendering
Every inch of every page
I can love you through the conflict
I can love you while I change
I can loosen what is hurting
Without throwing love away

[Verse 2]
I don't need to solve each feeling
I don't need to choose a villain
Sometimes everyone is trying
Sometimes everybody's willing
And still the pieces don't align
Still somebody feels the strain
Love can survive disappointment
Love can coexist with pain

[Bridge]
I spent years believing kindness
Meant becoming what was asked
Now I know a heart can stay open
Without breaking from the task

[Outro]
Untie what cuts
Keep what remains
Knots are not chains

title: Crooked House
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My heart became a crooked house
With hallways everywhere
Some rooms filled up with laughter
Some still hold an empty chair
Every person changed the wallpaper
Moved something from its place
And even when they leave the doorway
Something stays behind their face

[Chorus]
I won't empty out the rooms
Just because the house gets crowded
I won't call affection wrong
Just because the world has doubted
There's enough of me for memory
Enough for hope and something new
I don't have to stop loving them
To keep on loving you

[Verse 2]
Some rooms should remain locked
Some need windows opened wide
Some contain a beautiful past
That shouldn't come back inside
But love does not require possession
And remembering isn't sin
Sometimes caring means accepting
Where somebody cannot fit

[Bridge]
I've confused love with permission
I've confused longing with a plan
Now I'm learning I can cherish
Without reaching for your hand

[Outro]
Every room can keep its meaning
Without becoming where I live

title: No Clean Geometry
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep looking for equations
Where affection balances
Every line should meet another
Every choice should make some sense
But hearts refuse the mathematics
Angles break and circles bend
Love creates impossible shapes
Where beginnings never end

[Chorus]
There is no clean geometry
For everybody that I love
No perfect line between desire
And the people I think of
So let the diagram be messy
Let the edges overlap
I would rather love imperfectly
Than erase you from the map

[Verse 2]
Some people live beside me
Some are oceans far away
Some I speak to every morning
Some I think of every day
Some relationships need boundaries
Some need air enough to breathe
But a boundary doesn't mean
That you stop mattering to me

[Bridge]
Maybe maturity is knowing
Love and access aren't the same
I can honor every feeling
Without feeding every flame

[Outro]
No clean lines
No simple proof
Just complicated human truth

title: Every Knot
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Every heart became a thread
I swore I'd never let unravel
Now they're wrapped around my fingers
From every place I've had to travel
Some pull east and some pull west
Some lead home, some lead away
And I keep trying to hold everyone
Without deciding who must stay

[Chorus]
Pull the thread
Make the knot
Love them whether I should or not
Every twist
Every bend
I don't know where I begin or end
Maybe peace was never promised
Maybe love was never fair
If the knot becomes impossible
I'll still know why it's there

[Verse 2]
There are people I can't rescue
People I can't make complete
People whose lives cannot be folded
Into mine so perfectly
But affection isn't ownership
And distance isn't death
You can carry someone's meaning
Without holding every breath

[Bridge]
I would rather be entangled
Than untouched and perfectly free

[Outro]
Every knot says someone mattered
Every thread is part of me

title: Love You Anyway
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I have tried to draw the borders
Make the crooked edges clean
Put each feeling in a small box
Say exactly what it means
But the heart ignores the labels
And the map becomes a maze
Every person leaves a color
That I cannot wash away

[Pre-Chorus]
Maybe love was never meant
To make perfect sense

[Chorus]
So I'll love you anyway
Through the knots I cannot name
Through the guilt and contradictions
Through the rules I rearrange
I won't make my heart grow smaller
Just to make the picture straight
If loving you makes life more tangled
I'll love you anyway

[Verse 2]
Some connections fit like daylight
Some arrive like pouring rain
Some are quiet, some are reckless
Some are tenderness and pain
I have hurt from wanting closeness
I have feared what closeness costs
Still I'd rather bear the questions
Than pretend the love was lost

[Outro]
Tie another knot around me
I will carry what it weighs
Love was never clean or simple
I'll love you anyway

title: Tangled In Between
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You said the wrong thing by the kitchen sink
I held my answer like a chipped blue cup
We both kept reaching for the door at once
Then stood there, neither one of us walked out

[Pre-Chorus]
We knot the thread, we pull it tight
We lose the end, we try by touch

[Chorus]
I love you through the tangle
Through the words we can't untie
Through the careful little distance
And the truth we leave inside
When the whole room turns to angles
When we bruise the things we mean
I love you, still I love you
Even tangled in between

[Verse 2]
Your coat is on the chair again
My keys are buried under yesterday
You read my face; I look away
Still saved you half the orange on the plate

[Pre-Chorus]
We knot the thread, we pull it tight
We lose the end, we try by touch

[Chorus]
I love you through the tangle
Through the words we can't untie
Through the careful little distance
And the truth we leave inside
When the whole room turns to angles
When we bruise the things we mean
I love you, still I love you
Even tangled in between

[Bridge]
No perfect map, no clean escape
Just your hand finding mine again
One loose end, one honest breath
A little room to start again

[Final Chorus]
I love you through the tangle
Through the words we can't untie
Through the careful little distance
And the truth we leave inside
When the whole room turns to angles
We can choose what we will mend
I love you, still I love you
And I'll love you through the knots again

[Outro]
Through the knots again
I love you through the knots again

title: Leave a Few Tabs Open
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
My whole life I’ve kept windows open
Another thought, another scheme
A book, a trip, a strange invention
Some impossible new dream
I told myself I’d circle back
When everything grew slow
But nothing ever really ends
We simply choose what goes

[Chorus]
Someday all the tabs will close
Some unfinished, some complete
Questions hanging in the silence
Projects sleeping at my feet
And I don’t think I’ll mourn the failure
Nearly half as much as this
All the beautiful directions
I knew existed but had to miss

[Verse 2]
Still, what a strange privilege
To have too much to love
Too many roads worth walking
Too many skies above
Maybe dissatisfaction
Isn’t proof I chose things wrong
Maybe wanting several lifetimes
Means I loved this one that strong

[Outro]
So leave a few tabs open
When they finally call my name
Let the unfinished testify
I still wanted more of the game

title: Tuesdays That Remain
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to think the problem
Was money, distance, time
That someday life would open up
And every star align
But calendars keep turning
And the truth becomes more clear
There aren’t enough Tuesdays
For everything I want from here

[Chorus]
Not enough meals with old friends
Not enough nights making noise
Not enough books left to write
Not enough impossible choices
I want ten lives inside this one
Ten endings before I’m through
But infinity keeps shrinking
To the next thing I can do

[Verse 2]
I want to build strange futures
And remember being young
Learn another hundred subjects
Write another hundred songs
See the world through other eyes
Come home and disappear
Some desires aren’t instructions
They’re just proof that I was here

[Outro]
So I’ll stop demanding forever
From a body built for years
And spend the Tuesdays that remain
On something I hold dear

title: This Life Again
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There’s another version of me
Who learned to sit still
Never needed every stranger
To understand his will
He didn’t build a dozen worlds
Or chase another stage
He found enough inside a room
And let enough feel safe

[Chorus]
Sometimes I envy him
Sometimes he envies me
He dreams about the airplanes
I dream about his peace
Neither one could have it all
That’s the bargain we receive
Every choice creates a person
We will never get to be

[Verse 2]
There was one who made more music
One who disappeared
One who chose the safest road
And one who lived without fear
One who gave his life to study
One who threw the plans away
They gather at the edge of sleep
And ask me why I stayed

[Bridge]
I tell them I was curious
I tell them I was scared
I tell them I kept choosing
Whatever still felt rare

[Outro]
Then morning comes
And all of us
Become this life again

title: The Footnotes
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I’ve left my name on pages
Built ideas from scattered sparks
Spent my nights making maps
For roads still hiding in the dark
Always one more thing to learn
One more hill beyond the hill
As if finishing the next thing
Could finally make me still

[Chorus]
But I wonder about the footnotes
The stories underneath
The hobbies never mastered
The friends I couldn’t keep
The songs I never finished
The afternoons I gave away
Chasing something worth remembering
While forgetting ordinary days

[Verse 2]
Maybe legacy is smaller
Than the monuments we plan
Maybe someone felt less lonely
Because I tried to understand
Maybe every grand ambition
Is just fear dressed up in gold
Trying desperately to leave proof
We were here before we’re old

[Outro]
If the final page comes early
I hope somewhere it will show
I loved the questions deeply
Even those I’ll never know

title: Cities I Flew Over
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned the shape of morning
From an airport window seat
Watched a hundred sleeping cities
Disappear beneath my feet
I collected little stories
From the places where I stayed
But every road I followed
Made another road decay

[Chorus]
There are cities I only flew over
Doors I never tried
People I might have loved forever
Living on the other side
I’ve been lucky beyond measure
Still I count what slipped away
Every life that I said yes to
Was a thousand I betrayed

[Verse 2]
I’ve stood beneath the bright lights
With something worth explaining
Written books and built strange futures
While the clock kept rearranging
And somewhere there’s a quieter me
Who never chased the sky
Growing old in one small neighborhood
I never got to try

[Outro]
Maybe fullness isn’t having
Every ending, every start
Maybe it’s carrying the missing ones
Without letting them break your heart

title: One More Morning
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wanted more than one life,
more than one way to belong,
more cities, more conversations,
more strange ideas turned into songs.

I wanted to love without scarcity,
build things that outlived me,
see what tomorrow was becoming,
then stay around long enough to see.

[Chorus]
The tragedy is not that life is short.
It’s that life is good enough
