[Pre-Chorus]
I made a promise, then I made a plan
Both need my hands; I am only one man

[Chorus]
I want a life that fits the shape of me
I want to stay for all the ones I love
When every road pulls hard in opposite ways
I carry them, and still I reach for more
If happiness is somewhere I can stand
Let it make room for every heart I am

[Verse 2]
Your blue cup waits beside the kitchen sink
A school note curls beneath the grocery list
I say, “I’m here,” and mean it every time
Then hear the other life call from inside

[Pre-Chorus]
The good in me keeps watch beside the bed
The selfish one keeps naming what I need

[Chorus]
I want a life that fits the shape of me
I want to stay for all the ones I love
When every road pulls hard in opposite ways
I carry them, and still I reach for more
If happiness is somewhere I can stand
Let it make room for every heart I am

[Bridge]
I will not call my wanting a betrayal
I will not call my duty all I am
You are not weights I drag behind my living
You are the hands that steady where I stand
And if I stumble choosing how to balance
Come close; I’ll listen, and begin again

[Final Chorus]
I want a life that fits the shape of me
I want to stay for all the ones I love
No clean divide between the heart and hunger
No perfect answer written up above
If happiness is somewhere we can stand
Let it make room for every heart we are

[Outro]
Your blue cup waits; I’ll wash it when I’m home
I’m still becoming. I am not alone.

title: A Little Room to Breathe
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I make a list beside the sink
Of every promise left to keep
Your lunchbox waits beside the keys
While my own plans go stale and sleep

[Pre-Chorus]
One face says, “Stay. They need you here.”
One face says, “Leave before you disappear.”
I hear them arguing through my teeth
Both wearing my name underneath

[Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
I want your hand still holding mine
I’m not a saint, I’m not a thief
I’m trying to make room for all I love and all I need

[Verse 2]
The calendar is crowded blue
A school-night call, a late bill due
I laugh too loud, then miss the cue
And hate the hurt I hand to you

[Pre-Chorus]
The selfish voice keeps score of days
The kinder one still knows your face
They trade the wheel, they pull me wide
I’m trying not to choose a side

[Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
I want your hand still holding mine
I’m not a saint, I’m not a thief
I’m trying to make room for all I love and all I need

[Bridge]
If I say yes, I lose a piece
If I say no, I bruise the ones I keep
So take this honest, unfinished heart
I can’t be whole by coming apart

[Final Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
I want your hand still holding mine
No perfect answer, no clean release
Just all of us, and a little room to breathe

[Outro]
A little room to breathe
Stay close while I learn to leave
One promise kept, one want confessed
I love you all; I’m still becoming myself

title: Make Room for Truth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I make a list beside the sink
Of all the things I said I'd do
The pen runs dry; the kettle clicks
And every promise points to you

[Pre-Chorus]
One face says, give what they need
One says, there's nothing left to give
I keep them both behind my teeth
And try to choose the way I live

[Chorus]
I want a life that fits my hands
Not one I have to hide away
But every name I love is written
In the plans I can't erase
If I pull toward the open door
I still carry all of you
I am not choosing less love
I'm trying to make room for truth

[Verse 2]
Your jacket hangs beside the stairs
A small shoe waits beneath the chair
I hear you laughing down the hall
And hate that I could want elsewhere

[Pre-Chorus]
The kinder voice says stay awhile
The hungry one says don't go numb
I won't call either one a lie
They both know where I'm coming from

[Chorus]
I want a life that fits my hands
Not one I have to hide away
But every name I love is written
In the plans I can't erase
If I pull toward the open door
I still carry all of you
I am not choosing less love
I'm trying to make room for truth

[Bridge]
Let the good one speak
Let the selfish one be heard
Neither gets the whole of me
Neither gets the final word
I can love you and want change
I can grieve and still begin
Hold the door, don't call it leaving
There's a life I need to live

[Final Chorus]
I want a life that fits my hands
And room for everyone I love
No clean escape, no perfect answer
Just the next small honest step
If I pull toward the open door
I still carry all of you
I am not choosing less love
I'm trying to make room for truth

[Outro]
The list stays on the counter
The kettle settles down
Tomorrow I'll make one true choice
And let it be enough for now

title: Keeper and the Runaway
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I make a list beside the sink
Of all the things I said I'd do
The paper curls beneath the glass
While every line pulls me from you

[Pre-Chorus]
One hand holds tight to what is owed
One hand reaches past the door
Both are mine, both know your name
Both keep asking me for more

[Chorus]
I am the keeper and the runaway
The steady voice, the storm that won't sit still
I want the life that waits beyond these walls
And I love the ones I'm standing here with still
If I can't make the pieces all agree
Let every piece keep reaching back to me

[Verse 2]
Your coat is hanging by the stairs
The little shoes are turned around
I hear you laughing in the next room
And feel the miles inside this house

[Pre-Chorus]
I count the cost, I count the years
I count the faces that I love
The selfish self says, “Choose your own way”
The kinder one says, “Stay enough”

[Chorus]
I am the keeper and the runaway
The steady voice, the storm that won't sit still
I want the life that waits beyond these walls
And I love the ones I'm standing here with still
If I can't make the pieces all agree
Let every piece keep reaching back to me

[Bridge]
I won't call care a chain
I won't call wanting wrong
I'll carry both the promise and the ache
Until the two can walk along

[Final Chorus]
I am the keeper and the runaway
The steady voice, the storm that won't sit still
I want a life that leaves room for us all
And love the ones who make this life feel real
If I can't make the pieces all agree
I'll build a wider place for you and me

[Outro]
The list can wait beside the sink
I hear your footsteps; I come in

title: Room for Every Name
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I leave your lunch beside the sink
The list is folded in my sleeve
A dozen promises all tug
At the one life I can barely see

[Pre-Chorus]
One of me keeps every light on
One of me wants the door unlatched
I hear them arguing in my head
Both of them afraid to lose what lasts

[Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
I want to keep you close and safe
I’m not choosing who I love
I’m trying to find room for every name
When the good one and the greedy one collide
I’ll hold the people I can’t leave behind

[Verse 2]
Your note is waiting by the keys
The school shoes crowd the hallway floor
I picture roads I haven’t taken
Then come back when you call my name once more

[Pre-Chorus]
One of me says, “You owe them everything”
One of me says, “You’re disappearing”
They share the same tired face at night
And both still want the ones worth keeping

[Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
I want to keep you close and safe
I’m not choosing who I love
I’m trying to find room for every name
When the good one and the greedy one collide
I’ll hold the people I can’t leave behind

[Bridge]
If I ask for more, I’m not asking less of you
If I need a change, it doesn’t make our years untrue
Let the plan bend; let the hard truth breathe
I can want a different road and still want you with me

[Final Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
And I want you laughing at the table
I’m not choosing who I love
I’m learning what I can carry, what I’m able
When the good one and the greedy one collide
I’ll make a little room on either side
I’ll hold the people I can’t leave behind

[Outro]
Not gone, not yours to own
Still here, still finding home

title: Learning Where I End
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep two portraits folded in my coat
One offers bread, one counts what I am owed
You ask me how I’m doing; I say, “Fine”
While both of them are arguing in my mind

[Pre-Chorus]
The calendar is crowded with the lives I promised to protect
The door I want is open, but I’m scared of what I’d wreck

[Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
I want to keep you all beside me
The kinder hand, the grasping hand
Both reach for what I can’t divide
I’m trying to make room for joy
Without becoming someone’s loss
I love you more than I can say
And still I want to choose my own way

[Verse 2]
Your lunchbox waits beside the unpaid bills
A friend calls twice; I know I should call back
I mean to stay, I mean to leave, I mean
To be the one who never lets you crack

[Pre-Chorus]
I’ve made a home of every “yes” I couldn’t take away
Now every “maybe” sounds like someone I might betray

[Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
I want to keep you all beside me
The kinder hand, the grasping hand
Both reach for what I can’t divide
I’m trying to make room for joy
Without becoming someone’s loss
I love you more than I can say
And still I want to choose my own way

[Bridge]
If I step back, will you call it leaving?
If I stay, will I forget my name?
I can love you without disappearing
I can change and still be yours the same

[Final Chorus]
I want a life that feels like mine
I want to keep you all beside me
No perfect self will settle this
No clean escape, no flawless plan
I’ll take the next small honest step
And tell you where I truly stand
I love you more than I can say
Let’s find a way that holds us all

[Outro]
Not gone, not gone
Just learning where I end
Still here, still yours
And learning to begin

title: what a whole heart can keep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep two portraits face down on the table
One gives the last piece, one counts what it cost
You say my name from the next room, softly
I’m here, I’m here, though I’m split and lost

[Pre-Chorus]
The calendar fills up in blue ink
The life I want waits at the edge of the page
I love every hand that is holding me close
Still feel my own heart press against the cage

[Chorus]
I want to be kind, I want to be free
I want all the people I love to feel safe with me
When the good in me falters, when the selfish one speaks
Stay near while I learn what a whole heart can keep

[Verse 2]
Lunch boxes, keys, a promise for Friday
Your coat on the hook, the bills by the door
I picture a road with no names to remember
Then turn back because you matter more

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m tired of judging the voice in my head
As if one must be saint and the other a thief
Can both be afraid, both want to be seen
Can I make room for the want and the grief?

[Chorus]
I want to be kind, I want to be free
I want all the people I love to feel safe with me
When the good in me falters, when the selfish one speaks
Stay near while I learn what a whole heart can keep

[Bridge]
I can’t give every promise my whole life
I can’t call every longing a lie
If I choose a small door, I still choose you
If I need some air, I’m not saying goodbye

[Group Chant]
Still here, still yours
Still mine, still learning
Still here, still yours
The room keeps turning

[Final Chorus]
I want to be kind, I want to be free
I want all the people I love to feel safe with me
When the good in me falters, when the selfish one speaks
Stay near while I learn what a whole heart can keep

[Outro]
The page stays open
Your coat stays there
I take one breath
And meet you halfway

title: Static Between Answers
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Some mornings I know exactly
who I am and what I need.
By evening every certainty
is tangled up with doubt and greed.

I can argue both directions,
make a case for every road.
Too many truths inside me
and they all demand control.

[Chorus]
There’s static between answers,
noise between the yes and no.
Every part of me is certain
that the other parts should go.

I want freedom, I want duty.
I want comfort, I want change.
I want everybody near me,
then I need to get away.

[Verse 2]
And I hate when my confusion
turns into somebody’s pain.
They deserve a steady shelter,
not my constantly shifting rain.

[Bridge]
Maybe wisdom isn’t certainty.
Maybe clarity takes time.
But I can own the consequences
while I sort out what is mine.

[Final Chorus]
There’s static between answers,
but I’m learning how to hear.
Not every contradiction
has to disappear.

title: Roots and Runways
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
One voice tells me, “Build a home.”
One says, “Book another flight.”
One wants Sunday morning silence.
One wants cities every night.

I want someone who can know me,
I want freedom at the door.
Every time I choose one future
I start grieving ten more.

[Chorus]
I want roots and I want runways,
I want stillness, I want speed.
I want everything I’ve dreamed of,
even when those dreams disagree.

And I know my indecision
doesn’t only live in me.
Every time I change direction
someone else loses their certainty.

[Bridge]
Maybe life is not one answer.
Maybe balance shifts with time.
But I owe the ones who love me
more than chaos dressed as “mine.”

[Final Chorus]
I want roots and I want runways.
Maybe both can somehow fit.
I just have to stop pretending
there is no cost to choosing it.

title: The Version I Perform
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I know how to look certain,
how to make the whole room laugh,
how to speak like every question
already has an answer mapped.

But underneath the confidence
there’s a kid still keeping score,
wondering if they’d stay around
if I stopped being more.

[Chorus]
Do they love me
or the version I perform?
The loud one, the strong one,
the shelter in the storm?

I want to be admired,
I want to be understood,
but sometimes chasing validation
makes me worse when I mean good.

[Verse 2]
I can feel my ego rising
when I’m scared I might be small.
Then I hate myself for needing
to feel important at all.

[Bridge]
Maybe pride can be a doorway
without becoming a throne.
Maybe I can like the person
I am when I’m alone.

[Final Chorus]
I don’t want to keep performing
just to earn another cheer.
I want confidence that stays
when nobody else is here.

title: Enough Never Enough
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep climbing every ladder
then complain about the view.
Every finish line gets smaller
the second I break through.

I tell myself ambition
is the fire keeping me alive,
but sometimes all this reaching
feels like fear in a disguise.

[Chorus]
Why is enough never enough?
Why does winning feel so thin?
I keep proving I can make it,
then ask where I should begin.

Part of me wants peace and quiet,
part of me demands the crown.
I don’t know if I’m still rising
or just scared of slowing down.

[Verse 2]
I love the sound of progress,
I hate the weight it brings.
Every new achievement
just invents another thing.

[Bridge]
Maybe I don’t need to conquer
every mountain that I see.
Maybe worth is not a scoreboard.
Maybe rest can still be me.

[Final Chorus]
Why is enough never enough?
I am tired of the chase.
I want pride without the hunger
that keeps moving every place.

title: Storm Behind My Confidence
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I walk into rooms like I know where I’m going,
chin up, voice steady, every weakness hidden.
I know what I’ve built, I know what I’m worth,
but somehow none of it quiets the hurt.

There’s always another road calling my name,
another version of me I could chase.
I should be grateful, I should feel complete,
but satisfaction keeps moving its feet.

[Pre-Chorus]
So I build myself up,
then tear it apart,
pride in my head,
static in my heart.

[Chorus]
There’s a storm behind my confidence,
a question underneath my pride.
I keep saying that I know myself
while changing every road I drive.

And everyone around me
gets caught inside the rain.
They didn’t make this chaos,
but they still absorb the pain.

I hate that my confusion
has consequences too.
I’m trying to find myself
without losing all of you.

[Verse 2]
Some days I feel unstoppable,
like every risk is mine to take.
Other nights I stare at everything
and wonder if I chose by mistake.

I want more life, more love, more motion,
more proof I didn’t waste my time.
But every hunger has a shadow
when somebody else is standing nearby.

[Pre-Chorus]
I call it ambition,
I call it being free,
but sometimes I can’t tell
if I’m running toward or fleeing me.

[Chorus]
There’s a storm behind my confidence,
a question underneath my pride.
I keep saying that I know myself
while changing every road I drive.

And everyone around me
gets caught inside the rain.
They didn’t make this chaos,
but they still absorb the pain.

[Bridge]
I’m sorry for the mixed signals,
for the doors I open then close.
For loving people honestly
while never knowing where I’ll go.

I’m sorry when my restlessness
makes your ground feel insecure.
You deserve more than explanations
from someone who is never sure.

But I can’t fake a destination
just to make the map look clean.
I have to live through all this noise
to learn what any of it means.

[Final Chorus]
There’s a storm behind my confidence,
but I’m learning not to hide.
Pride can keep me standing,
but it cannot be my guide.

I may never find one answer,
one straight road, one perfect view.
But I can own the damage
when my chaos reaches you.

I’m trying to become someone
who can wander without harm.
Someone strong enough to question,
and still safe enough to hold.

title: Mind Upside Down
lyrics:
[Intro]
(chopped baby vocal sample)
(glitch, static, subtle dark wave synth, organ hum)
(animal screech, distant whisper, laughing sample)

[Verse 1]
Static buzzing behind my eyes
Counting every breath, counting every lie
Four, then five, then six, then seven
Falling through a broken heaven
Anxiety whispers from the hallway floor
Insecurity locking every single door

[Pre-Chorus]
(time signature shifts to 7/8)
(heavy Moog bass swell, breakbeat glitch)
It’s too loud, it’s too quiet
Every thought a silent riot
Will I break? Will I sink?
I can't hear what I think!

[Chorus]
(heavy sludge guitars, minor key, screaming organ)
Fear in the shadows, heavy and deep
Depression taking what I cannot keep!
Spinning in the chaos, caught in the sound
Mind upside down, going round and round!

[Breakdown / Glitch Solo]
(chopped baby vocal sample)
(hysterical laughter, dark wave synth arpeggio, erratic breakbeats)
(heavy Moog bass drop, animal growl effect)

[Verse 2]
(sludge tempo drop, 5/4 rhythm)
Doubt creeps in like a heavy fog
Stuck in the middle of a sunken bog
Who am I when the noise won't stop?
Waiting for the final drop...

[Guitar & Moog Solo]
(melodic prog rock lead, shifting time signatures, chaotic sound effects)

[Outro]
(fading breakbeat, Moog bass resonance, vinyl crackle)
Fear... insecurity... silence...
(distant laughter, baby vocal chop fade)
(final abrupt glitch cut)

title: Crowded Room Behind My Eyes
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I count the locks, then count again
The kettle clicks; I check the door
A thought arrives in borrowed clothes
And leaves its fingerprints on every room

[Pre-Chorus]
My hands say run
My feet stay planted
I make a map
Then doubt the planet

[Chorus]
There’s a crowded room behind my eyes
Every voice has learned my name
One says hide, one says you’ll be fine
One keeps feeding sparks to the flame
I hold the wheel; it turns in place
I lose the thread, I lose the day
If I can hear you through this noise
Tell me I’m still here, still here

[Verse 2]
I wear my doubt like Sunday clothes
Too neat to show the seams beneath
I hear a laugh and make it proof
That I’m the joke they didn’t have to tell

[Pre-Chorus]
The floor goes soft
The walls lean closer
I chase a thought
It changes over

[Chorus]
There’s a crowded room behind my eyes
Every voice has learned my name
One says hide, one says you’ll be fine
One keeps feeding sparks to the flame
I hold the wheel; it turns in place
I lose the thread, I lose the day
If I can hear you through this noise
Tell me I’m still here, still here

[Bridge]
Some mornings weigh a hundred pounds
Some nights refuse to close
I don’t need answers dressed as truth
Just stay until the weather goes

[Final Chorus]
There’s a crowded room behind my eyes
Every voice has learned my name
One says hide, one says you’ll be fine
One keeps feeding sparks to the flame
I hold the wheel; it turns in place
But somewhere through the blur, I stay
If I can hear you through this noise
Tell me I’m still here, still here

[Outro]
Count the locks
Let the kettle cool
Stay right here
I’m still here

title: Crowded Room
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I count the locks, then count again
The kettle clicks; I miss the rain
A paper cup caves in my hand
I nod like I can understand

[Pre-Chorus]
Every small mistake gets teeth
Every quiet room gets deep

[Chorus]
There’s a crowded room behind my eyes
One says run, one says you’ll be fine
Fear draws maps I never chose
Doubt keeps score of every no
I’m still here beneath the noise
Trying to find my own voice

[Verse 2]
Your message waits beside the sink
I read it once, then lose the link
The mirror holds a tired face
I ask it for a softer place

[Pre-Chorus]
Some days lift, then lose their ground
Some days I can’t turn around

[Chorus]
There’s a crowded room behind my eyes
One says run, one says you’ll be fine
Fear draws maps I never chose
Doubt keeps score of every no
I’m still here beneath the noise
Trying to find my own voice

[Bridge]
If I go quiet, stay awhile
Don’t fix the weather, sit and smile
Let the hard minute pass its name
I’m more than what my nerves proclaim

[Final Chorus]
There’s a crowded room behind my eyes
Still one small thought can hold the line
Fear draws maps; I set them down
Doubt can talk, but not decide
I’m still here, and that is choice
Learning how to trust my voice

[Outro]
One breath, then another
One breath, then another

title: Cuatro Manos
lyrics:
[Verso 1]
Hay una voz que quiere espejos,
quiere aplausos al entrar,
quiere ser el centro exacto
de cualquier lugar.

Otra voz quiere tocarlo todo,
arder antes de pensar,
seguir cada deseo
aunque no sepa dónde va.

[Pre-Coro]
Y mientras ellas gritan fuerte,
otras dos empiezan a hablar.
Una dice: “haz lo correcto”.
Otra dice: “aprende a amar”.

[Coro]
Narcisismo, deseo, deber y amor,
cuatro manos sobre el mismo corazón.
Una quiere que me miren,
otra quiere devorar,
una quiere ser responsable,
otra solo quiere abrazar.

Y yo en medio de las voces,
sin saber a cuál seguir,
intentando ser sincero
sin destruir lo que hay en mí.

[Verso 2]
El deber cuenta consecuencias,
pone nombres al dolor,
me recuerda que mis actos
también pesan sobre otros.

Pero el amor rompe las cuentas,
dice: “nadie es propiedad”.
Quiere dar sin pedir permiso,
quiere espacio para respirar.

Y el deseo dice: “ahora”.
Y mi ego: “quiero más”.
Mientras el deber construye muros
que el amor intenta cruzar.

[Pre-Coro]
No hay silencio dentro mío,
solo negociación.
Cada parte tiene razones,
cada parte tiene su obsesión.

[Coro]
Narcisismo, deseo, deber y amor,
cuatro manos sobre el mismo corazón.
Una quiere ser importante,
otra quiere libertad,
una quiere cumplir promesas,
otra quiere dar sin calcular.

Y yo en medio de las voces,
aprendiendo a decidir
qué deseo debo escuchar
y cuál tengo que dejar ir.

[Puente]
Mi ego no es siempre mentira,
a veces solo pide ser visto.
Mi deseo no es un demonio,
solo quiere sentirse vivo.

Mi deber no es una cárcel,
a veces guarda lo que amo.
Y el amor no siempre sabe
cuánto daño deja cuando corre sin cuidado.

Entonces no busco matar
ninguna parte de lo que soy.
Quiero enseñarles a sentarse
en la misma mesa interior.

Que el deseo tenga límites.
Que el deber tenga compasión.
Que mi ego aprenda humildad.
Que el amor tenga dirección.

[Coro Final]
Narcisismo, deseo, deber y amor,
siguen vivos dentro del corazón.
Ya no busco una victoria,
ya no quiero dividir.
Quiero aprender cuál toma el mando
cuando tenga que elegir.

Puedo querer que me admiren.
Puedo querer intensidad.
Puedo cumplir con mis promesas.
Puedo amar con libertad.

Tal vez vivir sea este equilibrio,
sin respuesta ni final:
cuatro voces discutiendo
y una vida por cuidar.

[Outro]
Quiero ser visto.
Quiero sentir.
Quiero cumplir.
Quiero amar.

Y quizás madurar
no sea elegir solo una,
sino aprender
cuándo escuchar a cada cual.

title: Quiéreme sin traducirme
lyrics:
[Verso 1]
No miro el mundo como todos,
nunca aprendí a encajar del todo.
Veo caminos donde otros ven
una sola forma de querer.

Hago preguntas incómodas,
quiero más aire al respirar.
No porque sienta menos profundo,
sino porque siento en más lugares a la vez.

[Pre-Coro]
No necesito que comprendas
cada rincón de mi verdad.
Solo que no me pidas
hacerme pequeño para poderme amar.

[Coro]
Quiéreme sin traducirme,
sin corregir lo que hay en mí.
Sin convertir mis diferencias
en algo que deba corregir.

Quiéreme raro,
quiéreme libre,
con mi manera de sentir.
No necesito que seas igual,
solo que me dejes existir.

[Verso 2]
No creo que el amor sea una jaula
ni que querer sea poseer.
Puedo cuidar sin controlar,
puedo elegir sin desaparecer.

Tal vez mis mapas son distintos,
tal vez mis reglas no son las de ayer.
Pero sigo buscando lo mismo:
ser visto, ser querido, pertenecer.

[Pre-Coro]
No quiero herirte por ser libre,
ni traicionarme por quedar.
Quiero encontrar ese equilibrio
donde ninguno tenga que actuar.

[Coro]
Quiéreme sin traducirme,
sin corregir lo que hay en mí.
Sin convertir mis diferencias
en algo que deba corregir.

Quiéreme raro,
quiéreme libre,
con mi manera de sentir.
No necesito que seas igual,
solo que me dejes existir.

[Puente]
No prometo ser sencillo.
No prometo ser convencional.
Tengo demasiadas preguntas
para vivir en una sola verdad.

Pero prometo ser honesto,
cuidar el peso de mi voz,
decirte dónde estoy parado
y no esconderte el corazón.

No quiero amor sin límites.
Quiero límites elegidos entre dos.
No quiero romper las reglas por romperlas.
Quiero reglas que tengan razón.

[Coro Final]
Quiéreme sin traducirme,
sin pedir otra versión de mí.
Con mis rarezas y mis dudas,
con mis formas de construir.

Y si podemos mirarnos
sin intentar cambiar quién somos,
tal vez amar no sea encajar,
sino hacer espacio
para existir juntos.

[Outro]
No quiero que me toleres.
Quiero que puedas verme así.

Completo.
Extraño.
Sincero.

Y aun así
elegirme a mí.

title: Vivo entre aeropuertos
lyrics:
[Verso 1]
Mi vida cabe en una maleta,
otra puerta, otro control,
otro café antes del vuelo,
otra ciudad bajo el sol.

Tengo amigos en Madrid,
en Berlín y algún rincón,
gente que conozco por tres días
y recuerdo con el corazón.

Cada viaje trae una historia,
cada escala una amistad,
pero cuando todos vuelven a casa
yo regreso a despegar.

[Pre-Coro]
Tengo abrazos por el mundo,
pero ninguna dirección
donde alguien deje una taza
esperándome en el comedor.

[Coro]
Vivo entre aeropuertos,
de un avión a otro avión,
coleccionando despedidas
como sellos del corazón.

Tengo amigos en cien lugares,
pero raíces en ninguno.
He conocido medio mundo,
sin construir mi propio mundo.

Y me encanta esta vida,
no la quiero abandonar,
pero a veces tanta libertad
se parece a no tener hogar.

[Verso 2]
Sé qué tren tomar en Londres,
dónde cenar en Barcelona,
quién me espera cuando llegue,
quién me escribe cuando vuelva.

Tengo conversaciones profundas
con personas que quizá
no volveré a ver en años,
pero nunca olvidaré jamás.

Y eso también es una vida,
no lo quiero despreciar.
Hay belleza en pertenecer
un poquito a cada lugar.

[Pre-Coro]
Pero mientras todos construyen
rutinas que pueden tocar,
yo construyo relaciones
que viven dentro del celular.

[Coro]
Vivo entre aeropuertos,
de un avión a otro avión,
coleccionando despedidas
como sellos del corazón.

Tengo amigos en cien lugares,
pero raíces en ninguno.
He conocido medio mundo,
sin construir mi propio mundo.

[Puente]
A veces quiero una cocina
donde sepa dónde está todo.
Una persona que me conozca
cuando no estoy siendo interesante.

Un viernes sin itinerario,
un domingo sin partir,
una amistad que no termine
con “avísame cuando vuelvas por aquí”.

Pero luego escucho los motores
y vuelve a despertarse algo en mí.
Hay tantas vidas esperándome
que todavía quiero vivir.

Y ahí está mi contradicción:
quiero raíces y quiero alas.
Quiero construir algo permanente
sin cerrar ninguna ventana.

[Coro Final]
Vivo entre aeropuertos,
y tal vez siempre sea así.
Con pedazos de mi historia
repartidos lejos de mí.

Tengo hogares temporales,
caras que me hacen sonreír.
Quizás todavía estoy aprendiendo
qué significa pertenecer aquí.

Porque he construido amistades,
aventuras, recuerdos, amor,
aunque todavía no haya construido
un lugar al que llamar hogar.

[Outro]
Próximo vuelo.
Otra ciudad.
Otro abrazo.
Otra amistad.

Y cuando alguien pregunte:
“¿Dónde vives de verdad?”
tal vez algún día
sepa qué contestar.

title: Corazón sin fronteras
lyrics:
[Verso 1]
Tengo pedazos de mi corazón
durmiendo en ciudades que no puedo ver,
una risa vive cruzando el océano,
otra voz me espera al amanecer.

Hay nombres escritos en aeropuertos,
recuerdos guardados en otra estación,
y cada persona que toca mi vida
se lleva una parte de esta habitación.

[Pre-Coro]
Me dijeron: “elige,
no puedes querer así”.
Como si el cariño fuera una copa
que algún día llega a su fin.

[Coro]
Pero mi corazón no tiene fronteras,
no entiende de mapas ni de propiedad.
No siento que amar a una persona
le quite a otra capacidad.

Hay más que suficiente dentro de mí,
más ternura de la que puedo explicar.
Pero el mundo dibuja pequeñas cajas
y me pregunta dónde debo guardar
todo este amor
que solo quiere caminar.

[Verso 2]
La vida no es una mesa pequeña
con una silla que alguien debe perder.
No tengo que apagar una estrella
para dejar que otra pueda encender.

Puedo extrañarte mientras abrazo
a alguien que también me enseñó a sentir.
Una conexión no borra otra,
hay muchas maneras de existir.

[Pre-Coro]
Pero escucho las reglas,
las conozco demasiado bien:
“Si amas aquí, no mires allá.
Si elegiste uno, olvida a los demás”.

Y trato de caber
en una forma que no hice yo,
mientras mi pecho sigue creciendo
más rápido que la explicación.

[Coro]
Mi corazón no tiene fronteras,
no entiende de mapas ni de propiedad.
No siento que amar a una persona
le quite a otra capacidad.

Hay más que suficiente dentro de mí,
más ternura de la que puedo explicar.
Pero el mundo dibuja pequeñas cajas
y me pregunta dónde debo guardar
todo este amor
que solo quiere caminar.

[Puente]
Y aquí empieza la guerra.

Porque también quiero ser justo.
No quiero dejar heridas detrás.
No quiero llamar libertad
a no pensar en cómo mis actos caerán.

No todo deseo merece respuesta.
No toda conexión debe continuar.
Amar sin límites no significa
que no existan límites al actuar.

Ese es el nudo que llevo:
mi corazón grita abundancia,
mi conciencia pide cuidado,
y la sociedad exige distancia.

Entonces camino entre tres voces,
intentando no traicionar
ni lo que siento,
ni a quien quiero,
ni la vida que quiero crear.

[Coro Final]
Mi corazón está por todo el mundo,
y quizás siempre será así.
No puedo fingir que siento menos
solo para hacer todo más fácil de definir.

Hay más que suficiente amor en la vida,
pero amar también es aprender a elegir.
No entre quién merece mi cariño,
sino cómo puedo darlo sin destruir.

Tal vez nunca resuelva el conflicto.
Tal vez esa sea mi verdad:
un corazón que cree en la abundancia
viviendo en un mundo que exige limitar.

[Outro]
Hay una parte de mí en cada puerto.
Una historia en cada adiós.
No quiero poseer a nadie.
No quiero que nadie me posea a mí.

Solo quiero aprender
cómo amar lo que amo
sin convertir el amor
en algo que tenga que esconder de mí.

title: Dos Voces en un corazón
lyrics:
[Verso 1]
Hay una parte de mí que quiere
que todos aprendan mi nombre,
que cada mirada se quede,
que cada silencio me nombre.

Quiere aplausos, quiere espejos,
quiere ser imposible de ignorar,
y aunque intento esconderla,
siempre encuentra cómo hablar.

Pero hay otra parte que escucha
cuando alguien empieza a caer,
que quisiera cargar sus heridas
aunque no gane nada después.

[Pre-Coro]
Y durante años pensé
que una tenía que vencer,
que no podía ser sincero
si también quería que me vieran bien.

[Coro]
Tengo dos voces en el mismo corazón,
una pide amor, la otra quiere admiración.
Una dice: “mírame, dime que soy especial”,
otra dice: “¿estás bien? Déjame ayudarte a respirar”.

Y quizás no tengo que destruir
ninguna parte para aprender a vivir.
Puedo querer que el mundo me vea
y aun así mirar a los demás.

[Verso 2]
A veces doy porque me importa,
a veces quiero que lo sepan.
A veces soy generoso
y también espero una respuesta.

No todo gesto tiene
una intención perfectamente pura.
Somos hambre y somos ternura,
somos miedo buscando cura.

Si hago algo bueno por razones mezcladas,
¿deja de ser algo bueno al final?
Tal vez crecer no sea ser perfecto,
sino aprender a mirar la verdad.

[Coro]
Tengo dos voces en el mismo corazón,
una pide amor, la otra quiere admiración.
Una construye monumentos para sentirse inmortal,
otra rompe sus paredes para dejar a alguien entrar.

Y quizás no tengo que destruir
ninguna parte para aprender a vivir.
Puedo querer que el mundo me vea
y aun así mirar a los demás.

[Puente]
Mi ego no tiene que conducir,
pero tampoco tengo que fingir
que no existe, que no desea,
que no necesita ser querido.

Puedo decirle:
“Ven conmigo,
pero no decides dónde vamos”.
Puedes querer reconocimiento,
pero no pisaremos otras manos.

Y a mi corazón le digo:
“No tienes que desangrarte
para demostrar que eres bueno.
También mereces recibir
lo mismo que entregas al mundo entero”.

[Coro Final]
Tengo dos voces en el mismo corazón,
ya no necesito declarar cuál tiene razón.
Una quiere brillar,
otra quiere iluminar,
y tal vez podamos aprender
la diferencia sin dejar de caminar.

No soy santo,
no soy monstruo,
soy contradicción.
Quiero ser amado,
quiero dar amor.

Y si ambas cosas viven dentro de mí,
no tengo que elegir cuál dejar morir.
Solo aprender quién toma el volante
cuando llegue el momento de decidir.

[Outro]
Quiero que me veas.
Quiero poder verte.
Quiero sentirme importante
sin olvidar que tú también lo eres.

title: Aprender a Escogerme
lyrics:
[Verso 1]
Aprendí a leer las caras,
a saber cuándo sonreír,
a cambiar un poco mi forma
para no hacerte sufrir.

Dije sí cuando era no,
me quedé cuando quise huir,
fui construyendo mil versiones
para que todos fueran feliz.

[Pre-Coro]
Y mientras cuidaba cada corazón,
fui dejando el mío en algún rincón.
Quise ser refugio para los demás,
pero nadie puede dar sin descansar.

[Coro]
No puedo ser todo para todos,
no puedo cargar con cada dolor.
Quiero verte bien, quiero darte todo,
pero también necesito amor.

No puedo vivir pidiendo permiso
para ser la persona que quiero ser.
Si tu felicidad exige que me pierda,
tengo que aprender a escogerme también.

[Verso 2]
Me preocupa decepcionarte,
me lastima verte partir,
y a veces cambio mis deseos
solo para hacerte sonreír.

Pero cada vez que me abandono
para evitar una discusión,
voy apagando lentamente
la pequeña luz de mi interior.

[Pre-Coro]
Ser amable no significa desaparecer,
amarte no significa dejar de crecer.
Puedo darte espacio, puedo comprender,
sin convertir tus sueños en mi deber.

[Coro]
No puedo ser todo para todos,
no puedo cargar con cada dolor.
Quiero verte bien, quiero darte todo,
pero también necesito amor.

No puedo vivir pidiendo permiso
para ser la persona que quiero ser.
Si tu felicidad exige que me pierda,
tengo que aprender a escogerme también.

[Puente]
Tal vez alguien se moleste
cuando aprenda a decir que no.
Tal vez alguien me prefiera
cuando no tenga una voz.

Pero quien de verdad me quiera
va a quererme completo también,
con mis límites, mis deseos,
con mis días de escogerme bien.

No quiero volverme frío,
no quiero dejar de cuidar.
Solo quiero que mi bondad
también me pueda alcanzar.

[Coro Final]
No puedo ser todo para todos,
pero puedo estar cuando pueda estar.
Puedo darte amor sin romperme,
puedo acompañarte sin dejarme atrás.

Quiero que seas feliz, de verdad,
pero yo también merezco felicidad.
Y quizá quererme un poco más
me enseñe una forma más sana de amar.

[Outro]
No voy a dejar de dar,
no voy a dejar de sentir.
Solo estoy aprendiendo
que yo también tengo que vivir.

title: One Small Kindness
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held the door when my hands were full
Said take your time, though the rain came down
A paper cup and a patient smile
Made that long walk feel less alone

[Pre-Chorus]
No grand parade, no price to name
Just one small kindness, passed along

[Chorus]
What you give keeps traveling
Past the corner, past the years
A little warmth from your open hands
Comes back when the road gets rough
Be the reason somebody breathes easier
The world remembers what we do

[Verse 2]
I saw you leave your seat for her
While the bus shook hard through the afternoon
She laughed and told you about her son
You listened like you had nowhere else to be

[Pre-Chorus]
No grand parade, no price to name
Just one small kindness, passed along

[Chorus]
What you give keeps traveling
Past the corner, past the years
A little warmth from your open hands
Comes back when the road gets rough
Be the reason somebody breathes easier
The world remembers what we do

[Bridge]
When your own day breaks in two
Someone may remember how you stayed
A borrowed coat, a call returned
A steady hand beside the stair

[Final Chorus]
What you give keeps traveling
Past the corner, past the years
A little warmth from your open hands
Comes back when the road gets rough
Be the reason somebody breathes easier
Let that kindness make its way back home

[Outro]
One small kindness, passed along
One small kindness, passed along

title: Kindness Returns
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Melodic bass line in 5/4, shifting to 9/4]

[Verse]
Every seed of grace you sow in the dust
Every quiet hand that you choose to trust
It goes spinning out through the open space
Rippling through time, leaving behind a trace

[Chorus]
What you put out comes back around
An echo rising up from the ground
The kindness you give, the light that you send
Returns to lift you up in the end
Yeah, it returns to lift you up in the end

[Bridge]
[Intricate fretless slap bass solo, shifting time signatures, brass accents]
A gentle word in a heavy hour
Grows and blooms with quiet power
Nothing is lost, nothing fades away

[Chorus]
What you put out comes back around
An echo rising up from the ground
The kindness you give, the light that you send
Returns to lift you up in the end

[Outro]
[Melodic brass and bass fade, resolving time signature]
It returns to you...
What you put out...
Kindness returns.

title: A Little Kindness Travels On
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You held the door when my hands were full
Said take your time, there’s room enough
I was carrying more than I let you see
You made a little space for me

[Pre-Chorus]
A small good turn can change the weight
Of someone’s day, someone’s fate

[Chorus]
Put a little kindness in the world
Let it travel farther than you know
When the hard days circle back around
May a helping hand be there to hold
What you give away is not gone
It finds its way back home

[Verse 2]
You learned the name the others missed
Shared your lunch and checked in later
No grand speech, no need to claim it
Just a steady heart that made room

[Pre-Chorus]
The seed you leave in someone’s care
Can take root anywhere

[Chorus]
Put a little kindness in the world
Let it travel farther than you know
When the hard days circle back around
May a helping hand be there to hold
What you give away is not gone
It finds its way back home

[Bridge]
And if the road turns rough for you
If you’re the one who needs a light
The voices you once lifted up
Will find you there and stand beside

[Final Chorus]
Put a little kindness in the world
Let it travel farther than you know
When the hard days circle back around
May a helping hand be there to hold
What you give away is not gone
It finds its way back home

[Outro]
A little kindness travels on
And finds its way back home

title: Where The Daylight Stands
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The hallway clock skips a number again
I count the stairs, then start over at ten
Your coat is still hanging beside the front door
The weather keeps changing; I can't tell what for

[Pre-Chorus]
If morning is somewhere behind all this gray
We don't need to know how it gets here today

[Chorus]
Hold on to the thread we can barely see
One small step is still a way through the deep
When every sure thing slips out of our hands
We can make a little room where the daylight lands

[Verse 2]
The kettle clicks off; the tea has gone cold
A note on the table says, “Be brave, be bold”
I fold it and keep it beside my keys
Some days hope is a door that just won't quite freeze

[Pre-Chorus]
No map for the miles that are waiting ahead
Just your steady breath and the words that we said

[Chorus]
Hold on to the thread we can barely see
One small step is still a way through the deep
When every sure thing slips out of our hands
We can make a little room where the daylight lands

[Instrumental Break]

[Bridge]
You don't have to promise the clouds will part
Just stay here beside me and lend me your heart
We'll name what is lost, let the unknown remain
And try one more morning, then try it again

[Final Chorus]
Hold on to the thread we can barely see
One small step is still a way through the deep
When every sure thing slips out of our hands
We can make a little room where the daylight lands

[Outro]
One more morning
One more step

title: One Small Window
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The forecast changed before the morning train
A paper cup went cold beside my hand
You said, “I don’t know what comes after this”
I watched the rain draw rivers through the sand

[Pre-Chorus]
No map could tell us where the road would turn
Still, one small window kept a candle burning

[Chorus]
When the ground gives way, take my hand
We can make a little room to breathe
Even here, where we can’t see the end
There’s a quiet spark we still can keep
If the night is all we understand
We’ll find the next step underneath our feet

[Verse 2]
The kitchen clock was running four minutes slow
Your coat was hanging by the open door
We let the unanswered questions stay unanswered
And set two plates out like we had before

[Pre-Chorus]
The first pale line came softly through the blinds
Not a promise, just enough to change our minds

[Chorus]
When the ground gives way, take my hand
We can make a little room to breathe
Even here, where we can’t see the end
There’s a quiet spark we still can keep
If the night is all we understand
We’ll find the next step underneath our feet

[Bridge]
Maybe hope is not a grand design
Maybe it’s your shoulder next to mine
One more call, one more ordinary day
A small yes, when we’re afraid to say

[Final Chorus]
When the ground gives way, take my hand
We can make a little room to breathe
Even here, where we can’t see the end
There’s a quiet spark we still can keep
If the night is all we understand
We’ll find the next step underneath our feet
We’ll find the next step, you and me

[Outro]
One small window, one small flame
Morning doesn’t need to know our names

title: One Small Door
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The hallway clock skips seven beats
Rain counts the cracks along the pane
I hold the map beneath the sink
The ink has run, the roads have changed

[Pre-Chorus]
You say the morning’s not a promise
Still, leave the curtain half undone

[Chorus]
When every answer disappears
And even solid ground feels thin
I’ll keep one small door open here
For whatever light can enter in
If we can’t see beyond the bend
We’ll take the next step, then the next

[Verse 2]
Your chipped blue cup is by the stove
The kettle clicks and settles down
We make a list of what remains:
Two coats, one key, this borrowed town

[Pre-Chorus]
You say the morning’s not a promise
Still, leave the curtain half undone

[Chorus]
When every answer disappears
And even solid ground feels thin
I’ll keep one small door open here
For whatever light can enter in
If we can’t see beyond the bend
We’ll take the next step, then the next

[Bridge]
No grand design, no certain sign
Just your hand steady next to mine
The dark can keep its questions wide
It cannot choose our next reply

[Final Chorus]
When every answer disappears
And even solid ground feels thin
We’ll keep one small door open here
For whatever light can enter in
If we can’t see beyond the bend
We’ll take the next step, then the next
We’ll take the next step, then the next

[Outro]
The clock moves on; the room is still
We leave the curtain open

title: One More Step (Alternate Version)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The hallway clock skips every seventh beat
I count the cracks that run beneath my feet
The map is wet, the ink has left the page
I hold your name like a match against the gray

[Pre-Chorus]
If morning takes the longer road
If every sign says turn around
I’ll keep one hand upon your sleeve
And trust the ground we haven’t found

[Chorus]
When the dark won’t tell us where to go
There’s a small, stubborn light we know
Not a promise, not a perfect sky
Just your hand finding mine nearby
When the next step disappears from view
I can still take one with you

[Verse 2]
The kettle clicks in our borrowed room
Rain writes its questions on the window soon
You draw a doorway on the folded bill
And somehow, for a breath, the world is still

[Pre-Chorus]
If morning takes the longer road
If every sign says turn around
I’ll keep one hand upon your sleeve
And trust the ground we haven’t found

[Chorus]
When the dark won’t tell us where to go
There’s a small, stubborn light we know
Not a promise, not a perfect sky
Just your hand finding mine nearby
When the next step disappears from view
I can still take one with you

[Bridge]
No grand answer, no sure way through
Only this breath, and the truth of you
The clouds can keep their heavy crown
We’ll make a little shelter now

[Final Chorus]
When the dark won’t tell us where to go
There’s a small, stubborn light we know
Not a promise, not a perfect sky
Just your hand finding mine nearby
When the next step disappears from view
I can still take one with you
Yes, I can still take one with you

[Outro]
One more step, one more day
We don’t need to see the way

title: Shadow of the Doubt
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Distorted Rhodes chords, choir stabs, heavy 7/8 drum groove)

[Verse 1]
Midnight falls, the numbers spin
Walls are close and breathing thin
Every step on broken ground
Looking for a steady sound
Counting beats in seven time
Trying to make the darkness rhyme

[Chorus]
In the shadow of the doubt
We will find a way on out
Hold the flame when winds blow cold
Turning dust into pure gold
Even in the dark we see
Hope is breaking through to me

[Verse 2]
Static hums across the screen
Searching for what lies between
Heavy bass line dragging low
Nowhere left for us to go
Yet a flicker starts to rise
Right before our open eyes

[Chorus]
In the shadow of the doubt
We will find a way on out
Hold the flame when winds blow cold
Turning dust into pure gold
Even in the dark we see
Hope is breaking through to me

[Bridge]
(Soaring choir stabs, distorted prog guitar solo over 7/8 rhythm)
Through the haze, through the strain
Light begins to take the rein!

[Outro]
One two three, one two three four
Walking through the open door
Found the hope inside the night
Step into the rising light
(Fade out on Rhodes and choir)

title: When the Road Runs Out of (Alternate Version)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The map tore loose in the station wind
Your last train vanished past the bend
I held the paper against my coat
While rain made rivers through every note

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “We’ll know when we get there”
I tried to believe you in the cold air

[Chorus]
When the road runs out of signs
When the hour has no name
I will keep one hand in yours
We can walk without a flame
There’s a door inside the dark
There’s a morning we can’t see
If the ground gives way beneath us
Stay right here and breathe with me

[Verse 2]
The kitchen clock skipped half a beat
Your muddy shoes dried by the heat
We wrote our fears on grocery sacks
Then folded them and took them back

[Pre-Chorus]
No promise that the sky will clear
Just your steady shoulder near

[Chorus]
When the road runs out of signs
When the hour has no name
I will keep one hand in yours
We can walk without a flame
There’s a door inside the dark
There’s a morning we can’t see
If the ground gives way beneath us
Stay right here and breathe with me

[Bridge]
Maybe hope is not a lantern
Maybe it’s the choice to stay
Maybe it’s your hand still reaching
At the end of a hard day

[Final Chorus]
When the road runs out of signs
When the hour has no name
I will keep one hand in yours
We can walk without a flame
There’s a door inside the dark
There’s a morning we can’t see
If the ground gives way beneath us
Stay right here and breathe with me

[Outro]
Stay right here
Breathe with me

title: When the Road Runs Out of
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
