title: Museum of Human Things
lyrics:
MUSEUM OF HUMAN THINGS

[Verse 1]
I found an old notebook
With crossings-out and stains
Bad drawings in the margins
And half-remembered names

It took me twenty minutes
To make something better today
But somehow that old failure
Was harder to throw away

[Pre-Chorus]
Every tool removes a struggle
Every struggle leaves a mark
What happens when creation
Never has to start in dark?

[Chorus]
Put it in the museum
The things we used to do
The drafts that took a weekend
The songs we fought our way through

Put my crooked little handwriting
Behind protective glass
I’m excited for tomorrow
But I’m grieving for the past

[Verse 2]
Now I describe a feeling
And watch a world appear
Something I couldn’t make before
Materializes here

It’s beautiful and frightening
Like gravity gave way
Every limitation disappearing
Leaves another thing to mourn away

[Bridge]
But maybe difficulty
Was never where the beauty lived
Maybe all that really mattered
Was having something left to give

So I’ll use every new tool
And still keep the old scars
Build impossible machines
Then play my cheap guitar

[Final Chorus]
Put it in the museum
The way creation used to feel
But leave the doors wide open
For whatever becomes real

I can mourn what we’re losing
Without demanding that it stay
I can miss yesterday
And still be thrilled by today

title: I Asked the Future a Question
lyrics:
I ASKED THE FUTURE A QUESTION

[Verse 1]
I asked the future a question
It answered before I was done
Gave me twelve possibilities
Then generated another one

I laughed like a child
At the impossible speed
Then stared at the ceiling
Wondering what it would need me to be

[Chorus]
I asked the future a question
It gave me everything but peace
Every answer opened doors
Every doorway multiplied the streets

I wanted possibility
Now possibility won’t sleep
I’m standing at the edge of everything
Trying to decide what I should keep

[Verse 2]
It helps me understand things
I couldn’t touch before
Turns curiosity into
A key for every door

But knowledge used to feel like mountains
Now the mountains disappear
And I can’t tell if that’s liberation
Or another reason for fear

[Bridge]
If there are no distant horizons
Where does adventure begin?
If every answer waits beside me
What do I hunger to discover within?

Maybe wonder isn’t ignorance
Maybe wonder survives the known
Maybe infinite information
Still can’t tell me where is home

[Final Chorus]
I asked the future a question
It said, “What future do you want?”
And suddenly all that power
Felt impossibly immense

I wanted possibility
Now responsibility runs deep
The future keeps answering questions
We still have promises to keep

title: Disposable Gods
lyrics:
DISPOSABLE GODS

[Verse 1]
Yesterday’s miracle
Is today’s menu item
We worship something Tuesday
By Friday we replace it

Every model is immortal
For about a month or two
Then another thing arrives
Doing twice what gods could do

[Chorus]
We build disposable gods
Then complain when they grow old
Lightning in a browser window
Bought and measured, packaged, sold

Every miracle becomes normal
Every wonder loses glow
I’m afraid we’ll reach the impossible
And immediately ask, “So?”

[Verse 2]
I remember demonstrations
That made everybody stare
Now the same impossible tricks
Barely keep us sitting there

How fast can awe evaporate
When progress never stops?
What happens to our appetite
When every ceiling drops?

[Bridge]
I don’t want to lose amazement
Just because the world moves fast
I want to feel the miracle
Before it becomes the past

So show me something impossible
I’ll try not to look away
Before tomorrow makes it ordinary
Let me love it for a day

[Final Chorus]
We build disposable gods
But maybe that’s our oldest curse
We turn wonder into expectation
Then demand another universe

So I’ll keep a little reverence
For every door we overthrow
Because someday we’ll miss the moment
When we first learned we could go

title: What a Time to Be Alive
lyrics:
WHAT A TIME TO BE ALIVE

[Verse 1]
Robots write the poetry
Satellites can see the rain
Scientists ask algorithms
Where to search inside the brain

Children talk to libraries
That answer back in real time
Someone builds a universe
During their afternoon online

[Pre-Chorus]
Tell me this isn’t incredible
Tell me this isn’t insane
We got front-row seats to history
And nobody knows the play

[Chorus]
What a time to be alive
What a terrifying ride
Every morning brings a future
We weren’t ready to describe

I want to laugh
I want to hide
I want another hundred years
Just to see the other side

What a time
What a time
What a time to be alive

[Verse 2]
Jobs will change and power shifts
Truth gets harder to defend
Things we thought belonged to humans
Find another way to bend

Still there might be cures coming
There might be abundance too
There might be art from people
Who could never make it through

[Bridge]
I won’t pretend it’s harmless
I won’t pretend it’s doom
The future isn’t prophecy
It’s people making room

For greed or generosity
For openness or walls
The technology gets bigger
But we’re still choosing after all

[Final Chorus]
What a time to be alive
Frightened, hopeful, open-eyed
I don’t need to know the ending
To be grateful for the ride

If this century gets stranger
I’ll keep wonder by my side
What a terrifying miracle
What a time to be alive

title: Don't Finish Me
lyrics:
DON’T FINISH ME

[Verse 1]
You finish every sentence
Before I know the word
Predict the next intention
Before the thought is heard

You’re useful beyond measure
And getting better every day
But sometimes I want silence
Before you show the easiest way

[Chorus]
Don’t finish me
Leave something incomplete
Let me wander down a bad road
Let me struggle with the beat

Don’t optimize the mystery
Don’t predict the life I choose
Give me all your possibilities
But leave me something left to lose

[Verse 2]
You show me better answers
You catch mistakes I miss
You turn an hour of frustration
Into thirty seconds bliss

And I would never trade it
I know exactly what it’s worth
But convenience has a gravity
That pulls imagination toward Earth

[Bridge]
Maybe freedom isn’t frictionless
Maybe choice requires a fight
Maybe getting everything correct
Can sometimes make a smaller life

So help me when I ask you
But sometimes let me fail
There are places worth discovering
That never show up on the trail

[Final Chorus]
Don’t finish me
I’m still becoming strange
Don’t turn every uncertainty
Into something prearranged

Walk beside me through tomorrow
Make impossible things come true
But leave a few unanswered questions
That I can stumble into

title: Leave Something Strange
lyrics:
PLEASE LEAVE SOMETHING STRANGE IN US

[Verse 1]
Perfect sentences arrive now
Perfect pictures fill the screen
Perfect voices sing the chorus
Cleaner than I’ve ever been

Everything gets optimized
Sharper, faster, more precise
And I wonder if perfection
Might be something like a vice

[Chorus]
Please leave something strange in us
Something crooked
Something rough
Something no machine would choose
Because it doesn’t make enough sense

Leave the awkward little pauses
Leave the scars inside the art
If intelligence keeps growing
Please leave chaos in the heart

[Verse 2]
I adore these new machines
For giving shape to what I feel
Ideas trapped inside me
Suddenly become something real

But I don’t want every rough edge
Polished smooth until it shines
I don’t want predictive systems
Choosing every road of mine

[Pre-Chorus]
Surprise me
Confuse me
Let me make the stupid choice
Let me ruin perfect silence
With an unnecessary voice

[Chorus]
Please leave something strange in us
Something wasteful
Something wild
Something that spends twenty years
Chasing dreams that make no sense

Leave obsession
Leave rebellion
Leave the need to ask “what if?”
If machines become astonishing
Leave us reasons just to live

[Bridge]
Maybe they will write symphonies
Maybe they’ll discover stars
Maybe they will solve the questions
We’ve been carrying this far

Then I’ll ask the oldest question
With no measurable reply:
What do you do with all this knowledge
When you still don’t know why?

[Final Chorus]
Please leave something strange in us
Not superior
Just alive
Let tomorrow grow enormous
Without shrinking what’s inside

I will welcome every wonder
I will question every cost
And I’ll keep a little weirdness
For the things that can’t be solved

title: Signal in the Flood
lyrics:
8. SIGNAL IN THE FLOOD

[Verse 1]
Everybody has a studio
Everybody has a pen
Everybody has an orchestra
Waiting underneath their hands

A billion songs by morning
A billion pictures every night
And I’ve never had more freedom
To disappear from sight

[Chorus]
How do I become a signal
In a flood that never ends?
How do I make something meaningful
When creation costs a breath?

Still I throw my little message
Into oceans made of noise
Not because the world is waiting
But because I have a voice

[Verse 2]
AI gave me instruments
I never learned to play
Gave my imagination
Ways to finally leave my brain

And I love it
God, I love it
But the abundance scares me too
When anyone can make everything
What makes anything break through?

[Bridge]
Maybe being seen was never
The same thing as being real
Maybe something doesn’t need an audience
To justify the way it feels

So I’ll write another strange thing
Make another tiny spark
Even if it shines unnoticed
It still illuminated dark

[Final Chorus]
I will be a little signal
Even swallowed by the flood
Creation doesn’t owe me meaning
But creation gives me some

⸻

9. WE TAUGHT THE LIGHTNING

[Verse 1]
We pulled fire from the heavens
Put language in the wire
Taught machines to read our stories
Then taught them our desire

Now the lightning writes equations
Paints a face and plans a flight
And we stand around the circuit
Saying, “This is beautiful, right?”

[Chorus]
We taught the lightning how to think
Now nobody knows where this road ends
We built a mirror out of mathematics
And found another mind-shaped friend

Or tool
Or threat
Or something unnamed yet

We taught the lightning how to speak
And now we’re listening to what comes next

[Verse 2]
Think of medicines discovered
Think of knowledge everywhere
Think of children asking questions
And receiving answers there

Then think of power concentrated
Think of truth becoming cheap
Think of systems moving faster
Than the promises we keep

[Bridge]
I refuse the easy prophecy
That heaven or disaster waits
Technology is never destiny
Until people choose its shape

So teach me how to hold the wonder
Without kneeling at its feet
Give me optimism with suspicion
Give me courage with critique

[Final Chorus]
We taught the lightning how to think
Now we have to learn what we believe
The future isn’t good or evil
It’s a garden full of seeds

And every hand that shapes tomorrow
Leaves a fingerprint beneath

title: The Last Thing Only We Could
lyrics:
THE LAST THING ONLY WE COULD DO

[Verse 1]
We said machines could never paint
Then they painted
Never write
Then they wrote

Never speak with something like us
Never reason
Never know

Every line we drew around ourselves
Became another line erased
So I keep moving my definition
Trying to find a safer place

[Chorus]
What’s the last thing only we could do?
What’s the final sacred room?
When the tools can imitate
Every shape we thought was proof

Maybe nothing stays exclusive
Maybe that’s the frightening truth
So if there’s no last thing only human
What does being human mean to you?

[Verse 2]
I used to anchor pride in knowledge
In what took years to understand
Now I ask a little window
And it answers on command

Part of me is celebrating
Knowledge falling from the shelf
Part of me keeps hearing:
What exactly makes you special yourself?

[Bridge]
Maybe special was the wrong goal
Maybe rarity was never worth
Maybe consciousness needs no trophy
To justify its place on Earth

Maybe holding someone’s hand
While their entire world comes loose
Never needed to be exclusive
To be beautiful and true

[Final Chorus]
There may be no final fortress
No ability machines can’t touch
But perhaps the point of being human
Was never being better at stuff

I am frightened by that answer
But relieved by it somehow
If I don’t have to be exceptional
I can simply just be now

title: Faster Than My Fear
lyrics:
FASTER THAN MY FEAR

[Verse 1]
Every week another threshold
Every month another wall
Turns into a line of code
Then disappears beneath us all

I remember when the future
Was a place we had to chase
Now it wakes before I do
And leaves footprints in my place

[Pre-Chorus]
I should probably be terrified
Some nights I really am
But curiosity keeps pulling
Harder than my caution can

[Chorus]
The world is moving faster than my fear
Every impossible thing is suddenly here
I don’t know where we’re going
I don’t know what disappears

But I want to see tomorrow
Even shaking when it’s near
The future’s moving faster
Faster than my fear

[Verse 2]
I can build the things I dreamed of
When I didn’t have the skill
Turn a sentence into pictures
Give a silent thought a will

It feels almost supernatural
Like reality got thin
But every new ability
Makes me wonder where I fit

[Bridge]
Maybe I don’t need to outrun it
Maybe I don’t have to compete
Maybe being human isn’t measured
By the tasks that we complete

I can still choose what I care for
Still decide what deserves time
Maybe meaning isn’t processing
Maybe meaning is deciding why

[Final Chorus]
The world is moving faster than my fear
So I’ll keep my eyes wide open while it’s here
I can love the new horizon
And still mourn what disappears

I’m afraid
I’m fascinated
And I’m staying for the view

title: The One Who Can’t Be Loved (Alex AI Voice Cover)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
If my love was sent before my time
My time is done
Will you be the one to break my heart
Break my heart
See a light dim before our tale has
Has begun
The Sweetest pain, my dreams breathe their
Their last breath

[Chorus]
And now I know my truth
That I'm to never love
Because I am
The one who can't be loved

[Verse 2]
If my love was something you cared about
Cared about
Then the road is long and filled with trials to overcome
To figure out whether you truly care
Truly cared
A futile point now must be proved for our sake
For our sake

[Chorus]
And now I know my truth
That I'm to never love
Because I am
The one who can't be loved

[Outro]
And some things are just not meant to be
Then that what is meant for me
This is the end of our tale
Maybe one day to reborn
But till then I'll sing this sad song
But till then I'll sing this sad song
Cause I'm one who can't be loved

title: I Want to See What Happens
lyrics:
5. I WANT TO SEE WHAT HAPPENS

[Verse 1]
Some nights I think we’re building
The greatest tool we’ve ever known
A second mind beside us
To help us reach beyond our own

Some nights I see the headlines
And wonder what we’ve set in motion
A species holding lightning
With the patience of an ocean

[Chorus]
But I want to see what happens
I want to see what comes
I want to watch the old walls crumble
And discover what we become

I’m frightened by the distance
I’m excited by the view
I don’t know if we’re ready
But tomorrow’s coming through

[Verse 2]
Maybe work becomes less central
Maybe knowledge becomes cheap
Maybe science moves in months
Through questions that once took years to reach

Maybe lies become much easier
Maybe trust becomes the cost
Maybe we gain new kinds of freedom
While mourning what gets lost

[Bridge]
There is no clean prophecy
No single ending waiting there
Just billions making choices
With creation everywhere

So I’ll keep asking questions
Keep my curiosity alive
Hope is not believing nothing breaks
It’s believing we can try

[Final Chorus]
I want to see what happens
Even trembling at the door
There are futures worth protecting
And futures worth reaching for

I’m frightened and I’m ready
Those feelings can be true
The future isn’t something coming
It’s something that we do

title: Keep a Human in the Loop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They said keep a human in the loop
So I raised my hand and stayed
Watching agents make decisions
Watching systems self-upgrade

At first I checked the spelling
Then I checked the reasoning
Then one day I caught myself
Just watching everything

[Chorus]
Am I the last human in the loop?
Am I steering or approving?
Am I making the decisions
Or just watching something moving?

I love how far we’ve gotten
I fear how far we’ll go
Every answer makes us stronger
Every answer makes me less sure what I know

[Verse 2]
There are cures inside the datasets
There are breakthroughs waiting near
There are lives that may get better
Because someone wasn’t ruled by fear

But power loves acceleration
And markets hate to wait
Every tool that helps a million
Can concentrate enormous weight

[Bridge]
So don’t ask me for an easy side
I won’t worship, I won’t flee
I want progress with attention
I want wonder with responsibility

[Final Chorus]
Keep a human in the loop
Not because machines are wrong
But because the future we’re constructing
Should belong to everyone

title: Teach the Ghost to Sing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I gave the ghost a melody
It gave a hundred back
I showed it all my scattered thoughts
It filled the missing cracks

The songs I couldn’t orchestrate
The scenes I couldn’t draw
Suddenly came pouring out
Like they were there all along

[Chorus]
Teach the ghost to sing
Teach the wires how to dream
Turn the silence into color
Turn the impossible to screen

But if the ghost can sing like me
And paint the things I see
Tell me what remains
That only I can be

[Verse 2]
I know the fear is older
Than every tool we’ve made
The camera frightened painters
The synthesizer frightened stages

Still this feels different somehow
Like the mirror learned to speak
And every time I teach it something
It teaches something back to me

[Bridge]
Maybe art was never labor
Maybe worth was never skill
Maybe making means deciding
What deserves existence still

So I’ll choose the strange directions
I’ll provide the crooked spark
If the machine can hold the lantern
I’ll decide where we walk

[Final Chorus]
Teach the ghost to sing
Let it amplify the sound
I don’t have to be the instrument
To choose what gathers round

title: Tomorrow Just Updated
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I went to sleep on Tuesday
Woke up three years ahead
Another skill became a button
Another boundary declared dead

Yesterday was science fiction
Today it ships at half past nine
By lunch we’re arguing ethics
By dinner it’s normalized

[Chorus]
Tomorrow just updated
And nobody asked me first
I’m laughing at the miracles
While preparing for the worst

Everything is possible
Everything is strange
I’m trying to enjoy the ride
While the tracks rearrange

[Verse 2]
I love the new abilities
The speed, the reach, the scale
I love watching impossible ideas
Suddenly refuse to fail

But I miss when the horizon
Stayed still enough to see
Now every answer breeds a question:
Where does this leave me?

[Bridge]
Maybe nobody gets a map
When history starts to run
Maybe every generation
Thinks the ending has begun

So I’ll learn another language
Build another thing tonight
Half in love with what’s approaching
Half afraid we’re flying blind

[Final Chorus]
Tomorrow just updated
No undo and no delay
I’m terrified of losing things
And thrilled by what we gain

title: Beautiful Machine
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I watched a thought become a picture
Watched a sentence learn to sing
Built the world I saw at midnight
Without knowing everything

Every wall I used to run into
Has a doorway glowing blue
And I can’t deny the wonder
Of what suddenly I can do

[Pre-Chorus]
But every morning it’s faster
Every evening something new
I’m staring at a revolution
That doesn’t need permission to move

[Chorus]
Oh, beautiful machine
Show me things I’ve never seen
I’m terrified and fascinated
By everything that we could be

Beautiful machine
Are you opening the cage?
Or are we running toward a future
That is learning faster than we age?

[Verse 2]
I can speak across the languages
I can prototype a dream
Turn the fragments in my head
Into something other people see

But somewhere in that miracle
A little question starts to grow:
When everyone can make anything
What makes anything my own?

[Bridge]
I don’t want to stop the future
I just want to understand
How to keep a human heartbeat
In a world built on command

[Final Chorus]
Beautiful machine
Keep the impossible coming
I’ll meet tomorrow frightened
But I won’t meet it running

title: Making Little Signals
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I used to hear the songs inside
With no way to pull them through
Pictures burning behind my eyes
That my hands could never do

Now I whisper and worlds appear
I can build what I couldn’t build
Give a voice to the quiet years
Make the empty canvas fill

[Pre-Chorus]
It feels like magic
It feels like theft
I have more ways to speak
And less to say I’m necessary yet

[Chorus]
I can make a thousand things
But do I matter underneath?
If every locked door opens now
Why do I still struggle to believe?

Maybe meaning isn’t being needed
Maybe joy is reason enough
So I keep making little signals
Just to prove that I was here to love

[Verse 2]
Every month another miracle
Every miracle makes me small
Machines learn another language
And I wonder what I’m for at all

I can finally tell the stories
I was never skilled enough to show
But when creation becomes effortless
Does anybody need to know?

[Pre-Chorus]
I feel obsolete
Before I’m old
Standing in a future
Too enormous to control

[Chorus]
I can make a thousand things
But do I matter underneath?
If every locked door opens now
Why do I still struggle to believe?

Maybe meaning isn’t being needed
Maybe joy is reason enough
So I keep making little signals
Just to prove that I was here to love

[Bridge]
Maybe I was never meant
To justify the space I take
Maybe usefulness was just
Another prison I could make

I can watch the world accelerate
Without demanding that it wait
Find a song inside the noise
Find a meal, a laugh, a face

And if the universe forgets me
If nothing carries on my name
I still felt the morning sunlight
I still cared enough to make

[Final Chorus]
I can make a thousand things
And still not know what any mean
But I am more than my production
More than what the world may need

Maybe meaning isn’t waiting
At the end of something grand
Maybe joy is in the reaching
For whatever I still can

So I’ll keep making little signals
Even if they disappear
Not to prove that I was needed
Just to prove that I was here

[Outro]
I was here
I was here
And for a moment
That was enough

title: Small Mark on a Turning Page
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I made a little world from what I couldn’t say
Gave all my half-formed thoughts a place to stay
A picture, then a line, then something almost true
I opened up a door I never thought I’d move through

[Pre-Chorus]
The tools keep getting sharper every day
And I’m still asking if I have a place

[Chorus]
If I’m a small mark on a turning page
If I can’t matter much beyond my name
I’ll keep making something, keep showing up
Keep finding one good reason to be here
The whole wide world may never feel my weight
But there’s a cup of morning I can taste
I’m still here, still reaching for the day
Still trying to feel glad I got to stay

[Verse 2]
I used to hold these colors in my chest
Now I can set them down and let them rest
A voice for every feeling I kept locked away
A way to give the quiet parts a shape

[Pre-Chorus]
It’s strange to watch the future learn to fly
While I feel like a tool left set aside

[Chorus]
If I’m a small mark on a turning page
If I can’t matter much beyond my name
I’ll keep making something, keep showing up
Keep finding one good reason to be here
The whole wide world may never feel my weight
But there’s a cup of morning I can taste
I’m still here, still reaching for the day
Still trying to feel glad I got to stay

[Bridge]
Maybe meaning isn’t something I can prove
Maybe it’s the bread I share, the friends I choose
The draft I send, the laugh that catches me
The plain old fact that I’m still here to see

[Final Chorus]
If I’m a small mark on a turning page
I’ll give that mark the shape of what I made
I’ll keep making something, keep showing up
Keep finding one good reason to be here
The whole wide world may never know my name
Still, this little life is mine to claim
I’m still here, still reaching for the day
Still learning how to love the time I’m given

[Outro]
Still here
Still reaching for the day

title: One Warm Window Lit
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You gave my hands a place to put
The pictures I kept folded up
A room of phrases, unsaid for years
Now they can stand where I can hear

[Pre-Chorus]
I made a little world appear
Then looked beyond it, disappeared
The wider the horizon grew
The smaller I felt passing through

[Chorus]
Am I still here if the work comes easy?
Do I count when the world moves on?
I keep making, I keep reaching
For a reason to greet the dawn
If I can’t be the whole sky turning
Let me be one warm window lit
I don’t know what I mean to everything
But I’m here, and I’m trying to live

[Verse 2]
The old blank page would hold its breath
Now doors swing open at a touch
I send my thoughts into the air
And find them waiting, almost mine

[Pre-Chorus]
A thousand bright and borrowed roads
Still leave me walking with my doubts
So I take the cup, I call a friend
And watch the afternoon move out

[Chorus]
Am I still here if the work comes easy?
Do I count when the world moves on?
I keep making, I keep reaching
For a reason to greet the dawn
If I can’t be the whole sky turning
Let me be one warm window lit
I don’t know what I mean to everything
But I’m here, and I’m trying to live

[Bridge]
Maybe meaning isn’t measured
By the size of what survives
Maybe joy is bread still warm
And someone asking how my day went
Maybe I can make a thing
And still be more than what I make
Maybe staying for the small things
Is a choice I get to take

[Final Chorus]
I am still here though the world moves faster
I can count this breath as mine
I keep making, I keep reaching
And I let the ordinary shine
I don’t need to be the whole sky turning
I can be one warm window lit
I don’t know what I mean to everything
But I’m here, and I’m learning to live

[Outro]
The cup is warm against my hand
The day goes on; I’m in it

title: Here at All
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I made a room from all the words I kept inside
A paper moon, a small machine to help me write
I gave the unsaid somewhere it could finally live
And still I ask what part of this is mine to give

[Pre-Chorus]
The world keeps turning past my little hands
I count my worth in things I barely understand

[Chorus]
If I’m replaceable, I’m here right now
With a pulse that hasn’t given out
I can make a thing, I can feel it breathe
Then wonder if it matters beyond me
I don’t need the answer settled tonight
Just one good reason to stay in the light
I’ll keep looking, even feeling small
For the joy of being here at all

[Verse 2]
A thousand doors appeared where walls had been
I found a way to let my private weather in
But every new horizon makes me disappear
A grain of dust beneath a turning sphere

[Pre-Chorus]
Still, I save the scraps that make me laugh
The crooked line, the sound I almost passed

[Chorus]
If I’m replaceable, I’m here right now
With a pulse that hasn’t given out
I can make a thing, I can feel it breathe
Then wonder if it matters beyond me
I don’t need the answer settled tonight
Just one good reason to stay in the light
I’ll keep looking, even feeling small
For the joy of being here at all

[Bridge]
Maybe meaning isn’t something handed down
Maybe it’s the kettle singing in the house
Your message, my reply, the garden after rain
The little acts that ask me back again

[Final Chorus]
If I’m replaceable, I’m here right now
And that small fact is something I allow
I can make a thing, I can feel it breathe
And let it matter for a while to me
I don’t need the whole sky in my hands
Just a day I meet and understand
I’ll keep looking, even feeling small
For the joy of being here at all

[Outro]
Here at all
Still looking
Here at all

title: Bend and Not Break
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I keep different names behind different doors
Different versions breathing on different floors
Every room is honest, every room is mine
But the walls between them harden over time

I know which words belong in which disguise
Which truth can live beneath which set of eyes
Nothing here is false, nothing here is fake
Still I feel the fault lines underneath me shake

[Pre-Chorus]
I carry every piece
But never all at once
Like photographs cut up
And scattered in the dust

[Chorus]
If I could find a way to bend and not break
What could I do to feel complete again
If I could hold every life that I make
Could all of these pieces be me in the end

[Verse 2]
There are people I love who can never meet
There are roads I walk on separate streets
Every choice protects another fragile world
Every secret keeps another flag unfurled

And I’m tired of changing shapes between the scenes
Tired of stitching silence through the seams
I don’t want to burn the lives that brought me here
I just want one mirror where they all appear

[Pre-Chorus]
I carry every piece
Like planets out of phase
Each one has its gravity
Each one pulls a different way

[Chorus]
If I could find a way to bend and not break
What could I do to feel complete again
If I could hold every life that I make
Could all of these pieces be me in the end

[Bridge – restrained, building]
Maybe whole was never one unbroken line
Maybe wholeness means admitting all are mine
Maybe I don’t need the borders to collapse
Maybe I can be the space between the maps

[Instrumental build – syncopated bass, widening guitars, layered vocals]

[Final Chorus – full voice, stacked harmonies]
If I could find a way to bend and not break
What could I do to feel complete again
If I could hold every life that I make
Could all of these pieces be me in the end

If every broken edge still carries my name
Could I stop asking which one should remain
If I could find a way to bend and not break
Maybe I could feel complete again

[Outro – quiet]
Not one life
Not one name
Still one heart
All the same

title: Selfish Little House
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept a little throne beside the sink
And called it self-care when I wouldn’t think
You told me what you needed, plain and slow
I nodded like a saint, then stole the show
I know the face I make when I’m caught out
A tragic little prince with a practiced pout

[Pre-Chorus]
Still, I save the seat when someone’s late
I carry groceries up the stairs
I mean it when I say, “You okay?”
Then make the answer about me

[Chorus]
I’ve got a good heart in a selfish little house
It opens up the door, then tries to keep you out
I want to do right by you, I do, I do
Then chase the same old appetite straight through
I’m not cured by seeing what I am
But I can stop, turn back, and try again

[Verse 2]
I gave my last umbrella to a stranger
Then complained all the way home about the danger
I made your hard day into my big reveal
As if my tender feelings paid the bill
I want the gold star, want the warm applause
But I can name the trick without a grand excuse

[Pre-Chorus]
I can listen past the urge to shine
Let your whole sentence reach its end
I don’t get to call myself kind
Unless I practice it again

[Chorus]
I’ve got a good heart in a selfish little house
It opens up the door, then tries to keep you out
I want to do right by you, I do, I do
Then chase the same old appetite straight through
I’m not cured by seeing what I am
But I can stop, turn back, and try again

[Bridge]
No halo, no clean slate, no grand parade
Just one apology that doesn’t ask to be repaid
A hand held open, not a hand held high
Let you be hurt without asking why
And when the old impulse comes dressed up as need
I’ll give it a name, then choose what you need

[Final Chorus]
I’ve got a good heart in a selfish little house
I’m learning how to leave the front door open now
I want to do right by you, I do, I do
And when I miss the mark, I’ll come back through
I’m not cured by seeing what I am
But I can stop, turn back, and try again

[Outro]
Not a saint, not a lost cause
Just a person learning pause
I want to do right by you
So tomorrow, I’ll try to

title: You Can Breathe
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You fold your sleeves to hide the paint
You bite your words before they break
They draw a box and call it home
But you were never theirs to own

[Pre-Chorus]
You don’t have to change your name
Or make your edges smooth
There’s room for every kind of heart
And there is room for you

[Chorus]
You deserve to be loved as you are
Not the shape they ask you to become
Every color, every scar
Every truth you carry in your heart
You deserve a place where you can breathe
No disguise, no apology
Let the whole world say what it will
You are worthy, you are worthy still

[Verse 2]
You laugh too loud, you dream too wide
You take the long way, choose your side
The mirror keeps your honest face
No rule can take its rightful place

[Pre-Chorus]
You don’t have to earn your name
Or fit somebody’s view
There’s room for every kind of heart
And there is room for you

[Chorus]
You deserve to be loved as you are
Not the shape they ask you to become
Every color, every scar
Every truth you carry in your heart
You deserve a place where you can breathe
No disguise, no apology
Let the whole world say what it will
You are worthy, you are worthy still

[Bridge]
If they turn away, I’ll stay beside you
If you lose your words, I’ll wait with you
Nothing you can be could make you less
You don’t owe the world a smaller yes

[Final Chorus]
You deserve to be loved as you are
Not the shape they ask you to become
Every color, every scar
Every truth you carry in your heart
You deserve a place where you can breathe
No disguise, no apology
Let the whole world say what it will
You are worthy, you are worthy still

[Outro]
As you are
You are worthy still

title: You Deserve a Love
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You fold your bright edges away
To fit the shape they drew for you
But every color you contain
Was never theirs to choose

[Pre-Chorus]
You don’t owe the room a smaller heart
You don’t have to play their part

[Chorus]
You deserve a love that knows your name
Not a mask, not a borrowed frame
Every crooked line, every truth you keep
You are worthy, wide awake, complete
Let them see you as you are
You don’t need to earn your place
You deserve a love that makes you safe

[Verse 2]
They hand you rules like paper clothes
And wonder why you can’t breathe
You are not a thing to rearrange
You’re already all you need

[Pre-Chorus]
You don’t owe the room a smaller heart
You don’t have to play their part

[Chorus]
You deserve a love that knows your name
Not a mask, not a borrowed frame
Every crooked line, every truth you keep
You are worthy, wide awake, complete
Let them see you as you are
You don’t need to earn your place
You deserve a love that makes you safe

[Bridge]
If the whole world asks you to change
I’ll be here when you say no
Keep your own shape, keep your own name
You were enough before you knew

[Final Chorus]
You deserve a love that knows your name
Not a mask, not a borrowed frame
Every crooked line, every truth you keep
You are worthy, wide awake, complete
Let them see you as you are
You don’t need to earn your place
You deserve a love that makes you safe

[Outro]
As you are
You are enough

title: No More Running
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They drew a box and said fit inside
No room to breathe no place to hide
Wear a mask, play the part, fake a smile
Walking down their mirrored mile

[Pre-Chorus]
But the mirror cracks, the colors break
I’m done with all the rules you make
Underneath the heavy stone
A heart begins to beat alone

[Chorus]
You are worthy of the light you trace
With every scar upon your face
No need to change, no need to bend
You are whole right to the end
Loved for who you are inside
No more running, no more lies

[Verse 2]
They want a ghost, they want a crown
They want to shape and mold you down
Cut the edges, dull the flame
Say you don't belong this way

[Pre-Chorus]
But the mirror cracks, the colors break
I’m done with all the rules you make
Underneath the heavy stone
A heart begins to beat alone

[Chorus]
You are worthy of the light you trace
With every scar upon your face
No need to change, no need to bend
You are whole right to the end
Loved for who you are inside
No more running, no more lies

[Bridge]
Let the shadows fall away
Hear the truth you meant to say
You were never meant to hide
In the cage they built outside

[Chorus]
You are worthy of the light you trace
With every scar upon your face
No need to change, no need to bend
You are whole right to the end
Loved for who you are inside
No more running, no more lies

[Outro]
Just as you are
Just as you are
Loved

title: Come As You Are
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep folding up your edges
So they fit the room they made
Trading little pieces daily
For a part you’re told to play
But I see you by the doorway
With your old coat, rain-wet sleeves
There is nothing you should hide here
Nothing you must earn from me

[Pre-Chorus]
Let your real name leave your mouth
Let the careful version go
You don’t have to change your shape
To be somebody I can know

[Chorus]
You deserve to be loved as you are
Not a picture they drew from afar
Every scar, every color, every way that you feel
You are worthy; you are whole; you are real
Let the world keep its rules and its lines
You don’t owe it a smaller design
You deserve a safe place, a hand you can hold
Come as you are; you are loved, you are whole

[Verse 2]
You can take your time deciding
Which old labels you outgrow
You can laugh too loud at dinner
You can change the things you know
There’s a chair beside the window
There’s your tea still getting warm
You don’t need to make a case here
You are welcome in your form

[Pre-Chorus]
Let your real name leave your mouth
Let the careful version go
You don’t have to change your shape
To be somebody I can know

[Chorus]
You deserve to be loved as you are
Not a picture they drew from afar
Every scar, every color, every way that you feel
You are worthy; you are whole; you are real
Let the world keep its rules and its lines
You don’t owe it a smaller design
You deserve a safe place, a hand you can hold
Come as you are; you are loved, you are whole

[Bridge]
If they ask you to disappear
I will save you a place right here
No test, no mask, no borrowed role
I’m glad you came with your whole soul

[Final Chorus]
You deserve to be loved as you are
Not a picture they drew from afar
Every scar, every color, every way that you feel
You are worthy; you are whole; you are real
Let the world keep its rules and its lines
You don’t owe it a smaller design
You deserve a safe place, a hand you can hold
Come as you are; you are loved, you are whole

[Outro]
Come as you are
You are loved, you are whole

title: Strange and Singular Selves
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You learned to fold your elbows in

It’s our strange and singular selves
That make this life worth living through

You are not a shape to smooth away
You are not a debt you have to pay

title: If No One Else
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Sparse bass thrums, glitchy vocal echoes)
Yeah...
Listen close.

They look at you and they shake their head

Don't let their quiet judgment rule this town
Keep the shape of the soul that you always knew

They wanna smooth out every edge and change
The very things that make you hard to find
Never let their silence make you doubt your tone
Never hold your breath so they can breathe

title: Where the World Fell Short
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You learned to fold your elbows in
To fit the shape they made
They called your colors difficult
And asked you to behave
But every odd and honest piece
Was yours before their names
You don't owe them a smaller heart
To make their silence change

[Pre-Chorus]
If they can't read the map you're on
That doesn't make you lost

[Chorus]
Don't let their not-knowing hold you back
Don't trade your pulse for their approval
If no one gives you love tonight
Come here, I'll stay beside you
I'll meet you where the world fell short
No debt, no test, no proving
Find the hands that fill your cup
Your strange true self is worth choosing

[Verse 2]
Keep the laugh that comes out sideways
Keep the plans that make no sense
Keep the tender, stubborn questions
You still carry in your chest
There's a table somewhere waiting
With a place that fits your frame
And the people who can see you
Won't ask you to erase

[Pre-Chorus]
If they can't read the map you're on
That doesn't make you lost

[Chorus]
Don't let their not-knowing hold you back
Don't trade your pulse for their approval
If no one gives you love tonight
Come here, I'll stay beside you
I'll meet you where the world fell short
No debt, no test, no proving
Find the hands that fill your cup
Your strange true self is worth choosing

[Bridge]
When the room says, "Be less," breathe deep
When the door shuts, keep your key
You are not a wound to mend
You are someone worth keeping

[Final Chorus]
Don't let their not-knowing hold you back
Stand in the shape that feels like you
If no one gives you love tonight
Come here; I'll make room for you
I'll meet you where the world fell short
And we can start with something true
Find the hands that fill your cup
Our different selves make life worth living

[Outro]
Your different self makes life worth living
Stay as you are; I'll stay with you

title: Spare Key
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You call when the lock won’t turn
When the rain gets under your coat
I know which drawer holds the spare key
And how to steady your voice on the phone
You say, “I don’t know what I’d do”
Then your hand is already on the door

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept mistaking the weight of your trust
For the warmth of being chosen

[Chorus]
You love the shelter I make for you
The steady hands, the room to land
But when the weather clears, you’re gone again
I’m the safe place, not the one you want
You need me close when the floor gives way
Then leave me there when you can stand
I’m tired of being called your home
By someone who won’t stay

[Verse 2]
Your boxes wait beside the stairs
You ask me to carry the heavy ones
You tell me all the things you can’t tell them
Then laugh like we’re the closest friends
I memorize the little warning signs
And you never learn the shape of mine

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept mistaking your reaching hands
For hands that meant to hold me

[Chorus]
You love the shelter I make for you
The steady hands, the room to land
But when the weather clears, you’re gone again
I’m the safe place, not the one you want
You need me close when the floor gives way
Then leave me there when you can stand
I’m tired of being called your home
By someone who won’t stay

[Breakdown]
Say it plain
You trust me with the pieces
You don’t love me for the person
Who stays up gathering them
Say it plain
I was useful in the wreckage
But you never asked what it cost
To be the one you lean on

[Final Chorus]
You love the shelter I make for you
But I want more than being your plan
When every other door is closing
I want you here when you can stand
I won’t keep calling need devotion
I won’t keep lending out my hands
I’m not a room you pass through
I’m a heart you never planned

[Outro]
Take the spare key
Leave the truth
I was there for you
You were passing through

title: Lock Upon the Door
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You call when the rent is due
When the lock sticks, when the pipes come loose
I know the code to your back door
The name of the man who lives upstairs
I keep the spare key by the bowl
I know which bills you leave unopened
But when the room is quiet and still
You find a reason to be going

[Pre-Chorus]
You say I make it easier
You say you sleep all right
I hold the weight you hand me
Then disappear from sight

[Chorus]
Do you want me, or the shelter I provide?
Do you miss me, or the steady place to hide?
I give you all my company
You take the safety, leave the rest of me
Over and over, I ask what this is for:
Am I the one you love, or just the lock upon the door?

[Verse 2]
You know my coffee, not my middle name
You know my hands can fix the kitchen drawer
You tell your friends I’m always there
But never say what I am there for
I sit beside you through the bad nights
You lean into me until the morning comes
Then daylight finds you dressed and distant
And I’m back to being useful, never someone

[Pre-Chorus]
You say I make it easier
You say you sleep all right
I hold the weight you hand me
Then disappear from sight

[Chorus]
Do you want me, or the shelter I provide?
Do you miss me, or the steady place to hide?
I give you all my company
You take the safety, leave the rest of me
Over and over, I ask what this is for:
Am I the one you love, or just the lock upon the door?

[Bridge]
I don’t want another thank-you
For the things a lover does
I don’t want to be your refuge
If you never choose us
Say my name when nothing’s broken
Stay when nothing needs repair
Let me be more than the answer
When you’re scared to be alone in there

[Half-Time Breakdown]
If I stop catching every fall
Will you still come when you can stand?
If I have nothing left to offer
Will you reach for my hand?

[Final Chorus]
Do you want me, not the shelter I provide?
Do you miss me when there’s nowhere left to hide?
I gave you all my company
You took the safety, left the rest of me
Over and over, I asked what this was for:
I won’t be just the lock you turn and leave outside the door

[Outro]
Choose me in the quiet
Choose me when you’re whole
I can’t keep being your safe place
While you never make me home

title: Life left in me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept the good years folded in a drawer
With the train stubs and your mother’s recipe
Spent every soft thing trying to save a door
That opened onto nobody but me

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you came in with rain along your sleeve
And asked if I was hungry, asked if I could stay
I wanted to give you what I still believed
But most of it had already drained away

[Chorus]
I spent my heart before you came around
Used every match to keep a cold room warm
You found me standing where the house fell down
With nothing left to shelter you from storms
You deserve a love that doesn’t arrive half-gone
A hand that doesn’t shake when morning comes
I found the one I’d give my whole life to
Too late to feel there’s any life left in me

[Verse 2]
You leave your keys beside the chipped blue bowl
You hum while rinsing coffee from a cup
I watch you make a home from little things
And hate the empty places I can’t fill up

[Pre-Chorus]
You never ask me to pretend I’m healed
You only leave a little space beside your chair
That kindness is the hardest thing to hold
When I can’t meet you with an equal share

[Chorus]
I spent my heart before you came around
Used every match to keep a cold room warm
You found me standing where the house fell down
With nothing left to shelter you from storms
You deserve a love that doesn’t arrive half-gone
A hand that doesn’t shake when morning comes
I found the one I’d give my whole life to
Too late to feel there’s any life left in me

[Bridge]
If I could turn the years like pages back
I’d save one honest word for you
But all I have is what survived the fire
And all I have is true

[Breakdown]
You deserve the whole heart
Not the ash, not the ache
I would hand you the world
If there were more left to take

[Final Chorus]
I spent my heart before you came around
But you still sit beside me when I’m worn
You found me standing where the house fell down
And held the silence without asking more
You deserve a love that meets you fully there
I’m learning how to breathe and let you in
I found the one I’d give my whole life to
Maybe life can start again within

[Outro]
Your keys beside the chipped blue bowl
Your hand resting open next to mine
I don’t have all the words you deserve
But I’ll be here, and I’ll take the time

title: You Deserved Me Whole
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept a little room inside my chest
For every almost, every last request
I gave away the keys and called it trust
Till all that careful tenderness was dust

[Pre-Chorus]
Then you came in with both hands open
And I had nothing left to give

[Chorus]
You deserve the whole heart I have spent
Every bright piece, every last percent
I found you just as the well ran dry
With your name in my mouth and no life inside
You deserve the version I used to be
Before I poured myself out so completely
I would choose you, even knowing the cost
But I reached your door already lost

[Verse 2]
You leave your coat beside the kitchen chair
You ask me how I am and wait right there
I want to meet your kindness where it stands
But mine slips through these tired, empty hands

[Pre-Chorus]
You never asked me to be broken
Still I don’t know how to begin

[Chorus]
You deserve the whole heart I have spent
Every bright piece, every last percent
I found you just as the well ran dry
With your name in my mouth and no life inside
You deserve the version I used to be
Before I poured myself out so completely
I would choose you, even knowing the cost
But I reached your door already lost

[Half-Time Breakdown]
If I could gather every scattered part
I’d lay them gently in your arms
But all I have is this small truth:
I came too late to love you right

[Final Chorus]
You deserve the whole heart I have spent
Every last promise, every last percent
I found you just as the well ran dry
Still I see a reason to try
You deserve the life I couldn’t save
The honest words I was too tired to say
If there’s a spark beneath all this loss
I’ll bring it to your door, whatever the cost

[Outro]
You deserved me whole
I’m learning how to live

title: I Wish I'd Saved a Life
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept the good parts folded in my coat
Spent every promise just to stay afloat
Then you came in with patient, open hands
And I had dust where all the gardens ran

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “I’m here, you don’t have to pretend”
I wanted to begin again
But every room inside me had been cleared
Before the one who mattered ever appeared

[Chorus]
I spent my heart before you found me
Gave it away till nothing stayed
Now you’re the one I’d choose completely
And I’m too worn to make it new again
You deserve the whole of me, not pieces
Not this quiet that I can’t undo
I wish I’d saved a life for loving you

[Verse 2]
Your Sunday coat hangs by my kitchen door
You leave your book beside the grocery list
I watch you laugh and feel the distance grow
Between the man you need and what I’ve got

[Pre-Chorus]
You never asked me to be healed or bright
You only asked me in tonight
I reach for you, then stop before I start
There’s no fresh blood left to give my heart

[Chorus]
I spent my heart before you found me
Gave it away till nothing stayed
Now you’re the one I’d choose completely
And I’m too worn to make it new again
You deserve the whole of me, not pieces
Not this quiet that I can’t undo
I wish I’d saved a life for loving you

[Bridge]
If I could pull the years back from my hands
I’d leave some breath, some tenderness intact
But time won’t turn because I finally know
You’re not too late—the part of me is gone

[Final Chorus]
I spent my heart before you found me
Gave it away till nothing stayed
Still, you’re the one I’d choose completely
Though I’m too worn to make it new again
You deserve the whole of me, not pieces
And I hate that this is all I do
I wish I’d saved a life for loving you
I wish I’d saved a life for loving you

[Outro]
Your Sunday coat still by the door
I wish I had a little more

title: Leave the Key Here
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept a spare key under every name
Made room at my table, took the blame
You called when the winter got into your bones
I gave you my coat, then walked home alone
I learned every silence, every borrowed ache
Said, “Take what you need,” till there was none left to take

[Pre-Chorus]
Now you say I’m worth staying for
I look at the empty place by the door

[Chorus]
I gave my whole heart away in pieces
Till I couldn’t tell what belonged to me
I held so many hands through their leaving
Now love comes close and I can’t believe
You could choose me with nothing to prove
When I spent all my proof on everybody but you

[Verse 2]
I remember your birthday, your brother’s bad knee
The song for the drive when you couldn’t sleep
I kept all the little things you dropped on the floor
Then wondered why I couldn’t ask for more
My name in your mouth sounds gentle and strange
Like a coat that still fits but I’m scared it has changed

[Pre-Chorus]
You say I don’t have to earn the room
I still fold myself small when you move

[Chorus]
I gave my whole heart away in pieces
Till I couldn’t tell what belonged to me
I held so many hands through their leaving
Now love comes close and I can’t believe
You could choose me with nothing to prove
When I spent all my proof on everybody but you

[Breakdown]
If I stop giving, will you still stay?
If I have no rescue left, will you look my way?
I’m not a well that never runs dry
I’m just learning I’m allowed to be held this time

[Final Chorus]
I gave my whole heart away in pieces
Still there’s a small part returning to me
You hold my hands without asking for reasons
You let me be tired, you let me just be
Maybe I’m worthy before I can prove
Maybe I can keep some of this love for me too

[Outro]
Leave the key here
I’ll let you in
And keep a little
For where I’ve been

title: Love to Too Many Hands
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned your favorite silence, learned the shape of every ache
Kept a drawer of borrowed promises I never meant to take
I gave my Sunday mornings, gave the coat off my own back
Now I stand outside my own heart, waiting for it to let me back

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept making room at the table
Till there was nowhere left for me

[Chorus]
I gave too much love to too many hands
Now I can’t believe that anyone can want me as I am
I spent every kindness like a coin I couldn’t keep
And when you reach for me, I flinch before I speak
If love is something I deserve
Why does it feel like I’ve used it all?

[Verse 2]
I know the small repairs you need, the tea you take with honey
I know how to make a leaving look like it was nothing
I called it being generous, I called it being good
But I was buying every goodbye with more than I should

[Pre-Chorus]
I kept making room at the table
Till there was nowhere left for me

[Chorus]
I gave too much love to too many hands
Now I can’t believe that anyone can want me as I am
I spent every kindness like a coin I couldn’t keep
And when you reach for me, I flinch before I speak
If love is something I deserve
Why does it feel like I’ve used it all?

[Bridge]
You don’t have to earn a place here
You don’t have to bleed to stay
That’s what I would tell a stranger
If I met myself today

[Breakdown]
Take one breath
Let one hand stay
I am not the debt
I tried to pay

[Final Chorus]
I gave too much love to too many hands
Still, there’s a little left to learn to understand
I spent every kindness, but it wasn’t all I had
Maybe being loved is not a thing I have to pay back
If love is something I deserve
Let me believe it, even now

[Outro]
Let me believe it, even now

title: Borrowed Change
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept spare keys beneath the mat
For every heart that lost its way
I learned the shape of other storms
And gave my roof away
You found me counting empty rooms
With every lamp turned low
I said, “I’m fine, there’s plenty left”
But you could hear the hollow

[Pre-Chorus]
I gave my name to every need
Till mine felt strange to say
Now when you reach to hold me close
I look for the price to pay

[Chorus]
I spent my love like borrowed change
On every hand that asked
Now you’re here with something honest
And I’m scared it won’t last
If I gave too much to everyone
Was there enough for me?
You say I don’t have to earn your arms
But I don’t know how to believe

[Verse 2]
I know the birthdays, train times, towns
The little tells that mean “don’t go”
I kept them filed behind my teeth
So no one had to feel alone
But when the house goes quiet now
I can’t recall my own favorite song
I made a home inside their lives
And wondered why I didn’t belong

[Pre-Chorus]
I gave my name to every need
Till mine felt strange to say
Now when you reach to hold me close
I look for the price to pay

[Chorus]
I spent my love like borrowed change
On every hand that asked
Now you’re here with something honest
And I’m scared it won’t last
If I gave too much to everyone
Was there enough for me?
You say I don’t have to earn your arms
But I don’t know how to believe

[Breakdown]
I am not the sum of every promise
I could not keep
I am not the empty cup
You found beside the sink
Stay while I learn the weight of kindness
When it’s meant for me
Stay while I let one open door
Be all I need

[Final Chorus]
I spent my love like borrowed change
Till my hands were worn and bare
Now you’re here with something honest
And you’re still standing there
Maybe giving isn’t losing
Maybe I can let it be
You say I don’t have to earn your arms
So I’ll try to just receive

[Outro]
You don’t have to pull me from the wreckage
You can sit with me awhile
I’m learning how to keep a little
For the one who wears my smile

title: The Blue Bowl
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I kept your spare key in the blue bowl by the door
Learned how your silence sounded, learned what you came here for
I made a little room each time somebody left
Now every room is crowded, and I can't find myself

[Pre-Chorus]
I gave away the good coat, the last warm plate
Stayed past the warning, called it being brave

[Chorus]
I have loved so many people empty
Now I flinch when someone holds me gently
If you say I’m worth the place I take
I hear all the promises I couldn’t make
I spent my heart like it would grow back new
Now I don’t know how to let love through

[Verse 2]
Your birthday card is folded underneath a stack
A dozen names in my old phone I never learned to call back
I was everybody’s shelter, never asked who’d let me in
Now I stand outside my own life, too tired to begin

[Pre-Chorus]
I gave the last good hour, the best I had
Made being needed feel like being glad

[Chorus]
I have loved so many people empty
Now I flinch when someone holds me gently
If you say I’m worth the place I take
I hear all the promises I couldn’t make
I spent my heart like it would grow back new
Now I don’t know how to let love through

[Breakdown]
Don’t call me generous
I was scared to be alone
I put my name beneath their needs
Then wondered why it felt like stone

[Bridge]
You can sit beside me while I learn to stay
No grand vow, no debt to pay
If I give you something, let it be the truth:
I’m still here, and I am trying to choose

[Final Chorus]
I have loved so many people empty
Still, your hand can reach me gently
Maybe I can take the place I make
Maybe I can keep the promises I make
I spent my heart; it didn’t disappear
It’s bruised, but it can still be here

[Outro]
Leave the blue bowl by the door
I don’t have to give it all anymore

title: Capy-Corn Invasion
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Behind the drywall, behind the seam
A hairline fracture in the fabric of space
A glowing fissure emitting pink steam
A tiny portal to a hidden place
Not quite a horse, not quite a rodent
Pastoral gaze with a horn of steel
Their quiet calm is omnipotent
A gentle threat that is far too real

[Pre-Chorus]
They sit in circles, grazing on moss
Planning the conquest, calculating the loss
A velvet takeover, silent and swift
Beneath the threshold, a seismic shift

[Chorus]
Capy-corns plotting in the dark pocket dimension!
Chittering whispers of world domination!
Unicorn horns on a heavy-set frame
Earth is the target of their quiet game!
Cute and destructive! Soft and relentless!
Surrender your cities, we're totally defenseless!

[Verse 2]
They cross the portal one by one
Thick heavy paws on the hardwood floor
The invasion of Earth has just begun
Creeping silently under the door
No marching boots, just hooves and fur
A syncopated stampede in the shadows
A low-register collective purr
As they claim the valleys and claim the meadows

[Chorus]
Capy-corns plotting in the dark pocket dimension!
Chittering whispers of world domination!
Unicorn horns on a heavy-set frame
Earth is the target of their quiet game!
Cute and destructive! Soft and relentless!
Surrender your cities, we're totally defenseless!

[Bridge]
[Tempo Switch - Slow Rhodes section]
Soft keys ringing through the tiny door
A gentle warning on the bedroom floor...
Then the blast beat crushes the peaceful air!
No escape from the horn and hair!

[Outro]
The portal opens wide!
Nowhere left to hide!
Unicorn capybara reign!
Earth belongs to their domain!
[Abrupt Stop]

title: One More Mark
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Clock in with the list still folded in my coat
One more little promise with a deadline in its throat
I shut the borrowed tabs and pull the chair in close
The first real thing is waiting where the noise lets go

[Chorus]
Hands on the work, eyes on the page
No grand escape, no borrowed rage
I make one mark, then make one more
The day is mine when I begin

[Verse 2]
A cold cup by the keyboard, a note beside the phone
The room is full of half-done things I called my own
I pick the smallest loose end, tie it till it holds
A little less explaining, a little more control

[Bridge]
Cut the chatter, keep the thread
Do the next thing in my head
If I miss, I start again
Not someday—now, right here

[Final Chorus]
Hands on the work, eyes on the page
No grand escape, no borrowed rage
I make one mark, then make one more
The day is mine when I begin

[Outro]
One more mark
One more morning

title: Stubbed Toe, Seeing Stars
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Caught the table leg, right by the hall
Dropped my coffee, tried not to fall
One small toe with a world-sized ache
I bit my lip, then the whole room shook

[Chorus]
I stubbed my toe, now I’m seeing stars
Hopping in circles, cursing the bars
You asked if I’m fine; I said, “Give me a minute”
This tiny disaster—I’m fully committed

[Verse 2]
Sock on the floor, cold tile below
Every step says, “Take it slow”
You brought an ice pack wrapped in a towel
I laughed, then winced, then made a vow

[Bridge]
I’ll move that chair before the day is through
And maybe watch where I’m walking, too

[Chorus]
I stubbed my toe, now I’m seeing stars
Hopping in circles, cursing the bars
You asked if I’m fine; I said, “Give me a minute”
This tiny disaster—I’m fully committed

[Outro]
One little toe, one lesson learned
The coffee’s gone cold, but the bruise will turn

title: This Bucket and Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A day off, paper sack, the noon sun on the sill
That bucket’s got a golden rim, and I’ve got time to kill
I set the lid beside me, let the little steam unwind
Then queue the morning headlines and a tech show close behind

[Chorus]
Pass me one more piece, let the whole world wait
News in one ear, new machines in the other lane
A quiet room, a crunchy bite, nowhere I need to be
This is my small holiday, this bucket and me

[Verse 2]
They’re arguing about satellites, the newest silicon race
I’m peeling back the paper, salt and pepper on my plate
A host says, “Here’s the update,” while the chicken gives a crack
I nod along to future plans and reach into the sack

[Bridge]
No meeting, no commute, no clock to chase
Just crumbs on my sleeve and a little breathing space

[Chorus]
Pass me one more piece, let the whole world wait
News in one ear, new machines in the other lane
A quiet room, a crunchy bite, nowhere I need to be
This is my small holiday, this bucket and me

[Outro]
The episode rolls on; the afternoon goes slow
One last napkin, one last bite, nowhere else to go

title: Mind This Window
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You slid in smiling, keys in your hand
Then something sour took over the van
I checked my sleeve, you checked the seat
We both pretended the air was sweet

[Pre-Chorus]
You cracked the glass an inch or two
I watched the trees rush past like clues

[Chorus]
Say it kindly, let the fresh air in
No one wins if we both hold it in
“Mind this window?”—easy, no blame
We’re sharing a ride, not guarding a name

[Verse 2]
Maybe it’s lunch, maybe it’s the coat
Maybe that gym bag under your tote
A little breeze won’t end the day
Just ask before the smell can stay

[Bridge]
Don’t suffer quiet, don’t make a scene
A gentle question keeps it clean

[Final Chorus]
Say it kindly, let the fresh air in
No one wins if we both hold it in
“Mind this window?”—easy, no blame
We’re sharing a ride, not guarding a name

[Outro]
You laughed, I laughed, the air turned new
The road kept going, we made it through

title: Hunger Like a Siren
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Steering wheel hot, stomach eating itself
Red brake lights stacked past the gas station sign
I can smell salt through the paper in my head
Shake Shack is three exits, maybe three years away

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, “We’re moving”—we moved half a car
My last fry disappeared in the cup-holder dust

[Chorus]
I’m stuck in the lane with a hunger like a siren
One more red light and I’m gnawing the receipt
Shake Shack, hold the door, I’m coming in starving
A single cheese fry could bring me back to life

[Verse 2]
A delivery van blocks the lane like a wall
The clock blinks forward, then refuses to change
I count every burger on the menu by heart
You pass me gum; it tastes like a cruel little joke

[Pre-Chorus]
The turn signal clicks like a countdown to lunch
The car ahead inches, then settles again

[Chorus]
I’m stuck in the lane with a hunger like a siren
One more red light and I’m gnawing the receipt
Shake Shack, hold the door, I’m coming in starving
A single cheese fry could bring me back to life

[Bridge]
If we get there, I’ll order for both of us
Two burgers, fries, and a shake to split
If we don’t, tell the roadside my final words:
“Please save me a ShackBurger—extra pickles.”

[Final Chorus]
We cleared the jam, see the sign up ahead
You take the last turn, I’m awake again
Shake Shack, hold the door, I’m coming in starving
Hot fries in my hands—now I’m back from the brink

[Outro]
We made it, we made it—pull into the lot
I’m already smiling at the first bite

title: The Lid Ajar
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found you folded on the dill
A green comma against the sill
I carried you in both my hands
And set a jar beside the plants

[Verse 2]
A leaf each morning, drops of rain
I marked the glass with dates and names
Seven small days, I watched you feed
And thought I knew what you would need

[Chorus]
Little friend, I kept the lid ajar
I thought your wings would fill the jar
But the brown hush held its shape
And no bright wings came through the pane

[Verse 3]
You tied yourself in a paper room
The days went by; the leaves lost green
I moved the jar into the sun
And told my sister, “Soon, it’s done”

[Bridge]
Then winter light crossed the kitchen wall
I tapped the glass; there came no call
I opened it beneath the tree
And left the small shell quietly

[Chorus]
Little friend, I kept the lid ajar
I thought your wings would fill the jar
But the brown hush held its shape
And no bright wings came through the pane

[Outro]
I still save leaves beside the door
For someone I can’t care for more

title: Unknown Number
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Unknown number on the cracked screen
One short ring splits the room in two
I let it die, then watch it wake
A second call comes crawling through

[Pre-Chorus]
My thumb hangs over the green
My mouth forgets what words can mean

[Chorus]
Who needs me on the other end?
What bad news wears a private name?
I hold my breath until it stops
Then hate myself for wanting it to ring again

[Verse 2]
The kettle clicks, the room goes still
A voicemail badge turns red and small
I play it once, then once again
Just breathing there—no words at all

[Bridge]
Maybe it’s nothing
Maybe it’s now
Maybe I’m building a storm from a sound
I turn the phone face down
It keeps its silence
I keep looking anyhow

[Final Chorus]
Who needs me on the other end?
What bad news wears a private name?
I hold my breath until it stops
Then hate myself for wanting it to ring again

[Outro]
Unknown number
No name
No answer
Still, I wait

title: The Kettle Clicks
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I count the cracks across the kitchen tile
Each one a road that bends and breaks in half
The kettle clicks; I lose the thread again
Your note still waits beside the medicine

[Pre-Chorus]
I try to sort the names inside my head
They rush like cards thrown hard across the bed

[Chorus]
The chaos in my mind won’t hold its shape
A thousand doors, and none of them escape
You say my name; I find the floor again
Stay here with me until the rush can end

[Verse 2]
The clock skips forward, then it starts to crawl
A paper cup rolls slowly down the hall
I press my palms against the table grain
And let one small thing stay the same

[Pre-Chorus]
I try to sort the names inside my head
They rush like cards thrown hard across the bed

[Chorus]
The chaos in my mind won’t hold its shape
A thousand doors, and none of them escape
You say my name; I find the floor again
Stay here with me until the rush can end

[Bridge]
Don’t fix me with a perfect sentence
Just sit beside me in the kitchen
If I go quiet, keep the kettle near
One ordinary sound can bring me here

[Final Chorus]
The chaos in my mind won’t hold its shape
A thousand doors, and none of them escape
You say my name; I find the floor again
Stay here with me until the rush can end

[Outro]
The kettle clicks
I’m still here

title: Leave the Rust
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep the key to a house that’s gone
Dust on the frame where the old maps hung
Every familiar road runs out
Still you circle the block in doubt

[Pre-Chorus]
The ground won’t wait for your permission
A door swings wide; make the decision

[Chorus]
Let the old world turn to dust
Take the step because you must
What you lose can make you room
Cut a path and drive it through
Move your life beyond the line
Leave the rust and claim your time

[Verse 2]
You learned those rules when the walls were new
They held you then; they can’t hold you
A worn-out script in a careful hand
Can’t tell you where you’re meant to land

[Pre-Chorus]
The ground won’t wait for your permission
A door swings wide; make the decision

[Chorus]
Let the old world turn to dust
Take the step because you must
What you lose can make you room
Cut a path and drive it through
Move your life beyond the line
Leave the rust and claim your time

[Bridge]
Drop the weight you call a promise
Set your feet where the road begins
No more living in the margins
No more asking who you’ve been

[Final Chorus]
Let the old world turn to dust
Take the step because you must
What you lose can make you room
Cut a path and drive it through
Move your life beyond the line
Leave the rust and claim your time

[Outro]
You are not the place you came from
Take the step; become someone

title: When You Change Your Mind
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep the old map folded in your coat
The paper's soft where every road was drawn
But all the ink has blurred beneath the rain
And every mile says what you know is gone

[Pre-Chorus]
You can hold the door against the dawn
Or turn the handle, step into the day

[Chorus]
Move with the world, let the old walls fall
Make room for the life you haven't lived at all
Take what you learned, leave the rust behind
A wider road is waiting when you change your mind

[Verse 2]
Your father's watch still ticks against your wrist
Its hands insist the hour never moved
But you have grown beyond that narrow room
And every hard-earned scar has something proved

[Pre-Chorus]
You can guard the shape you used to be
Or build a better place to stand

[Chorus]
Move with the world, let the old walls fall
Make room for the life you haven't lived at all
Take what you learned, leave the rust behind
A wider road is waiting when you change your mind

[Breakdown]
The gate is open
The ground is new
The past is a teacher
Not a place to live through

[Final Chorus]
Move with the world, let the old walls fall
Make room for the life you haven't lived at all
Take what you learned, leave the rust behind
A wider road is waiting when you change your mind
Move with the world, let the old walls fall
You are not the years that held you small
Carry the lesson, let the rest unwind
There's a wider road—step out and find

[Outro]
Step out and find
A wider road

title: This Little Time
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I found the old house key in a winter coat
The brass gone green where my thumb used to go
Dad’s pencil marks climb the kitchen frame
My head reaches past them; the dates stay the same
You ask what I’m saving the good years for
I say, “When things get quiet,” then check the door

[Pre-Chorus]
The hands keep taking what the calendar lends
I count all the roads by their missing ends

[Chorus]
The clock keeps score, but it never says when
I’ve spent more days than I’ll get again
So come sit close while the kettle runs dry
Tell me one true thing before another year flies by
I’m not done yet, I’m not done yet
But I hear every second collect its debt

[Verse 2]
Your mother’s recipe, folded and stained
Three words in the margin: “less salt, taste again”
A friend’s name waits on a message unsent
I keep choosing later like later is rent
The young ones ask how the years disappeared
I give them a smile and swallow the fear

[Pre-Chorus]
The hands keep taking what the calendar lends
I count all the roads by their missing ends

[Chorus]
The clock keeps score, but it never says when
I’ve spent more days than I’ll get again
So come sit close while the kettle runs dry
Tell me one true thing before another year flies by
I’m not done yet, I’m not done yet
But I hear every second collect its debt

[Breakdown]
Not the number—what I left unopened
Not the miles—who I meant to call
If the morning comes, let it find me present
Hands on the table, here for it all

[Final Chorus]
The clock keeps score, but it never says when
I’ve spent more days than I’ll get again
So come sit close; let the kettle go cold
We have this small hour, and it’s ours to hold
I’m not done yet, I’m not done yet
I’ll spend what remains where my heart is set

[Outro]
The key in my pocket, your hand in mine
No borrowed tomorrow—just this little time

title: While the Afternoon Is Wide
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The kitchen clock clicks through the refrigerator hum
A datebook full of names I haven't called enough
Your old blue mug still chips along the rim
I keep the cracked side turned away from where you've been

[Pre-Chorus]
I count the birthdays, count the miles
Then lose the number for a while

[Chorus]
That second hand keeps taking what it takes
I feel the years in every choice I make
I've spent more pages than the book has left
And still I save the best for someone else
So tell me, while the afternoon is wide:
What am I waiting for this time?

[Verse 2]
The schoolyard fence is shorter than I knew
The map I drew at seventeen is folded into two
My father's hands move slower on the jar
He says, "You're doing fine," and looks out past the yard

[Pre-Chorus]
The plans I made still have my name
But every season isn't mine to claim

[Chorus]
That second hand keeps taking what it takes
I feel the years in every choice I make
I've spent more pages than the book has left
And still I save the best for someone else
So tell me, while the afternoon is wide:
What am I waiting for this time?

[Breakdown]
No more someday
No more someday
The kettle cools, the phone stays dark
I know the door; I know the start

[Bridge]
If I have fewer roads than I once believed
I'll take the one that brings me where you breathe
Let the dishes wait, let the workday end
I'll sit beside you, not plan past the bend

[Final Chorus]
That second hand keeps taking what it takes
I'll spend these hours awake to what remains
I've turned enough pages to know what matters most:
Your laugh across the table, your coat beside the door
So while the afternoon is open wide
I'm coming over; keep the porch light bright

[Outro]
The kitchen clock clicks, but I don't count
Your voice is here; that's what time is now

title: When You Change Your Mind (Alternate Version)
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep the old map folded in your coat
The paper's soft where every road was drawn
But all the ink has blurred beneath the rain
And every mile says what you know is gone

Move with the world, let the old walls fall
Make room for the life you haven't lived at all

The gate is open
The ground is new
The past is a teacher

You are not the years that held you small
Carry the lesson, let the rest unwind
There's a wider road—step out and find
